Description: Tests how CloudWatch alarm TreatMissingData settings (notBreaching, breaching, missing) affect alarm state transitions using a nonexistent AWS/NetworkELB metric with actions disabled.

Resources:
  AlwaysOKAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: AlwaysOKAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Missing data treated as notBreaching; expected to transition to OK.
      Namespace: AWS/NetworkELB
      MetricName: AlwaysOK
      Statistic: Minimum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  AlwaysFAILAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: AlwaysFAILAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Missing data treated as breaching; expected to transition to ALARM.
      Namespace: AWS/NetworkELB
      MetricName: AlwaysOK
      Statistic: Minimum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  AlwaysINSUFFICIENTAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: AlwaysINSUFFICIENTAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Missing data treated as missing; expected to remain in INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
      Namespace: AWS/NetworkELB
      MetricName: AlwaysOK
      Statistic: Minimum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ActionsEnabled: false

    Value: !Ref AlwaysOKAlarm
  AlwaysOKAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the alarm expected to be in OK state.

    Description: Name of the alarm expected to be in ALARM state.

  AlwaysINSUFFICIENTAlarmName:

    Description: ARN of the alarm expected to remain in INSUFFICIENT_DATA state.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Deploys an AWS Backup Audit Manager compliance framework with five controls
  (backup plan protection, recovery point encryption, manual deletion disabled,
  minimum recovery point retention, and backup plan minimum frequency and
  retention), together with the AWS Config configuration recorder, delivery
  channel, IAM role, KMS key, and S3 bucket that Backup Audit Manager requires.

Mappings:
  FrameworkSettings:
    Framework:
      Name: BackupComplianceFramework
      RequiredRetentionDays: '35'
      RequiredFrequencyUnit: hours
      RequiredFrequencyValue: '24'

Resources:
  ConfigBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key that encrypts the AWS Config delivery bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAWSConfigUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AWSConfigDeliveryEncryption
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ConfigBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/backup-audit-config-bucket
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ConfigBucketKey

  ConfigBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AWSConfigDelivery
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ConfigBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ConfigBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketPermissionsCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketExistenceCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/Config/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ConfigRecorderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role assumed by AWS Config to record resource configurations.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWS_ConfigRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConfigBucketDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/Config/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AWSConfigRecorder
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ConfigRecorder:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ConfigRecorderRole.Arn
      RecordingGroup:
        AllSupported: true
        IncludeGlobalResourceTypes: true

  ConfigDeliveryChannel:
    Type: AWS::Config::DeliveryChannel
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      S3BucketName: !Ref ConfigBucket
      S3KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn
      ConfigSnapshotDeliveryProperties:
        DeliveryFrequency: TwentyFour_Hours

  BackupComplianceFramework:
    Type: AWS::Backup::Framework
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigRecorder
      - ConfigDeliveryChannel
    Properties:
      FrameworkName: !FindInMap [FrameworkSettings, Framework, Name]
      FrameworkDescription: >-
        Backup compliance framework evaluating backup plan coverage, recovery
        point encryption, manual deletion protection, minimum retention, and
        backup plan frequency and retention.
      FrameworkControls:
        - ControlName: BACKUP_RESOURCES_PROTECTED_BY_BACKUP_PLAN
        - ControlName: BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_ENCRYPTED
        - ControlName: BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MANUAL_DELETION_DISABLED
        - ControlName: BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MINIMUM_RETENTION_CHECK
          ControlInputParameters:
            - ParameterName: requiredRetentionDays
              ParameterValue: !FindInMap [FrameworkSettings, Framework, RequiredRetentionDays]
        - ControlName: BACKUP_PLAN_MIN_FREQUENCY_AND_MIN_RETENTION_CHECK
          ControlInputParameters:
            - ParameterName: requiredRetentionDays
              ParameterValue: !FindInMap [FrameworkSettings, Framework, RequiredRetentionDays]
            - ParameterName: requiredFrequencyUnit
              ParameterValue: !FindInMap [FrameworkSettings, Framework, RequiredFrequencyUnit]
            - ParameterName: requiredFrequencyValue
              ParameterValue: !FindInMap [FrameworkSettings, Framework, RequiredFrequencyValue]
      FrameworkTags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: BackupCompliance
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  BackupFrameworkArn:
    Description: ARN of the AWS Backup Audit Manager framework.
    Value: !GetAtt BackupComplianceFramework.FrameworkArn
  BackupFrameworkName:
    Description: Name of the AWS Backup Audit Manager framework.
    Value: !FindInMap [FrameworkSettings, Framework, Name]
  ConfigRecorderName:
    Description: Name of the AWS Config configuration recorder.
    Value: !Ref ConfigRecorder
  ConfigDeliveryChannelName:
    Description: Name of the AWS Config delivery channel.
    Value: !Ref ConfigDeliveryChannel
  ConfigBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket receiving AWS Config snapshots and history.
    Value: !Ref ConfigBucket
  ConfigBucketKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the AWS Config bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn
  ConfigRecorderRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by AWS Config.
    Value: !GetAtt ConfigRecorderRole.Arn
deploy_logs: ["Creating stack 'iac-god-eval-f327b633' on aws", 'iac-god-eval-f327b633: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - User Initiated', 'ConfigBucketKey: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'ConfigBucketKey: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'ConfigBucketKey: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Eventual consistency check initiated', 'ConfigBucketKeyAlias: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'ConfigBucketKeyAlias: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'ConfigBucketKey: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'ConfigBucket: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'ConfigBucket: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'ConfigBucketKeyAlias: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'ConfigBucket: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'ConfigBucketPolicy: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'ConfigRecorderRole: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'ConfigBucketPolicy: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'ConfigRecorderRole: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'ConfigBucketPolicy: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'ConfigDeliveryChannel: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'ConfigDeliveryChannel: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'ConfigRecorderRole: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'ConfigRecorder: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'ConfigRecorder: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'ConfigDeliveryChannel: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'ConfigRecorder: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'BackupComplianceFramework: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'BackupComplianceFramework: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'BackupComplianceFramework: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Eventual consistency check initiated', 'iac-god-eval-f327b633: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Eventual consistency check initiated', 'BackupComplianceFramework: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A']

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless debugging pipeline in which an AWS Step Functions state machine publishes
  custom events to a custom Amazon EventBridge event bus. An EventBridge rule on that
  bus forwards all events to an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group for testing and
  debugging. State machine execution logs and X-Ray tracing are also enabled.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: sfn-events-debug
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: AppName may contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    Description: Application name used as a prefix for resource names and in tags.

Resources:
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AppName}-bus"
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: debugging

  EventsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/events/${AppName}"
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: debugging

  EventsLogsResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AppName}-events-to-logs"
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Sid": "EventBridgeToCloudWatchLogs",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": [
                  "events.amazonaws.com",
                  "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com"
                ]
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "${EventsLogGroup.Arn}"
            }
          ]
        }

  ForwardAllEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    DependsOn: EventsLogsResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AppName}-all-events-to-logs"
      Description: Forwards all events on the custom event bus to CloudWatch Logs for debugging.
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        account:
          - !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Targets:
        - Id: EventsLogGroupTarget
          Arn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${EventsLogGroup}"

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AppName}"
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: debugging

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}-sfn-role"
      Description: Execution role for the Step Functions state machine that publishes events to the custom bus.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${AppName}-sfn-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutEventsToCustomBus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
              - Sid: StepFunctionsLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: debugging

  EventPublisherStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub "${AppName}-state-machine"
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        EventBusArn: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
        EventSource: !Sub "${AppName}.workflow"
      Definition:
        Comment: Publishes custom events to the custom EventBridge bus for debugging.
        StartAt: PrepareEvent
        States:
          PrepareEvent:
            Type: Pass
            Parameters:
              input.$: "$"
              executionId.$: "$$.Execution.Id"
              stateMachineId.$: "$$.StateMachine.Id"
              startTime.$: "$$.Execution.StartTime"
            Next: PublishCustomEvent
          PublishCustomEvent:
            Type: Task
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::events:putEvents"
            Parameters:
              Entries:
                - EventBusName: "${EventBusArn}"
                  Source: "${EventSource}"
                  DetailType: WorkflowCustomEvent
                  Detail.$: "$"
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.TaskFailed
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Next: Done

    Description: Environment name used for resource naming, metrics, tags, and exports.

  UsEast1Only:
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Equals [!Ref 'AWS::Region', 'us-east-1']

Resources:
  SpreeWebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cloudfront-webacl'
      Description: CloudFront WAF WebACL for Spree Commerce
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-webacl'
      Rules:
        # Blocks requests whose User-Agent contains "bot" unless it identifies
        # as Googlebot or Bingbot.
        # NOTE: User-Agent allow-listing can be spoofed by any client. Stronger
        # crawler verification (e.g. AWSManagedRulesBotControlRuleSet or
        # reverse-DNS checks) is intentionally out of scope for this template.
        - Name: BlockBadBots
          Priority: 0
          Action:
            Block: {}
          Statement:
            AndStatement:
              Statements:
                - ByteMatchStatement:
                    FieldToMatch:
                      SingleHeader:
                        Name: user-agent
                    PositionalConstraint: CONTAINS
                    SearchString: bot
                    TextTransformations:
                      - Priority: 0
                        Type: LOWERCASE
                - NotStatement:
                    Statement:
                      OrStatement:
                        Statements:
                          - ByteMatchStatement:
                              FieldToMatch:
                                SingleHeader:
                                  Name: user-agent
                              PositionalConstraint: CONTAINS
                              SearchString: googlebot
                              TextTransformations:
                                - Priority: 0
                                  Type: LOWERCASE
                          - ByteMatchStatement:
                              FieldToMatch:
                                SingleHeader:
                                  Name: user-agent
                              PositionalConstraint: CONTAINS
                              SearchString: bingbot
                              TextTransformations:
                                - Priority: 0
                                  Type: LOWERCASE
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-BlockBadBots'

        # Blocks any single IP exceeding 2000 requests in the default 300-second window.
        - Name: RateLimitPerIP

          Action:
            Block: {}
          Statement:

              AggregateKeyType: IP
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-RateLimitPerIP'

        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 2
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS

              # Exclude Spree admin paths from evaluation by this rule group.

                NotStatement:
                  Statement:
                    ByteMatchStatement:
                      FieldToMatch:

                        - Priority: 0

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an EventBridge to Step Functions workflow for EC2 instance state changes.
  An EventBridge rule on the default event bus matches EC2 instance transitions to
  running, stopped, or terminated and starts a Step Functions state machine with
  placeholder business logic per path, KMS-encrypted execution logging, and a
  KMS-encrypted SQS dead-letter queue for failed deliveries.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name used in resource names and tags.

Resources:
  LogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for EC2 state workflow state machine logs (${EnvironmentName})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vendedlogs/states/ec2-state-workflow-${EnvironmentName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: ec2-state-workflow

  QueueKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for EC2 state workflow EventBridge dead-letter queue (${EnvironmentName})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeUseForDeadLetterQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: ec2-state-workflow

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/ec2-state-workflow-${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: ec2-state-workflow

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the EC2 state change Step Functions state machine.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: VendedLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: StateMachineTracing
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: ec2-state-workflow

  Ec2StateStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub 'ec2-state-workflow-${EnvironmentName}'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      TracingConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
      Definition:
        Comment: Routes EC2 instance state change events to per-state business logic placeholders.
        StartAt: RouteByInstanceState
        States:
          RouteByInstanceState:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: $.detail.state
                StringEquals: running
                Next: HandleRunning
              - Variable: $.detail.state
                StringEquals: stopped
                Next: HandleStopped
              - Variable: $.detail.state
                StringEquals: terminated
                Next: HandleTerminated
            Default: UnhandledState
          HandleRunning:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Placeholder for business logic when an instance enters the running state.
            Parameters:
              action: running
              instanceId.$: $.detail.instance-id
              region.$: $.region
              time.$: $.time
            ResultPath: $.result
            Next: WorkflowSucceeded
          HandleStopped:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Placeholder for business logic when an instance enters the stopped state.
            Parameters:
              action: stopped
              instanceId.$: $.detail.instance-id
              region.$: $.region
              time.$: $.time
            ResultPath: $.result
            Next: WorkflowSucceeded
          HandleTerminated:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Placeholder for business logic when an instance enters the terminated state.
            Parameters:
              action: terminated
              instanceId.$: $.detail.instance-id
              region.$: $.region
              time.$: $.time
            ResultPath: $.result
            Next: WorkflowSucceeded
          UnhandledState:
            Type: Fail
            Error: UnhandledInstanceState
            Cause: The event did not contain a supported EC2 instance state.
          WorkflowSucceeded:
            Type: Succeed
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: ec2-state-workflow

  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows EventBridge to start executions of the EC2 state change state machine.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref Ec2StateStateMachine
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: ec2-state-workflow

  EventDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub 'ec2-state-workflow-dlq-${EnvironmentName}'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: ec2-state-workflow

  EventDeadLetterQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref EventDeadLetterQueue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeDeadLetterDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !GetAtt EventDeadLetterQueue.Arn
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                'aws:SourceArn': !GetAtt Ec2StateChangeRule.Arn
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'sqs:*'
            Resource: !GetAtt EventDeadLetterQueue.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  Ec2StateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'ec2-state-change-${EnvironmentName}'
      Description: Starts the EC2 state workflow when an instance becomes running, stopped, or terminated.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an S3 bucket, Glue database, Glue crawler, and IAM role for
  cataloging AWS CloudTrail logs stored under the cloud-trail/AWSLogs/ prefix
  so they can be queried with Amazon Athena.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: cloudtrail
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-40 characters of lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.
    Description: Project name used to build the Glue database name (<ProjectName>-kk-admin-db).

Resources:
  CloudTrailLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key encrypting CloudTrail log objects in the CloudTrail logs bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountIamDelegation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailEncryptLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              StringLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:cloudtrail:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:*:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailDescribeKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: cloudtrail-athena

  CloudTrailLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-cloudtrail-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CloudTrailLogsKey

  CloudTrailLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: cloudtrail-athena

  CloudTrailLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CloudTrailLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailAclCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by the Glue crawler that catalogs CloudTrail logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailLogsBucketReadAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListCloudTrailPrefix
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    s3:prefix:
                      - cloud-trail/AWSLogs/
                      - cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*
              - Sid: GetBucketLocation
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadCloudTrailObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*'
              - Sid: DecryptCloudTrailObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: cloudtrail-athena

  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-kk-admin-db'
        Description: Glue database holding the CloudTrail log tables queried via Athena.

  CloudTrailCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Properties:
      Description: Catalogs CloudTrail logs stored under cloud-trail/AWSLogs/ for Athena queries.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      TablePrefix: cloudtrail_
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Sub 's3://${CloudTrailLogsBucket}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/'
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: UPDATE_IN_DATABASE
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_EVERYTHING
      Configuration: '{"Version":1.0,"CrawlerOutput":{"Partitions":{"AddOrUpdateBehavior":"InheritFromTable"}},"Grouping":{"TableGroupingPolicy":"CombineCompatibleSchemas"}}'
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: cron(0 1 * * ? *)
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Purpose: cloudtrail-athena

Outputs:
  CloudTrailLogsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that stores CloudTrail logs.
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailLogsBucket
  CloudTrailLogsBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket that stores CloudTrail logs.
    Value: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
  CloudTrailLogsS3Path:
    Description: S3 path crawled by the Glue crawler.
    Value: !Sub 's3://${CloudTrailLogsBucket}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/'
  CloudTrailLogsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting CloudTrail logs (use as the trail KMSKeyId).
    Value: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsKey.Arn
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue database to query from Athena.
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabase
  GlueCrawlerName:
    Description: Name of the Glue crawler that catalogs CloudTrail logs.
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailCrawler
  GlueCrawlerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the Glue crawler.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn

Description: Provisions a DynamoDB session store (dva-lab-02-07-sessions) with TTL, provisioned capacity auto-scaling, and Point-in-Time Recovery.

Resources:
  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: dva-lab-02-07-sessions
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: session_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: session_id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expires_at
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: dva-lab-02-07
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: web-sessions

  SessionsTableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${SessionsTable}
      MinCapacity: 5
      MaxCapacity: 40

  SessionsTableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${SessionsTable}
      MinCapacity: 5
      MaxCapacity: 40

  SessionsTableReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: dva-lab-02-07-sessions-read-scaling-policy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref SessionsTableReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 70.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  SessionsTableWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: dva-lab-02-07-sessions-write-scaling-policy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref SessionsTableWriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 70.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

Outputs:
  SessionsTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB sessions table
    Value: !Ref SessionsTable
  SessionsTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB sessions table
    Value: !GetAtt SessionsTable.Arn
  SessionsTableReadScalingPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the read capacity target tracking scaling policy
    Value: !Ref SessionsTableReadScalingPolicy
  SessionsTableWriteScalingPolicyArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  ECS Anywhere foundational infrastructure - provisions an ECS cluster, an
  SSM-managed instance IAM role for external (hybrid) container instances,
  and an SSM Command document that registers an external host into the cluster.

# NOTE: AWS::SSM::Activation and the ECS Anywhere agent installation itself
# cannot be modeled natively in CloudFormation. They are intentionally omitted
# rather than using non-existent resource types or custom resources. Create the
# hybrid activation out-of-band (e.g. `aws ssm create-activation --iam-role
# <EcsAnywhereInstanceRoleName output>`), then run the registration document
# with the resulting activation ID and code.

Parameters:
  ClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-anywhere-cluster
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster that external instances register into.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Up to 255 letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

  ContainerInstanceName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-anywhere-instance
    Description: Default name (hostname) applied to the external container instance.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9.-]{1,63}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Up to 63 letters, numbers, dots, and hyphens.

Resources:
  EcsAnywhereCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Ref ClusterName
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Cluster
          Value: !Ref ClusterName

  EcsAnywhereInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role supplied to SSM hybrid activations for ECS Anywhere external instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceforEC2Role
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcsAnywhereInstanceAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ClusterScopedEcsActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:RegisterContainerInstance
                  - ecs:DeregisterContainerInstance
                  - ecs:SubmitContainerStateChange
                  - ecs:SubmitTaskStateChange
                  - ecs:UpdateContainerInstancesState
                Resource: !GetAtt EcsAnywhereCluster.Arn
              - Sid: ContainerInstanceScopedEcsActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:Poll
                  - ecs:StartTelemetrySession
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:container-instance/${ClusterName}/*'
              - Sid: EcsDiscoverPollEndpoint
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DiscoverPollEndpoint
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrAuthorization
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrImagePull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Cluster
          Value: !Ref ClusterName

  EcsAnywhereRegistrationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Command
      DocumentFormat: JSON
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '2.2'
        description: !Sub 'Registers an external host into the ECS Anywhere cluster ${ClusterName} in ${AWS::Region}.'
        parameters:
          activationId:
            type: String
            description: SSM hybrid activation ID generated out-of-band.
            allowedPattern: '^[a-f0-9-]{36}$'
          activationCode:
            type: String
            description: SSM hybrid activation code generated out-of-band.
            allowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,250}$'
          containerInstanceName:
            type: String
            description: Name (hostname) applied to the external container instance.
            default: !Ref ContainerInstanceName
            allowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9.-]{1,63}$'
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: registerEcsAnywhereInstance
            inputs:
              timeoutSeconds: '1800'
              runCommand:
                - set -euo pipefail
                - hostnamectl set-hostname "{{ containerInstanceName }}"
                - curl --proto "=https" --tlsv1.2 -fsSL -o /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh "https://amazon-ecs-agent.s3.amazonaws.com/ecs-anywhere-install-latest.sh"
                - !Sub 'bash /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh --region "${AWS::Region}" --cluster "${ClusterName}" --activation-id "{{ activationId }}" --activation-code "{{ activationCode }}"'
                - rm -f /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh
      Tags:
        - Key: Cluster
          Value: !Ref ClusterName
        - Key: ContainerInstanceName
          Value: !Ref ContainerInstanceName

Outputs:
  ClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS Anywhere cluster.
    Value: !Ref EcsAnywhereCluster

  ClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS Anywhere cluster.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsAnywhereCluster.Arn

  EcsAnywhereInstanceRoleName:
    Description: IAM role name to pass to `aws ssm create-activation --iam-role`.
    Value: !Ref EcsAnywhereInstanceRole

  EcsAnywhereInstanceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS Anywhere instance IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsAnywhereInstanceRole.Arn

  RegistrationDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Command document used to register external hosts.
    Value: !Ref EcsAnywhereRegistrationDocument

  ContainerInstanceName:
    Description: Default container instance name used by the registration document.
    Value: !Ref ContainerInstanceName

  ActivationCommand:
    Description: Command to create the SSM hybrid activation out-of-band.
    Value: !Sub 'aws ssm create-activation --iam-role ${EcsAnywhereInstanceRole} --region ${AWS::Region} --default-instance-name ${ContainerInstanceName}'

#    Each role must:
#      - trust the service principal events.amazonaws.com
#      - allow events:PutEvents on its matching *-org-sink event bus in the
#        central account
#    The principal deploying this stack needs iam:PassRole on these roles.
#    If a role is missing or misconfigured, target creation fails at deploy
#    time or event delivery fails at runtime.
#
# 2. Central event bus policies. This template does NOT create
#    AWS::Events::EventBusPolicy resources. The central monitoring account
#    (578003269847, us-east-1) must grant this account, or the organization,
#    events:PutEvents on each *-org-sink event bus. Otherwise cross-account
#    delivery is rejected.
#
# 3. Delivery failure visibility. No DeadLetterConfig or RetryPolicy is
#    configured, because that would require extra resources that were not
#    requested. You can add an SQS dead-letter queue to each target later to
#    see delivery failures.
#
# 4. Regional event delivery. IAM API calls and root console sign-ins are
#    global-service events and are published to EventBridge in us-east-1.
#    Deploy this stack in us-east-1 (in addition to any other regions) to
#    capture them.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Mappings:
  CentralMonitoring:
    Destination:
      AccountId: '578003269847'
      Region: us-east-1

Resources:
  CloudWatchAlarmRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: PRX-CloudWatchAlarmStateChange-To-OrgSink
      Description: Forwards CloudWatch alarm state changes to the central CloudWatch-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudwatch
        detail-type:
          - CloudWatch Alarm State Change
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudWatchOrgSinkTarget
          Arn: !Sub
            - arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralRegion}:${CentralAccountId}:event-bus/CloudWatch-org-sink
            - CentralRegion: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, Region]
              CentralAccountId: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, AccountId]
          RoleArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudWatchOrgSinkRole

  CloudFormationStatusRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: PRX-CloudFormationStatusChange-To-OrgSink
      Description: Forwards CloudFormation resource, stack, and stack set status changes to the central CloudFormation-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudformation
        detail-type:
          - CloudFormation Resource Status Change
          - CloudFormation Stack Status Change
          - CloudFormation StackSet Status Change
          - CloudFormation StackSet Operation Status Change
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudFormationOrgSinkTarget
          Arn: !Sub
            - arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralRegion}:${CentralAccountId}:event-bus/CloudFormation-org-sink
            - CentralRegion: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, Region]
              CentralAccountId: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, AccountId]
          RoleArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudFormationOrgSinkRole

  GuardDutyFindingRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: PRX-GuardDutyFinding-To-OrgSink
      Description: Forwards GuardDuty findings to the central GuardDuty-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.guardduty
        detail-type:
          - GuardDuty Finding
      Targets:
        - Id: GuardDutyOrgSinkTarget
          Arn: !Sub
            - arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralRegion}:${CentralAccountId}:event-bus/GuardDuty-org-sink
            - CentralRegion: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, Region]
              CentralAccountId: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, AccountId]
          RoleArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-GuardDutyOrgSinkRole

  # Slack relay payloads are custom application events published with
  # PutEvents. Producers must set DetailType to "Slack Message Relay".
  SlackRelayRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: PRX-SlackMessageRelay-To-OrgSink
      Description: Forwards Slack message relay payloads to the central Slack-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        detail-type:
          - Slack Message Relay
      Targets:
        - Id: SlackOrgSinkTarget
          Arn: !Sub
            - arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralRegion}:${CentralAccountId}:event-bus/Slack-org-sink
            - CentralRegion: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, Region]
              CentralAccountId: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, AccountId]
          RoleArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-SlackOrgSinkRole

  AutoScalingEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: PRX-AutoScalingEvents-To-OrgSink
      Description: Forwards AutoScaling launch/terminate lifecycle and instance refresh events to the central AutoScaling-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.autoscaling
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance Launch Successful
          - EC2 Instance Launch Unsuccessful
          - EC2 Instance Terminate Successful
          - EC2 Instance Terminate Unsuccessful
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Checkpoint Reached
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Started
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Succeeded
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Failed
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Cancelled
      Targets:
        - Id: AutoScalingOrgSinkTarget
          Arn: !Sub
            - arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralRegion}:${CentralAccountId}:event-bus/AutoScaling-org-sink
            - CentralRegion: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, Region]
              CentralAccountId: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, AccountId]
          RoleArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-AutoScalingOrgSinkRole

  CloudTrailRootActivityRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: PRX-CloudTrailRootActivity-To-OrgSink

      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
          - AWS Console Sign In via CloudTrail
        detail:
          userIdentity:
            type:
              - Root
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudTrailRootOrgSinkTarget
          Arn: !Sub
            - arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralRegion}:${CentralAccountId}:event-bus/CloudTrail-org-sink
            - CentralRegion: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, Region]
              CentralAccountId: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, AccountId]
          RoleArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudTrailOrgSinkRole

  CloudTrailIamUserKeyRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: PRX-CloudTrailIamUserKey-To-OrgSink
      Description: Forwards IAM CreateUser and CreateAccessKey API calls recorded by CloudTrail to the central CloudTrail-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.iam
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - iam.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - CreateUser
            - CreateAccessKey
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudTrailIamOrgSinkTarget
          Arn: !Sub
            - arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralRegion}:${CentralAccountId}:event-bus/CloudTrail-org-sink
            - CentralRegion: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, Region]
              CentralAccountId: !FindInMap [CentralMonitoring, Destination, AccountId]
          RoleArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudTrailOrgSinkRole

  # Identity Center actions are emitted by three services:

  #   - user and group management: sso-directory.amazonaws.com and
  #     identitystore.amazonaws.com
  # The rule filters on eventSource so that IAM CreateUser calls are not

  CloudTrailIdentityCenterRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: PRX-CloudTrailIdentityCenterAdmin-To-OrgSink

Description: Provisions ECR programmatic access credentials for the Wave service, including an IAM managed policy, IAM service user, inactive access key, and a Secrets Manager secret storing the credentials.

Parameters:
  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/aws/secretsmanager
    AllowedPattern: '^alias/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid KMS key alias beginning with "alias/".
    Description: KMS key alias used to encrypt the Secrets Manager secret.

Resources:
  WaveEcrAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Grants the Wave service programmatic access to Amazon ECR repositories in this account.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EcrRepositoryLevelAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:DescribeImages
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:ListImages
              - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
              - ecr:UploadLayerPart
              - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
              - ecr:PutImage
              - ecr:ListTagsForResource
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*'
          - Sid: EcrRegistryLevelAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:DescribeRegistry
            Resource: '*'

  WaveServiceUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      Path: /service-accounts/
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref WaveEcrAccessPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Service
          Value: wave

  WaveServiceAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey

    Properties:

      KmsKeyId: !Ref KmsKeyAlias
      SecretString: !Sub '{"username":"${WaveServiceAccessKey}","password":"${WaveServiceAccessKey.SecretAccessKey}"}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Service

Outputs:

    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret storing the ECR service credentials.
    Value: !Ref WaveEcrServiceSecret

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: DynamoDB idempotency store for hybrid polling and event-driven file-processing deduplication.

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter or digit and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (2-31 characters).
    Description: Project prefix used for naming and tagging all resources.

  IdempotencyTtlDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 365
    Description: Default number of days idempotency records are retained before TTL expiry. Writers compute expiresAt (epoch seconds) using this value.

  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Enable DynamoDB Point-in-Time Recovery on the idempotency table.

Conditions:
  IsPitrEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, 'true']

Resources:
  IdempotencyTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-store'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: pk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: pk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expiresAt
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [IsPitrEnabled, true, false]
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectPrefix
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: idempotency-store
        - Key: IdempotencyTtlDays
          Value: !Ref IdempotencyTtlDays

  IdempotencyTableAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-table-rw'
      Description: Read/write access to the idempotency store table. Intended for attachment to Lambda execution roles and Step Functions state machine roles.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: IdempotencyTableReadWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
            Resource: !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn

Outputs:
  IdempotencyTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB idempotency store table.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-IdempotencyTableName'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Chaos engineering workflow using AWS Step Functions. Terminates a dedicated
  ECS container instance (EC2) running in private subnets with VPC-endpoint-only
  egress, waits 300 seconds, checks the health of an ECS service via the ECS
  API, and publishes an SNS alert (CMK-encrypted) if the service is unhealthy.
  The container image is served through an ECR pull-through cache. All
  infrastructure (VPC, VPC endpoints, EC2, ECS, ECR, KMS, SNS, Lambda, IAM,
  Step Functions) is created by this template.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Operational note:
# This experiment is destructive and effectively one-shot. Once the chaos
# target instance is terminated, CloudFormation will NOT recreate it, which
# causes stack drift. With no Auto Scaling group backing the cluster, the ECS
# service is expected to report unhealthy after termination and trigger the
# SNS alert. To re-run the experiment, replace the instance, e.g. by changing
# a launch template or instance property and then updating the stack.
#
# Networking: the container instance runs in private subnets with no public
# IP and no internet route. Its only egress is TCP 443 to the interface VPC
# endpoints (ecs, ecs-agent, ecs-telemetry, ecr.api, ecr.dkr, s3, logs). The
# busybox image is pulled from ECR Public via an ECR pull-through cache rule,
# so the instance never contacts public.ecr.aws directly.
#
# Storage: the encrypted root volume is declared ONLY on the ChaosTargetInstance
# resource (BlockDeviceMappings), not in the launch template. Do not
# reintroduce a root-volume mapping in the launch template; a duplicated
# mapping for the same device can cause the instance to terminate at launch.
# The root volume is encrypted with an in-stack customer managed key
# (EbsVolumeKey) whose key policy explicitly authorizes EC2 to use the key and
# create grants for it, scoped to this account via kms:CallerAccount and
# kms:ViaService. The default aws/ebs key is intentionally NOT used; do not
# remove KmsKeyId from the instance's block device mapping.
#
# Cost: interface endpoints are billed hourly per AZ. Seven endpoints across
# two AZs is about 14 endpoint ENI-hours per hour, plus data processing.
#
# SNS subscriptions are intentionally not defined and must be added after
# deployment.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: chaos-ecs
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,20}$'
    Description: Project name used for Name/Project tags.

  EcsAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2023/recommended/image_id
    Description: Public AWS SSM path for the latest ECS-optimized Amazon Linux 2023 AMI.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (private only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Interface VPC endpoints - HTTPS from ECS container instance only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Restrict egress to the VPC CIDR (replaces default allow-all)
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  ContainerInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: ECS container instance - no ingress, egress to VPC endpoints only

      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:

        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowEc2GrantsForAwsResources

            Action:

            Condition:
              StringEquals:

        - Key: Purpose

  # Terminate Lambda IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TerminateFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TerminateChaosTarget
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TerminateOnlyChaosTarget
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/${ChaosTargetInstance}'
              - Sid: DescribeInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Terminate Lambda function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TerminateFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Terminates the chaos target EC2 instance (ECS container instance).
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt TerminateFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          INSTANCE_ID: !Ref ChaosTargetInstance
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")


          def handler(event, context):
              instance_id = os.environ["INSTANCE_ID"]
              reservations = ec2.describe_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])["Reservations"]
              state = reservations[0]["Instances"][0]["State"]["Name"]
              logger.info("Instance %s current state: %s", instance_id, state)

              if state in ("shutting-down", "terminated"):
                  return {"instanceId": instance_id, "previousState": state, "currentState": state, "terminated": False}

              response = ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              change = response["TerminatingInstances"][0]
              logger.info("Termination requested for %s: %s", instance_id, change)
              return {
                  "instanceId": instance_id,
                  "previousState": change["PreviousState"]["Name"],
                  "currentState": change["CurrentState"]["Name"],
                  "terminated": True,
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-terminate'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Health-check Lambda IAM role

  HealthCheckFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

        - PolicyName: EcsHealthCheckAndAlert
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeEcsService
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                Resource: !Ref EcsService
              - Sid: PublishAlert
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref AlertTopic
              - Sid: UseAlertTopicCmkViaSns
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt AlertTopicKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Health-check Lambda function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HealthCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Checks ECS service health and publishes an SNS alert if unhealthy.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt HealthCheckFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CLUSTER_NAME: !Ref EcsCluster
          SERVICE_NAME: !GetAtt EcsService.Name
          TOPIC_ARN: !Ref AlertTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ecs = boto3.client("ecs")
          sns = boto3.client("sns")


          def handler(event, context):
              cluster = os.environ["CLUSTER_NAME"]
              service_name = os.environ["SERVICE_NAME"]
              topic_arn = os.environ["TOPIC_ARN"]

              response = ecs.describe_services(cluster=cluster, services=[service_name])
              services = response.get("services", [])

              if not services:
                  status, desired, running, pending = "MISSING", 0, 0, 0
                  reason = f"Service {service_name} not found in cluster {cluster}: {response.get('failures')}"
              else:
                  svc = services[0]
                  status = svc.get("status")
                  desired = svc.get("desiredCount", 0)
                  running = svc.get("runningCount", 0)
                  pending = svc.get("pendingCount", 0)
                  reason = f"status={status}, desired={desired}, running={running}, pending={pending}"

              healthy = status == "ACTIVE" and desired > 0 and running >= desired
              logger.info("Service %s health: healthy=%s (%s)", service_name, healthy, reason)

              alert_sent = False
              if not healthy:
                  message = {
                      "experiment": "ecs-instance-termination",
                      "cluster": cluster,
                      "service": service_name,
                      "healthy": False,
                      "details": reason,
                      "trigger": event,
                  }
                  sns.publish(
                      TopicArn=topic_arn,
                      Subject=f"Chaos experiment: ECS service {service_name} UNHEALTHY"[:100],
                      Message=json.dumps(message, default=str),
                  )
                  alert_sent = True
                  logger.warning("Alert published to %s", topic_arn)

              return {
                  "cluster": cluster,
                  "service": service_name,
                  "status": status,
                  "desiredCount": desired,
                  "runningCount": running,
                  "pendingCount": pending,
                  "healthy": healthy,
                  "alertSent": alert_sent,
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-health-check'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Condition:

            Statement:

                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TerminateFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TerminateFunction.Arn}:*'

                  - !Sub '${HealthCheckFunction.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsDelivery

                Action:
