                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions log group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-chaos'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # State machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ChaosStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: false
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      TracingConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        TerminateFunctionArn: !GetAtt TerminateFunction.Arn
        HealthCheckFunctionArn: !GetAtt HealthCheckFunction.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Chaos experiment - terminate ECS container instance, wait 300s, check ECS service health, alert via SNS if unhealthy.
        StartAt: TerminateInstance
        States:
          TerminateInstance:
            Type: Task
            Resource: 'arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke'
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: '${TerminateFunctionArn}'
              Payload.$: '$'
            ResultSelector:
              result.$: '$.Payload'
            ResultPath: '$.terminate'
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: '$.error'
                Next: ExperimentFailed
            Next: WaitForImpact
          WaitForImpact:
            Type: Wait
            Seconds: 300
            Next: CheckServiceHealth
          CheckServiceHealth:
            Type: Task
            Resource: 'arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke'
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: '${HealthCheckFunctionArn}'
              Payload.$: '$'
            ResultSelector:
              result.$: '$.Payload'
            ResultPath: '$.health'
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: '$.error'
                Next: ExperimentFailed
            Next: EvaluateHealth
          EvaluateHealth:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: '$.health.result.healthy'
                BooleanEquals: true
                Next: ServiceResilient
            Default: ServiceUnhealthy
          ServiceResilient:
            Type: Succeed
            Comment: ECS service remained healthy after instance termination.
          ServiceUnhealthy:
            Type: Fail
            Error: ServiceUnhealthy
            Cause: ECS service was unhealthy after instance termination; SNS alert published.
          ExperimentFailed:
            Type: Fail
            Error: ExperimentError
            Cause: A chaos experiment step failed; see execution history for details.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chaos-workflow'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an AWS DevOps Agent Space, its IAM roles for the agent service and
  operator application, and a primary monitoring-account association for the
  current AWS account. Target region is us-east-1 (DevOps Agent preview region).

Parameters:
  AgentSpaceName:
    Type: String
    Default: DevOpsAgentSpace
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-64 characters of letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
    Description: Name of the DevOps Agent Space.

Resources:
  DevOpsAgentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AgentSpaceName}-AgentRole'
      Path: /service-role/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agentspace/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AIDevOpsAgentAccessPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowCreateServiceLinkedRoles
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowCreateServiceLinkedRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/resource-explorer-2.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForResourceExplorer'

  DevOpsOperatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AgentSpaceName}-OperatorRole'
      Path: /service-role/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agentspace/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AIDevOpsOperatorAppAccessPolicy

  AgentSpace:
    Type: AWS::DevOpsAgent::AgentSpace
    DependsOn:
      - DevOpsAgentRole
      - DevOpsOperatorRole
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref AgentSpaceName
      Description: !Sub 'DevOps Agent Space ${AgentSpaceName}'
      OperatorApp:
        Iam:
          OperatorAppRoleArn: !GetAtt DevOpsOperatorRole.Arn

  PrimaryMonitoringAccountAssociation:
    Type: AWS::DevOpsAgent::Association
    Properties:
      AgentSpaceId: !GetAtt AgentSpace.AgentSpaceId
      ServiceId: aws
      Configuration:
        Aws:
          AssumableRoleArn: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentRole.Arn
          AccountId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          AccountType: monitor

    Value: !GetAtt AgentSpace.AgentSpaceId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AgentSpaceId'

  AgentSpaceArn:
    Description: ARN of the DevOps Agent Space.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentSpace.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AgentSpaceArn'

  AgentSpaceName:
    Description: Name of the DevOps Agent Space.
    Value: !Ref AgentSpaceName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AgentSpaceName'

  OperatorAppUrl:
    Description: URL of the DevOps Agent operator web application.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AgentSpace.AgentSpaceId}.aidevops.global.app.aws/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-OperatorAppUrl'

    Value: !GetAtt DevOpsOperatorRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DevOpsOperatorRoleArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Demo of AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and AWS Secrets Manager access from
  AWS Lambda. Creates several SSM parameters under the stack's path, a Secrets
  Manager secret with a generated password, and a Python 3.12 Lambda function
  (ParameterStoreDemo) that retrieves and prints all parameters under the stack
  path and all secrets matching the stack prefix, masking sensitive values.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Secrets Manager
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DbSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/db/credentials'
      Description: !Sub 'Demo database credentials for stack ${AWS::StackName} (password generated by Secrets Manager)'
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username": "demo_admin", "engine": "postgres", "port": 5432}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'''
        ExcludePunctuation: false
        IncludeSpace: false
        RequireEachIncludedType: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ParameterStoreDemo

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameter Store
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppNameParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/app/name'
      Description: Application name for the Parameter Store demo
      Type: String
      Value: ParameterStoreDemo
      Tags:
        Stack: !Ref AWS::StackName
        Purpose: ParameterStoreDemo

  AppEnvironmentParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/app/environment'
      Description: Deployment environment for the Parameter Store demo
      Type: String
      Value: demo
      Tags:
        Stack: !Ref AWS::StackName
        Purpose: ParameterStoreDemo

  AppAllowedRegionsParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/app/allowed-regions'
      Description: Comma-separated list of regions the demo application may operate in
      Type: StringList
      Value: !Ref AWS::Region
      Tags:
        Stack: !Ref AWS::StackName
        Purpose: ParameterStoreDemo

  DbSecretArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/db/secret-arn'
      Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding DB credentials (pointer only, not the secret value)
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref DbSecret
      Tags:
        Stack: !Ref AWS::StackName
        Purpose: ParameterStoreDemo

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/ParameterStoreDemo
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ParameterStoreDemo

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the ParameterStoreDemo Lambda function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ParameterStoreDemoAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: ReadStackParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}/*'
              - Sid: ReadStackSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${AWS::StackName}/*'
              - Sid: ListSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action: secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ParameterStoreDemo

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ParameterStoreDemoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ParameterStoreDemo
      Description: Retrieves and prints SSM parameters and Secrets Manager secrets for this stack
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STACK_NAME: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
          secretsmanager = boto3.client('secretsmanager')

          MASK = '********'
          SENSITIVE_WORDS = ('password', 'secret', 'token', 'apikey', 'api_key', 'private')


          def is_sensitive(key):
              return any(word in key.lower() for word in SENSITIVE_WORDS)


          def mask_dict(data):
              return {k: (MASK if is_sensitive(k) else v) for k, v in data.items()}


          def get_parameters(path):
              """Return all parameters under the given path using GetParametersByPath."""
              params = []
              paginator = ssm.get_paginator('get_parameters_by_path')
              for page in paginator.paginate(Path=path, Recursive=True, WithDecryption=True):
                  for p in page['Parameters']:
                      value = MASK if p['Type'] == 'SecureString' else p['Value']
                      params.append({
                          'Name': p['Name'],
                          'Type': p['Type'],
                          'Value': value,
                          'Version': p['Version'],
                      })
              return params


          def get_secrets(prefix):
              """Return all secrets whose name starts with prefix, with sensitive fields masked."""
              results = []
              paginator = secretsmanager.get_paginator('list_secrets')
              for page in paginator.paginate(Filters=[{'Key': 'name', 'Values': [prefix]}]):
                  for s in page['SecretList']:
                      entry = {'Name': s['Name'], 'ARN': s['ARN']}
                      try:
                          resp = secretsmanager.get_secret_value(SecretId=s['ARN'])
                          raw = resp.get('SecretString')
                          if raw is None:
                              entry['Value'] = '<binary secret omitted>'
                          else:
                              try:
                                  parsed = json.loads(raw)
                                  entry['Value'] = mask_dict(parsed) if isinstance(parsed, dict) else MASK
                              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                                  entry['Value'] = MASK
                      except ClientError as e:
                          code = e.response['Error']['Code']
                          logger.error('Failed to read secret %s: %s', s['Name'], code)
                          entry['Error'] = code
                      results.append(entry)
              return results


          def handler(event, context):
              stack_name = os.environ['STACK_NAME']
              path = f'/{stack_name}'
              prefix = f'{stack_name}/'
              result = {'StackName': stack_name, 'ParameterPath': path, 'SecretPrefix': prefix}

              try:
                  result['Parameters'] = get_parameters(path)
              except (ClientError, BotoCoreError) as e:
                  logger.error('Failed to retrieve parameters under %s: %s', path, e)
                  result['ParametersError'] = str(e)

              try:
                  result['Secrets'] = get_secrets(prefix)
              except (ClientError, BotoCoreError) as e:
                  logger.error('Failed to list secrets with prefix %s: %s', prefix, e)
                  result['SecretsError'] = str(e)

              print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, default=str))
              return result
      Tags:
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ParameterStoreDemo

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the demo Lambda function
    Value: !Ref ParameterStoreDemoFunction
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the demo Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt ParameterStoreDemoFunction.Arn
  LambdaExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group for the Lambda function
    Value: !Ref LambdaLogGroup
  ParameterPath:
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path containing the demo parameters
    Value: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}'
  DbSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the generated database credentials secret
    Value: !Ref DbSecret
  DbSecretArnParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter storing the secret ARN
    Value: !Ref DbSecretArnParameter
  InvokeCommand:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Lambda blue-green CI/CD deployment environment. Provisions a main Lambda
  function with a published version and alias, CodeDeploy canary traffic
  shifting (10 percent for 5 minutes), automated pre-traffic and post-traffic
  validation hook functions, a CloudWatch error alarm, and automatic rollback
  on deployment failure or alarm.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: lambda-bluegreen
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-30 characters of lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.
    Description: Naming prefix applied to every named resource.

  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Log groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AppName}-main'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PreTrafficHookLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AppName}-pre-traffic-hook'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostTrafficHookLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AppName}-post-traffic-hook'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainFunctionExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AppName}-main-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AppName}-main-logs'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt MainFunctionLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  HookFunctionExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AppName}-hook-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AppName}-hook-permissions'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteHookLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PreTrafficHookLogGroup.Arn
                  - !GetAtt PostTrafficHookLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: ReportDeploymentStatus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codedeploy:PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codedeploy:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deploymentgroup:${AppName}-app/${AppName}-dg'
              - Sid: ValidateMainFunction
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:ListVersionsByFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MainFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MainFunction.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  CodeDeployServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AppName}-codedeploy-service-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codedeploy.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AppName}-codedeploy-lambda'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ShiftAliasTraffic
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:GetAlias
                  - lambda:UpdateAlias
                  - lambda:GetProvisionedConcurrencyConfig
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MainFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MainFunction.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: InvokeValidationHooks
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PreTrafficHookFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt PostTrafficHookFunction.Arn
              - Sid: ReadAlarmState
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main function, version, and alias
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AppName}-main'
      Description: Main application function deployed through CodeDeploy blue-green traffic shifting.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt MainFunctionExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref MainFunctionLogGroup
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ENVIRONMENT: !Ref EnvironmentName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os


          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({
                      "message": "Hello from the main function",
                      "environment": os.environ.get("ENVIRONMENT"),
                      "version": context.function_version,
                  }),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  MainFunctionVersion:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Version
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      Description: Published version of the main function.

  MainFunctionAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt MainFunctionVersion.Version
      Name: live
      Description: Production traffic alias shifted by CodeDeploy.
    UpdatePolicy:
      CodeDeployLambdaAliasUpdate:
        ApplicationName: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
        DeploymentGroupName: !Ref DeploymentGroup
        BeforeAllowTrafficHook: !Ref PreTrafficHookFunction
        AfterAllowTrafficHook: !Ref PostTrafficHookFunction

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Validation hook functions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PreTrafficHookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AppName}-pre-traffic-hook'
      Description: Validates the newly published main function version before traffic shifts.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt HookFunctionExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 60
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref PreTrafficHookLogGroup
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TARGET_FUNCTION_NAME: !Ref MainFunction
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os

          import boto3

          lambda_client = boto3.client("lambda")
          codedeploy = boto3.client("codedeploy")


          def latest_published_version(function_name):
              versions = []
              paginator = lambda_client.get_paginator("list_versions_by_function")
              for page in paginator.paginate(FunctionName=function_name):
                  versions.extend(
                      v["Version"] for v in page["Versions"] if v["Version"] != "$LATEST"
                  )
              return max(versions, key=int)


          def handler(event, context):
              status = "Succeeded"
              try:
                  function_name = os.environ["TARGET_FUNCTION_NAME"]
                  version = latest_published_version(function_name)
                  print(f"Validating {function_name}:{version}")
                  response = lambda_client.invoke(
                      FunctionName=function_name,
                      Qualifier=version,
                      Payload=json.dumps({"healthcheck": True}).encode(),
                  )
                  payload = json.loads(response["Payload"].read())
                  if response.get("FunctionError") or payload.get("statusCode") != 200:
                      print(f"Validation failed: {payload}")
                      status = "Failed"
              except Exception as exc:
                  print(f"Validation error: {exc}")
                  status = "Failed"

              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=event["DeploymentId"],
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=event["LifecycleEventHookExecutionId"],
                  status=status,
              )
              return {"status": status}
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostTrafficHookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AppName}-post-traffic-hook'
      Description: Validates the live alias after traffic has fully shifted.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt HookFunctionExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 60
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref PostTrafficHookLogGroup
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TARGET_FUNCTION_NAME: !Ref MainFunction
          TARGET_ALIAS: live
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os

          import boto3

          lambda_client = boto3.client("lambda")
          codedeploy = boto3.client("codedeploy")


          def handler(event, context):
              status = "Succeeded"
              try:
                  function_name = os.environ["TARGET_FUNCTION_NAME"]
                  alias = os.environ["TARGET_ALIAS"]
                  print(f"Validating {function_name}:{alias}")
                  response = lambda_client.invoke(
                      FunctionName=function_name,
                      Qualifier=alias,
                      Payload=json.dumps({"healthcheck": True}).encode(),
                  )
                  payload = json.loads(response["Payload"].read())
                  if response.get("FunctionError") or payload.get("statusCode") != 200:
                      print(f"Validation failed: {payload}")
                      status = "Failed"
              except Exception as exc:
                  print(f"Validation error: {exc}")
                  status = "Failed"

              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=event["DeploymentId"],
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=event["LifecycleEventHookExecutionId"],
                  status=status,
              )
              return {"status": status}
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Monitoring
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainFunctionErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-main-errors'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers a CodeDeploy rollback when the live alias reports errors.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Sub '${AppName}-main'
        - Name: Resource
          Value: !Sub '${AppName}-main:live'
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CodeDeploy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CodeDeployApplication:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::Application
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Sub '${AppName}-app'
      ComputePlatform: Lambda
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DeploymentGroup:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::DeploymentGroup
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
      DeploymentGroupName: !Sub '${AppName}-dg'
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt CodeDeployServiceRole.Arn
      DeploymentConfigName: CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes
      DeploymentStyle:
        DeploymentType: BLUE_GREEN
        DeploymentOption: WITH_TRAFFIC_CONTROL
      AutoRollbackConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
        Events:
          - DEPLOYMENT_FAILURE
          - DEPLOYMENT_STOP_ON_ALARM
      AlarmConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
        IgnorePollAlarmFailure: false
        Alarms:
          - Name: !Ref MainFunctionErrorAlarm

Outputs:
  MainFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the main Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt MainFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MainFunctionArn'

  MainFunctionAliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the live alias that receives shifted traffic.
    Value: !Ref MainFunctionAlias
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MainFunctionAliasArn'

  MainFunctionVersion:
    Description: Published version number of the main function.
    Value: !GetAtt MainFunctionVersion.Version
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MainFunctionVersion'

  PreTrafficHookFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the pre-traffic validation hook function.
    Value: !GetAtt PreTrafficHookFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PreTrafficHookFunctionArn'

  PostTrafficHookFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the post-traffic validation hook function.
    Value: !GetAtt PostTrafficHookFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PostTrafficHookFunctionArn'

  CodeDeployApplicationName:
    Description: Name of the CodeDeploy application.
    Value: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CodeDeployApplicationName'

  DeploymentGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CodeDeploy deployment group.
    Value: !Ref DeploymentGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DeploymentGroupName'

  CodeDeployServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodeDeploy service role.
    Value: !GetAtt CodeDeployServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CodeDeployServiceRoleArn'

  MainFunctionErrorAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch alarm that triggers automatic rollback.
    Value: !Ref MainFunctionErrorAlarm
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MainFunctionErrorAlarmName'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provides custom SSM Inventory collection of running database and caching
  processes (Cassandra, DSE, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Memcached)
  on Windows and Linux EC2 instances using an SSM Command document and a
  scheduled State Manager association.

Parameters:
  LinuxProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of process command-line substrings to match on
      Linux instances. Entries may contain spaces.
    Default: CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9 ,._\-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must contain only letters, digits, spaces, commas, periods, underscores,
      and hyphens.

  WindowsProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of process name or command-line substrings to match
      on Windows instances (case-insensitive).
    Default: sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9 ,._\-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must contain only letters, digits, spaces, commas, periods, underscores,
      and hyphens.

  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Cron or rate expression that controls how often the inventory
      association runs, for example rate(30 days) or cron(0 2 ? * SUN *).
    Default: rate(30 days)

Resources:
  CustomInventoryProcessesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Command
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '2.2'
        description: >-
          Collects running database and caching processes on Linux and Windows
          instances and writes them to the custom inventory type
          Custom:RunningProcesses.
        parameters:
          linuxProcesses:
            type: String
            description: >-
              Comma-separated list of process command-line substrings to match
              on Linux instances.
            default: CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached
            allowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9 ,._\-]+$'
          windowsProcesses:
            type: String
            description: >-
              Comma-separated list of process name or command-line substrings
              to match on Windows instances (case-insensitive).
            default: sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached
            allowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9 ,._\-]+$'
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: collectLinuxProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              timeoutSeconds: '600'
              runCommand:
                - |
                  #!/bin/bash
                  set -eo pipefail

                  TYPE_NAME="Custom:RunningProcesses"
                  KEYWORDS="{{ linuxProcesses }}"

                  json_escape() {
                    printf '%s' "$1" | tr -d '[:cntrl:]' | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g'
                  }

                  # Query instance metadata (IMDSv2 with IMDSv1 fallback) for the instance ID
                  TOKEN=$(curl -sf -m 5 -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600" || true)
                  if [ -n "$TOKEN" ]; then
                    INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -sf -m 5 -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id" || true)
                  else
                    INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -sf -m 5 "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id" || true)
                  fi
                  if ! [[ "$INSTANCE_ID" =~ ^i-[0-9a-f]+$ ]]; then
                    echo "Unable to determine a valid instance ID from instance metadata" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi

                  INVENTORY_DIR="/var/lib/amazon/ssm/$INSTANCE_ID/inventory/custom"
                  INVENTORY_FILE="$INVENTORY_DIR/RunningProcesses.json"

                  # Parse and trim the keyword list
                  IFS=',' read -r -a RAW_KEYWORDS <<< "$KEYWORDS"
                  KEYWORD_LIST=()
                  for kw in "${RAW_KEYWORDS[@]}"; do
                    kw=$(printf '%s' "$kw" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
                    if [ -n "$kw" ]; then
                      KEYWORD_LIST+=("$kw")
                    fi
                  done

                  # Snapshot running processes before matching so this script never matches itself
                  PS_OUTPUT=$(ps -eo pid=,user=,args=)
                  SELF_PID=$$
                  COLLECTION_TIME=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
                  ENTRIES=()

                  while read -r pid user args; do
                    if [ -z "$pid" ] || [ "$pid" = "$SELF_PID" ]; then
                      continue
                    fi
                    match=""
                    for kw in "${KEYWORD_LIST[@]}"; do
                      if [[ "$args" == *"$kw"* ]]; then
                        match="$kw"
                        break
                      fi
                    done
                    if [ -z "$match" ]; then
                      continue
                    fi
                    name=$(basename -- "${args%% *}")
                    ENTRIES+=("{\"ProcessName\":\"$(json_escape "$name")\",\"ProcessId\":\"$pid\",\"User\":\"$(json_escape "$user")\",\"MatchedKeyword\":\"$(json_escape "$match")\",\"CommandLine\":\"$(json_escape "${args:0:1024}")\",\"CollectionTime\":\"$COLLECTION_TIME\"}")
                  done <<< "$PS_OUTPUT"

                  CONTENT=""
                  if [ "${#ENTRIES[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
                    CONTENT=$(IFS=','; printf '%s' "${ENTRIES[*]}")
                  fi

                  # Write the custom inventory file atomically
                  mkdir -p "$INVENTORY_DIR"
                  TMP_FILE=$(mktemp "$INVENTORY_DIR/.RunningProcesses.XXXXXX")
                  printf '{"SchemaVersion":"1.0","TypeName":"%s","Content":[%s]}\n' "$TYPE_NAME" "$CONTENT" > "$TMP_FILE"
                  chmod 644 "$TMP_FILE"
                  mv -f "$TMP_FILE" "$INVENTORY_FILE"

                  echo "Wrote ${#ENTRIES[@]} matching process(es) to $INVENTORY_FILE"
          - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
            name: collectWindowsProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Windows
            inputs:
              timeoutSeconds: '600'
              runCommand:
                - |
                  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

                  $typeName = 'Custom:RunningProcesses'
                  $keywordString = '{{ windowsProcesses }}'

                  # Query instance metadata (IMDSv2 with IMDSv1 fallback) for the instance ID
                  $instanceId = $null
                  try {
                    $token = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put -Uri 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token' -Headers @{ 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds' = '21600' } -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing
                    $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id' -Headers @{ 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token' = $token } -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing
                  }
                  catch {
                    $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id' -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing
                  }
                  $instanceId = [string]$instanceId
                  if ($instanceId -notmatch '^i-[0-9a-f]+$') {
                    throw 'Unable to determine a valid instance ID from instance metadata'
                  }

                  $inventoryDir = Join-Path $env:ProgramData "Amazon\SSM\InstanceData\$instanceId\inventory\custom"
                  $inventoryFile = Join-Path $inventoryDir 'RunningProcesses.json'

                  # Parse and trim the keyword list
                  $keywords = @($keywordString -split ',' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })

                  $collectionTime = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
                  $items = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]

                  foreach ($proc in Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Process) {
                    if ($proc.ProcessId -eq $PID) {
                      continue
                    }
                    $name = [string]$proc.Name
                    $cmd = [string]$proc.CommandLine
                    $match = $null
                    foreach ($kw in $keywords) {
                      if ($name.IndexOf($kw, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -or $cmd.IndexOf($kw, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) {
                        $match = $kw
                        break
                      }
                    }
                    if (-not $match) {
                      continue
                    }

                    $user = ''
                    try {
                      $owner = Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $proc -MethodName GetOwner
                      if ($owner.User) {
                        if ($owner.Domain) {
                          $user = "$($owner.Domain)\$($owner.User)"
                        }
                        else {
                          $user = [string]$owner.User
                        }
                      }
                    }
                    catch {
                      $user = ''
                    }

                    if ($cmd.Length -gt 1024) {
                      $cmd = $cmd.Substring(0, 1024)
                    }

                    $entry = [ordered]@{
                      ProcessName    = $name
                      ProcessId      = [string]$proc.ProcessId
                      User           = $user
                      MatchedKeyword = [string]$match
                      CommandLine    = $cmd
                      CollectionTime = $collectionTime
                    }
                    $items.Add([pscustomobject]$entry)
                  }

                  $inventory = [ordered]@{
                    SchemaVersion = '1.0'
                    TypeName      = $typeName
                    Content       = $items.ToArray()
                  }
                  $json = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $inventory -Depth 5 -Compress

                  # Write the custom inventory file atomically as UTF-8 without BOM
                  if (-not (Test-Path -Path $inventoryDir)) {
                    New-Item -Path $inventoryDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
                  }
                  $tmpFile = Join-Path $inventoryDir ('.RunningProcesses.' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.tmp')
                  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($tmpFile, $json, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
                  Move-Item -Path $tmpFile -Destination $inventoryFile -Force

                  Write-Output ("Wrote {0} matching process(es) to {1}" -f $items.Count, $inventoryFile)

  CustomInventoryProcessesAssociation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Association
    Properties:
      AssociationName: Custom-Inventory-Processes
      Name: !Ref CustomInventoryProcessesDocument
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      ComplianceSeverity: MEDIUM
      Targets:
        - Key: InstanceIds
          Values:
            - '*'
      Parameters:
        linuxProcesses:
          - !Ref LinuxProcessKeywords
        windowsProcesses:
          - !Ref WindowsProcessKeywords

Outputs:
  DocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Command document that collects running database and caching processes.
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryProcessesDocument

  AssociationId:
    Description: ID of the SSM State Manager association that runs the custom inventory document.
    Value: !GetAtt CustomInventoryProcessesAssociation.AssociationId

  AssociationName:
    Description: Name of the SSM State Manager association.
    Value: Custom-Inventory-Processes

  InventoryTypeName:
    Description: Custom SSM Inventory type name populated on both Linux and Windows instances.
    Value: Custom:RunningProcesses

  ScheduleExpressionInUse:
    Description: Schedule expression applied to the association.
    Value: !Ref ScheduleExpression

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Amazon DataZone domain with a configurable name, a SalesPublisher producer
  project and a MarketingConsumer consumer project, the IAM roles for domain
  execution, data access (Glue, Redshift and Secrets Manager) and provisioning,
  and an environment blueprint configuration that enables the
  DefaultDataWarehouse blueprint in the current region.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: cookbookChapter11
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 55
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w -]+$'
    Description: >-
      Name prefix of the Amazon DataZone domain. A hyphen and an 8-character
      stack-unique suffix are appended automatically to keep the name unique.
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 1-55 characters of letters, numbers, underscores, spaces or
      hyphens (a 9-character unique suffix is appended automatically).

Resources:
  DomainExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role assumed by Amazon DataZone to operate the domain.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: datazone.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ForAllValues:StringLike:
                aws:TagKeys: datazone*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDataZoneDomainExecutionRolePolicy'

  DataAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Manage-access role used by the DefaultDataWarehouse blueprint for Glue, Redshift and Secrets Manager access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: datazone.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:datazone:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:domain/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDataZoneGlueManageAccessRolePolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataZoneRedshiftAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RedshiftDiscovery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - redshift:DescribeClusters
                  - redshift:DescribeDataShares
                  - redshift:DescribeDataSharesForProducer
                  - redshift:DescribeDataSharesForConsumer
                  - redshift-serverless:ListNamespaces
                  - redshift-serverless:ListWorkgroups
                  - redshift-serverless:GetNamespace
                  - redshift-serverless:GetWorkgroup
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RedshiftDataShareManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - redshift:AuthorizeDataShare
                  - redshift:DeauthorizeDataShare
                  - redshift:AssociateDataShareConsumer
                  - redshift:DisassociateDataShareConsumer
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:redshift:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:datashare:*/datazone*'
              - Sid: RedshiftDataApi
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - redshift-data:ExecuteStatement
                  - redshift-data:BatchExecuteStatement
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:redshift:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:redshift-serverless:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workgroup/*'
              - Sid: RedshiftDataApiStatementResults
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - redshift-data:DescribeStatement
                  - redshift-data:GetStatementResult
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: DataZoneSecretsManagerAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DomainTaggedSecretsReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    secretsmanager:ResourceTag/AmazonDataZoneDomain: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.Id

  ProvisioningRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role used by Amazon DataZone to provision environment resources for the DefaultDataWarehouse blueprint.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: datazone.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDataZoneRedshiftGlueProvisioningPolicy'

  # The domain name is suffixed with the first 8 characters of the stack ID's
  # UUID so it is unique per stack and stable across stack updates.
  DataZoneDomain:
    Type: AWS::DataZone::Domain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub
        - '${DomainName}-${StackSuffix}'
        - StackSuffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      Description: Amazon DataZone domain for producer and consumer data sharing.
      DomainExecutionRole: !GetAtt DomainExecutionRole.Arn

  SalesPublisherProject:
    Type: AWS::DataZone::Project
    Properties:
      DomainIdentifier: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.Id
      Name: SalesPublisher
      Description: Data producer team that publishes sales data assets to the catalog.

  MarketingConsumerProject:
    Type: AWS::DataZone::Project
    Properties:
      DomainIdentifier: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.Id
      Name: MarketingConsumer
      Description: Data consumer team that subscribes to published data assets.

  # RegionalParameters is intentionally omitted. Its Redshift-specific keys
  # (cluster or workgroup name, secret ARN) would reference infrastructure that
  # does not exist in a greenfield account.
  DataWarehouseBlueprintConfig:
    Type: AWS::DataZone::EnvironmentBlueprintConfiguration
    Properties:
      DomainIdentifier: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.Id
      EnvironmentBlueprintIdentifier: DefaultDataWarehouse
      EnabledRegions:
        - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      ManageAccessRoleArn: !GetAtt DataAccessRole.Arn
      ProvisioningRoleArn: !GetAtt ProvisioningRole.Arn

Outputs:
  DomainId:
    Description: ID of the Amazon DataZone domain.
    Value: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.Id
  DomainArn:
    Description: ARN of the Amazon DataZone domain.
    Value: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.Arn
  DomainNameEffective:
    Description: Effective name of the Amazon DataZone domain, including the stack-unique suffix.
    Value: !Sub
      - '${DomainName}-${StackSuffix}'
      - StackSuffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
  DomainPortalUrl:
    Description: URL of the Amazon DataZone data portal.
    Value: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.PortalUrl
  SalesPublisherProjectId:
    Description: ID of the SalesPublisher producer project.
    Value: !GetAtt SalesPublisherProject.Id
  MarketingConsumerProjectId:
    Description: ID of the MarketingConsumer consumer project.
    Value: !GetAtt MarketingConsumerProject.Id
  DomainExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the domain execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt DomainExecutionRole.Arn
  DataAccessRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the data access (manage-access) role.
    Value: !GetAtt DataAccessRole.Arn
  ProvisioningRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the provisioning role.
    Value: !GetAtt ProvisioningRole.Arn
  DataWarehouseBlueprintId:
    Description: ID of the enabled DefaultDataWarehouse environment blueprint.
    Value: !GetAtt DataWarehouseBlueprintConfig.EnvironmentBlueprintId

        DnsRecords:
          - Type: A
            TTL: 300

        - Key: Application
          Value: colorteller

        Listeners:

              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        - Key: Application
          Value: colorteller

        Listeners:

              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping

              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        - Key: Application
          Value: colorteller

    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualNode
    Properties:

        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:

              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:
          AWSCloudMap:
            NamespaceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
            ServiceName: !GetAtt ColorTellerCloudMapService.Name
            Attributes:
              - Key: ECS_TASK_DEFINITION_FAMILY
                Value: colorteller-green
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        - Key: Application
          Value: colorteller

  ColorTellerVirtualRouter:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualRouter
    Properties:
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      VirtualRouterName: colorteller-vr
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        - Key: Application
          Value: colorteller

  ColorTellerRoute:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::Route
    Properties:
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      VirtualRouterName: !GetAtt ColorTellerVirtualRouter.VirtualRouterName
      RouteName: colorteller-route
      Spec:
        HttpRoute:
          Match:
            Prefix: /
          Action:
            WeightedTargets:

                Weight: 50
              - VirtualNode: !GetAtt ColorTellerGreenVirtualNode.VirtualNodeName
                Weight: 50
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        - Key: Application
          Value: colorteller

  ColorTellerVirtualService:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualService
    Properties:
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        - Key: Application
          Value: colorteller

  ColorTellerGatewayRoute:

      VirtualGatewayName: !GetAtt VirtualGateway.VirtualGatewayName

                VirtualServiceName: !GetAtt ColorTellerVirtualService.VirtualServiceName
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        - Key: Application
          Value: colorteller

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Private S3 buckets for a data processing pipeline, including a source bucket,
  a target bucket, and an optional EMR log bucket. All buckets are encrypted
  with a customer managed KMS key, versioned, block public access, enforce TLS,
  and carry a lifecycle rule that transitions objects to GLACIER or STANDARD_IA
  after 90 days depending on the region and expires them after 2555 days. The
  lifecycle rule is enabled only on the EMR log bucket.

Parameters:
  CreateEmrLogBucket:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create the optional EMR log bucket.

Conditions:
  CreateEmrLogBucketCondition: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateEmrLogBucket
    - 'true'
  UseGlacierStorageClass: !Or
    - !Equals
      - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      - us-east-1
    - !Equals
      - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      - us-west-2
    - !Equals
      - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      - eu-west-1

Resources:
  PipelineBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the data processing pipeline S3 buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  PipelineBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-buckets'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref PipelineBucketKey

  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: TransitionAndExpireObjects
            Status: Disabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: !If
                  - UseGlacierStorageClass
                  - GLACIER
                  - STANDARD_IA
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  TargetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: TransitionAndExpireObjects
            Status: Disabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: !If
                  - UseGlacierStorageClass
                  - GLACIER
                  - STANDARD_IA
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  EmrLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: CreateEmrLogBucketCondition
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: TransitionAndExpireObjects
            Status: Enabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: !If
                  - UseGlacierStorageClass
                  - GLACIER
                  - STANDARD_IA
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  SourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref SourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${SourceBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  TargetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TargetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TargetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${TargetBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  EmrLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: CreateEmrLogBucketCondition
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref EmrLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt EmrLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${EmrLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

Outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Enforces IMDSv2 (disables IMDSv1) on EC2 instances when they enter the running
  state, using the AWS-owned AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata SSM Automation runbook
  triggered by an Amazon EventBridge rule.

# Notes:
# - AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata is an AWS-owned SSM Automation document that is
#   available in every account and region, so this stack does not create an
#   AWS::SSM::Document resource.
# - This stack creates IAM roles, so the deploying principal must acknowledge
#   CAPABILITY_IAM (for example, aws cloudformation deploy --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM).
# - The solution is fully serverless. It creates no VPCs, subnets, security groups,
#   or EC2 instances, and it acts on instances that are started after deployment.
# - MetadataAccess is left at the runbook default (enabled), so IMDS stays reachable
#   but only through IMDSv2 session tokens.

Parameters:
  HttpPutResponseHopLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 64
    Description: >-
      Desired HTTP PUT response hop limit for instance metadata requests (1-64).

Resources:
  # Role assumed by SSM Automation to inspect instances and modify their metadata options.
  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Execution role used by the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata automation to
        describe instances and enforce IMDSv2.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConfigureEC2MetadataPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # ec2:DescribeInstances does not support resource-level permissions.
              - Sid: DescribeInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'

  # Role assumed by EventBridge to start the automation and pass the execution role.
  EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by EventBridge to start the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata
        automation when EC2 instances enter the running state.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartConfigureEC2MetadataAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartAutomationExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:$DEFAULT'
              - Sid: PassAutomationExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ssm.amazonaws.com

  EventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Starts AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata to enforce IMDSv2 whenever an EC2
        instance enters the running state.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
      Targets:
        - Id: EnforceIMDSv2Automation
          # $DEFAULT has no braces, so Fn::Sub leaves it as a literal.
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:$DEFAULT'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              instance: $.detail.instance-id
            # Fn::Sub resolves the hop limit and role ARN. <instance> is filled in by EventBridge.
            InputTemplate: !Sub |
              {
                "InstanceId": ["<instance>"],
                "EnforceIMDSv2": ["required"],
                "HttpPutResponseHopLimit": ["${HttpPutResponseHopLimit}"],
                "AutomationAssumeRole": ["${AutomationExecutionRole.Arn}"]
              }

Outputs:
  EventRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule that triggers IMDSv2 enforcement.
    Value: !GetAtt EventRule.Arn
  AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the SSM Automation execution.
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
  EventBridgeInvokeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role EventBridge assumes to start the automation.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole.Arn
  ConfiguredHopLimit:
    Description: HTTP PUT response hop limit applied to instances.
    Value: !Ref HttpPutResponseHopLimit

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates an AWS AppSync GraphQL API with AWS IAM authentication and an Amazon EventBridge data source that writes events to a custom event bus.

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: NotesApi
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    Description: Name of the AppSync GraphQL API, also used in resource tags and the event bus name.

Resources:
  EventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ApiName}-${AWS::StackName}-bus'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApiName

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiName
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApiName

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

        type Note {
          NoteId: ID!
          title: String
          content: String
        }

        type Query {
          getNote(NoteId: ID!): Note
        }

        type Mutation {
          saveNote(NoteId: ID!, title: String!, content: String!): Note
        }

  AppSyncEventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows AWS AppSync to put events onto the custom EventBridge event bus.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.Arn
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncPutEventsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt EventBus.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApiName

  EventBridgeDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: EventBridgeDataSource
      Description: Puts events onto the custom EventBridge event bus.
      Type: AMAZON_EVENTBRIDGE
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncEventBridgeRole.Arn
      EventBridgeConfig:
        EventBusArn: !GetAtt EventBus.Arn

  NoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: NoneDataSource
      Description: Local data source used to echo query arguments.
      Type: NONE

  SaveNoteResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: saveNote
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt EventBridgeDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'PutEvents',
            events: [
              {
                source: 'notes.api',
                detailType: 'NoteSaved',
                detail: {
                  NoteId: ctx.args.NoteId,
                  title: ctx.args.title,
                  content: ctx.args.content,
                },
              },
            ],
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return {
            NoteId: ctx.args.NoteId,
            title: ctx.args.title,
            content: ctx.args.content,
          };
        }

  GetNoteResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getNote
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt NoneDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            payload: {
              NoteId: ctx.args.NoteId,
            },
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result;
        }

Outputs:

    Description: ID of the AppSync GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the AppSync GraphQL API.

    Description: GraphQL endpoint URL of the AppSync API.

  EventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus.

  EventBusArn:

    Value: !GetAtt EventBus.Arn
  AppSyncEventBridgeRoleArn:

    Value: !GetAtt AppSyncEventBridgeRole.Arn
