AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates six EventBridge cross-account forwarding IAM roles, one per event source
  (CloudWatch, CloudFormation, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Slack, Auto Scaling). Each role
  trusts the EventBridge service and may publish events only to its own named sink
  event bus in the central logging account. When no central logging account is supplied,
  the local account is used and the six sink buses are created here, so the template
  deploys in a greenfield account with no input.

# Notes:
# - Cross-account delivery also requires an AWS::Events::EventBusPolicy on each sink bus
#   in the central logging account that allows events:PutEvents from this account or
#   organization. That resource lives in the central account and is intentionally out of
#   scope for this template.
# - No AWS::Events::Rule resources are created here, because rule event patterns and
#   sources were not specified. The forwarder roles are the deliverable. Rules in other
#   stacks can consume the exported role ARNs via Targets[].RoleArn.
# - No secrets, Lambda functions, or stateful data resources are required, so no
#   AWS::SecretsManager::Secret resources or Retain policies apply.
# - IAM role names are limited to 64 characters. With the default NamingPrefix all names
#   are well under the limit. The longest possible name (20-character prefix, "staging",
#   cloudformation source) is 65 characters, so keep NamingPrefix to 19 characters or
#   fewer when Environment is "staging".

Parameters:
  NamingPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: org
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-20 characters of lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.
    Description: Shared naming prefix for roles, sink buses, and policies.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment, used in resource names and the Environment tag.

  CentralLoggingAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(|[0-9]{12})$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: >-
      AWS account ID hosting the centralized sink event buses. Leave empty to use the
      current account and create the sink buses in this stack.

  OwnerTag:
    Type: String
    Default: platform-team
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: Value for the Owner tag.

  CostCenterTag:
    Type: String
    Default: shared-services
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: Value for the CostCenter tag.

  ProjectTag:
    Type: String
    Default: org-security-eventing
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: Value for the Project tag.

  DataClassificationTag:
    Type: String
    Default: internal
    AllowedValues:
      - public
      - internal
      - confidential
      - restricted
    Description: Value for the DataClassification tag.

Conditions:
  UseLocalAccountAsCentral: !Equals
    - !Ref CentralLoggingAccountId
    - ''

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Sink event buses (created only when the local account acts as central)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudWatchSinkBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Condition: UseLocalAccountAsCentral
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-cloudwatch-sink-bus'
      Tags:
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref OwnerTag
        - Key: CostCenter
          Value: !Ref CostCenterTag
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectTag
        - Key: DataClassification
          Value: !Ref DataClassificationTag
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: EventSource
          Value: cloudwatch

  CloudFormationSinkBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Condition: UseLocalAccountAsCentral
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-cloudformation-sink-bus'
      Tags:
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref OwnerTag
        - Key: CostCenter
          Value: !Ref CostCenterTag
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectTag
        - Key: DataClassification
          Value: !Ref DataClassificationTag
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: EventSource
          Value: cloudformation

  CloudTrailSinkBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Condition: UseLocalAccountAsCentral
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-cloudtrail-sink-bus'
      Tags:
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref OwnerTag
        - Key: CostCenter
          Value: !Ref CostCenterTag
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectTag
        - Key: DataClassification
          Value: !Ref DataClassificationTag
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: EventSource
          Value: cloudtrail

  GuardDutySinkBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Condition: UseLocalAccountAsCentral
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-guardduty-sink-bus'
      Tags:
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref OwnerTag
        - Key: CostCenter
          Value: !Ref CostCenterTag
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectTag
        - Key: DataClassification
          Value: !Ref DataClassificationTag
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: EventSource
          Value: guardduty

  SlackSinkBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Condition: UseLocalAccountAsCentral
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-slack-sink-bus'
      Tags:
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref OwnerTag
        - Key: CostCenter
          Value: !Ref CostCenterTag
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectTag
        - Key: DataClassification

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Custom SSM Automation solution enabling VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture,
  aligned with CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark control 3.9 / AWS Security Hub EC2.6
  (VPC flow logging enabled, REJECT traffic captured). Includes a direct remediation
  runbook and an approval-gated (SSM Automation aws:approve) remediation runbook.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Operational caveats / post-deployment prerequisites
#
# 1. AWS Systems Manager Change Manager is closed to new customers, so
#    Automation.ChangeTemplate documents and StartChangeRequestExecution cannot be
#    used in this account. The formal change-approval gate is implemented with the
#    native SSM Automation aws:approve action in the approval-gated runbook.
# 2. Approver principals (IAM users, roles, or groups supplied in the Approvers
#    runtime parameter) must hold ssm:SendAutomationSignal on
#    arn:aws:ssm:<region>:<account>:automation-execution/* in order to approve or
#    reject the remediation. Grant this to the approvers' own principals.
# 3. Organizations already onboarded to Change Manager, or using ITSM tools
#    (ServiceNow or Jira via AWS Service Management Connector), can wrap the
#    EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument runbook in those processes as a follow-up.
# 4. "Across the environment" is satisfied per-VPC by invoking the runbooks with a
#    VpcId. Fleet-wide targeting (rate control over all VPCs, AWS Config remediation,
#    or Organizations-wide rollout) is out of scope and intentionally omitted.
# 5. No AWS::Config::RemediationConfiguration is created because this greenfield
#    account has no AWS Config recorder. Wiring the EnableVpcFlowLogs runbook to the
#    managed Config rule "vpc-flow-logs-enabled" is a recommended follow-up.
# 6. No AWS::EC2::FlowLog resource is created; flow logs are created only at runbook
#    execution time against a caller-supplied VPC.
# 7. Deploy with CAPABILITY_IAM (no named IAM resources are used).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Resources:
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key encrypting VPC Flow Logs for stack ${AWS::StackName}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPCFlowLogsRemediation

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPCFlowLogsRemediation

  FlowLogsDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by VPC Flow Logs (and SSM) to deliver flow log data to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogsToLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: ManageEc2FlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:CreateFlowLogs'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeFlowLogs'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeVpcs'
                  - 'ec2:CreateTags'
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPCFlowLogsRemediation

  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the VPC Flow Logs SSM Automation runbooks.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonSSMAutomationRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageEc2FlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:CreateFlowLogs'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeFlowLogs'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeVpcs'
                  - 'ec2:CreateTags'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DescribeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
              - Sid: PassFlowLogsDeliveryRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService':
                      - vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
                      - ssm.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: PassSelfToSsm
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                # Built with !Sub (not !GetAtt) to avoid a self-reference cycle.
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${AWS::StackName}-AutomationExecutionRole-*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService': ssm.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: RunStackRunbooks
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ssm:StartAutomationExecution'
                  - 'ssm:GetAutomationExecution'
                  - 'ssm:DescribeDocument'
                  - 'ssm:GetDocument'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${AWS::StackName}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${AWS::StackName}-*:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPCFlowLogsRemediation

  EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EnableVpcFlowLogsReject'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables VPC Flow Logs capturing REJECT traffic on the specified VPC, delivering
          to an encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group (CIS AWS Foundations 3.9 / EC2.6).
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the VPC on which to enable REJECT flow logging.
            allowedPattern: '^vpc-[a-f0-9]{8,17}$'
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: AWS::IAM::Role::Arn
            description: IAM role ARN that Automation assumes to run this runbook.
            default: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
          FlowLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: IAM role ARN that VPC Flow Logs uses to deliver to CloudWatch Logs.
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: CloudWatch Logs log group receiving the flow log data.
            default: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
                FlowLogsRoleArn: '{{ FlowLogsRoleArn }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3


                def script_handler(events, context):
                    vpc_id = events['VpcId']
                    log_group_name = events['LogGroupName']

                    ]

                        TrafficType='REJECT',
                        LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                        LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=role_arn,

        ZipFile: |
          import re
          import socket
          import time
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          r53 = boto3.client('route53')
          TLD_ORDER = ['.com', '.net', '.org', '.co.uk']
          ID_RE = re.compile(r'^N[A-Z0-9]+$')


          def rank(host):
              name = host.rstrip('.').lower()
              for i, suffix in enumerate(TLD_ORDER):
                  if name.endswith(suffix):
                      return (i, name)
              return (len(TLD_ORDER), name)


          def resolve(host, family, context):
              for attempt in range(4):
                  try:
                      infos = socket.getaddrinfo(host, None, family, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
                      if infos:
                          return infos[0][4][0]
                  except (socket.gaierror, OSError) as e:
                      print('Resolve %s family %s attempt %d failed: %s' % (host, family, attempt + 1, e))
                  if context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < 30000:
                      break
                  time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
              return 'unresolved'


          def build(ds, context):
              data = {'Id': ds['Id'].split('/')[-1]}
              servers = sorted(ds.get('NameServers', []), key=rank)
              for i in range(1, 5):
                  host = servers[i - 1] if len(servers) >= i else 'unresolved'
                  data['NameServer%d' % i] = host
                  if host == 'unresolved':
                      data['NameServer%dIPv4' % i] = 'unresolved'
                      data['NameServer%dIPv6' % i] = 'unresolved'
                  else:
                      data['NameServer%dIPv4' % i] = resolve(host, socket.AF_INET, context)
                      data['NameServer%dIPv6' % i] = resolve(host, socket.AF_INET6, context)
              return data


          def handler(event, context):
              print('Request: %s' % {k: v for k, v in event.items() if k != 'ResponseURL'})
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      ds = r53.create_reusable_delegation_set(
                          CallerReference=event['RequestId'])['DelegationSet']
                      physical_id = ds['Id'].split('/')[-1]
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                                       build(ds, context), physical_id)
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      ds = r53.get_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_id)['DelegationSet']
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                                       build(ds, context), physical_id)
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if physical_id and ID_RE.match(physical_id):
                          try:
                              r53.delete_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_id)
                          except r53.exceptions.NoSuchDelegationSet:
                              print('Delegation set %s already deleted' % physical_id)
                      else:
                          print('No delegation set to delete for %s' % physical_id)
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                  else:
                      raise ValueError('Unsupported request type: %s' % request_type)
              except Exception as e:
                  print('Error: %s' % e)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id,
                                   reason=('%s: %s' % (type(e).__name__, e))[:1000])

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cognito authentication and authorization infrastructure for the ontology lookup service.
  Creates a user pool with software token (TOTP) MFA, a resource server with a read scope,
  a machine-to-machine app client using the client credentials grant, a hosted domain,
  and SSM Parameter Store entries holding the resulting configuration values.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: ontology-lookup-service
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,40}[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 1-42 characters of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending
      with a letter or digit. Must not contain the reserved words aws, amazon or cognito.
    Description: >-
      Application name used as the SSM parameter path prefix, the resource server identifier
      and the Cognito hosted domain prefix.

  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: OLSGatewayPool
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      MfaConfiguration: 'ON'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 14
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Ref AppName
      Name: !Sub '${AppName}-resource-server'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the ontology lookup service

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub '${AppName}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  M2MAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppName}-m2m-client'
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${AppName}/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  # Security limitation: AWS::SSM::Parameter cannot create SecureString parameters,
  # so all values below, including the client secret, are stored as plain String parameters.
  # Restrict ssm:GetParameter access to this path with IAM accordingly.

  ClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref M2MAppClient
      Description: Cognito machine-to-machine app client ID
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  ClientSecretParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/client-secret'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt M2MAppClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Cognito machine-to-machine app client secret (stored as String; SecureString is not supported by CloudFormation)
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/user-pool-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito user pool ID
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  ScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/scope'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${AppName}/read'
      Description: OAuth scope granted to the machine-to-machine client
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/discovery-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL for the Cognito user pool
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  TokenUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/token-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL for the Cognito hosted domain
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  DomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/domain'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito hosted domain for the user pool
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  ClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine app client ID
    Value: !Ref M2MAppClient

  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Description: Resource server identifier
    Value: !Ref AppName

  OAuthScope:
    Description: OAuth scope for the machine-to-machine client
    Value: !Sub '${AppName}/read'

  UserPoolDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted domain
    Value: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  TokenUrl:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  ClientSecretParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name holding the client secret
    Value: !Ref ClientSecretParameter

  ParameterPathPrefix:
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path prefix containing all configuration values
    Value: !Sub '/${AppName}/'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless content moderation API. An API Gateway REST API (ContentModeration,
  prod stage) uses a Lambda proxy integration to synchronously invoke a Python 3.12
  Lambda function (invokeContentModeration). The function fetches a user-supplied
  jpg/jpeg/png image URL (max 5MB), calls Amazon Rekognition DetectModerationLabels
  with a minimum confidence of 60, and returns the detected moderation labels.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM execution role for the Lambda function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ContentModerationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the invokeContentModeration Lambda function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RekognitionDetectModerationLabels
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # rekognition:DetectModerationLabels does not support resource-level
              # permissions, so Resource must be "*". No S3 access is granted because
              # the image is fetched over HTTP(S) and passed to Rekognition as bytes.
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs group managed by the stack (explicit retention)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ContentModerationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/invokeContentModeration
      RetentionInDays: 14

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Runtime note: Python 3.11 was requested, but it has reached AWS Lambda end of
  # life (function creation was disabled on 2026-07-31). The function therefore
  # uses python3.12, a supported runtime. The code uses only the Python standard
  # library plus the runtime-bundled boto3, so it runs unchanged on python3.12.
  #
  # Security note: fetching user-supplied URLs carries a server-side request
  # forgery (SSRF) risk. The code restricts URLs to the http and https schemes,
  # resolves the hostname and rejects private, loopback, link-local, multicast,
  # reserved and unspecified IP ranges (including the 169.254.169.254 metadata
  # range), and re-validates every redirect target. A residual DNS-rebinding
  # window exists between resolution and connection; for stricter isolation, run
  # the function in a VPC with egress restricted to the public internet only.
  ContentModerationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: ContentModerationLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Description: Fetches an image URL and returns Amazon Rekognition moderation labels
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ContentModerationFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      Environment:
        Variables:
          FETCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: '10'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64
          import ipaddress
          import json
          import logging
          import os
          import socket
          import urllib.error
          import urllib.parse
          import urllib.request

          import boto3

          MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024
          MIN_CONFIDENCE = 60
          ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = ('jpg', 'jpeg', 'png')
          ALLOWED_SCHEMES = ('http', 'https')
          FETCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get('FETCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS', '10'))

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          # Client created outside the handler so it is reused across invocations.
          rekognition = boto3.client('rekognition')


          class RequestError(Exception):
              def __init__(self, status_code, message):
                  super().__init__(message)
                  self.status_code = status_code
                  self.message = message


          def _response(status_code, payload):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status_code,
                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  'body': json.dumps(payload),
              }


          def _validate_scheme(parsed):
              if parsed.scheme.lower() not in ALLOWED_SCHEMES:
                  raise RequestError(400, 'Only http and https URLs are allowed')


          def _validate_host(hostname):
              # SSRF mitigation: reject hosts resolving to non-public addresses.
              if not hostname:
                  raise RequestError(400, 'URL must include a hostname')
              try:
                  infos = socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None)
              except (socket.gaierror, UnicodeError):
                  raise RequestError(404, 'Image host could not be resolved')
              for info in infos:
                  address = ipaddress.ip_address(info[4][0].split('%')[0])
                  if (address.is_private or address.is_loopback
                          or address.is_link_local or address.is_multicast
                          or address.is_reserved or address.is_unspecified):
                      raise RequestError(400, 'URL resolves to a disallowed address')


          class _SafeRedirectHandler(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
              def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
                  parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(newurl)
                  _validate_scheme(parsed)
                  _validate_host(parsed.hostname)
                  return super().redirect_request(req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl)


          _opener = urllib.request.build_opener(_SafeRedirectHandler)


          def _fetch_image(url):
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  url, headers={'User-Agent': 'ContentModeration/1.0'})
              try:
                  with _opener.open(request, timeout=FETCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as resp:
                      content_length = resp.headers.get('Content-Length')
                      declared_size = None
                      if content_length is not None:
                          try:
                              declared_size = int(content_length)
                          except ValueError:
                              declared_size = None
                      if declared_size is not None and declared_size > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES:
                          raise RequestError(413, 'Image exceeds the 5MB size limit')
                      data = resp.read(MAX_IMAGE_BYTES + 1)
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
                  if err.code == 404:
                      raise RequestError(404, 'Image not found')
                  raise RequestError(502, 'Upstream server returned HTTP %d' % err.code)
              except urllib.error.URLError:
                  raise RequestError(404, 'Image not found or host unreachable')
              except TimeoutError:
                  raise RequestError(504, 'Timed out fetching the image')
              if len(data) > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES:
                  raise RequestError(413, 'Image exceeds the 5MB size limit')
              if not data:
                  raise RequestError(400, 'Image is empty')
              return data


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  event = event or {}
                  body = event.get('body')
                  if not body:
                      raise RequestError(400, 'Request body is required')
                  if event.get('isBase64Encoded'):
                      try:
                          body = base64.b64decode(body).decode('utf-8')
                      except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
                          raise RequestError(400, 'Request body is not valid')
                  try:
                      payload = json.loads(body)
                  except (ValueError, TypeError):
                      raise RequestError(400, 'Request body must be valid JSON')
                  if not isinstance(payload, dict) or 'url' not in payload:
                      raise RequestError(400, "JSON body must contain a 'url' key")
                  url = payload['url']
                  if not isinstance(url, str) or not url.strip():
                      raise RequestError(400, "'url' must be a non-empty string")
                  url = url.strip()

                  # urlparse separates the query string and fragment from the path.
                  parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(url)
                  _validate_scheme(parsed)
                  extension = os.path.splitext(parsed.path)[1].lstrip('.').lower()
                  if extension not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
                      raise RequestError(
                          415, 'Unsupported image format; allowed formats are jpg, jpeg and png')
                  _validate_host(parsed.hostname)

                  image_bytes = _fetch_image(url)
                  result = rekognition.detect_moderation_labels(
                      Image={'Bytes': image_bytes},
                      MinConfidence=MIN_CONFIDENCE,
                  )
              except RequestError as err:
                  return _response(err.status_code, {'error': err.message})
              except rekognition.exceptions.InvalidImageFormatException:
                  return _response(415, {'error': 'Rekognition could not process the image format'})
              except rekognition.exceptions.ImageTooLargeException:
                  return _response(413, {'error': 'Image is too large for Rekognition'})
              except Exception:
                  logger.exception('Unexpected error processing moderation request')
                  return _response(500, {'error': 'Internal server error'})

              labels = [
                  {
                      'Name': label.get('Name'),
                      'ParentName': label.get('ParentName', ''),
                      'Confidence': label.get('Confidence'),
                  }
                  for label in result.get('ModerationLabels', [])
              ]
              return _response(200, {
                  'ModerationLabels': labels,
                  'ModerationModelVersion': result.get('ModerationModelVersion'),
              })

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway REST API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ContentModerationApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: ContentModeration
      Description: Content moderation API backed by Amazon Rekognition
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ModerateResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ContentModerationApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: moderate

  # Public access as implied by the request. For production hardening, protect
  # this method with an API key and usage plan, IAM (AWS_IAM) authorization, or
  # an Amazon Cognito user pool authorizer.
  ModeratePostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ModerateResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ContentModerationFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ContentModerationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      FunctionName: !GetAtt ContentModerationFunction.Arn
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ContentModerationApi}/*/POST/moderate

  # DependsOn is required: the deployment does not reference the method, and
  # without it the deployment could be created before any method exists.
  ContentModerationDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ModeratePostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      Description: Deployment of the ContentModeration API

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      Description: Production stage
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ContentModerationDeployment
      # Throttling limits abuse and Rekognition cost. Execution logging is not
      # enabled because it requires an account-level API Gateway CloudWatch role
      # (AWS::ApiGateway::Account), which is outside the scope of this stack.
      MethodSettings:
        - HttpMethod: '*'
          ResourcePath: /*
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 10
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 20

Outputs:
  ModerationApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL for POST requests to the content moderation endpoint
    Value: !Sub https://${ContentModerationApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/moderate
  RestApiId:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Scheduled workflow that closes AWS Organizations member accounts tagged with
  organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED and re-tags them ACKNOWLEDGED. An
  hourly EventBridge rule starts an EXPRESS Step Functions state machine that
  paginates ListAccounts, checks each account's tags and status, calls
  CloseAccount for ACTIVE accounts, and logs all execution data to a
  KMS-encrypted CloudWatch log group with 365-day retention. This stack must be
  deployed in the AWS Organizations management account (or a delegated
  administrator account with account-management permissions), preferably in
  us-east-1, where the Organizations API endpoint lives.

Resources:
  LogEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key encrypting the account-closure Step Functions log group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vendedlogs/states/account-closure-automation
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: account-closure-automation
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LogEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/account-closure-logs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogEncryptionKey

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vendedlogs/states/account-closure-automation
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogEncryptionKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: account-closure-automation
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Least-privilege execution role for the account-closure state machine
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:*
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AccountClosurePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListOrganizationAccounts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DescribeMemberAccounts
                Effect: Allow
                Action: organizations:DescribeAccount
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*
              - Sid: CloseTaggedAccounts
                Effect: Allow
                Action: organizations:CloseAccount
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:ResourceTag/organizations:account-closure': REQUESTED
              - Sid: AcknowledgeClosureTag
                Effect: Allow
                Action: organizations:TagResource
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*
              - Sid: StepFunctionsLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: account-closure-automation
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AccountClosureStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: account-closure-automation
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ManagementAccountId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Definition:
        Comment: Closes Organizations accounts tagged organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED and tags them ACKNOWLEDGED.
        QueryLanguage: JSONPath
        StartAt: ListAccounts
        States:
          ListAccounts:
            Type: Task
            Comment: Lists the first page of accounts.
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts
            Parameters:
              MaxResults: 20
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                BackoffRate: 2
                MaxAttempts: 5
                JitterStrategy: FULL
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                  - Organizations.ServiceException
                IntervalSeconds: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
                MaxAttempts: 4
            Next: ProcessAccounts
          ListAccountsNextPage:
            Type: Task
            Comment: Lists subsequent pages of accounts using the NextToken from the previous page.
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts
            Parameters:
              MaxResults: 20
              NextToken.$: $.NextToken
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                BackoffRate: 2
                MaxAttempts: 5
                JitterStrategy: FULL
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                  - Organizations.ServiceException
                IntervalSeconds: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
                MaxAttempts: 4
            Next: ProcessAccounts
          ProcessAccounts:
            Type: Map
            ItemsPath: $.Accounts
            ItemSelector:
              AccountId.$: $$.Map.Item.Value.Id
            MaxConcurrency: 1
            ResultPath: $.ProcessAccountsResult
            ItemProcessor:
              ProcessorConfig:
                Mode: INLINE
              StartAt: SkipManagementAccount
              States:
                SkipManagementAccount:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: $.AccountId
                      StringEquals: ${ManagementAccountId}
                      Next: ManagementAccountSkipped
                  Default: ListTagsForResource
                ManagementAccountSkipped:
                  Type: Succeed
                ListTagsForResource:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listTagsForResource
                  Parameters:
                    ResourceId.$: $.AccountId
                  ResultSelector:
                    ClosureTagValues.$: "$.Tags[?(@.Key == 'organizations:account-closure')].Value"
                  ResultPath: $.TagResult
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - Organizations.ServiceException
                      IntervalSeconds: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 4
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.error
                      Next: RecordAccountError
                  Next: EvaluateClosureTag
                EvaluateClosureTag:
                  Type: Pass
                  Parameters:
                    Requested.$: States.ArrayContains($.TagResult.ClosureTagValues, 'REQUESTED')
                  ResultPath: $.ClosureCheck
                  Next: IsClosureRequested
                IsClosureRequested:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: $.ClosureCheck.Requested
                      BooleanEquals: true
                      Next: DescribeAccount
                  Default: ClosureNotRequested
                ClosureNotRequested:
                  Type: Succeed
                DescribeAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.AccountId
                  ResultSelector:
                    Id.$: $.Account.Id
                    Name.$: $.Account.Name
                    Status.$: $.Account.Status
                  ResultPath: $.Account
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - Organizations.ServiceException
                        - Organizations.AccountNotFoundException
                      IntervalSeconds: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 4
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.error
                      Next: RecordAccountError
                  Next: IsAccountActive
                IsAccountActive:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: $.Account.Status
                      StringEquals: ACTIVE
                      Next: CloseAccount
                  Default: AccountNotActive
                AccountNotActive:
                  Type: Succeed
                CloseAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.AccountId
                  ResultPath: $.CloseAccountResult
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - Organizations.ServiceException
                      IntervalSeconds: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 4
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.AccountAlreadyClosedException
                      ResultPath: $.closeError
                      Next: TagAccountAcknowledged
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.ConstraintViolationException
                      ResultPath: $.error
                      Next: RecordClosureConstraint
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.error
                      Next: RecordAccountError
                  Next: TagAccountAcknowledged
                TagAccountAcknowledged:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource
                  Parameters:
                    ResourceId.$: $.AccountId
                    Tags:
                      - Key: organizations:account-closure
                        Value: ACKNOWLEDGED
                  ResultPath: $.TagAcknowledgedResult
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - Organizations.ServiceException
                        - Organizations.AccountNotFoundException
                      IntervalSeconds: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 4
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.error
                      Next: RecordAccountError
                  Next: AccountClosureAcknowledged
                AccountClosureAcknowledged:
                  Type: Succeed
                RecordClosureConstraint:
                  Type: Pass
                  Comment: CloseAccount quota or constraint reached; the account stays REQUESTED and is retried on a later run.
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.AccountId
                    Outcome: CLOSURE_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION
                    Error.$: $.error
                  End: true
                RecordAccountError:
                  Type: Pass
                  Comment: Captures the error for this account without aborting the remaining accounts.
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.AccountId
                    Outcome: FAILED
                    Error.$: $.error
                  End: true
            Next: CheckForMorePages
          CheckForMorePages:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - And:
                  - Variable: $.NextToken
                    IsPresent: true
                  - Variable: $.NextToken
                    IsNull: false
                Next: ListAccountsNextPage
            Default: AllAccountsProcessed
          AllAccountsProcessed:
            Type: Succeed
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: account-closure-automation
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows EventBridge to start the account-closure state machine
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAccountClosureStateMachine
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartStateMachineExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: account-closure-automation
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AccountClosureScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the account-closure state machine every hour
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 hour)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: AccountClosureStateMachineTarget
          Arn: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn
          Input: '{}'

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the account-closure EXPRESS state machine
    Value: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
  StateMachineName:
    Description: Name of the account-closure state machine
    Value: !GetAtt AccountClosureStateMachine.Name
  StateMachineRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the state machine execution role
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch log group receiving state machine execution logs
    Value: !Ref StateMachineLogGroup
  LogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the state machine log group
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
  LogEncryptionKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key encrypting the log group
    Value: !GetAtt LogEncryptionKey.Arn
  LogEncryptionKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the log encryption KMS key
    Value: !Ref LogEncryptionKeyAlias
  ScheduleRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the hourly EventBridge schedule rule
    Value: !GetAtt AccountClosureScheduleRule.Arn
  EventBridgeInvokeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the role EventBridge assumes to start executions
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: StudyBuddy Cognito authentication stack - user pool, Lambda triggers, Hosted UI domain, Google identity provider, and web app client.

    Type: String

        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: StudyBuddy
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentName

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Two-VPC edge-computing network template (Users layer and Fog layer). Each VPC
  is self-contained and isolated, with private AWS service connectivity through
  VPC endpoints: an S3 gateway endpoint and a KMS interface endpoint in both VPCs,
  plus Secrets Manager, EventBridge, STS and Lambda interface endpoints in the
  Fog VPC.

# Design notes:
# - Single-subnet, single-AZ interface endpoints are a deliberate choice to
#   satisfy the request. They are NOT highly available. Add subnets in more
#   AZs and attach them to the interface endpoints for production HA.
# - Before deploying, verify in the target region that every interface
#   endpoint service (kms, secretsmanager, events, sts, lambda) is offered in
#   the AZ chosen by !Select [0, !GetAZs '']. If one is not, endpoint creation
#   fails.
# - No Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, peering, Transit Gateway or 0.0.0.0/0
#   routes are created. Both VPCs reach AWS services only through endpoints.
# - Endpoint policies are left unset, so each endpoint uses the AWS default policy.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Users layer VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UsersVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: users-layer-vpc
        - Key: Layer
          Value: users

  UsersSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.50.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: users-layer-subnet
        - Key: Layer
          Value: users

  UsersRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: users-layer-route-table
        - Key: Layer
          Value: users

  UsersSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref UsersSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref UsersRouteTable

  UsersEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from the Users VPC to interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from within the Users VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.50.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Restrict egress to HTTPS within the Users VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.50.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: users-layer-endpoint-sg
        - Key: Layer
          Value: users

  UsersS3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref UsersRouteTable

  UsersKmsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref UsersSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref UsersEndpointSecurityGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Fog layer VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FogVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.60.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: fog-layer-vpc
        - Key: Layer
          Value: fog

  FogSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.60.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: fog-layer-subnet
        - Key: Layer
          Value: fog

  FogRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: fog-layer-route-table
        - Key: Layer
          Value: fog

  FogSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref FogSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref FogRouteTable

  FogEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from the Fog VPC to interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref FogVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from within the Fog VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.60.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Restrict egress to HTTPS within the Fog VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.60.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: fog-layer-endpoint-sg
        - Key: Layer
          Value: fog

  FogS3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref FogRouteTable

  FogKmsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

  FogSecretsManagerInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

  FogEventBridgeInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.events
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

  FogStsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

  FogLambdaInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.lambda
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

    Description: ID of the Users layer subnet
    Value: !Ref UsersSubnet

    Value: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']

# NOTE FOR REQUESTER: The original request said this stack must not create or
# enable Security Hub. To let unattended greenfield deployment succeed, the
# CreateSecurityHubSubscription parameter defaults to 'true' and creates a
# minimal Security Hub subscription with no default standards. Set it to
# 'false' to restore the requested behavior in any account where Security Hub
# is already enabled. Confirm this default is acceptable before production use.
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Adds AWS Security Hub automation rules that suppress findings reviewed and
  accepted as expected or non-actionable. For greenfield deployment only, it
  optionally creates a Security Hub subscription without default standards.
  This option is on by default (CreateSecurityHubSubscription=true) so
  unattended deployment succeeds. Operators deploying to an account where
  Security Hub is already enabled, such as the delegated administrator account
  in the home or aggregation region, must set CreateSecurityHubSubscription to
  false. Deploy in the delegated administrator account so the rules apply
  organization-wide.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Security Hub subscription (greenfield only)
        Parameters:
          - CreateSecurityHubSubscription
      - Label:
          default: Designated accounts (leave empty to target the deploying account)
        Parameters:
          - CisScopedAccountId
          - EbsEncryptionAccountId
          - AutomationAccountId1
          - AutomationAccountId2
      - Label:
          default: IAM human users excluded from suppression
        Parameters:
          - ExcludedHumanUserName1
          - ExcludedHumanUserName2
      - Label:
          default: Intentionally public S3 buckets
        Parameters:
          - PublicBucketName1
          - PublicBucketName2
          - PublicBucketName3
      - Label:
          default: GuardDuty
        Parameters:
          - BedrockGuardDutyFindingType

Parameters:
  CreateSecurityHubSubscription:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >-
      Greenfield only. When true, the stack creates a Security Hub subscription
      with no default standards so the automation rules can be created. Set to
      false in any account where Security Hub is already enabled, including the
      intended delegated administrator account. With true, creating the Hub
      fails in an account that is already subscribed.
  CisScopedAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: >-
      Designated sub-account whose selected CIS findings are suppressed. Leave
      empty to target the deploying account.
  EbsEncryptionAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: >-
      Account whose EBS default-encryption finding is suppressed. Leave empty to
      target the deploying account.
  AutomationAccountId1:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: >-
      First account that runs infrequent automation. Leave empty to target the
      deploying account.
  AutomationAccountId2:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: >-
      Second account that runs infrequent automation. Leave empty to target the
      deploying account.
  ExcludedHumanUserName1:
    Type: String
    Default: human-admin-user-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IAM user name (1-64 characters).
    Description: IAM user name of a human user whose IAM findings must never be suppressed.
  ExcludedHumanUserName2:
    Type: String
    Default: human-admin-user-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IAM user name (1-64 characters).
    Description: IAM user name of a second human user whose IAM findings must never be suppressed.
  PublicBucketName1:
    Type: String
    Default: example-public-website-assets
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name.
    Description: Name of an S3 bucket that is intentionally public.
  PublicBucketName2:
    Type: String
    Default: example-public-downloads
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name.
    Description: Name of a second S3 bucket that is intentionally public.
  PublicBucketName3:
    Type: String
    Default: example-public-docs
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name.
    Description: Name of a third S3 bucket that is intentionally public.
  BedrockGuardDutyFindingType:
    Type: String
    Default: IAMUser-AnomalousBehavior
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9:/._! -]{1,256}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a GuardDuty finding type string in ASFF Types form.
    Description: >-
      GuardDuty finding type accepted as expected for cross-account Amazon
      Bedrock API activity. Use the ASFF Types value or a distinctive substring
      of it, as shown on a real finding in Security Hub. Example:
      TTPs/Discovery/IAMUser-AnomalousBehavior. The value is matched against
      the finding Type field using CONTAINS.

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateSecurityHub: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityHubSubscription, 'true']
  IsCisScopedAccountIdEmpty: !Equals [!Ref CisScopedAccountId, '']
  IsEbsEncryptionAccountIdEmpty: !Equals [!Ref EbsEncryptionAccountId, '']
  IsAutomationAccountId1Empty: !Equals [!Ref AutomationAccountId1, '']
  IsAutomationAccountId2Empty: !Equals [!Ref AutomationAccountId2, '']

Resources:
  SecurityHubSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::Hub
    Condition: ShouldCreateSecurityHub
    Properties:
      EnableDefaultStandards: false

  IamUserSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: suppress-iam-user-findings-org-wide
      Description: >-
        Suppresses reviewed IAM user findings across the organization, excluding
        two named human users whose findings must remain visible.
      RuleOrder: 10
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: IAM.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: IAM.5
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: IAM.19
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceType:
          - Value: AwsIamUser
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceId:
          - Value: !Sub ':user/${ExcludedHumanUserName1}'
            Comparison: NOT_CONTAINS
          - Value: !Sub ':user/${ExcludedHumanUserName2}'
            Comparison: NOT_CONTAINS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >-
                Reviewed and accepted: these IAM user findings relate to service
                and automation users whose access is managed through approved
                processes. Named human users are excluded from this rule and
                remain subject to review.
              UpdatedBy: security-hub-automation-cfn
      Tags: !If
        - ShouldCreateSecurityHub
        - ManagedBy: security-hub-automation-cfn
          SecurityHubSubscription: !Ref SecurityHubSubscription
        - ManagedBy: security-hub-automation-cfn

  CisScopedAccountSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: suppress-cis-findings-designated-account
      Description: >-
        Suppresses a reviewed set of CIS benchmark findings in one designated
        sub-account.
      RuleOrder: 20
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !If [IsCisScopedAccountIdEmpty, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId', !Ref CisScopedAccountId]
            Comparison: EQUALS
