AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudFormation template, deployable with sam deploy using CAPABILITY_IAM only,
  that provisions the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function, an MCP tool for testing an
  Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway used by an AWS operations agent. It also
  creates a dedicated AgentCore Gateway execution role and a CloudWatch log group
  with two-week retention. Future addition: AgentCore Gateway and GatewayTarget
  resources are intentionally not created here.

Resources:
  FunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool
      RetentionInDays: 14

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BedrockInvokeModels
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeFoundationModelsAndInferenceProfiles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*
        - PolicyName: CostAndUsageRead
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CostExplorerAndCurRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsage
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsageWithResources
                  - ce:GetCostForecast
                  - ce:GetUsageForecast
                  - ce:GetDimensionValues
                  - ce:GetTags
                  - ce:GetCostCategories
                  - ce:GetReservationUtilization
                  - ce:GetReservationCoverage
                  - ce:GetSavingsPlansUtilization
                  - ce:GetSavingsPlansCoverage
                  - ce:GetRightsizingRecommendation
                  - ce:GetAnomalies
                  - cur:DescribeReportDefinitions
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: S3BasicObjectOperations
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ObjectReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*
              - Sid: BucketList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*
        - PolicyName: FunctionLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFunctionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub ${FunctionLogGroup.Arn}

  BacMcpToolFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: bac-mcp-tool
      Description: MCP tool Lambda for testing a Bedrock AgentCore Gateway used by an AWS operations agent
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Architectures:
        - x86_64
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 1024
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogFormat: Text
        LogGroup: !Ref FunctionLogGroup
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              event = event if isinstance(event, dict) else {}
              tool_name = None
              client_context = getattr(context, "client_context", None)
              custom = getattr(client_context, "custom", None) if client_context else None
              if isinstance(custom, dict):
                  tool_name = custom.get("bedrockAgentCoreToolName")
              if not tool_name:
                  tool_name = event.get("toolName") or event.get("name") or "unknown"
              arguments = event.get("arguments", event)

              logger.info("Received tool invocation: %s", tool_name)

              result = {
                  "tool": tool_name,
                  "arguments": arguments,
                  "message": "bac-mcp-tool echo response",
              }
              return {
                  "content": [
                      {"type": "text", "text": json.dumps(result, default=str)}
                  ],
                  "isError": False,
              }

  AgentCoreGatewayExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role assumed by Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke Lambda tool functions
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:gateway/*
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaInvoke
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeSameAccountFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*
        - PolicyName: AgentCoreManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageAgentCoreResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:*
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
        - PolicyName: PassRoleToAgentCore
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassRolesToAgentCoreOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
        - PolicyName: S3ObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ObjectReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*
              - Sid: BucketList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*
        - PolicyName: AgentCoreLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteAgentCoreLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*

    Value: !Ref BacMcpToolFunction

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: "EC2 Image Builder pipeline for a CIS L1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 AMI, preconfigured for Elastic Beanstalk."

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OPERATIONAL NOTES (read before relying on pipeline output)
#
# 1. VULNERABILITY SCANNING: ImageScanningConfiguration is enabled on the
#    pipeline. Scan findings are produced only when Amazon Inspector is
#    activated in this account and region. This template does not enable
#    Inspector, so you must activate it separately (console, CLI, or delegated
#    admin). Otherwise no scan findings are produced.
#
# 2. MARKETPLACE SUBSCRIPTION / PARENT IMAGE SELECTION:
#    - With UseCisMarketplaceImage=false (the default), the stack deploys in
#      any account. AMIs are built from the AWS-managed Amazon Linux 2023
#      ARM64 base image and are NOT CIS Level 1 hardened, so they do NOT meet
#      the stated hardening requirement. These AMIs carry the tag
#      CisHardened=false and the "-base" name suffix.
#    - To meet the requirement, subscribe to the CIS Hardened Image Level 1 on
#      Amazon Linux 2023 (ARM) AWS Marketplace product in the build account
#      and region, then update the stack with UseCisMarketplaceImage=true.
#      Without the subscription, stack creation or update fails with a 404 on
#      the parent image ARN.
#    - Recipient accounts, including the organization and the dev and prod
#      accounts, may also need their own subscription to launch the resulting
#      AMI.
#
# 3. ROOT DEVICE NAME: The template uses /dev/xvda as the root device name.
#    This is verified for the AWS-managed AL2023 ARM64 base image. Before
#    enabling the CIS path, verify the root device name of the CIS Marketplace
#    AMI. If it differs, the 50 GB mapping attaches a second volume instead of
#    resizing root.
#
# 4. PLACEHOLDER VALUES: The default OrganizationId (o-a1b2c3d4e5) and
#    SharedAccountIds (111111111111, 222222222222) let the stack deploy, but
#    they may cause the distribution or launch-permission step to fail at build
#    time. Replace them with real values before relying on pipeline output.
#
# 5. NETWORKING: Build and test instances have NO internet access. They reach
#    AWS only through VPC endpoints: interface endpoints for SSM, SSM
#    Messages, EC2 Messages, Image Builder, KMS, and CloudWatch Logs, plus an
#    S3 gateway endpoint for AL2023 dnf repositories, TOE artifacts, and log
#    uploads. If the CIS Marketplace image's dnf configuration points at
#    non-S3 mirrors, or the custom component later needs non-AWS downloads,
#    the update-linux component and the InstallPackages step will fail. In
#    that case, add the specific required endpoint or mirror rather than
#    reopening egress to 0.0.0.0/0.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Organization ID (o-xxxxxxxxxx) that receives launch permissions for the AMI. The default is a placeholder.
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    Default: 'o-a1b2c3d4e5'

  OrganizationManagementAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: 12-digit account ID of the Organization management account, used to build the organization ARN. Leave empty if this stack runs in the management account.
    AllowedPattern: '^(|[0-9]{12})$'
    Default: ''

  SharedAccountIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Dev and prod AWS account IDs that receive launch permissions for the AMI. The defaults are PLACEHOLDERS and must be replaced with real account IDs.
    Default: '111111111111,222222222222'

  UseCisMarketplaceImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Set to 'true' to build from the CIS Hardened Image Level 1 on Amazon Linux 2023 (ARM) Marketplace image. 'true' requires an active AWS Marketplace subscription to that product in this account and region; otherwise stack creation fails with a 404 on the parent image. 'false' builds from the AWS-managed Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 base image, which is NOT CIS hardened.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

Conditions:
  HasOrgMgmtAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationManagementAccountId, '']]
  UseCisImage: !Equals [!Ref UseCisMarketplaceImage, 'true']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (private only, AWS access via VPC endpoints)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: cis-al2023-eb-ami
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-a'
        - Key: Project
          Value: cis-al2023-eb-ami
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-b'
        - Key: Project

  PrefixListLookupLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:

      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogKmsKey.Arn

        - Key: Project
          Value: cis-al2023-eb-ami
        - Key: ManagedBy

  PrefixListLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the S3 managed prefix list lookup function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PrefixListLookup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteOwnLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt PrefixListLookupLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-prefix-list-lookup-role'
        - Key: Project
          Value: cis-al2023-eb-ami
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrefixListLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Resolves the regional S3 managed prefix list ID for security group egress rules
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PrefixListLookupRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref PrefixListLookupLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse


          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 's3-prefix-list-lookup')
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  name = event['ResourceProperties']['PrefixListName']
                  response = boto3.client('ec2').describe_managed_prefix_lists(
                      Filters=[{'Name': 'prefix-list-name', 'Values': [name]}]
                  )
                  prefix_lists = response.get('PrefixLists', [])
                  if not prefix_lists:
                      raise ValueError('Managed prefix list not found: ' + name)
                  prefix_list_id = prefix_lists[0]['PrefixListId']
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                                   {'PrefixListId': prefix_list_id}, prefix_list_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id,
                                   reason=str(exc))
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-prefix-list-lookup'
        - Key: Project
          Value: cis-al2023-eb-ami
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

              - kms:GenerateDataKey*

            Action: kms:CreateGrant

  EbPreconfigComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-preconfig'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Pre-configures a CIS L1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 image for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AmiKmsKey.Arn
      Data: |
        name: eb-preconfig
        description: Installs and configures prerequisites expected by Elastic Beanstalk on Amazon Linux 2023.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - dnf -y install aws-cfn-bootstrap python3 python3-pip jq rsyslog amazon-cloudwatch-agent tar gzip unzip
              - name: CreateWebappUser
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - getent group webapp >/dev/null || groupadd --system webapp
                    - id -u webapp >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --gid webapp --no-create-home --home-dir /var/app/current --shell /sbin/nologin webapp
              - name: CreateDirectories
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o webapp -g webapp /var/app /var/app/staging /var/app/current
                    - install -d -m 0750 -o root -g root /var/log/eb-engine
              - name: EnableServices
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - systemctl enable rsyslog
                    - systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
              - name: Cleanup
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - dnf clean all
                    - rm -rf /var/cache/dnf
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateConfiguration
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - command -v cfn-init
                    - command -v python3
                    - command -v jq
                    - id webapp
                    - test -d /var/app/staging
                    - test -d /var/app/current
                    - test -d /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                    - systemctl is-enabled rsyslog
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestConfiguration
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - test "$(uname -m)" = "aarch64"
                    - command -v cfn-init
                    - id webapp
                    - test -d /var/app/current
                    - systemctl is-active amazon-ssm-agent
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-preconfig'
        Project: cis-al2023-eb-ami
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Maths MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for testing, using API Gateway, Lambda and Cognito authentication.

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: 'dev'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores.
    Description: API Gateway deployment stage name.

  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'maths-mcp-users'
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.

  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'maths-mcp-client'
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool app client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  McpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Description: Placeholder handler for the Maths MCP server. Code will be updated later.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          CORS_HEADERS = {
              "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
              "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type,Authorization",
              "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET,POST,OPTIONS",
          }


          def _response(status, body):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json", **CORS_HEADERS},
                  "body": json.dumps(body),
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              method = event.get("httpMethod")
              path = event.get("resource")

              if method == "GET" and path == "/":
                  return _response(200, {"status": "healthy", "service": "maths-mcp"})

              if method == "POST" and path == "/mcp":
                  try:
                      request = json.loads(event.get("body") or "{}")
                  except json.JSONDecodeError:
                      return _response(400, {
                          "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                          "id": None,
                          "error": {"code": -32700, "message": "Parse error"},
                      })
                  return _response(200, {
                      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                      "id": request.get("id"),
                      "result": {"message": "Placeholder MCP handler; implementation pending."},
                  })

              return _response(404, {"message": "Not found"})

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: REST API for the Maths MCP server.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoAuthorizer
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${McpFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Amz-Date,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  HealthCheckMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${McpFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  LambdaApiGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref McpFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - McpPostMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod
      - HealthCheckMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Maths MCP API deployment.

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      Description: Maths MCP API stage.

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the Maths MCP API (public GET health check).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${DeploymentStage}/'

  McpEndpoint:
    Description: Cognito-protected MCP POST endpoint.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ApiStage}/mcp'

  RestApiId:
    Description: ID of the REST API.
    Value: !Ref RestApi

  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool app client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the MCP Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref McpFunction

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the MCP Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt McpFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Bookstore Cedar-based access control stack. Creates an Amazon Verified Permissions
  policy store with a strictly validated Bookstore schema, static Cedar policies for
  admins, publishers, customers, and named principals, and publishes the policy store
  ID as an SSM Parameter.

Resources:
  BookstorePolicyStore:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::PolicyStore
    Properties:
      Description: Cedar policy store for the Bookstore application
      ValidationSettings:
        Mode: STRICT
      Schema:
        CedarJson: |
          {
            "Bookstore": {
              "entityTypes": {
                "Role": {
                  "shape": {
                    "type": "Record",
                    "attributes": {}
                  }
                },
                "User": {
                  "memberOfTypes": ["Role"],
                  "shape": {
                    "type": "Record",
                    "attributes": {
                      "yearsAsMember": {
                        "type": "Long",
                        "required": false
                      }
                    }
                  }
                },
                "Book": {
                  "shape": {
                    "type": "Record",
                    "attributes": {
                      "owner": {
                        "type": "Entity",
                        "name": "User",
                        "required": true
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              "actions": {
                "View": {
                  "appliesTo": {
                    "principalTypes": ["User"],
                    "resourceTypes": ["Book"],
                    "context": {
                      "type": "Record",
                      "attributes": {
                        "region": {
                          "type": "String",
                          "required": true
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                },
                "ViewWithPremiumOffers": {
                  "appliesTo": {
                    "principalTypes": ["User"],
                    "resourceTypes": ["Book"],
                    "context": {
                      "type": "Record",
                      "attributes": {
                        "region": {
                          "type": "String",
                          "required": true
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }

  PolicyStoreIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/bookstore/policy-store-id'
      Description: Amazon Verified Permissions policy store ID for the Bookstore application
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore

  AdminViewPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit users in the Admin role to view any book
          Statement: |
            permit (
              principal in Bookstore::Role::"Admin",
              action == Bookstore::Action::"View",
              resource
            );

  ForbidNamedAdminViewPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Forbid the named administrator Alice from viewing books, overriding the Admin permit
          Statement: |
            forbid (
              principal == Bookstore::User::"Alice",
              action == Bookstore::Action::"View",
              resource
            );

  PublisherOwnBooksPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit users in the Publisher role to view only the books they own
          Statement: |
            permit (
              principal in Bookstore::Role::"Publisher",
              action == Bookstore::Action::"View",
              resource
            )
            when { principal == resource.owner };

  NamedUserNamedBookPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit the named user Bob to view the named book TheGreatGatsby
          Statement: |
            permit (
              principal == Bookstore::User::"Bob",
              action == Bookstore::Action::"View",
              resource == Bookstore::Book::"TheGreatGatsby"
            );

  CustomerPremiumOffersPermitPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit customers with two or more years of membership to view premium offers
          Statement: |
            permit (
              principal in Bookstore::Role::"Customer",
              action == Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers",
              resource
            )
            when { principal has yearsAsMember && principal.yearsAsMember >= 2 };

  CustomerPremiumOffersForbidPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Forbid customers with less than two years of membership from viewing premium offers
          Statement: |
            forbid (
              principal in Bookstore::Role::"Customer",
              action == Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers",
              resource

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Fargate ECS task definition that pulls a container image from an ECR repository
  created in this template. The image URI is built from the current account ID,
  region, repository name, and an immutable version tag. The template creates
  separate task and execution IAM roles and a CloudWatch Logs log group.
  Scope boundary: this template intentionally creates no ECS service, cluster,
  VPC, or subnets, because registering a task definition requires no networking
  resources. Note: the image identified by the RepositoryName and ImageTag
  parameters (<RepositoryName>:<ImageTag>) does not exist in a new account until
  it is pushed. Task definition registration succeeds without it, but you must
  push the image before running tasks.

Parameters:
  RepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: sample-app
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._/-][a-z0-9]+)*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by '.', '_', '-', or '/'.
    Description: Name of the ECR repository that this template creates and the task definition references.

  ImageTag:
    Type: String
    Default: v1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,128}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 1-128 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', or '-'. Use a specific
      version tag, not 'latest'.
    Description: Specific immutable image tag to deploy, for example v1.0.0. Do not use 'latest'.

Resources:
  # Same-account pulls are authorized through the execution role's IAM
  # permissions, so no repository policy is required.
  EcrRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Ref RepositoryName
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Expire untagged images older than 14 days",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "untagged",
                  "countType": "sinceImagePushed",
                  "countUnit": "days",
                  "countNumber": 14
                },
                "action": {
                  "type": "expire"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref RepositoryName

  ContainerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${AWS::StackName}/${RepositoryName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref RepositoryName

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: ECS task execution role used to pull the image from ECR and write container logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcrPullAndLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # GetAuthorizationToken does not support resource-level permissions.
              - Sid: EcrAuthToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrPullFromRepository
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: !GetAtt EcrRepository.Arn
              - Sid: WriteContainerLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref RepositoryName

  # Runtime identity for the application container. It intentionally has no
  # permissions. Add inline policies here when the application needs to call AWS APIs.
  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Runtime IAM role assumed by the application container.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref RepositoryName

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-task'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      RuntimePlatform:
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: app
          Image: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${RepositoryName}:${ImageTag}'
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ContainerLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: app
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref RepositoryName

Outputs:
  ImageUri:
    Description: >-
      Full ECR image URI referenced by the task definition. Push the image with
      this exact repository and tag before running tasks.
    Value: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${RepositoryName}:${ImageTag}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ImageUri'

  RepositoryUri:
    Description: URI of the ECR repository. Push images to this URI.
    Value: !GetAtt EcrRepository.RepositoryUri
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RepositoryUri'

  RepositoryArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECR repository.
    Value: !GetAtt EcrRepository.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RepositoryArn'

  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Fargate ECS task definition.
    Value: !Ref TaskDefinition
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TaskDefinitionArn'

  TaskExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TaskExecutionRoleArn'

  TaskRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task role, the application's runtime identity.
    Value: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TaskRoleArn'

  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for container logs.
    Value: !Ref ContainerLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LogGroupName'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: nih-grants Cognito authentication stack - User Pool with MFA and advanced security, Identity Pool, app clients, IAM roles, and encrypted S3 context bucket.

Parameters:
  AllowUnauthenticatedAccess:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether the identity pool allows unauthenticated identities.

Conditions:
  EnableUnauthAccess: !Equals
    - !Ref AllowUnauthenticatedAccess
    - 'true'

Resources:
  S3DataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for nih-grants S3 context bucket encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: nih-grants

  S3DataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/nih-grants-s3-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref S3DataKey

  ContextBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub nih-grants-context-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt S3DataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: nih-grants

  ContextBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ContextBucket

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ContextBucket.Arn
              - !Sub ${ContextBucket.Arn}/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: nih-grants-user-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: 'ON'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 11
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailSubject: Your verification code
        EmailMessage: 'Your verification code is {####}'
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: nih-grants

  WebUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: nih-grants-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: nih-grants-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: nih_grants_identity_pool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: !If
        - EnableUnauthAccess
        - true
        - false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref WebUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
        - ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nih-grants-cognito-authenticated-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: nih-grants-authenticated-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObjectTagging
                Resource: !Sub ${ContextBucket.Arn}/*
              - Sid: KmsDataKeyAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt S3DataKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:RequestAlias: alias/nih-grants-s3-key
              - Sid: WebSocketConnect
                Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:Invoke
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/$connect
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: nih-grants

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nih-grants-cognito-unauthenticated-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: nih-grants

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless email-submission REST API (API Gateway POST /email -> Amazon SES SendEmail)
  using a direct AWS service integration with JSON schema request validation, secured with
  an API key and a usage plan (500 rps throttle, 1000 burst, 10,000 requests per month quota).

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Stage name may contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores.
    Description: Name of the API Gateway deployment stage.

  ApiKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: email-apikey
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: API key name may contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.
    Description: Name of the API Gateway API key used by clients.

Resources:
  EmailApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-email-api'
      Description: REST API that accepts email submissions and sends them through Amazon SES.
      ApiKeySourceType: HEADER
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  EmailResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt EmailApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: email

  EmailModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      ContentType: application/json
      Name: EmailRequest
      Description: Schema for an email submission request.
      Schema:
        $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#'
        title: EmailRequest
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required:
          - to
          - from
          - html
          - text
        properties:
          to:
            type: array
            minItems: 1
            items:
              type: string
              minLength: 3
          from:
            type: string
            minLength: 3
          html:
            type: string
          text:
            type: string
          cc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
              minLength: 3
          bcc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
              minLength: 3
          subject:
            type: string

  BodyValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Reusable nested stack that subscribes optional email, SQS, Lambda, and HTTPS
  endpoints to a caller-supplied SNS topic. The parent stack is responsible for
  creating the SNS topic, SQS queue (including its queue policy), and Lambda
  function, and for passing their ARNs into this stack. TopicArn is required in
  practice but defaults to the "none" sentinel so the template can be deployed
  standalone; with TopicArn set to "none" no subscriptions are created.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: SNS Topic
        Parameters:
          - TopicArn
      - Label:
          default: Optional Subscription Endpoints
        Parameters:
          - EmailAddress
          - SqsQueueArn
          - LambdaFunctionArn
          - HttpsEndpoint
    ParameterLabels:
      TopicArn:
        default: SNS topic ARN (required in practice; none disables all subscriptions)
      EmailAddress:
        default: Email address (example@example.com disables)
      SqsQueueArn:
        default: SQS queue ARN (none disables)
      LambdaFunctionArn:
        default: Lambda function ARN (none disables)
      HttpsEndpoint:
        default: HTTPS endpoint URL (none disables)

Parameters:
  TopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      ARN of the SNS topic to subscribe endpoints to. Real usage requires the
      parent stack to pass the topic ARN. Leave as none to create no subscriptions.
    Default: none
    AllowedPattern: '^(none|arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:sns:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,256}(\.fifo)?)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be none (no subscriptions are created) or a valid SNS topic ARN supplied by the parent stack.

  EmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Description: Email address to subscribe. Leave as example@example.com to skip the email subscription.
    Default: example@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address.

  SqsQueueArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      ARN of the SQS queue to subscribe. Leave as none to skip the SQS subscription.
      The parent stack must grant sns.amazonaws.com sqs:SendMessage on the queue.
    Default: none
    AllowedPattern: '^(none|arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:sqs:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}(\.fifo)?)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be none or a valid SQS queue ARN.

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function to subscribe. Leave as none to skip the Lambda subscription.
    Default: none
    AllowedPattern: '^(none|arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:lambda:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:function:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}(:[A-Za-z0-9$_-]+)?)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be none or a valid Lambda function ARN.

  HttpsEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Description: HTTPS endpoint URL to subscribe. Leave as none to skip the HTTPS subscription.
    Default: none
    AllowedPattern: '^(none|https://.+)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be none or a URL beginning with https://.

Conditions:
  HasTopic: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref TopicArn
      - none
  CreateEmailSubscription: !And
    - !Condition HasTopic
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Ref EmailAddress
        - example@example.com
  CreateSqsSubscription: !And
    - !Condition HasTopic
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Ref SqsQueueArn
        - none
  CreateLambdaSubscription: !And
    - !Condition HasTopic
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
        - none
  CreateHttpsSubscription: !And
    - !Condition HasTopic
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Ref HttpsEndpoint
        - none

Resources:
  # Stateless, cost-free placeholder. CloudFormation rejects a stack in which
  # every resource is excluded by conditions, which happens when all
  # parameters are left at their sentinel defaults.
  StackPlaceholder:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::WaitConditionHandle

  EmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateEmailSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref EmailAddress
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn

  SqsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateSqsSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: sqs
      Endpoint: !Ref SqsQueueArn
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn

  LambdaSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateLambdaSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: lambda
      Endpoint: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: CreateLambdaSubscription
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
      Principal: sns.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Ref TopicArn

  HttpsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateHttpsSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: https
      Endpoint: !Ref HttpsEndpoint
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn
      DeliveryPolicy:
        healthyRetryPolicy:
          minDelayTarget: 1
          maxDelayTarget: 60
          numRetries: 50
          numNoDelayRetries: 3
          numMinDelayRetries: 2
          numMaxDelayRetries: 35
          backoffFunction: exponential
        throttlePolicy:
          maxReceivesPerSecond: 10

Outputs:
  EmailSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: CreateEmailSubscription
    Description: ARN of the email subscription (reports pending confirmation until the recipient confirms).
    Value: !Ref EmailSubscription
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EmailSubscriptionArn'

  SqsSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: CreateSqsSubscription
    Description: ARN of the SQS subscription.
    Value: !Ref SqsSubscription
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SqsSubscriptionArn'

  LambdaSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: CreateLambdaSubscription
    Description: ARN of the Lambda subscription.
    Value: !Ref LambdaSubscription
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LambdaSubscriptionArn'

  HttpsSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: CreateHttpsSubscription
    Description: ARN of the HTTPS subscription.
    Value: !Ref HttpsSubscription
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HttpsSubscriptionArn'

# NOTE: The original request specified Node.js 20.x. AWS disabled function creation on
# nodejs20.x on 2026-06-01, so the runtime has been deliberately changed to nodejs24.x,
# the newest supported Node.js runtime. The inline async CommonJS handler is compatible as-is.
Description: Step Functions calculator demo - a Choice-based state machine that routes arithmetic operations to a Node.js 24.x Lambda function.

Resources:
  CalculatorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/Calculator
      RetentionInDays: 3

  CalculatorLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CalculatorLambdaLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CalculatorLogGroup.Arn

  CalculatorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CalculatorLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: Calculator
      Description: Performs add, subtract, multiply, or divide on two operands.
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CalculatorLambdaRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          class CalculatorError extends Error {
            constructor(name, message) {
              super(message);
              this.name = name;
            }
          }

          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const operator = event && event.operator;
            const operands = event && event.operands;

            if (!Array.isArray(operands) || operands.length !== 2) {
              throw new CalculatorError('InvalidOperands', 'operands must be an array of exactly two numbers');
            }

            const [a, b] = operands.map(Number);
            if (!Number.isFinite(a) || !Number.isFinite(b)) {
              throw new CalculatorError('InvalidOperands', 'operands must be finite numbers');
            }

            let result;
            switch (operator) {
              case 'add':
                result = a + b;
                break;
              case 'subtract':
                result = a - b;
                break;
              case 'multiply':
                result = a * b;
                break;
              case 'divide':
                if (b === 0) {
                  throw new CalculatorError('DivisionByZero', 'Cannot divide by zero');
                }
                result = a / b;
                break;
              default:
                throw new CalculatorError('UnsupportedOperator', `Unsupported operator: ${operator}`);
            }

            console.log(JSON.stringify({ operator, operands: [a, b], result }));
            return { operator, operands: [a, b], result };
          };

  CalculatorStateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CalculatorInvokeLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CalculatorFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CalculatorFunction.Arn}:*'

  CalculatorStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: Calculator-StateMachine
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt CalculatorStateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        CalculatorFunctionArn: !GetAtt CalculatorFunction.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Calculator demo that routes to an arithmetic operation based on the operator.
        StartAt: Select Operation
        States:
          Select Operation:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: $.operator
                StringEquals: add
                Next: Add
              - Variable: $.operator
                StringEquals: subtract
                Next: Subtract
              - Variable: $.operator
                StringEquals: multiply
                Next: Multiply
              - Variable: $.operator
                StringEquals: divide
                Next: Divide
            Default: UnknownOperator
          Add:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${CalculatorFunctionArn}
              Payload.$: $
            OutputPath: $.Payload
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            End: true
          Subtract:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${CalculatorFunctionArn}
              Payload.$: $
            OutputPath: $.Payload
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            End: true
          Multiply:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${CalculatorFunctionArn}
              Payload.$: $
            OutputPath: $.Payload
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            End: true
          Divide:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${CalculatorFunctionArn}
              Payload.$: $
            OutputPath: $.Payload
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            End: true
          UnknownOperator:
            Type: Fail
            Error: UnsupportedOperator
            Cause: Operator must be one of add, subtract, multiply, divide

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Calculator state machine
    Value: !Ref CalculatorStateMachine
  StateMachineName:
    Description: Name of the Calculator state machine
    Value: !GetAtt CalculatorStateMachine.Name
  CalculatorFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Calculator Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt CalculatorFunction.Arn
  CalculatorFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the Calculator Lambda function
    Value: !Ref CalculatorFunction
  CalculatorLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch log group for the Calculator Lambda function
    Value: !Ref CalculatorLogGroup
  SampleInput:
    Description: Sample execution input for the Calculator state machine (operator is one of add, subtract, multiply, divide)
