      - t3.large
      - m5.large
      - m6i.large
    Description: Instance type used for the Image Builder build and test instances.

Conditions:
  HasOrganizationId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationId, '']]
  HasOrganizationManagementAccountId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationManagementAccountId, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.20.0.0/24
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.20.0.0/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-public-subnet'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.20.0.64/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-igw'

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-nat'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-rt'

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ESCALATION (Trivy AWS-0104): the HTTPS egress rule below intentionally targets 0.0.0.0/0.
  # The build must download packages from third-party, CDN-fronted hosts (repo.mongodb.org,
  # pgp.mongodb.com, pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org, dot.net / Microsoft CDN) via the NAT Gateway,
  # and none of them publish stable CIDRs or AWS-managed prefix lists. This finding conflicts with a
  # stated functional requirement and must be resolved by the pipeline owner outside this template:
  #   (a) record a documented risk acceptance for this ephemeral, ingress-less Image Builder security
  #       group (build/test instances terminate after each build, TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true), or
  #   (b) change the requirement so all packages come from an internal mirror (S3 / CodeArtifact),
  #       allowing egress to be limited to AWS endpoints only.
  # Optional defense-in-depth (does not clear the finding): AWS Network Firewall with a stateful
  # domain allowlist in a dedicated subnet between the private subnet and the NAT Gateway.
  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Image Builder build and test instances - no inbound, HTTPS outbound only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: >-
            HTTPS required for third-party package repositories (MongoDB, PyPI, Microsoft .NET) and
            AWS endpoints reached through the NAT Gateway; these hosts publish no stable CIDRs
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-build-sg'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Instance role for EC2 Image Builder build and test instances
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-instance-role'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder components
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SsmAgentComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssm-agent'
      Description: Installs or upgrades to the latest Amazon SSM Agent
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Data: |
        name: ssm-agent-latest
        description: Installs or upgrades to the latest Amazon SSM Agent
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallLatestSsmAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf install -y https://s3.amazonaws.com/ec2-downloads-windows/SSMAgent/latest/linux_amd64/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm
                      systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateSsmAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      rpm -q amazon-ssm-agent
                      systemctl is-enabled amazon-ssm-agent
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestSsmAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      rpm -q amazon-ssm-agent
                      systemctl is-active amazon-ssm-agent
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssm-agent'

  MongoToolsComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mongodb-tools'
      Description: Adds the MongoDB 8.0 yum repository and installs mongodb-database-tools and mongosh
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Data: |
        name: mongodb-tools
        description: Adds the MongoDB 8.0 yum repository and installs mongodb-database-tools and mongosh
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: CreateMongoRepo
                action: CreateFile
                inputs:
                  - path: /etc/yum.repos.d/mongodb-org-8.0.repo
                    overwrite: true
                    content: |
                      [mongodb-org-8.0]
                      name=MongoDB Repository
                      baseurl=https://repo.mongodb.org/yum/amazon/2023/mongodb-org/8.0/x86_64/
                      gpgcheck=1
                      enabled=1
                      gpgkey=https://pgp.mongodb.com/server-8.0.asc
              - name: InstallMongoTools
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf makecache -y
                      dnf install -y mongodb-database-tools mongodb-mongosh
                      dnf clean all
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateMongoTools
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      mongosh --version
                      mongodump --version
                      mongorestore --version
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestMongoTools
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      mongosh --version
                      mongodump --version
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mongodb-tools'

  PythonSynapseComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-python-synapse'
      Description: Installs Python 3.11 and the Synapse Python client (synapseclient)
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Data: |
        name: python-synapse
        description: Installs Python 3.11 and the Synapse Python client (synapseclient)
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallPython
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf install -y python3.11 python3.11-pip
                      dnf clean all
              - name: InstallSynapseClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      python3.11 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip
                      python3.11 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade synapseclient
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateSynapseClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      python3.11 --version
                      python3.11 -c "import synapseclient; print(synapseclient.__version__)"
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestSynapseClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      python3.11 -c "import synapseclient; print(synapseclient.__version__)"
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-python-synapse'

  DotnetRunnerComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dotnet-runner'
      Description: Installs the .NET 8 SDK and dependencies for a GitHub Actions self-hosted runner
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Data: |
        name: dotnet-runner
        description: Installs the .NET 8 SDK and dependencies for a GitHub Actions self-hosted runner
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallRunnerDependencies
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf install -y git jq tar gzip libicu krb5-libs openssl-libs zlib lttng-ust
              - name: InstallDotnetSdk
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      if ! dnf install -y dotnet-sdk-8.0; then
                        echo "dotnet-sdk-8.0 not available in AL2023 repositories, using dotnet-install.sh"
                        curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o /tmp/dotnet-install.sh
                        bash /tmp/dotnet-install.sh --channel 8.0 --install-dir /usr/share/dotnet
                        ln -sf /usr/share/dotnet/dotnet /usr/bin/dotnet
                        rm -f /tmp/dotnet-install.sh
                      fi
                      dnf clean all
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateDotnet
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dotnet --list-sdks | grep -E '^8\.'
                      git --version
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestDotnet
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1
                      export DOTNET_CLI_HOME=/tmp/dotnet-home
                      dotnet --info
                      dotnet --list-sdks | grep -E '^8\.'
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dotnet-runner'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder recipe, infrastructure and distribution
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-al2023-recipe'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 bastion image with SSM Agent, MongoDB tools, Python/Synapse and .NET SDK
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageId
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/update-linux/x.x.x'
        - ComponentArn: !Ref MongoToolsComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref PythonSynapseComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref DotnetRunnerComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SsmAgentComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      AdditionalInstanceConfiguration:
        SystemsManagerAgent:
          UninstallAfterBuild: false
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-al2023-recipe'

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-infrastructure'
      Description: Builds and tests in the private subnet with outbound access through the NAT Gateway
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      ResourceTags:
        Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-instance'
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-infrastructure'

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-distribution'
      Description: Publishes the AMI publicly and shares it with the configured AWS Organization
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-al2023-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: !Sub '${ProjectName} Amazon Linux 2023 bastion AMI'
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-al2023'
              Project: !Ref ProjectName
              ImageVersion: !Ref ImageVersion
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns: !If
                - HasOrganizationId
                - - !Sub
                    - 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${ManagementAccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
                    - ManagementAccountId: !If
                        - HasOrganizationManagementAccountId
                        - !Ref OrganizationManagementAccountId
                        - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-distribution'

  BastionImage:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Image
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DependsOn:
      - PrivateDefaultRoute
      - PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-al2023-image'

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    DependsOn:
      - PrivateDefaultRoute
      - PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-al2023-pipeline'
      Description: Manually triggered pipeline for rebuilding the bastion AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-al2023-pipeline'

Outputs:
  AmiId:
    Description: ID of the built Amazon Linux 2023 bastion AMI
    Value: !GetAtt BastionImage.ImageId

  ImageArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder image
    Value: !GetAtt BastionImage.Arn

  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder image recipe
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipe

  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder pipeline for manual rebuilds
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline

  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the build VPC
    Value: !Ref Vpc

  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the private build subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the NAT Gateway serving the private subnet
    Value: !Ref NatGateway

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Plot Palette DynamoDB data layer - Jobs, Queue, Templates, and CostTracking tables with on-demand billing, KMS encryption, and point-in-time recovery.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment name used in table names and tags.
    AllowedValues:
      - development
      - staging
      - production
    Default: production

Resources:
  JobsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-Jobs-${EnvironmentName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: created_at
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: user-id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: user_id
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: created_at
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: plot-palette
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  QueueTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-Queue-${EnvironmentName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: status
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: job_id_timestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: status
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: job_id_timestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: plot-palette
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TemplatesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-Templates-${EnvironmentName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: template_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: version
          AttributeType: N
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: template_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: version
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: user-id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: user_id
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: plot-palette
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  CostTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-CostTracking-${EnvironmentName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: timestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: timestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: plot-palette
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  JobsTableName:
    Description: Name of the Jobs table.
    Value: !Ref JobsTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-JobsTableName'

  QueueTableName:
    Description: Name of the Queue table.
    Value: !Ref QueueTable
    Export:

  Creates six monthly AWS cost budgets for security and monitoring services

    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'

      First linked member account ID for the CloudWatch budget. Leave empty to
      fall back to the current (payer) account ID.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  SageMaker notebook stack for RAPIDS AI development. Creates an IAM execution
  role, a lifecycle configuration that installs a RAPIDS AI conda environment
  and registers a Jupyter kernel, and an ml.t3.medium notebook instance named
  "rapidsai" that clones https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks. NOTE -
  ml.t3.medium has no GPU, but RAPIDS (cuDF, cuML) requires an NVIDIA GPU.
  The environment and kernel can be installed and explored, but RAPIDS GPU
  workloads will not execute until the instance type is changed to a GPU
  instance type (for example ml.g4dn.xlarge or ml.g5.xlarge).

Resources:
  RapidsNotebookExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: RAPIDS-AI-Development

  RapidsLifecycleConfig:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName: rapidsai-lifecycle-config
      OnCreate:
        - Content:
            Fn::Base64: |
              #!/bin/bash
              set -e

              # Install the RAPIDS AI conda environment as ec2-user.
              # The environment is created under /home/ec2-user/SageMaker so it
              # persists across notebook stop/start cycles. The install runs in
              # the background because lifecycle scripts must finish within
              # 5 minutes.
              sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'EOF'
              mkdir -p /home/ec2-user/SageMaker/custom-envs
              nohup bash -c '
              set -e
              source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/bin/activate
              export CONDA_OVERRIDE_CUDA=12.5
              conda create -y -p /home/ec2-user/SageMaker/custom-envs/rapids \
                -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia \
                rapids=24.12 python=3.12 cuda-version=12.5 ipykernel
              /home/ec2-user/SageMaker/custom-envs/rapids/bin/python -m ipykernel install \
                --user --name rapids --display-name "Python (RAPIDS)"
              echo "RAPIDS environment installation complete."
              ' > /home/ec2-user/SageMaker/rapids-install.log 2>&1 &
              EOF
      OnStart:
        - Content:
            Fn::Base64: |
              #!/bin/bash
              set -e

              # Re-register the persistent RAPIDS conda environment as a Jupyter
              # kernel on every start, since kernel specs under the home
              # directory outside /home/ec2-user/SageMaker are not persisted.
              sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'EOF'
              RAPIDS_ENV=/home/ec2-user/SageMaker/custom-envs/rapids
              LOG_FILE=/home/ec2-user/SageMaker/rapids-onstart.log
              if [ -x "$RAPIDS_ENV/bin/python" ]; then
                "$RAPIDS_ENV/bin/python" -m ipykernel install \
                  --user --name rapids --display-name "Python (RAPIDS)" >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1
                echo "$(date) RAPIDS kernel registered." >> "$LOG_FILE"
              else

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Deploys an optional SLO dashboard and CloudWatch alarms for the FSx for ONTAP /
  S3 Access Point event-driven pipeline pattern. All SLO resources are created only
  when EnableSloDashboard is set to "true". Alarm notifications are optionally
  forwarded to an SNS topic when AlarmSnsTopicArn is provided.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - EnableSloDashboard
          - ProjectPrefix
          - DashboardRegion
          - AlarmSnsTopicArn
      - Label:
          default: Metric Namespaces
        Parameters:
          - MetricNamespace
          - CanaryMetricNamespace
      - Label:
          default: SLO Thresholds
        Parameters:
          - EventIngestionLatencyThreshold
          - ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold
          - FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold
          - ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold

Parameters:
  EnableSloDashboard:
    Type: String
    Description: Master switch. Set to "true" to deploy the SLO dashboard and alarms.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Name prefix for the dashboard and all alarms.
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudWatch namespace for the four SLO metrics.
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255

  CanaryMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudWatch namespace for the synthetic canary metrics.
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255

  DashboardRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: Region used by the dashboard widgets to query metrics.
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-\d$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region code (e.g. us-east-1).

  AlarmSnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional SNS topic ARN for alarm notifications. Leave empty to disable notifications.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:sns:.*$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid SNS topic ARN.

  EventIngestionLatencyThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: P99 event ingestion latency SLO threshold, in seconds.
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 0

  ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: Average processing success rate SLO threshold, in percent. Alarm fires below this value.
    Default: 99.5
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 100

  FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum FPolicy reconnect time SLO threshold, in seconds.
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0

  ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum replay completion time SLO threshold, in seconds (300 = 5 minutes).
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0

Conditions:
  IsEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableSloDashboard
    - 'true'
  HasSnsTopic: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
      - ''

Resources:
  # Unconditional placeholder so the stack always has at least one resource
  # when EnableSloDashboard is "false".
  SloPlaceholderHandle:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::WaitConditionHandle

  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${ProjectPrefix}-slo-event-ingestion-latency
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        SLO breach: P99 event ingestion latency exceeded
        ${EventIngestionLatencyThreshold} seconds for 3 consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency
      ExtendedStatistic: p99
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${ProjectPrefix}-slo-processing-success-rate
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        SLO breach: average processing success rate fell below
        ${ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold}% for 3 consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${ProjectPrefix}-slo-fpolicy-reconnect-time
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        SLO breach: maximum FPolicy reconnect time exceeded
        ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold} seconds for 3 consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: FPolicyReconnectTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${ProjectPrefix}-slo-replay-completion-time
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        SLO breach: maximum replay completion time exceeded
        ${ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold} seconds for 3 consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ReplayCompletionTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  SloDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub ${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "text",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 2,
              "properties": {
                "markdown": "# ${ProjectPrefix} SLO Dashboard\nFSx for ONTAP / S3 Access Point event-driven pipeline SLOs (namespace: ${MetricNamespace}) and synthetic canaries (namespace: ${CanaryMetricNamespace})."
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Event Ingestion Latency (P99)",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "stat": "p99",
                "period": 300,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EventIngestionLatency", { "stat": "p99", "period": 300, "label": "P99 latency (s)" } ]
                ],
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0, "label": "Seconds", "showUnits": false } },
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    { "label": "SLO: P99 <= ${EventIngestionLatencyThreshold}s", "value": ${EventIngestionLatencyThreshold}, "color": "#d62728" }
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Processing Success Rate (Average)",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "stat": "Average",
                "period": 300,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "ProcessingSuccessRate", { "stat": "Average", "period": 300, "label": "Success rate (%)" } ]
                ],
                "yAxis": { "left": { "max": 100, "label": "Percent", "showUnits": false } },
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    { "label": "SLO: >= ${ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold}%", "value": ${ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold}, "color": "#d62728", "fill": "below" }
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 8,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "FPolicy Reconnect Time (Maximum)",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "stat": "Maximum",
                "period": 300,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "FPolicyReconnectTime", { "stat": "Maximum", "period": 300, "label": "Max reconnect time (s)" } ]
                ],
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0, "label": "Seconds", "showUnits": false } },
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    { "label": "SLO: Max <= ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold}s", "value": ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold}, "color": "#d62728" }
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 8,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Replay Completion Time (Maximum)",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "stat": "Maximum",
                "period": 300,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "ReplayCompletionTime", { "stat": "Maximum", "period": 300, "label": "Max replay time (s)" } ]
                ],
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0, "label": "Seconds", "showUnits": false } },
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    { "label": "SLO: Max <= ${ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold}s", "value": ${ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold}, "color": "#d62728" }
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 14,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Canary: S3 Access Point Latency",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "stat": "Average",
                "period": 300,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3APListLatency", { "stat": "Average", "period": 300, "label": "S3AP List latency" } ],
                  [ "${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3APGetLatency", { "stat": "Average", "period": 300, "label": "S3AP Get latency" } ]
                ],
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0 } }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 14,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Canary: ONTAP Health Check",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "stat": "Minimum",
                "period": 300,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "OntapHealthCheck", { "stat": "Minimum", "period": 300, "label": "ONTAP health (1 = healthy)" } ]
                ],
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0, "max": 1 } }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "alarm",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 20,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "title": "SLO Alarm Status",
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "sortBy": "stateUpdatedTimestamp",
                "alarms": [
                  "${EventIngestionLatencyAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm.Arn}"
                ]
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  SloDashboardName:
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Description: Name of the SLO CloudWatch dashboard.
    Value: !Ref SloDashboard

  SloDashboardUrl:
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Description: Console URL of the SLO CloudWatch dashboard.
    Value: !Sub https://${DashboardRegion}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${DashboardRegion}#dashboards:name=${SloDashboard}

  EventIngestionLatencyAlarmArn:
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Description: ARN of the EventIngestionLatency SLO alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt EventIngestionLatencyAlarm.Arn

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarmArn:
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Description: ARN of the ProcessingSuccessRate SLO alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm.Arn

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarmArn:
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Description: ARN of the FPolicyReconnectTime SLO alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm.Arn

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarmArn:
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Description: ARN of the ReplayCompletionTime SLO alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a self-service Cognito user pool for testing JWT authentication flows
  with an AgentCore Gateway and MCP server. Includes email-based self-service
  signup with email verification, a hosted UI domain, a resource server with
  custom scopes (api/mcp, api/gateway), a public PKCE web client, and two
  machine-to-machine (client credentials) clients whose credentials are stored
  in Secrets Manager.

# Notes on intentional omissions:
# - Managed login branding (AWS::Cognito::ManagedLoginBranding) and the
#   ManagedLoginVersion property on the domain are intentionally omitted;
#   the classic hosted UI is used for signup and login pages.
# - UserPoolTier and advanced security features (UserPoolAddOns) are
#   intentionally omitted to avoid unverified property usage and extra cost.

Parameters:
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "http://localhost:3000/callback,http://localhost:8080/callback"
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed OAuth callback URLs for the web client.

  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "http://localhost:3000/logout,http://localhost:8080/logout"
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed sign-out URLs for the web client.

  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: agentcore-auth-test
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,40}[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 1-42 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens, must not start or end
      with a hyphen, and must not contain the reserved words aws, amazon, or cognito.
    Description: >-
      Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. The AWS account ID is appended
      to make the domain globally unique.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      # Self-service signup: users may register without admin intervention
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      # Users sign in with their email address
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      # Email verification without admin intervention
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailSubject: Verify your email address
        EmailMessage: 'Your verification code is {####}'
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      UserPoolTags:
        Purpose: agentcore-jwt-auth-testing

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub '${DomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: api
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: mcp
          ScopeDescription: Access to the MCP server
        - ScopeName: gateway
          ScopeDescription: Access to the AgentCore Gateway

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      # Authorization code grant; PKCE is enforced for public clients without a secret
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - api/mcp
        - api/gateway
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  # client_credentials only issues access tokens; ID and refresh token
  # validity are set as requested but are not exercised by this grant.
  GatewayM2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-gateway-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - api/gateway
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  McpM2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mcp-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - api/mcp
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  GatewayM2MClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/gateway-m2m-client'
      Description: Client credentials for the AgentCore Gateway M2M Cognito app client.
      SecretString: !Sub
        - '{"client_id":"${ClientId}","client_secret":"${ClientSecret}","scope":"api/gateway","token_endpoint":"https://${Domain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"}'
        - ClientId: !Ref GatewayM2MClient
          ClientSecret: !GetAtt GatewayM2MClient.ClientSecret
          Domain: !Ref UserPoolDomain

  McpM2MClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/mcp-m2m-client'
      Description: Client credentials for the MCP server M2M Cognito app client.
      SecretString: !Sub
        - '{"client_id":"${ClientId}","client_secret":"${ClientSecret}","scope":"api/mcp","token_endpoint":"https://${Domain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"}'
        - ClientId: !Ref McpM2MClient
          ClientSecret: !GetAtt McpM2MClient.ClientSecret
          Domain: !Ref UserPoolDomain

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  IssuerURL:
    Description: JWT issuer URL for AgentCore Gateway and MCP server JWT authorizer configuration.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderURL

  DiscoveryURL:
    Description: OIDC discovery URL for AgentCore Gateway and MCP server JWT authorizer configuration.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  HostedUIBaseURL:
    Description: Base URL of the Cognito hosted UI for signup and login.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  WebClientId:
    Description: Public web client ID (authorization code with PKCE, USER_PASSWORD_AUTH, USER_SRP_AUTH).
    Value: !Ref WebClient

  GatewayM2MClientId:
    Description: Gateway machine-to-machine client ID.
    Value: !Ref GatewayM2MClient

  McpM2MClientId:
    Description: MCP server machine-to-machine client ID.
    Value: !Ref McpM2MClient

  GatewayM2MClientSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the gateway M2M client credentials.
    Value: !Ref GatewayM2MClientSecret

  McpM2MClientSecretArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito machine-to-machine (client credentials) authentication, a customer-managed KMS key for EventBridge, and a Cognito-secured API Gateway REST API.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyServerlessLandUserPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyWebClient
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool app client.
  CallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com/callback
    Description: Callback URL for the app client.
  LogoutURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com/logout
    Description: Logout URL for the app client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      MfaConfiguration: 'OPTIONAL'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Join
        - '-'
        - - 'petstore-auth'
          - !Select
            - 4
            - !Split
              - '-'
              - !Select
                - 2
                - !Split
                  - '/'
                  - !Ref 'AWS::StackId'

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: petstore-api.example.com
      Name: PetStoreApiResourceServer
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: domestic.read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to domestic pets

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackURL
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref LogoutURL
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  EventBridgeKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for EventBridge encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  EventBridgeKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-eventbridge-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EventBridgeKmsKey

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs'

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  PetStoreApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-petstore-api'
      Description: PetStore API secured by Cognito User Pool authorizer
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoUserPoolAuthorizer
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      RestApiId: !Ref PetStoreApi
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PetsResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PetStoreApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt PetStoreApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: pets

  PetsPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PetStoreApi
      ResourceId: !Ref PetsResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      AuthorizationScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      Integration:
        Type: HTTP_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: http://petstore-demo-endpoint.execute-api.com/petstore/pets

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: PetsPostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PetStoreApi
      Description: PetStore API deployment

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref PetStoreApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      TracingEnabled: true
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          MetricsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Invoke URL of the PetStore POST /pets endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${PetStoreApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ProdStage}/pets'
  AppClientId:
    Description: Cognito app client ID (retrieve the secret via DescribeUserPoolClient)
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge customer-managed KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeKmsKey.Arn
  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: Cognito OAuth2 token endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Tag-driven AWS Backup infrastructure. Resources tagged backup=daily, backup=weekly
  or backup=monthly are backed up automatically at 05:00 UTC on their respective
  schedules (daily retained 14 days, weekly on Sunday retained 56 days, monthly on
  the 1st retained 365 days) into separate KMS-encrypted backup vaults. Includes a
  rotating customer-managed KMS key, an AWS Backup service role, and Service Catalog
  TagOptions for the backup tag values associated with a self-contained portfolio.

Resources:
  BackupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed KMS key encrypting AWS Backup vaults for stack ${AWS::StackName}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUseOfKeyThroughAWSBackup
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              - 'kms:CreateGrant'
              - 'kms:ListGrants'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'backup.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-backup-key'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: TagBasedBackup

  BackupKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-backup-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BackupKmsKey

  DailyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
      BackupVaultTags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: TagBasedBackup
        Schedule: daily

  WeeklyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-weekly-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
      BackupVaultTags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: TagBasedBackup
        Schedule: weekly

  MonthlyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
      BackupVaultTags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: TagBasedBackup
        Schedule: monthly

  BackupServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role assumed by AWS Backup to create and restore recovery points
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForRestores'
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: TagBasedBackup

  DailyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-plan'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyBackupRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref DailyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 * * ? *)'
            ScheduleExpressionTimezone: Etc/UTC
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 180
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 14
            RecoveryPointTags:
              ManagedBy: CloudFormation
              Purpose: TagBasedBackup
              Schedule: daily
      BackupPlanTags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: TagBasedBackup
        Schedule: daily

  WeeklyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-weekly-plan'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: WeeklyBackupRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref WeeklyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 ? * SUN *)'
            ScheduleExpressionTimezone: Etc/UTC
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 360
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 56
            RecoveryPointTags:
              ManagedBy: CloudFormation
              Purpose: TagBasedBackup
              Schedule: weekly
      BackupPlanTags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: TagBasedBackup
        Schedule: weekly

  MonthlyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-plan'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: MonthlyBackupRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref MonthlyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 1 * ? *)'
            ScheduleExpressionTimezone: Etc/UTC
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 720
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 365
            RecoveryPointTags:
              ManagedBy: CloudFormation
              Purpose: TagBasedBackup
              Schedule: monthly
      BackupPlanTags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: TagBasedBackup
        Schedule: monthly

  DailyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref DailyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-selection'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: daily

  WeeklyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref WeeklyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-weekly-selection'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: weekly

  MonthlyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref MonthlyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-selection'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: monthly

  BackupTagOptionDaily:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: daily
      Active: true

  BackupTagOptionWeekly:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: weekly
      Active: true

  BackupTagOptionMonthly:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: monthly
      Active: true

  BackupPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-backup-portfolio'
      ProviderName: Platform Engineering
      Description: Portfolio exposing backup TagOptions (daily, weekly, monthly) so provisioned products are enrolled in AWS Backup plans
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: TagBasedBackup

  BackupTagOptionDailyAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOptionAssociation
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref BackupPortfolio
      TagOptionId: !Ref BackupTagOptionDaily

  BackupTagOptionWeeklyAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOptionAssociation
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref BackupPortfolio
      TagOptionId: !Ref BackupTagOptionWeekly

  BackupTagOptionMonthlyAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOptionAssociation
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref BackupPortfolio
      TagOptionId: !Ref BackupTagOptionMonthly

Outputs:
  BackupKmsKeyId:
    Description: ID of the KMS key encrypting the backup vaults
    Value: !Ref BackupKmsKey
  BackupKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key encrypting the backup vaults
    Value: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
  BackupKmsKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the backup KMS key
    Value: !Ref BackupKmsKeyAlias
  DailyBackupVaultName:
    Description: Name of the daily backup vault
    Value: !Ref DailyBackupVault
  DailyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: ARN of the daily backup vault
    Value: !GetAtt DailyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn
  WeeklyBackupVaultName:
    Description: Name of the weekly backup vault
    Value: !Ref WeeklyBackupVault
  WeeklyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: ARN of the weekly backup vault
    Value: !GetAtt WeeklyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn
  MonthlyBackupVaultName:
    Description: Name of the monthly backup vault
    Value: !Ref MonthlyBackupVault
  MonthlyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: ARN of the monthly backup vault
    Value: !GetAtt MonthlyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn
  DailyBackupPlanId:
    Description: ID of the daily backup plan
    Value: !Ref DailyBackupPlan
  DailyBackupPlanArn:
    Description: ARN of the daily backup plan
    Value: !GetAtt DailyBackupPlan.BackupPlanArn
  WeeklyBackupPlanId:
    Description: ID of the weekly backup plan
    Value: !Ref WeeklyBackupPlan
  WeeklyBackupPlanArn:
    Description: ARN of the weekly backup plan
    Value: !GetAtt WeeklyBackupPlan.BackupPlanArn
  MonthlyBackupPlanId:
    Description: ID of the monthly backup plan
    Value: !Ref MonthlyBackupPlan
  MonthlyBackupPlanArn:
    Description: ARN of the monthly backup plan
    Value: !GetAtt MonthlyBackupPlan.BackupPlanArn
  BackupServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM service role used by AWS Backup
    Value: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
  BackupPortfolioId:
    Description: ID of the Service Catalog portfolio associated with the backup TagOptions
    Value: !Ref BackupPortfolio
  BackupTagOptionDailyId:
    Description: ID of the Service Catalog TagOption backup=daily
    Value: !Ref BackupTagOptionDaily
  BackupTagOptionWeeklyId:
    Description: ID of the Service Catalog TagOption backup=weekly
    Value: !Ref BackupTagOptionWeekly
  BackupTagOptionMonthlyId:
    Description: ID of the Service Catalog TagOption backup=monthly
    Value: !Ref BackupTagOptionMonthly

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a self-contained Route 53 public hosted zone and all DNS records for
  the organisation's external services (Squarespace website, Google Workspace
  mail and DKIM, DMARC, office printer, Zendesk helpdesk, and Campaign Monitor
  email marketing).

# NOTE: The DKIM public keys, verification tokens and the Campaign Monitor MX
# host below default to clearly non-functional placeholders so that this stack
# deploys successfully in a greenfield account. Real values MUST be supplied
# through a stack update before the vendor services (Google Workspace, Zendesk,
# Campaign Monitor) will validate. Until then the stack is healthy but those
# integrations remain unverified.
#
# NOTE: A single TXT character-string is limited to 255 characters. If a real
# DKIM public key (e.g. a 2048-bit RSA key) exceeds this, split the value into
# multiple quoted strings within the same ResourceRecords entry, for example:
#   '"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkq..." "...remainderOfKey"'

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Domain
        Parameters:
          - DomainName
      - Label:
          default: Google Workspace
        Parameters:
          - GoogleSiteVerificationToken
          - GoogleDkimPublicKey
      - Label:
          default: Internal Network
        Parameters:
          - PrinterPrivateIp
      - Label:
          default: Zendesk
        Parameters:
          - ZendeskVerificationToken
      - Label:
          default: Campaign Monitor
        Parameters:
          - CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKey
          - CampaignMonitorSubdomainLabel
          - CampaignMonitorMxTarget

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: podcastgarage.org
    Description: Apex domain name for the public hosted zone (no trailing dot).
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z]{2,}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid lowercase apex domain without a trailing dot.

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-REPLACE-WITH-GOOGLE-SITE-VERIFICATION-TOKEN
    Description: Google site verification token (the part after "google-site-verification=").
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, digits, underscores and hyphens.

  GoogleDkimPublicKey:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDERREPLACEWITHGOOGLEDKIMPUBLICKEY
    Description: Base64 Google Workspace DKIM public key (the value after "p=").
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a base64-encoded public key.

  PrinterPrivateIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 192.168.1.50
    Description: Private IPv4 address of the office printer on the local network.
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.

  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-REPLACE-WITH-ZENDESK-VERIFICATION-TOKEN
    Description: Zendesk domain verification token.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, digits, underscores and hyphens.

  CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKey:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDERREPLACEWITHCAMPAIGNMONITORDKIMPUBLICKEY
    Description: Base64 Campaign Monitor DKIM public key (the value after "p=").
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a base64-encoded public key.

  CampaignMonitorSubdomainLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: cmail
    Description: Label of the SPF-aligned Campaign Monitor sending subdomain (e.g. "cmail" for cmail.<domain>).
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a single valid lowercase DNS label.

  CampaignMonitorMxTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: mx.placeholder.invalid.
    Description: Fully qualified MX host provided by Campaign Monitor for the sending subdomain (trailing dot recommended).
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}\.?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid fully qualified host name.

Resources:
  PublicHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'Public hosted zone for ${DomainName} external services'
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  # Apex TXT: SPF policy and Google site verification combined in one RecordSet
  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:mail.zendesk.com ~all"'
        - !Sub '"google-site-verification=${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'

  # Squarespace website hosting
  ApexARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 198.185.159.144
        - 198.185.159.145
        - 198.49.23.144
        - 198.49.23.145

  WwwCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - ext-cust.squarespace.com

  # Google Workspace mail delivery
  ApexMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 1 smtp.google.com.

  DmarcTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@${DomainName}; pct=100"'

  GoogleDkimTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'google._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=${GoogleDkimPublicKey}"'

  # Office printer on the local network
  PrinterARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'printer.${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PrinterPrivateIp

  # Zendesk helpdesk integration
  ZendeskVerificationTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendeskverification.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${ZendeskVerificationToken}"'

  ZendeskMail1CnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail1.zendesk.com

  ZendeskMail2CnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk2.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail2.zendesk.com

  ZendeskMail3CnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk3.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail3.zendesk.com

  ZendeskMail4CnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk4.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail4.zendesk.com

  ZendeskDkim1CnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - zendesk1._domainkey.zendesk.com

  ZendeskDkim2CnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk2._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - zendesk2._domainkey.zendesk.com

  # Campaign Monitor email marketing integration
  CampaignMonitorDkimTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cm._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"k=rsa; p=${CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKey}"'

  CampaignMonitorSubdomainTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${CampaignMonitorSubdomainLabel}.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.createsend.com ~all"'

  CampaignMonitorSubdomainMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${CampaignMonitorSubdomainLabel}.${DomainName}.'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '10 ${CampaignMonitorMxTarget}'

Outputs:
  HostedZoneId:
    Description: ID of the Route 53 public hosted zone.
    Value: !Ref PublicHostedZone
  HostedZoneName:
    Description: Domain name served by the hosted zone.
    Value: !Ref DomainName
  NameServers:
    Description: Name servers to configure at the domain registrar.
    Value: !Join [',', !GetAtt PublicHostedZone.NameServers]
  WebsiteUrl:
    Description: Public website URL hosted on Squarespace.
    Value: !Sub 'https://www.${DomainName}'
  CampaignMonitorSendingDomain:
    Description: SPF-aligned Campaign Monitor sending subdomain.
    Value: !Sub '${CampaignMonitorSubdomainLabel}.${DomainName}'
