final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions IAM roles, managed policies, and the supporting messaging/data
  resources (customer managed KMS key, SQS queue, DynamoDB table with streams,
  SNS topic) for an e-commerce serverless architecture.

# Deployment note:
#   This template sets explicit RoleName and ManagedPolicyName values, so it must
#   be deployed with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM, for example:
#     aws cloudformation deploy --template-file template.yaml \
#       --stack-name ecommerce-iam-dev --parameter-overrides Environment=dev \
#       --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
#   All names include the Environment suffix so dev, test, and prod stacks can
#   coexist in one account.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used in resource names, tags, and export names.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption key for messaging resources
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MessagingKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for e-commerce messaging encryption (SQS queue and SNS topic).
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdminAndIamDelegation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  MessagingKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/ecommerce-messaging-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MessagingKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Messaging and data resources
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OrdersQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub 'POC-Queue-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt MessagingKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  OrdersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'ecommerce-orders-${Environment}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: orderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: orderId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  OrdersTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub 'POC-Topic-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt MessagingKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OrderProcessorLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ecommerce-order-processor-${Environment}'
      Description: Execution role for the Lambda that consumes the orders queue and writes to the orders table.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  StreamProcessorLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ecommerce-stream-processor-${Environment}'
      Description: Execution role for the Lambda that reads the orders table stream and publishes to the orders topic.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  ApiGatewaySqsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ecommerce-apigw-sqs-${Environment}'
      Description: Role assumed by API Gateway to send messages to the orders queue.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed policies (attached via the Roles property)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-lambda-basic-exec-${Environment}'
      Description: Allows Lambda functions to write logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
      Roles:
        - !Ref OrderProcessorLambdaRole
        - !Ref StreamProcessorLambdaRole

  SqsConsumerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-sqs-consumer-${Environment}'
      Description: Allows consuming messages from the KMS-encrypted orders queue.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowOrdersQueueConsume
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
              - sqs:GetQueueUrl
            Resource: !GetAtt OrdersQueue.Arn
          - Sid: AllowKmsDecryptViaSqs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: !GetAtt MessagingKey.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sqs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Roles:
        - !Ref OrderProcessorLambdaRole

  DynamoDbWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-dynamodb-write-${Environment}'
      Description: Allows writing items to the orders table.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowOrdersTableWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
            Resource: !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
      Roles:
        - !Ref OrderProcessorLambdaRole

  DynamoDbStreamReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-dynamodb-stream-read-${Environment}'
      Description: Allows reading records from the orders table stream.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowOrdersTableStreamRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:ListStreams
            Resource: !GetAtt OrdersTable.StreamArn
      Roles:
        - !Ref StreamProcessorLambdaRole

  SnsPublishPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a VPC with a public subnet and a private subnet, an internet gateway,
  and a NAT gateway with an Elastic IP that gives private-subnet resources outbound
  internet access. Use it to test private connectivity. NOTE: The NAT gateway and
  Elastic IP incur hourly charges. Delete this stack when testing completes.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: nat-test
    Description: Prefix applied to the Name tags of all resources.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (e.g. 172.18.0.0/16).

  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/22
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the public subnet. Must fall within the VPC CIDR.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (e.g. 172.18.0.0/22).

  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.32.0/21
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the private subnet. Must fall within the VPC CIDR.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (e.g. 172.18.32.0/21).

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet'

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt'

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet that hosts the NAT gateway.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetId'

  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the private subnet that routes outbound traffic through the NAT gateway.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetId'

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGatewayId'

  NatGatewayPublicIp:
    Description: Public IP address of the Elastic IP attached to the NAT gateway.
    Value: !Ref NatGatewayEIP
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGatewayPublicIp'

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the public route table.
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTableId'

  PrivateRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the private route table.
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableId'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions Amazon Athena named queries, plus the supporting data catalog (Glue database
  "appstream-usage" with sessions and applications tables), S3 buckets, and an Athena workgroup
  for AppStream 2.0 usage reporting. Both S3 buckets and the Athena query results are encrypted
  with a template-managed AWS KMS customer managed key (CMK). NOTE - AppStream 2.0 usage report
  subscriptions cannot be enabled through CloudFormation; they must be enabled separately and the
  reports delivered or replicated to UsageReportsBucket under the sessions/ and applications/
  prefixes. Any process delivering or replicating reports into UsageReportsBucket requires
  kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Encrypt on the CMK, which the key policy grants to in-account
  principals via the S3 service (kms:ViaService).

Resources:
  DataEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key encrypting AppStream 2.0 usage reports and Athena query results.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUseForAccountPrincipals
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  DataEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-appstream-usage'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataEncryptionKey

  UsageReportsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataEncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  UsageReportsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref UsageReportsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt UsageReportsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${UsageReportsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  AthenaResultsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataEncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireAthenaResults
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 30
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7

  AthenaResultsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AthenaResultsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AthenaResultsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AthenaResultsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: appstream-usage
        Description: Data catalog database for AppStream 2.0 usage reports.

  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: sessions
        Description: AppStream 2.0 sessions usage report.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          skip.header.line.count: '1'
          projection.enabled: 'true'
          projection.schedule.type: enum
          projection.schedule.values: DAILY
          projection.year.type: integer
          projection.year.range: '2019,2099'
          projection.month.type: integer
          projection.month.range: '1,12'
          projection.month.digits: '2'
          projection.day.type: integer
          projection.day.range: '1,31'
          projection.day.digits: '2'
          storage.location.template: !Sub 's3://${UsageReportsBucket}/sessions/schedule=${!schedule}/year=${!year}/month=${!month}/day=${!day}/'
        PartitionKeys:
          - Name: schedule
            Type: string
          - Name: year
            Type: string
          - Name: month
            Type: string
          - Name: day
            Type: string
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${UsageReportsBucket}/sessions/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: user_session_id
              Type: string
            - Name: aws_account_id
              Type: string
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: session_start_time
              Type: string
            - Name: session_end_time
              Type: string
            - Name: session_duration_in_seconds
              Type: int
            - Name: user_id
              Type: string
            - Name: user_arn
              Type: string
            - Name: authentication_type
              Type: string
            - Name: authentication_type_user_id
              Type: string
            - Name: fleet_name
              Type: string
            - Name: stack_name
              Type: string
            - Name: instance_type
              Type: string
            - Name: eni_private_ip_address
              Type: string
            - Name: connected_at_least_once
              Type: string
            - Name: client_ip_addresses
              Type: string
            - Name: google_analytics_client_id
              Type: string
            - Name: user_agent
              Type: string
            - Name: domain_joined
              Type: string
            - Name: max_session_duration
              Type: int
            - Name: session_type
              Type: string
            - Name: stream_view
              Type: string

  ApplicationsTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: applications
        Description: AppStream 2.0 applications usage report.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          skip.header.line.count: '1'
          projection.enabled: 'true'
          projection.schedule.type: enum
          projection.schedule.values: DAILY
          projection.year.type: integer
          projection.year.range: '2019,2099'
          projection.month.type: integer
          projection.month.range: '1,12'
          projection.month.digits: '2'
          projection.day.type: integer
          projection.day.range: '1,31'
          projection.day.digits: '2'
          storage.location.template: !Sub 's3://${UsageReportsBucket}/applications/schedule=${!schedule}/year=${!year}/month=${!month}/day=${!day}/'
        PartitionKeys:
          - Name: schedule
            Type: string
          - Name: year
            Type: string
          - Name: month
            Type: string
          - Name: day
            Type: string
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${UsageReportsBucket}/applications/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: user_session_id
              Type: string
            - Name: application_name
              Type: string

  AthenaWorkGroup:
    Type: AWS::Athena::WorkGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-appstream-usage'
      Description: Workgroup for AppStream 2.0 usage reporting queries.
      State: ENABLED
      RecursiveDeleteOption: false
      WorkGroupConfiguration:
        EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration: true
        PublishCloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        ResultConfiguration:
          OutputLocation: !Sub 's3://${AthenaResultsBucket}/results/'
          EncryptionConfiguration:
            EncryptionOption: SSE_KMS
            KmsKey: !GetAtt DataEncryptionKey.Arn

  AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AvgSessionLengthPerStack-CurrentMonth
      Description: Session count and average session length in minutes per stack for the current month.
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT stack_name,
               count(*) AS session_count,
               avg(session_duration_in_seconds) / 60 AS avg_session_minutes
        FROM "${GlueDatabase}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = lpad(cast(month(current_date) AS varchar), 2, '0')
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY stack_name

  AvgSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AvgSessionLengthPerStack-PreviousMonth
      Description: Session count and average session length in minutes per stack for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT stack_name,
               count(*) AS session_count,
               avg(session_duration_in_seconds) / 60 AS avg_session_minutes
        FROM "${GlueDatabase}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = cast(year(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date))) AS varchar)
          AND month = lpad(cast(month(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date))) AS varchar), 2, '0')
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY stack_name

  DailySessionCountCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: DailySessionCount-CurrentMonth
      Description: Number of sessions per day for the current month.
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT date(from_iso8601_timestamp(session_start_time)) AS session_date,
               count(*) AS sessions
        FROM "${GlueDatabase}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = lpad(cast(month(current_date) AS varchar), 2, '0')
        GROUP BY date(from_iso8601_timestamp(session_start_time))
        ORDER BY session_date

  DailySessionCountPreviousMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: DailySessionCount-PreviousMonth
      Description: Number of sessions per day for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT date(from_iso8601_timestamp(session_start_time)) AS session_date,
               count(*) AS sessions
        FROM "${GlueDatabase}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = cast(year(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date))) AS varchar)
          AND month = lpad(cast(month(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date))) AS varchar), 2, '0')
        GROUP BY date(from_iso8601_timestamp(session_start_time))
        ORDER BY session_date

  AllSessionDetailsCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AllSessionDetails-CurrentMonth
      Description: All session details for the current month.
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT *
        FROM "${GlueDatabase}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = lpad(cast(month(current_date) AS varchar), 2, '0')
        ORDER BY session_start_time

  AllSessionDetailsPreviousMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AllSessionDetails-PreviousMonth
      Description: All session details for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT *
        FROM "${GlueDatabase}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = cast(year(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date))) AS varchar)
          AND month = lpad(cast(month(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date))) AS varchar), 2, '0')
        ORDER BY session_start_time

  StreamingHoursPerUserCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: StreamingHoursPerUser-CurrentMonth
      Description: Total streaming hours per user for the current month.
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT user_id,
               authentication_type,
               round(sum(session_duration_in_seconds) / 3600.0, 2) AS streaming_hours
        FROM "${GlueDatabase}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = lpad(cast(month(current_date) AS varchar), 2, '0')
        GROUP BY user_id, authentication_type
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC

  StreamingHoursPerUserPreviousMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: StreamingHoursPerUser-PreviousMonth
      Description: Total streaming hours per user for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT user_id,
               authentication_type,
               round(sum(session_duration_in_seconds) / 3600.0, 2) AS streaming_hours
        FROM "${GlueDatabase}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = cast(year(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date))) AS varchar)
          AND month = lpad(cast(month(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date))) AS varchar), 2, '0')
        GROUP BY user_id, authentication_type
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC

  UniqueUsersPerApplicationCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: UniqueUsersPerApplication-CurrentMonth
      Description: Number of unique users per application for the current month.
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT a.application_name,
               count(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS unique_users
        FROM "${GlueDatabase}"."applications" a
        JOIN "${GlueDatabase}"."sessions" s
          ON a.user_session_id = s.user_session_id
        WHERE a.year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND a.month = lpad(cast(month(current_date) AS varchar), 2, '0')
          AND s.year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND s.month = lpad(cast(month(current_date) AS varchar), 2, '0')
        GROUP BY a.application_name
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC

  UniqueUsersPerApplicationPreviousMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: UniqueUsersPerApplication-PreviousMonth
      Description: Number of unique users per application for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT a.application_name,
               count(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS unique_users
        FROM "${GlueDatabase}"."applications" a
        JOIN "${GlueDatabase}"."sessions" s
          ON a.user_session_id = s.user_session_id
        WHERE a.year = cast(year(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date))) AS varchar)
          AND a.month = lpad(cast(month(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date))) AS varchar), 2, '0')
          AND s.year = cast(year(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date))) AS varchar)
          AND s.month = lpad(cast(month(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date))) AS varchar), 2, '0')
        GROUP BY a.application_name

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Three-tier VPC network foundation with a 10.0.0.0/16 VPC, an internet gateway,
  a single NAT gateway backed by an Elastic IP, and public, private application,
  and private database subnets across three availability zones, with dedicated
  route tables per tier.

# Design note: this template provisions a single NAT gateway in PublicSubnet1 as a
# cost-optimized design. It creates a single-AZ egress failure domain. If the AZ
# hosting the NAT gateway fails, the private application and database subnets in
# all AZs lose outbound internet access. For high availability, deploy one NAT
# gateway per AZ with per-AZ private route tables. That design is intentionally not
# provisioned here, per the request.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used as a prefix for resource Name tags.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

Mappings:
  SubnetConfig:
    VPC:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/16
    Public1:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/24
    Public2:
      CIDR: 10.0.1.0/24
    Public3:
      CIDR: 10.0.2.0/24
    App1:
      CIDR: 10.0.3.0/24
    App2:
      CIDR: 10.0.4.0/24
    App3:
      CIDR: 10.0.5.0/24
    Db1:
      CIDR: 10.0.6.0/24
    Db2:
      CIDR: 10.0.7.0/24
    Db3:
      CIDR: 10.0.8.0/24

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public subnets
  # Auto-assign public IP is intentionally disabled. These subnets are public
  # because they route to the internet gateway. Resources that need public
  # reachability (for example a bastion host or load balancer) must request a
  # public IP explicitly at launch or attach an Elastic IP.
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Public1, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Public2, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Public3, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # Private application subnets
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, App1, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-app-subnet-1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, App2, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-app-subnet-2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, App3, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-app-subnet-3"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  # Private database subnets
  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Db1, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-db-subnet-1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Db2, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-db-subnet-2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Db3, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-db-subnet-3"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  # NAT gateway (single, cost-optimized; see design note above)
  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip"

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway"

  # Route tables
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt"

  AppRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-app-rt"

  DbRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-db-rt"

  # Routes
  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  AppDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  DbDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  # Subnet route table associations
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable

  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable

  DbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable

  DbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable

  DbSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPCId"

  VPCCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPCCidr"

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the internet gateway
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-InternetGatewayId"

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the single NAT gateway
    Value: !Ref NatGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NatGatewayId"

  NatEIPAddress:
    Description: Public IP address of the NAT gateway
    Value: !Ref NatEIP
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NatEIPAddress"

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 1 (AZ index 0)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: QuickSight Admin Suite monitoring and data pipeline stack. Extracts QuickSight usage, dataset, datasource, folder, Q and access metadata with AWS Glue, and streams QuickSight CloudWatch metrics through Kinesis Data Firehose into an S3 data lake for Athena analytics.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,39}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 3-41 lowercase letters, numbers, dots and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or number.
    Description: Base name of the S3 bucket created by this stack to hold the Glue ETL scripts. The stack appends the account ID and a stack-unique suffix to guarantee global uniqueness.

Resources:
  AdminSuiteKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key encrypting the QuickSight Admin Suite data lake and Glue script buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPolicies
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags: [{Key: Application, Value: QuickSightAdminSuite}]

  AdminSuiteKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/admin-suite
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKey

  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub
        - 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}-${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref AWS::StackId]]]]
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration: {BlockPublicAcls: true, BlockPublicPolicy: true, IgnorePublicAcls: true, RestrictPublicBuckets: true}
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules: [{ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced}]
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration: {Status: Enabled}
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - {Id: ExpireGlueTemp, Status: Enabled, Prefix: glue-temp/, ExpirationInDays: 7}
          - {Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions, Status: Enabled, NoncurrentVersionExpiration: {NoncurrentDays: 30}}
          - {Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads, Status: Enabled, AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload: {DaysAfterInitiation: 7}}
      Tags: [{Key: Application, Value: QuickSightAdminSuite}]

  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub
        - '${ScriptBucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref AWS::StackId]]]]
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration: {BlockPublicAcls: true, BlockPublicPolicy: true, IgnorePublicAcls: true, RestrictPublicBuckets: true}
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules: [{ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced}]
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration: {Status: Enabled}
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - {Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions, Status: Enabled, NoncurrentVersionExpiration: {NoncurrentDays: 30}}
          - {Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads, Status: Enabled, AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload: {DaysAfterInitiation: 7}}
      Tags: [{Key: Application, Value: QuickSightAdminSuite}]

  AdminSuiteBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: [!GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn, !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*']
            Condition: {Bool: {aws:SecureTransport: 'false'}}

  ScriptBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScriptBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: [!GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn, !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*']
            Condition: {Bool: {aws:SecureTransport: 'false'}}

  FirehoseLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/kinesisfirehose/admin-suite
      RetentionInDays: 30

  IngestionMetricsLogStream:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogStream
    Properties: {LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup, LogStreamName: S3Delivery-ingestion}

  DashboardMetricsLogStream:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogStream
    Properties: {LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup, LogStreamName: S3Delivery-dashboard}

  SpiceMetricsLogStream:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogStream
    Properties: {LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup, LogStreamName: S3Delivery-spice}

  QIndexMetricsLogStream:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogStream
    Properties: {LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup, LogStreamName: S3Delivery-q-index}

  QActionMetricsLogStream:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogStream
    Properties: {LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup, LogStreamName: S3Delivery-q-action}

  ScriptUploaderLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/admin-suite-script-uploader
      RetentionInDays: 30

  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub admin-suite-role-${AWS::Region}
      Description: Consolidated role for the QuickSight Admin Suite Glue jobs, Firehose streams, metric streams and script uploader.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowServiceAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: [glue.amazonaws.com, cloudformation.amazonaws.com, lambda.amazonaws.com, streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com]
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowFirehoseAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: firehose.amazonaws.com}
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition: {StringEquals: {sts:ExternalId: !Ref AWS::AccountId}}
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuitePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3BucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [s3:GetBucketLocation, s3:ListBucket, s3:ListBucketVersions, s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads]
                Resource: [!GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn, !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn]
              - Sid: S3ObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [s3:GetObject, s3:GetObjectVersion, s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:DeleteObjectVersion, s3:AbortMultipartUpload, s3:ListMultipartUploadParts]
                Resource: [!Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*', !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*']
              - Sid: KmsDataKeyAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey*, kms:ReEncrypt*, kms:DescribeKey]
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
              - Sid: GlueCatalogAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [glue:GetDatabase, glue:GetDatabases, glue:GetTable, glue:GetTables, glue:CreateTable, glue:UpdateTable, glue:GetPartition, glue:GetPartitions, glue:BatchGetPartition, glue:CreatePartition, glue:BatchCreatePartition, glue:UpdatePartition]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/default'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/admin_suite'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/admin_suite/*'
              - Sid: GlueJobAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [glue:GetJob, glue:GetJobRun, glue:GetJobRuns, glue:StartJobRun, glue:BatchStopJobRun]
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/admin-suite-*'
              - Sid: QuickSightReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [quicksight:Describe*, quicksight:List*, quicksight:Search*]
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IamPassSelf
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [iam:GetRole, iam:PassRole]
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-role-${AWS::Region}'
                Condition:
                  StringEqualsIfExists:
                    iam:PassedToService: [glue.amazonaws.com, firehose.amazonaws.com, streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com, lambda.amazonaws.com]
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [cloudwatch:PutMetricData, cloudwatch:GetMetricData, cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics, cloudwatch:ListMetrics]
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [logs:CreateLogGroup, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents, logs:DescribeLogStreams]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/admin-suite-*'
                  - !GetAtt FirehoseLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: FirehoseAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [firehose:PutRecord, firehose:PutRecordBatch, firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream]
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/admin-suite-*'
      Tags: [{Key: Application, Value: QuickSightAdminSuite}]

  ScriptUploaderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: ScriptUploaderLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: admin-suite-script-uploader
      Description: Uploads the Admin Suite Glue scripts and empties the script bucket on stack deletion.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')


          def empty_bucket(bucket):
            try:
              for page in s3.get_paginator('list_object_versions').paginate(Bucket=bucket):
                objs = [{'Key': v['Key'], 'VersionId': v['VersionId']}
                        for v in page.get('Versions', []) + page.get('DeleteMarkers', [])]
                for i in range(0, len(objs), 1000):
                  s3.delete_objects(Bucket=bucket, Delete={'Objects': objs[i:i + 1000], 'Quiet': True})
            except s3.exceptions.NoSuchBucket:
              pass


          def handler(event, context):
            props = event['ResourceProperties']
            bucket, prefix = props['BucketName'], props['Prefix']
            physical_id = 's3://' + bucket + '/' + prefix
            try:
              if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                for name, body in props.get('Scripts', {}).items():
                  s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=prefix + name, Body=body.encode('utf-8'), ContentType='text/x-python')
              elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                empty_bucket(bucket)
              cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'ScriptPrefix': physical_id}, physical_id)
            except Exception as exc:
              print('Script upload failed: ' + str(exc))
              cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(exc)}, physical_id)
      Tags: [{Key: Application, Value: QuickSightAdminSuite}]

  UploadGlueScripts:
    Type: Custom::ScriptUploader
    DependsOn: ScriptBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ScriptUploaderFunction.Arn
      ServiceTimeout: 300
      BucketName: !Ref ScriptBucket
      Prefix: glue-scripts/
      Scripts:
        admin_suite_common.py: |
          import sys
          import json
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3
          from botocore.config import Config
          from awsglue.context import GlueContext
          from awsglue.job import Job
          from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
          from pyspark.context import SparkContext
          from pyspark.sql.types import StringType, StructField, StructType


          def init():
            global args, spark, job, qs, glue, ACCOUNT_ID, RUN_DATE, SNAPSHOT_TIME
            args = getResolvedOptions(
              sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME', 'AWS_ACCOUNT_ID', 'QS_REGION', 'DEST_BUCKET', 'DEST_PREFIX', 'GLUE_DATABASE'])
            glue_context = GlueContext(SparkContext.getOrCreate())
            spark = glue_context.spark_session
            job = Job(glue_context)
            job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)
            ACCOUNT_ID = args['AWS_ACCOUNT_ID']
            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            RUN_DATE = now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
            SNAPSHOT_TIME = now.isoformat()
            config = Config(retries={'max_attempts': 10, 'mode': 'adaptive'})
            qs = boto3.client('quicksight', region_name=args['QS_REGION'], config=config)
            glue = boto3.client('glue', region_name=args['QS_REGION'], config=config)


          def paginate(method, key, limit=None, **kwargs):
            count, token = 0, None
            while True:
              params = dict(kwargs)
              if token:
                params['NextToken'] = token
              response = getattr(qs, method)(**params)
              for item in response.get(key, []):
                yield item
                count += 1
                if limit and count >= limit:
                  return
              token = response.get('NextToken')
              if not token:
                return


          def pick(obj, mapping, **extra):
            row = {col: obj.get(key) for col, key in mapping.items()}
            row.update(account_id=ACCOUNT_ID, snapshot_time=SNAPSHOT_TIME, **extra)
            return row


          def to_str(value):
            if value is None:
              return None
            if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
              return json.dumps(value, default=str)
            return str(value)


          def publish(table, columns, rows):
            location = f"s3://{args['DEST_BUCKET']}/{args['DEST_PREFIX']}/{table}/"
            schema = StructType([StructField(c, StringType(), True) for c in columns])
            data = [tuple(to_str(r.get(c)) for c in columns) for r in rows]
            spark.createDataFrame(data, schema).write.mode('overwrite').parquet(f'{location}run_date={RUN_DATE}/')
            table_input = {
              'Name': table,
              'TableType': 'EXTERNAL_TABLE',
              'Parameters': {
                'classification': 'parquet',
                'projection.enabled': 'true',
                'projection.run_date.type': 'date',
                'projection.run_date.format': 'yyyy-MM-dd',
                'projection.run_date.range': '2024-01-01,NOW',
                'projection.run_date.interval': '1',
                'projection.run_date.interval.unit': 'DAYS',
              },
              'PartitionKeys': [{'Name': 'run_date', 'Type': 'string'}],
              'StorageDescriptor': {
                'Columns': [{'Name': c, 'Type': 'string'} for c in columns],
                'Location': location,
                'InputFormat': 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.MapredParquetInputFormat',
                'OutputFormat': 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.MapredParquetOutputFormat',
                'SerdeInfo': {'SerializationLibrary': 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'},
              },
            }
            try:
              glue.update_table(DatabaseName=args['GLUE_DATABASE'], TableInput=table_input)
            except glue.exceptions.EntityNotFoundException:
              glue.create_table(DatabaseName=args['GLUE_DATABASE'], TableInput=table_input)
            print(f'Published {len(rows)} rows to {location}')


          init()
        assets_access.py: |
          from admin_suite_common import ACCOUNT_ID, job, paginate, pick, publish, qs

          PERMISSIONS = ('account_id asset_type asset_id asset_name asset_arn principal_arn principal_type '
                         'principal_name actions snapshot_time').split()
          USERS = ('account_id namespace user_name user_arn email role identity_type active principal_id '
                   'snapshot_time').split()
          MEMBERSHIPS = 'account_id namespace group_name group_arn member_name member_arn snapshot_time'.split()
          USER_MAP = {'user_name': 'UserName', 'user_arn': 'Arn', 'email': 'Email', 'role': 'Role',
                      'identity_type': 'IdentityType', 'active': 'Active', 'principal_id': 'PrincipalId'}
          ASSET_TYPES = [
            ('dashboard', 'list_dashboards', 'DashboardSummaryList', 'DashboardId', 'describe_dashboard_permissions'),
            ('analysis', 'list_analyses', 'AnalysisSummaryList', 'AnalysisId', 'describe_analysis_permissions'),
            ('dataset', 'list_data_sets', 'DataSetSummaries', 'DataSetId', 'describe_data_set_permissions'),
            ('datasource', 'list_data_sources', 'DataSources', 'DataSourceId', 'describe_data_source_permissions'),
            ('folder', 'list_folders', 'FolderSummaryList', 'FolderId', 'describe_folder_permissions'),
          ]

          permission_rows, user_rows, membership_rows = [], [], []
          for asset_type, list_method, list_key, id_key, perm_method in ASSET_TYPES:
            try:
              assets = list(paginate(list_method, list_key, AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID))
            except Exception as exc:
              print(f'Unable to list {asset_type}: {exc}')
              continue
            for asset in assets:
              asset_id = asset.get(id_key)
              if asset.get('Status') == 'DELETED':
                continue
              try:
                response = getattr(qs, perm_method)(**{'AwsAccountId': ACCOUNT_ID, id_key: asset_id})
              except Exception as exc:
                print(f'Unable to read permissions for {asset_type} {asset_id}: {exc}')
                continue
              for permission in response.get('Permissions', []):
                principal = permission.get('Principal', '')
                permission_rows.append(pick(
                  asset, {'asset_name': 'Name', 'asset_arn': 'Arn'},
                  asset_type=asset_type, asset_id=asset_id, principal_arn=principal,
                  principal_type=principal.split(':')[-1].split('/')[0] if principal else None,
                  principal_name=principal.split('/')[-1] if principal else None,
                  actions=sorted(permission.get('Actions', []))))

          try:
            namespaces = [n['Name'] for n in paginate('list_namespaces', 'Namespaces', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID)]
          except Exception as exc:
            print(f'Unable to list namespaces, using default: {exc}')
            namespaces = ['default']

          for namespace in namespaces:
            try:
              for user in paginate('list_users', 'UserList', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID, Namespace=namespace):
                user_rows.append(pick(user, USER_MAP, namespace=namespace))
              for group in paginate('list_groups', 'GroupList', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID, Namespace=namespace):
                for member in paginate('list_group_memberships', 'GroupMemberList', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID,
                                       Namespace=namespace, GroupName=group['GroupName']):
                  membership_rows.append(pick(
                    member, {'member_name': 'MemberName', 'member_arn': 'Arn'},
                    namespace=namespace, group_name=group.get('GroupName'), group_arn=group.get('Arn')))
            except Exception as exc:
              print(f'Unable to read users or groups in namespace {namespace}: {exc}')

          publish('assets_access_permissions', PERMISSIONS, permission_rows)
          publish('assets_access_users', USERS, user_rows)
          publish('assets_access_group_membership', MEMBERSHIPS, membership_rows)
          job.commit()
        dataset_metadata.py: |
          from admin_suite_common import ACCOUNT_ID, job, paginate, pick, publish, qs

          DATASETS = ('account_id dataset_id dataset_name dataset_arn import_mode created_time last_updated_time '
                      'consumed_spice_capacity_bytes row_level_permission_enabled row_level_tag_configuration_applied '
                      'column_level_permission_applied data_source_arns output_column_count output_columns '
                      'describe_error snapshot_time').split()
          INGESTIONS = ('account_id dataset_id dataset_name ingestion_id ingestion_status request_source request_type '
                        'created_time ingestion_time_seconds ingestion_size_bytes rows_ingested rows_dropped error_type '
                        'error_message snapshot_time').split()
          DATASET_MAP = {'dataset_id': 'DataSetId', 'dataset_name': 'Name', 'dataset_arn': 'Arn',
                         'import_mode': 'ImportMode', 'created_time': 'CreatedTime',
                         'last_updated_time': 'LastUpdatedTime',
                         'row_level_tag_configuration_applied': 'RowLevelPermissionTagConfigurationApplied',
                         'column_level_permission_applied': 'ColumnLevelPermissionRulesApplied'}
          INGESTION_MAP = {'ingestion_id': 'IngestionId', 'ingestion_status': 'IngestionStatus',
                           'request_source': 'RequestSource', 'request_type': 'RequestType',
                           'created_time': 'CreatedTime', 'ingestion_time_seconds': 'IngestionTimeInSeconds',
                           'ingestion_size_bytes': 'IngestionSizeInBytes'}

          dataset_rows, ingestion_rows = [], []
          for summary in paginate('list_data_sets', 'DataSetSummaries', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID):
            dataset_id = summary.get('DataSetId')
            row = pick(summary, DATASET_MAP,
                       row_level_permission_enabled=summary.get('RowLevelPermissionDataSet') is not None)
            try:
              dataset = qs.describe_data_set(AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID, DataSetId=dataset_id)['DataSet']
              columns = dataset.get('OutputColumns', [])
              sources = {v['DataSourceArn'] for t in dataset.get('PhysicalTableMap', {}).values()
                         for v in t.values() if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get('DataSourceArn')}
              row.update(consumed_spice_capacity_bytes=dataset.get('ConsumedSpiceCapacityInBytes'),
                         data_source_arns=sorted(sources), output_column_count=len(columns),
                         output_columns=[c.get('Name') for c in columns])
            except Exception as exc:
              row['describe_error'] = str(exc)
            dataset_rows.append(row)

            if summary.get('ImportMode') != 'SPICE':
              continue
            try:
              for ingestion in paginate('list_ingestions', 'Ingestions', limit=100,
                                        AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID, DataSetId=dataset_id):
                row_info = ingestion.get('RowInfo') or {}
                error_info = ingestion.get('ErrorInfo') or {}
                ingestion_rows.append(pick(
                  ingestion, INGESTION_MAP, dataset_id=dataset_id, dataset_name=summary.get('Name'),
                  rows_ingested=row_info.get('RowsIngested'), rows_dropped=row_info.get('RowsDropped'),
                  error_type=error_info.get('Type'), error_message=error_info.get('Message')))
            except Exception as exc:
              print(f'Unable to list ingestions for {dataset_id}: {exc}')

          publish('dataset_metadata', DATASETS, dataset_rows)
          publish('dataset_ingestions', INGESTIONS, ingestion_rows)
          job.commit()
        folder_assets.py: |
          from admin_suite_common import ACCOUNT_ID, job, paginate, pick, publish, qs

          FOLDERS = ('account_id folder_id folder_name folder_arn folder_type sharing_model parent_folder_arn '
                     'folder_path created_time last_updated_time snapshot_time').split()
          MEMBERS = 'account_id folder_id folder_name member_id member_arn member_type snapshot_time'.split()
          FOLDER_MAP = {'folder_id': 'FolderId', 'folder_name': 'Name', 'folder_arn': 'Arn',
                        'folder_type': 'FolderType', 'sharing_model': 'SharingModel',
                        'created_time': 'CreatedTime', 'last_updated_time': 'LastUpdatedTime'}

          folder_rows, member_rows = [], []
          for summary in paginate('list_folders', 'FolderSummaryList', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID):
            folder_id = summary.get('FolderId')
            folder_path = []
            try:
              folder = qs.describe_folder(AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID, FolderId=folder_id)['Folder']
              folder_path = folder.get('FolderPath', [])
            except Exception as exc:
              print(f'Unable to describe folder {folder_id}: {exc}')
            folder_rows.append(pick(summary, FOLDER_MAP, folder_path=folder_path,
                                    parent_folder_arn=folder_path[-1] if folder_path else None))
            try:
              for member in paginate('list_folder_members', 'FolderMemberList',
                                     AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID, FolderId=folder_id):
                member_arn = member.get('MemberArn') or ''
                member_rows.append(pick(
                  member, {'member_id': 'MemberId'}, folder_id=folder_id, folder_name=summary.get('Name'),
                  member_arn=member_arn,
                  member_type=member_arn.split(':')[-1].split('/')[0] if member_arn else None))
            except Exception as exc:
              print(f'Unable to list members of folder {folder_id}: {exc}')

          publish('folders', FOLDERS, folder_rows)
          publish('folder_assets', MEMBERS, member_rows)
          job.commit()
        q_metadata.py: |
          from admin_suite_common import ACCOUNT_ID, job, paginate, pick, publish, qs

          TOPICS = ('account_id topic_id topic_name topic_arn user_experience_version description dataset_count '
                    'describe_error snapshot_time').split()
          TOPIC_DATASETS = ('account_id topic_id topic_name dataset_arn dataset_name dataset_description column_count '
                            'calculated_field_count named_entity_count filter_count snapshot_time').split()
          REFRESHES = ('account_id topic_id dataset_id dataset_arn dataset_name is_enabled based_on_spice_schedule '
                       'schedule_frequency timezone snapshot_time').split()
          TOPIC_MAP = {'topic_id': 'TopicId', 'topic_name': 'Name', 'topic_arn': 'Arn',
                       'user_experience_version': 'UserExperienceVersion'}
          TOPIC_DATASET_MAP = {'dataset_arn': 'DatasetArn', 'dataset_name': 'DatasetName',
                               'dataset_description': 'DatasetDescription'}
          SCHEDULE_MAP = {'dataset_id': 'DatasetId', 'dataset_arn': 'DatasetArn', 'dataset_name': 'DatasetName'}
          REFRESH_MAP = {'is_enabled': 'IsEnabled', 'based_on_spice_schedule': 'BasedOnSpiceSchedule',
                         'schedule_frequency': 'ScheduleFrequency', 'timezone': 'Timezone'}

          topic_rows, topic_dataset_rows, refresh_rows = [], [], []
          for summary in paginate('list_topics', 'TopicsSummaries', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID):
            topic_id = summary.get('TopicId')
            row = pick(summary, TOPIC_MAP)
            try:
              topic = qs.describe_topic(AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID, TopicId=topic_id).get('Topic', {})
              datasets = topic.get('DataSets', [])
              row.update(description=topic.get('Description'), dataset_count=len(datasets))
              for dataset in datasets:
                topic_dataset_rows.append(pick(
                  dataset, TOPIC_DATASET_MAP, topic_id=topic_id, topic_name=summary.get('Name'),
                  column_count=len(dataset.get('Columns', [])),
                  calculated_field_count=len(dataset.get('CalculatedFields', [])),
                  named_entity_count=len(dataset.get('NamedEntities', [])),
                  filter_count=len(dataset.get('Filters', []))))
            except Exception as exc:
              row['describe_error'] = str(exc)
            topic_rows.append(row)

            try:
              response = qs.list_topic_refresh_schedules(AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID, TopicId=topic_id)
              for schedule in response.get('RefreshSchedules', []):
                refresh = schedule.get('RefreshSchedule') or {}
                row = pick(schedule, SCHEDULE_MAP, topic_id=topic_id)
                row.update({col: refresh.get(key) for col, key in REFRESH_MAP.items()})
                refresh_rows.append(row)
            except Exception as exc:
              print(f'Unable to list refresh schedules for topic {topic_id}: {exc}')

          publish('q_topics', TOPICS, topic_rows)
          publish('q_topic_datasets', TOPIC_DATASETS, topic_dataset_rows)
          publish('q_topic_refresh_schedules', REFRESHES, refresh_rows)
          job.commit()
        datasource_properties.py: |
          from admin_suite_common import ACCOUNT_ID, job, paginate, pick, publish

          DATASOURCES = ('account_id datasource_id datasource_name datasource_arn datasource_type status created_time '
                         'last_updated_time connection_type connection_parameters alternate_parameter_count '
                         'vpc_connection_arn ssl_disabled uses_secrets_manager error_type error_message '
                         'snapshot_time').split()
          DATASOURCE_MAP = {'datasource_id': 'DataSourceId', 'datasource_name': 'Name', 'datasource_arn': 'Arn',
                            'datasource_type': 'Type', 'status': 'Status', 'created_time': 'CreatedTime',
                            'last_updated_time': 'LastUpdatedTime'}

          datasource_rows = []
          for source in paginate('list_data_sources', 'DataSources', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID):
            parameters = source.get('DataSourceParameters') or {}
            error_info = source.get('ErrorInfo') or {}
            datasource_rows.append(pick(
              source, DATASOURCE_MAP,
              connection_type=next(iter(parameters.keys()), None),
              connection_parameters=parameters,
              alternate_parameter_count=len(source.get('AlternateDataSourceParameters', [])),
              vpc_connection_arn=(source.get('VpcConnectionProperties') or {}).get('VpcConnectionArn'),
              ssl_disabled=(source.get('SslProperties') or {}).get('DisableSsl'),
              uses_secrets_manager=source.get('SecretArn') is not None,
              error_type=error_info.get('Type'), error_message=error_info.get('Message')))

          publish('datasource_properties', DATASOURCES, datasource_rows)
          job.commit()

Description: VPC and private DNS infrastructure for a Puppet Quick Start deployment, including a VPC, public subnet, internet gateway, public routing, and a Route53 private hosted zone with A records for the Puppet master and agents.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VPCCIDR
          - PublicSubnetCIDR
      - Label:
          default: Private DNS Configuration
        Parameters:
          - PuppetMasterIP
          - LinuxAgentIP
          - WindowsAgentIP
    ParameterLabels:
      VPCCIDR:
        default: VPC CIDR block
      PublicSubnetCIDR:
        default: Public subnet CIDR block
      PuppetMasterIP:
        default: Puppet master private IP
      LinuxAgentIP:
        default: Linux agent private IP
      WindowsAgentIP:
        default: Windows agent private IP

Parameters:
  VPCCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(\d|[1-2]\d|3[0-2])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/0-32.

  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/19
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet. Must be within the VPC CIDR block. Instances in this subnet do not receive public IP addresses by default; instances that need one must request it explicitly at launch (for example, via a network interface's AssociatePublicIpAddress setting or an Elastic IP).
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(\d|[1-2]\d|3[0-2])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/0-32.

  PuppetMasterIP:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.10
    Description: Private IP address for the Puppet master (puppet.example.com).
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address in the form x.x.x.x.

  LinuxAgentIP:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.11
    Description: Private IP address for the Linux agent (linuxagent.example.com).
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address in the form x.x.x.x.

  WindowsAgentIP:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.12
    Description: Private IP address for the Windows agent (windowsagent.example.com).
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address in the form x.x.x.x.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VPCCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vpc

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-public-rt

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: example.com
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Private hosted zone for Puppet Quick Start internal name resolution within the VPC.
      VPCs:
        - VPCId: !Ref VPC
          VPCRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-zone

  PuppetMasterRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: puppet.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PuppetMasterIP

  LinuxAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: linuxagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LinuxAgentIP

  WindowsAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: windowsagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WindowsAgentIP

Outputs:
  VPCID:
    Description: ID of the Puppet Quick Start VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-VPCID

  PublicSubnetID:
    Description: ID of the Puppet Quick Start public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetID
