AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with AWS Cloud Map private DNS (SRV) service
  discovery and CloudWatch alarm-driven step-scaling auto scaling (2-10 tasks). The stack
  creates its own VPC (one public subnet, two private subnets across separate AZs), an
  internet gateway, a NAT gateway, interface VPC endpoints (ECR API, ECR DKR, CloudWatch
  Logs, S3) so task traffic to AWS stays inside the VPC, an ECR pull-through cache rule
  that serves the public ECR image from private ECR, an ECS cluster, IAM roles, a log
  group, and a Cloud Map namespace and service. It accepts no VPC, subnet, security group,
  AMI, or ARN parameters. NOTE - ContainerCpu and ContainerMemory must form a valid Fargate
  CPU/memory combination (for example 256/512, 512/1024, 1024/2048, 2048/4096, 4096/8192).

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Environment name used in resource names, tags, and the Cloud Map namespace name.

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-service
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Name used for the ECS service, container, Cloud Map service, and log group path.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx/nginx:latest
    Description: >-
      Repository path and tag of an image in public ECR (public.ecr.aws). The image is served
      from private ECR through the in-stack pull-through cache rule, so no registry credentials
      are required and tasks never need direct internet access.

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: Port the container listens on.

  ContainerCpu:
    Type: String
    Default: '256'
    AllowedValues:
      - '256'
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '4096'
    Description: Task CPU units. Must form a valid Fargate combination with ContainerMemory.

  ContainerMemory:
    Type: String
    Default: '512'
    AllowedValues:
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '3072'
      - '4096'
      - '8192'
      - '16384'
    Description: Task memory in MiB. Must form a valid Fargate combination with ContainerCpu.

  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Initial number of tasks. Must be within the auto scaling bounds (2-10).

  CreateTaskRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a custom IAM task role the containers can assume to access other AWS resources.

Conditions:
  HasTaskRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateTaskRole, 'true']

Mappings:
  NetworkConfig:
    VPC:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/16
    PublicSubnet:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/24
    PrivateSubnet1:
      CIDR: 10.0.1.0/24
    PrivateSubnet2:
      CIDR: 10.0.2.0/24

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-subnet
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet1, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet2, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-eip
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub Allows ${ServiceName} containers to communicate within the VPC CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: Container port traffic from within the VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Container port traffic to other services within the VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, CIDR]
        - Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints within the VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Interface VPC endpoints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub Allows HTTPS from within the VPC to ${ServiceName} interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from within the VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS within the VPC only
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpce-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-ecr-api-vpce
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-ecr-dkr-vpce
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-logs-vpce
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      # No S3 gateway endpoint exists in this VPC, so private DNS must apply to all
      # resolvers; the EC2 API otherwise defaults to inbound-resolver-only for S3,
      # which requires a gateway endpoint and fails endpoint creation.
      DnsOptions:
        PrivateDnsOnlyForInboundResolverEndpoint: AllResolvers
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-s3-vpce
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECR pull-through cache (public.ecr.aws -> private ECR)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PullThroughCacheRule:
    Type: AWS::ECR::PullThroughCacheRule
    Properties:
      EcrRepositoryPrefix: ecr-public
      UpstreamRegistryUrl: public.ecr.aws

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS cluster, logging, and IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ecr-pull-through-cache
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchImportUpstreamImage
                  - ecr:CreateRepository
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/ecr-public/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasTaskRole
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref ContainerCpu
      Memory: !Ref ContainerMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If [HasTaskRole, !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Sub ${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/ecr-public/${ContainerImage}
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cloud Map service discovery
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}.internal
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Description: !Sub Private service discovery namespace for the ${EnvironmentName} environment
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  DiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: !Sub Cloud Map service for ${ServiceName}
      NamespaceId: !GetAtt PrivateNamespace.Id
      DnsConfig:
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS service
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - PrivateRoute
      - PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation
      - PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation
      - EcrApiEndpoint
      - EcrDkrEndpoint
      - LogsEndpoint
      - S3Endpoint
      - PullThroughCacheRule
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
        MaximumPercent: 200
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Auto Scaling
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ResourceId: !Sub service/${ECSCluster}/${ECSService.Name}
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-up
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          # CPU 70% - <85%: add 1 task
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          # CPU 85% - <95%: add 2 tasks
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 15
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 25
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          # CPU >= 95%: add 3 tasks
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 25
            ScalingAdjustment: 3

  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-down
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  HighCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high
      AlarmDescription: !Sub Scale up ${ServiceName} when average CPU utilization is at or above 70 percent
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  LowCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low
      AlarmDescription: !Sub Scale down ${ServiceName} when average CPU utilization is at or below 20 percent
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC created by this stack
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated IDs of the private subnets
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]

  ContainerSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the container security group
    Value: !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the interface VPC endpoint security group
    Value: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  ClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster

  ClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS cluster
    Value: !GetAtt ECSCluster.Arn

  ECSServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service
    Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name

  ECSServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS service
    Value: !Ref ECSService

  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task definition
    Value: !Ref TaskDefinition

  ContainerImageUri:
    Description: Private ECR image URI served through the pull-through cache
    Value: !Sub ${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/ecr-public/${ContainerImage}

  TaskExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task execution role
    Value: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn

  TaskRoleArn:
    Condition: HasTaskRole
    Description: ARN of the custom task role assumed by the containers
    Value: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn

  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group for container logs
    Value: !Ref LogGroup

  NamespaceId:
    Description: ID of the Cloud Map private DNS namespace
    Value: !GetAtt PrivateNamespace.Id

  NamespaceName:
    Description: Name of the Cloud Map private DNS namespace
    Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}.internal

  DiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service
    Value: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn

  ServiceDiscoveryEndpoint:
    Description: Private DNS name (SRV record) other services use to discover this service

  ScaleUpPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the step-scaling scale-up policy
    Value: !Ref ScaleUpPolicy

  ScaleDownPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the step-scaling scale-down policy
    Value: !Ref ScaleDownPolicy

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS-side hybrid interconnect network backbone for an OCI primary region. Creates a VPC,
  internet gateway, private subnet, route table, transit gateway with VPC attachment,
  HTTPS-restricted security group, optional static-route site-to-site VPN to OCI, transit
  gateway routing for OCI traffic, and VPC flow logs to CloudWatch Logs encrypted with a
  customer-managed KMS key.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^((25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the private subnet. Must fall within VpcCidr.
    AllowedPattern: ^((25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  InternalCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: Internal CIDR range that is the only permitted source for inbound HTTPS.
    AllowedPattern: ^((25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.16.0.0/16
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR range. Must not overlap VpcCidr.
    AllowedPattern: ^((25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  CreateOciVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create the customer gateway and site-to-site VPN connection to OCI.

  OciVpnPublicIp:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Public IPv4 address of the OCI IPSec headend. Required when CreateOciVpn is true.
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^((25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid dotted IPv4 address.

Conditions:
  CreateVpn: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateOciVpn, 'true']
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref OciVpnPublicIp, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Core network
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vpc
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-igw
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-rt
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  DefaultInternetRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Hybrid interconnect transit gateway for ${AWS::StackName}
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  BackboneTgwRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw-vpc-attachment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  TgwVpcAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref BackboneTgwRouteTable

  OciBackboneVpcRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BackboneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows HTTPS inbound from the internal CIDR and HTTPS outbound to the OCI backbone only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCidr
          Description: HTTPS from internal CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: HTTPS to OCI backbone
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-sg
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional site-to-site VPN to OCI (static routing)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OciCustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      BgpAsn: 65000
      IpAddress: !Ref OciVpnPublicIp
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-oci-cgw
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  OciVpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref OciCustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-oci-vpn
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  VpnTgwLookupLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: CreateVpn
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-vpn-tgw-lookup
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vpn-tgw-lookup-logs
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  VpnTgwLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the VPN transit gateway attachment lookup function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpn-tgw-attachment-lookup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeTgwAttachments
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteFunctionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt VpnTgwLookupLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vpn-tgw-lookup-role
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  VpnTgwLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: CreateVpn
    DependsOn: VpnTgwLookupLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vpn-tgw-lookup
      Description: Resolves the transit gateway attachment ID of a site-to-site VPN connection
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt VpnTgwLookupRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")
          ACTIVE_STATES = {"initiating", "initiatingRequest", "pendingAcceptance", "pending", "available", "modifying"}


          def find_attachment(vpn_id, tgw_id):
              resp = ec2.describe_transit_gateway_attachments(
                  Filters=[
                      {"Name": "resource-id", "Values": [vpn_id]},
                      {"Name": "transit-gateway-id", "Values": [tgw_id]},
                      {"Name": "resource-type", "Values": ["vpn"]},
                  ]
              )
              for att in resp.get("TransitGatewayAttachments", []):
                  if att.get("State") in ACTIVE_STATES:
                      return att["TransitGatewayAttachmentId"]
              return None


          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId", "vpn-tgw-attachment-lookup")
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  props = event["ResourceProperties"]
                  vpn_id = props["VpnConnectionId"]
                  tgw_id = props["TransitGatewayId"]
                  attachment_id = None
                  while context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() > 20000:
                      attachment_id = find_attachment(vpn_id, tgw_id)
                      if attachment_id:
                          break
                      time.sleep(10)
                  if not attachment_id:
                      raise RuntimeError(f"No transit gateway attachment found for VPN {vpn_id} on {tgw_id}")
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event,
                      context,
                      cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                      {"TransitGatewayAttachmentId": attachment_id},
                      attachment_id,
                  )
              except Exception as exc:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id, reason=str(exc))
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vpn-tgw-lookup
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  VpnTgwAttachmentLookup:
    Type: Custom::VpnTgwAttachmentLookup
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt VpnTgwLookupFunction.Arn
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref OciVpnConnection
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  TgwVpnAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !GetAtt VpnTgwAttachmentLookup.TransitGatewayAttachmentId
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref BackboneTgwRouteTable

  OciBackboneTgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref BackboneTgwRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !If
        - CreateVpn
        - !GetAtt VpnTgwAttachmentLookup.TransitGatewayAttachmentId
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Blackhole: !If
        - CreateVpn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flow logs encryption and delivery
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer-managed key encrypting VPC flow logs for ${AWS::StackName}
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs-key
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  FlowLogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to deliver records to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-log-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: DescribeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs-role
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-flowlog
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained infrastructure for the QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline, including a KMS-encrypted S3 bucket, a Glue IAM role, five Glue jobs, and scheduled triggers.

Resources:
  BucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the QuickSight admin console S3 bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-admin-console

  BucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BucketKey

  Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt BucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-admin-console

  BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt Bucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${Bucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  GlueJobRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'AdminConsoleGlueRole-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role assumed by Glue and CloudFormation for the QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSGlueConsoleFullAccess'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchFullAccess'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchLogsFullAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'quicksight:*'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: KmsBucketKeyAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt BucketKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-admin-console

  UserInfoJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: adminconsole-user-info
      Description: Collects QuickSight users and group membership.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 60
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${Bucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_user_info.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref Bucket
        '--GROUP_MEMBERSHIP_PATH': !Sub 's3://${Bucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/group_membership/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  ObjectAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: adminconsole-object-access-info
      Description: Collects QuickSight dashboard, analysis, and dataset access permissions.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 60
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${Bucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_object_access_info.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref Bucket
        '--OBJECT_ACCESS_PATH': !Sub 's3://${Bucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/object_access/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  DatasetInfoJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: adminconsole-dataset-info
      Description: Collects QuickSight dataset and data source metadata and CloudTrail table details.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 60
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${Bucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_dataset_info.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref Bucket
        '--CLOUDTRAIL_TABLE_NAME': 'cloudtrail_logs'
        '--CLOUDTRAIL_LOG_LOCATION': !Sub 's3://${Bucket}/admin-console/cloudtrail/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: adminconsole-folder-assets
      Description: Collects QuickSight folder assets and folder lookup data.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 60
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${Bucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-job-insights': 'true'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${Bucket}/admin-console/temp/'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref Bucket
        '--FOLDER_ASSETS_PATH': !Sub 's3://${Bucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_assets/'
        '--FOLDER_LOOKUP_PATH': !Sub 's3://${Bucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_lookup/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  FolderPathJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: adminconsole-folder-path
      Description: Builds QuickSight folder hierarchy paths.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder AMI pipeline for a hardened Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized golden image.
  Includes a Chef component that installs Chef Infra Client and applies a recipe staged in S3,
  a custom build workflow (SSM agent update and metadata collection before AMI creation),
  daily scheduling with image scanning and tests, an age-based lifecycle deprecation policy,
  KMS-encrypted S3 buckets, and all required networking and IAM resources. Build instances run
  in a private subnet with no internet egress and reach AWS services only through VPC interface
  endpoints, so Chef recipes must not fetch internet resources and must rely on artifacts
  staged in the recipe bucket.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-golden-ami
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only.
    Description: Prefix for every Image Builder resource name, IAM role name, and tag.

  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Region name such as us-east-1.
    Description: Region the distribution configuration delivers the resulting AMI to.

  ParentImageSsmPath:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id
    Description: Public SSM parameter that resolves the latest Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI ID.

  BuildInstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.medium
    AllowedValues:
      - t3.medium
      - t3.large
      - m5.large
    Description: Instance type used for the Image Builder build and test instances.

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 30
    MaxValue: 200
    Description: Size in GiB of the encrypted gp3 root volume of the resulting AMI.

  ChefRecipeKey:
    Type: String
    Default: chef/recipes/default.rb
    Description: >-
      S3 object key of the Chef recipe executed by the component. Both this recipe and the Chef
      Infra Client installer RPM (ChefInstallerKey) must be uploaded to the recipe bucket created
      by this stack before the first scheduled build runs.

  ChefInstallerKey:
    Type: String
    Default: chef/installers/chef-18.x86_64.rpm
    Description: >-
      S3 object key of the Chef Infra Client RPM for EL7 / Amazon Linux 2. The RPM must be
      uploaded to the recipe bucket created by this stack before the first scheduled build runs,
      because build instances have no internet access.

  AmiDeprecationAgeDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Age in days after which AMIs produced by this pipeline are deprecated.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (private only, no internet gateway)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Image Builder build instances - no inbound, HTTPS to VPC endpoints only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
          Description: HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-build-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: VPC interface endpoints - HTTPS from build instances only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS from Image Builder build instances
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
          Description: Restrict egress to the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssm-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssmmessages-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ec2messages-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ImageBuilderEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.imagebuilder'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      DnsOptions:
        PrivateDnsOnlyForInboundResolverEndpoint: AllResolvers
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-s3-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-logs-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3Key:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the Image Builder recipe and logs buckets
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  S3KeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-s3'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref S3Key

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 buckets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RecipeBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chef-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt S3Key.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RecipeBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref RecipeBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt RecipeBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${RecipeBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  LogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt S3Key.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireBuildLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 30
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${LogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role assumed by Image Builder build and test instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-s3-access'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadChefArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${RecipeBucket.Arn}/${ChefRecipeKey}'
                  - !Sub '${RecipeBucket.Arn}/${ChefInstallerKey}'
              - Sid: WriteBuildLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${LogsBucket.Arn}/image-builder-logs/*'
              - Sid: UseS3KeyViaS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt S3Key.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-profile-${AWS::Region}'
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  WorkflowExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-workflow-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role assumed by Image Builder to run the custom build workflow
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-workflow-actions'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: Ec2BuildLifecycle
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:StartInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:RegisterImage
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypeOfferings
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:DescribeImportImageTasks
                  - ec2:DescribeExportImageTasks
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SsmRunCommandAndInventory
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:GetCommandInvocation
                  - ssm:ListCommands
                  - ssm:ListCommandInvocations
                  - ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation
                  - ssm:ListInventoryEntries
                  - ssm:CreateAssociation
                  - ssm:DeleteAssociation
                  - ssm:DescribeAssociationExecutions
                  - ssm:DescribeAssociationExecutionTargets
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:StopAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ImageBuilderRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponent
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe
                  - imagebuilder:GetInfrastructureConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:GetDistributionConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:GetWorkflow
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: InspectorScanResults
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - inspector2:ListCoverage
                  - inspector2:ListFindings
                  - inspector2:BatchGetAccountStatus
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassInstanceRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt InstanceRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ec2.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lifecycle-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role assumed by Image Builder to execute AMI lifecycle policies
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/EC2ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project

      Description: Installs Chef Infra Client from S3, downloads a recipe from S3, and applies it

      Data: |
        name: chef-recipe
        description: Install Chef Infra Client and apply a Chef recipe, both staged in S3.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        parameters:
          - RecipeS3Uri:
              type: string
              description: S3 URI of the Chef recipe to apply.
          - InstallerS3Uri:
              type: string
              description: S3 URI of the Chef Infra Client RPM for Amazon Linux 2.
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefInstaller
                action: S3Download
                maxAttempts: 3
                inputs:
                  - source: '{{ InstallerS3Uri }}'
                    destination: /tmp/chef/chef-installer.rpm
              - name: InstallChef
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - rpm -Uvh --replacepkgs /tmp/chef/chef-installer.rpm
                    - rm -f /tmp/chef/chef-installer.rpm
              - name: DownloadRecipe
                action: S3Download
                maxAttempts: 3
                inputs:
                  - source: '{{ RecipeS3Uri }}'
                    destination: /tmp/chef/recipe.rb
              - name: ApplyRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - CHEF_LICENSE=accept-no-persist /opt/chef/bin/chef-apply /tmp/chef/recipe.rb
              - name: CleanupRecipe
                action: DeleteFolder
                inputs:
                  - path: /tmp/chef
                    force: true
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: VerifyChefInstalled
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - test -x /opt/chef/bin/chef-apply
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

      Components:

            - Name: InstallerS3Uri

            DeleteOnTermination: true
      AdditionalInstanceConfiguration:

    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:

      Description: Private build infrastructure for the golden AMI pipeline

      ResourceTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Data: |
        name: build-image
        description: Custom build workflow with SSM agent update and metadata collection.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        steps:
          - name: LaunchBuildInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              waitFor: ssmAgent
          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: RunCommand
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              documentName: AWS-UpdateSSMAgent
              instanceId.$: $.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId
              parameters:
                allowDowngrade:
                  - "false"
          - name: ApplyBuildComponents
            action: ExecuteComponents
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: $.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId
          - name: CollectImageMetadata
            action: CollectImageMetadata
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: $.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId
          - name: CreateOutputAMI
            action: CreateImage
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: $.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId
          - name: TerminateBuildInstance
            action: TerminateInstance
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: $.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId
        outputs:

      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:

        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 0 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:

        Project: !Ref ProjectName
