AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 5 EC2 instances with CloudWatch CPU, status-check and attached-EBS alarms

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: ec2-monitoring
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Project name used as a prefix for resource Name tags and alarm names.
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: SSM public parameter for the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI.

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet-2'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for monitored EC2 instances - no inbound access
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS egress within the VPC only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-sg'

  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-role'

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  EbsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting EC2 instance root EBS volumes
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEc2VolumeEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowEc2CreateGrantForVolumes
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              Bool:
                kms:GrantIsForAWSResource: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ebs-key'

  InstanceLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-launch-template'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt InstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
        Monitoring:
          Enabled: true
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
          HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: volume
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-root-volume'

  Instance1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref InstanceLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt InstanceLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
            KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EbsKey.Arn
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-1'

  Instance2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref InstanceLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt InstanceLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
            KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EbsKey.Arn
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-2'

  Instance3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref InstanceLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt InstanceLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
            KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EbsKey.Arn

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-3'

  Instance4:

        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref InstanceLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt InstanceLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber

          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-4'

  Instance5:

        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref InstanceLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt InstanceLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
            KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EbsKey.Arn

      Tags:

          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-5'

  AlarmTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the CloudWatch alarm SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyPolicy:

        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-alarm-topic-key'

  AlarmTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-alarm-topic'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:

        - !Ref AlarmTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Test DynamoDB table (USER_ID hash key, on-demand billing, point-in-time recovery) with CloudWatch alarms that monitor table health and performance.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    AllowedValues:
      - test
      - dev
      - staging
    Description: Environment name used in resource names and the Environment tag.

  ReplicaReceivingRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Region code, for example us-west-2.
    Description: Receiving Region used as the ReceivingRegion dimension for DynamoDB replication metrics.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TestTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-test-table'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm notifications
  # CloudWatch alarms cannot publish to an SNS topic encrypted with the
  # AWS managed key (alias/aws/sns), so a customer managed key is created here.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for the ${EnvironmentName} DynamoDB alarm notification topic'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AlarmTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-alarm-topic'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey

  AlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-alarm-notifications'
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} DynamoDB alarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AlarmNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Count-based alarms (threshold 1)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WriteThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${TestTable}-WriteThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: Write requests to the table are being throttled.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TestTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ThrottledRequests is only published per TableName + Operation, so the
  # alarm sums the metric across the common data-plane operations.
  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${TestTable}-ThrottledRequests'
      AlarmDescription: Requests to the table exceeded provisioned throughput limits and were throttled.
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Metrics:
        - Id: total
          Label: ThrottledRequests (all operations)
          Expression: SUM(METRICS())
          ReturnData: true
        - Id: getitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Stat: Sum
            Period: 60
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref TestTable
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: GetItem
        - Id: putitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Stat: Sum
            Period: 60
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref TestTable
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: PutItem
        - Id: updateitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Stat: Sum
            Period: 60
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref TestTable
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: UpdateItem
        - Id: deleteitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Stat: Sum
            Period: 60
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref TestTable
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: DeleteItem
        - Id: query
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Stat: Sum
            Period: 60
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref TestTable
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: Query
        - Id: scan
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Stat: Sum
            Period: 60
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref TestTable
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: Scan
        - Id: batchgetitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Stat: Sum
            Period: 60
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref TestTable
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: BatchGetItem
        - Id: batchwriteitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Stat: Sum
            Period: 60
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref TestTable
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: BatchWriteItem
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ConditionalCheckFailedRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${TestTable}-ConditionalCheckFailedRequests'
      AlarmDescription: Conditional writes against the table are failing their condition checks.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ConditionalCheckFailedRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TestTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # UserErrors is an account- and Region-level metric with no dimensions.
  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${TestTable}-UserErrors'
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB requests in this account and Region are returning HTTP 400 errors.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # SystemErrors is only published per TableName + Operation, so the alarm
  # sums the metric across the common data-plane operations.
  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${TestTable}-SystemErrors'
      AlarmDescription: Requests to the table are returning HTTP 500 errors.
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Metrics:
        - Id: total

          Expression: SUM(METRICS())
          ReturnData: true

          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Stat: Sum
            Period: 60
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref TestTable
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: GetItem
        - Id: putitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Stat: Sum
            Period: 60
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref TestTable
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: PutItem
        - Id: updateitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Stat: Sum
            Period: 60
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors

        - Id: deleteitem

              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName

                - Name: Operation

        - Id: query

            Period: 60

                - Name: TableName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Replication alarms (5 evaluation periods, 3 datapoints to alarm)
  # NOTE: AWS::DynamoDB::Table does not support replicas, so TestTable is not
  # replicated. PendingReplicationCount and ReplicationLatency will report
  # missing data, which TreatMissingData: notBreaching evaluates as OK. These
  # alarms become meaningful only if the table is later part of a global table
  # replicating to ReplicaReceivingRegion.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PendingReplicationCountAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${TestTable}-PendingReplicationCount-${ReplicaReceivingRegion}'
      AlarmDescription: Number of item updates pending replication to the receiving Region exceeds 100.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: PendingReplicationCount
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TestTable
        - Name: ReceivingRegion
          Value: !Ref ReplicaReceivingRegion
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ReplicationLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${TestTable}-ReplicationLatency-${ReplicaReceivingRegion}'
      AlarmDescription: Average replication latency to the receiving Region exceeds 10 milliseconds.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReplicationLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TestTable
        - Name: ReceivingRegion
          Value: !Ref ReplicaReceivingRegion
      Statistic: Average
      Unit: Milliseconds
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the test DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref TestTable

  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the test DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt TestTable.Arn

  AlarmNotificationTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic that receives alarm notifications.
    Value: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  AlarmTopicKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key that encrypts the alarm notification topic.
    Value: !GetAtt AlarmTopicKey.Arn

  DeploymentRegion:
    Description: Region where the table and alarms are deployed.
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Content-level PII classification scanner for S3 Access Points using Amazon Comprehend
  DetectPiiEntities. Results are stored in an encrypted DynamoDB table with point-in-time
  recovery, and optional SNS email notifications are sent when PII is found. The SNS findings
  topic is encrypted with a stack-owned customer managed KMS key. The scanner Lambda runs
  outside any VPC by default, which works only for Internet-origin access points. For
  VPC-origin access points, supply VpcId, SubnetIds, SecurityGroupId and RouteTableIds.
  The access point to scan is supplied at invocation time. Prerequisites outside this stack:
  the underlying bucket policy must delegate access control to access points, and the access
  point policy must allow the scanner role (see ScannerRoleArn output).

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network placement (leave empty for Internet-origin access points)
        Parameters:
          - VpcId
          - SubnetIds
          - SecurityGroupId
          - RouteTableIds
          - CreateVpcEndpoints
      - Label:
          default: Scanner settings
        Parameters:
          - LambdaMemorySize
          - LambdaTimeout
          - DefaultLanguageCode
          - DefaultMaxFiles
      - Label:
          default: Notifications
        Parameters:
          - NotificationEmail

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^(vpc-[0-9a-f]{8,17})?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid VPC ID (vpc-xxxxxxxx).
    Description: >-
      Run 'aws s3control get-access-point --account-id <ACCOUNT_ID> --name <ACCESS_POINT_NAME>'
      first. If NetworkOrigin is "Internet", leave this empty. If it is "VPC", enter the
      access point's VPC ID (VpcConfiguration.VpcId) here so the Lambda is deployed inside that VPC.

  SubnetIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^(subnet-[0-9a-f]{8,17}(,subnet-[0-9a-f]{8,17})*)?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a comma-separated list of subnet IDs.
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated private subnet IDs in the target VPC (required when VpcId is set).
      Each subnet must be in a distinct Availability Zone, because an Interface endpoint
      accepts at most one subnet per AZ.

  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^(sg-[0-9a-f]{8,17})?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid security group ID (sg-xxxxxxxx).
    Description: >-
      Security group in the target VPC to attach to the Lambda ENIs (required when VpcId is set).
      It must allow outbound TCP 443.

  RouteTableIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^(rtb-[0-9a-f]{8,17}(,rtb-[0-9a-f]{8,17})*)?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a comma-separated list of route table IDs.
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated route table IDs associated with SubnetIds (required when VpcId is set).
      They are used for the S3 and DynamoDB Gateway endpoints.

  CreateVpcEndpoints:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "true"
    Description: >-
      Only used when VpcId is set. Creates S3 and DynamoDB Gateway endpoints and Comprehend and
      SNS Interface endpoints. Set this to "false" if the VPC already has ANY of these: an S3
      Gateway endpoint on the same route tables, a DynamoDB Gateway endpoint, a Comprehend
      Interface endpoint, or an SNS Interface endpoint. A duplicate endpoint fails creation and
      rolls back the entire stack. Interface endpoints need VPC DNS support and DNS hostnames enabled.

  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^([^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+)?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid email address.
    Description: Optional email address subscribed to PII finding notifications (requires confirmation).

  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Scanner Lambda memory size in MB.

  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Scanner Lambda timeout in seconds (Lambda hard limit is 900).

  DefaultLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: en
    AllowedValues: [en, es]
    Description: Default Comprehend language code (DetectPiiEntities supports only en and es).

  DefaultMaxFiles:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000
    Description: Default maximum number of files scanned per invocation (cost and runtime cap).

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]]
  HasEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, ""]]
  HasRouteTables: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RouteTableIds, ""]]
  CreateEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition HasVpc
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateVpcEndpoints, "true"]
  CreateGatewayEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition CreateEndpoints
    - !Condition HasRouteTables

Rules:
  VpcDeploymentRequiresNetworkInputs:
    RuleCondition: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]]
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SubnetIds, ""]]
        AssertDescription: SubnetIds must be supplied when VpcId is set.
      - Assert: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SecurityGroupId, ""]]
        AssertDescription: SecurityGroupId must be supplied when VpcId is set.
      - Assert: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RouteTableIds, ""]]
        AssertDescription: RouteTableIds must be supplied when VpcId is set.
  NoVpcRequiresEmptyNetworkInputs:
    RuleCondition: !Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !And
          - !Equals [!Ref SubnetIds, ""]
          - !Equals [!Ref SecurityGroupId, ""]
          - !Equals [!Ref RouteTableIds, ""]
        AssertDescription: SubnetIds, SecurityGroupId and RouteTableIds must be empty unless VpcId is set.

Resources:
  ReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pii-reports"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: scan_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: object_key
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: scan_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: object_key
          KeyType: RANGE
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expires_at
        Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  FindingsTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "${AWS::StackName} customer managed key for the PII findings SNS topic"
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUseForFindingsTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${AWS::StackName}-pii-findings"
      Tags:
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  FindingsTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-pii-findings"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FindingsTopicKey

  FindingsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pii-findings"
      DisplayName: PII scanner findings
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt FindingsTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  FindingsTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref FindingsTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref FindingsTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  EmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref FindingsTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail

  ScannerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner"
      RetentionInDays: 90

  ScannerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Execution role for the ${AWS::StackName} PII scanner Lambda"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HasVpc
        - - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole"
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: pii-scanner
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListThroughAccessPoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*"
              - Sid: ReadObjectsThroughAccessPoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*/object/*"
              # s3:GetAccessPoint and comprehend:DetectPiiEntities do not support resource-level permissions.
              - Sid: CheckAccessPointNetworkOrigin
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetAccessPoint
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DetectPii
                Effect: Allow
                Action: comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: WriteReports
                Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ReportTable.Arn
              - Sid: PublishFindings
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref FindingsTopic
              - Sid: UseFindingsTopicKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt FindingsTopicKey.Arn
              # Objects behind the access point may be SSE-KMS encrypted.
              - Sid: DecryptSseKmsObjectsViaS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub "s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt ScannerLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub "${AWS::StackName} Comprehend and SNS interface endpoints"
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from the PII scanner Lambda
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref SecurityGroupId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Endpoint ENIs only receive traffic; deny all egress
          IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: 127.0.0.1/32
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-endpoints"

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateGatewayEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      RouteTableIds: !Split [",", !Ref RouteTableIds]

  DynamoDbGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateGatewayEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb"
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      RouteTableIds: !Split [",", !Ref RouteTableIds]

  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend"
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SubnetIds: !Split [",", !Ref SubnetIds]
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SnsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns"
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SubnetIds: !Split [",", !Ref SubnetIds]
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner"
      Description: Scans objects exposed through an S3 Access Point for PII using Comprehend DetectPiiEntities
      Runtime: python3.12
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref ScannerLogGroup
        LogFormat: Text
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Split [",", !Ref SubnetIds]
          SecurityGroupIds:
            - !Ref SecurityGroupId
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ReportTable
          TOPIC_ARN: !Ref FindingsTopic
          DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref DefaultLanguageCode
          DEFAULT_MAX_FILES: !Ref DefaultMaxFiles
          MAX_BYTES_PER_FILE: "262144"
          CHUNK_BYTES: "90000"
          SCORE_THRESHOLD: "0.8"
          REPORT_TTL_DAYS: "365"
          IN_VPC: !If [HasVpc, "true", "false"]
      Tags:
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os, re, json, time, uuid, logging
          from collections import Counter
          from datetime import datetime, timezone
          from decimal import Decimal
          import boto3
          from botocore.config import Config
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          log = logging.getLogger()
          log.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          E = os.environ
          RETRY = Config(retries={"max_attempts": 5, "mode": "standard"})
          s3 = boto3.client("s3", config=RETRY)
          # Short timeouts so an unreachable S3 Control endpoint cannot stall the run.
          s3c = boto3.client("s3control", config=Config(connect_timeout=5, read_timeout=10, retries={"max_attempts": 2}))
          comprehend = boto3.client("comprehend", config=Config(retries={"max_attempts": 1}))
          sns = boto3.client("sns", config=RETRY)
          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb", config=RETRY).Table(E["TABLE_NAME"])

          CHUNK_BYTES = int(E["CHUNK_BYTES"])
          MAX_BYTES = int(E["MAX_BYTES_PER_FILE"])
          THRESHOLD = float(E["SCORE_THRESHOLD"])
          TTL_SECONDS = int(E["REPORT_TTL_DAYS"]) * 86400
          IN_VPC = E["IN_VPC"] == "true"
          SAFETY_MS = 30000
          MAX_FINDINGS = 200
          MAX_NOTIFY_FILES = 100
          SKIP_EXT = {
              "png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "bmp", "tif", "tiff", "webp", "ico", "heic", "svgz",
              "mp3", "wav", "flac", "aac", "ogg", "m4a", "mp4", "mov", "avi", "mkv", "webm",
              "zip", "gz", "tgz", "bz2", "xz", "7z", "rar", "tar", "zst", "jar", "whl",
              "parquet", "orc", "avro", "pdf", "docx", "xlsx", "pptx", "exe", "dll", "so",
              "bin", "class", "pyc", "woff", "woff2", "ttf", "otf", "iso", "dmg", "db", "sqlite",
          }
          SKIP_CT = ("image/", "video/", "audio/", "font/", "application/zip", "application/gzip",
                     "application/x-tar", "application/x-7z", "application/x-rar", "application/pdf",
                     "application/vnd.apache.parquet")
          ARN_RE = re.compile(r"^arn:aws[a-z-]*:s3:[a-z0-9-]+:(\d{12}):accesspoint/([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,61}[a-z0-9])$")


          def network_origin(account, name):
              try:
                  origin = s3c.get_access_point(AccountId=account, Name=name).get("NetworkOrigin")
              except Exception as e:  # informational only; the data-plane calls decide reachability
                  log.warning("NetworkOrigin check failed for %s: %s", name, e)
                  return None
              log.info("Access point %s NetworkOrigin=%s", name, origin)
              return origin


          def chunks(text):
              """Yield (char_offset, segment) with each segment <= CHUNK_BYTES UTF-8 bytes."""
              b = text.encode("utf-8")
              start, char_off = 0, 0
              while start < len(b):
                  end = min(start + CHUNK_BYTES, len(b))
                  if end < len(b):
                      cut = max(b.rfind(b"\n", start, end), b.rfind(b" ", start, end))
                      if cut > start:
                          end = cut + 1
                      else:
                          while end > start and (b[end] & 0xC0) == 0x80:
                              end -= 1
                  seg = b[start:end].decode("utf-8")
                  yield char_off, seg
                  char_off += len(seg)
                  start = end


          def detect(text, lang):
              for attempt in range(6):
                  try:
                      return comprehend.detect_pii_entities(Text=text, LanguageCode=lang)["Entities"]
                  except ClientError as e:
                      code = e.response["Error"]["Code"]
                      if code not in ("ThrottlingException", "TooManyRequestsException") or attempt == 5:
                          raise
                      time.sleep(min(0.5 * 2 ** attempt, 8))


          def skip_reason(key, size):
              if size == 0 or key.endswith("/"):
                  return "empty_or_directory"
              name = key.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
              if "." in name and name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() in SKIP_EXT:
                  return "binary_extension"
              return None


          def scan_object(ap, obj, sample, lang):
              resp = s3.get_object(Bucket=ap, Key=obj["Key"], Range=f"bytes=0-{sample - 1}")
              raw = resp["Body"].read()
              if resp.get("ContentType", "").lower().startswith(SKIP_CT) or b"\x00" in raw[:8192]:
                  return None, len(raw)
              text = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
              found = []
              for off, seg in chunks(text):
                  if seg.strip():
                      for e in detect(seg, lang):
                          found.append({"type": e["Type"], "score": e["Score"],
                                        "begin": e["BeginOffset"] + off, "end": e["EndOffset"] + off})
              return found, len(raw)


          def save(scan_id, ap, obj, lang, found, nbytes, counts):
              now = int(time.time())
              top = sorted(found, key=lambda f: -f["score"])[:MAX_FINDINGS]
              table.put_item(Item={
                  "scan_id": scan_id,
                  "object_key": obj["Key"],
                  "access_point_arn": ap,
                  "etag": obj.get("ETag", "").strip('"'),
                  "last_modified": obj["LastModified"].isoformat() if obj.get("LastModified") else "",
                  "size_bytes": obj["Size"],
                  "bytes_scanned": nbytes,
                  "sampled": nbytes < obj["Size"],
                  "language_code": lang,
                  "has_pii": bool(counts),
                  "entity_counts": dict(counts),
                  "max_score": Decimal(str(round(max((f["score"] for f in found), default=0), 4))),
                  "findings": [{"type": f["type"], "score": Decimal(str(round(f["score"], 4))),
                                "begin_offset": f["begin"], "end_offset": f["end"]} for f in top],
                  "findings_truncated": len(found) > MAX_FINDINGS,
                  "scanned_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                  "expires_at": now + TTL_SECONDS,
              })


          def notify(scan_id, ap, flagged, totals):
              if not flagged:
                  return
              msg = {"scan_id": scan_id, "access_point_arn": ap, "files_with_pii": len(flagged),
                     "entity_totals": dict(totals), "files": flagged[:MAX_NOTIFY_FILES],
                     "files_truncated": len(flagged) > MAX_NOTIFY_FILES}
              try:
                  sns.publish(TopicArn=E["TOPIC_ARN"], Subject=f"PII detected in {len(flagged)} file(s)",
                              Message=json.dumps(msg))
              except ClientError as e:
                  log.error("SNS publish failed: %s", e)


          def handler(event, context):
              ap = (event or {}).get("access_point_arn", "")
              m = ARN_RE.match(ap)
              if not m:
                  return {"error": "access_point_arn is required and must be an S3 access point ARN"}
              origin = network_origin(m[1], m[2])
              if origin == "VPC" and not IN_VPC:
                  return {"error": "Access point NetworkOrigin is VPC but this function runs outside any VPC. "
                                   "Update the stack with VpcId, SubnetIds, SecurityGroupId and RouteTableIds "
                                   "of the access point's VPC."}
              lang = event.get("language_code") or E["DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_CODE"]
              if lang not in ("en", "es"):
                  return {"error": "language_code must be 'en' or 'es'"}
              scan_id = event.get("scan_id") or str(uuid.uuid4())
              max_files = max(1, min(int(event.get("max_files") or E["DEFAULT_MAX_FILES"]), 10000))
              sample = max(1, min(int(event.get("sample_bytes") or MAX_BYTES), MAX_BYTES))
              resume = event.get("continuation_token")
              kw = {"Bucket": ap, "MaxKeys": 1000}
              if event.get("prefix"):
                  kw["Prefix"] = event["prefix"]

              totals, flagged = Counter(), []
              stats = {"files_scanned": 0, "files_with_pii": 0, "files_skipped": 0, "files_failed": 0}
              stopped = False
              while not stopped:
                  kw.pop("ContinuationToken", None)
                  kw.pop("StartAfter", None)
                  if resume:
                      # "startafter:<key>" resumes mid-page; anything else is an S3 continuation token.
                      if resume.startswith("startafter:"):
                          kw["StartAfter"] = resume[len("startafter:"):]
                      else:
                          kw["ContinuationToken"] = resume
                  page = s3.list_objects_v2(**kw)
                  for obj in page.get("Contents", []):
                      if stats["files_scanned"] >= max_files or context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < SAFETY_MS:
                          stopped = True
                          break
                      key = obj["Key"]
                      if skip_reason(key, obj.get("Size", 0)):
                          stats["files_skipped"] += 1
                      else:
                          try:
                              found, nbytes = scan_object(ap, obj, sample, lang)
                              if found is None:
                                  stats["files_skipped"] += 1
                              else:
                                  counts = Counter(f["type"] for f in found if f["score"] >= THRESHOLD)
                                  save(scan_id, ap, obj, lang, found, nbytes, counts)
                                  stats["files_scanned"] += 1
                                  if counts:
                                      stats["files_with_pii"] += 1
                                      totals.update(counts)
                                      flagged.append({"key": key, "entity_counts": dict(counts)})
                          except ClientError as e:
                              stats["files_failed"] += 1
                              log.error("Failed to scan %s: %s", key, e)
                      resume = "startafter:" + key
                  else:
                      resume = page.get("NextContinuationToken") if page.get("IsTruncated") else None
                      stopped = resume is None

              notify(scan_id, ap, flagged, totals)
              result = {"scan_id": scan_id, "access_point_arn": ap, "network_origin": origin, **stats,
                        "entity_totals": dict(totals), "next_continuation_token": resume,
                        "complete": resume is None}
              log.info(json.dumps(result))
              return result

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PiBot Cognito authentication stack - main web application authentication plus IoT trusted user provisioning authentication.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: pibot
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+$
    Description: Lowercase project name used to prefix resource names and export names.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main web application authentication
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-main-user-pool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  MainUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-main-user-pool-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref MainUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  MainIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-main-identity-pool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref MainUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt MainUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  MainAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "${ProjectName} main web app Cognito authenticated role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Production public DNS zone for radiotopia.fm, including its CloudFront origins
  (shared KMS-encrypted S3 origin bucket, Origin Access Control, shared WAFv2 Web ACL,
  and the media, tower, v1, and plus distributions), email authentication records,
  and third-party vendor verification records.

# Operational note:
#   0. Deploy this stack in us-east-1. CloudFront-scoped WAFv2 Web ACLs, and the
#      later ACM certificates used by CloudFront, can only be created in that region.
#   1. After deployment, update the registrar NS records for radiotopia.fm to the
#      values in the NameServers output.
#   2. Supply real vendor token values through parameter overrides on a stack update.
#   3. Request ACM certificates in us-east-1 for media, tower, v1, and plus
#      .radiotopia.fm, and supply their validation names and values through the
#      Acm* parameters.
#   4. Once the certificates are issued, attach Aliases and an ACM ViewerCertificate
#      to each distribution in a follow-up stack update.
#   5. Principals that upload content to the origin bucket need kms:GenerateDataKey
#      and kms:Encrypt on the OriginBucketKey. Grant these with IAM policies, which
#      the key policy permits through its account-root delegation statement.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Apex domain verification
        Parameters:
          - DomainVerificationToken1
          - DomainVerificationToken2
          - SquarespaceVerificationToken
          - ZendeskVerificationValue
      - Label:
          default: DKIM public keys
        Parameters:
          - GoogleDkimPublicKeyPart1
          - GoogleDkimPublicKeyPart2
          - CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKeyPart1
          - CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKeyPart2
      - Label:
          default: ACM validation records
        Parameters:
          - AcmMediaValidationName
          - AcmMediaValidationValue
          - AcmTowerValidationName
          - AcmTowerValidationValue
          - AcmV1ValidationName
          - AcmV1ValidationValue
          - AcmPlusValidationName
          - AcmPlusValidationValue
      - Label:
          default: Other endpoints
        Parameters:
          - FeedProxyHostname
          - EventSubdomainIPv4

Parameters:
  DomainVerificationToken1:
    Type: String
    Description: First apex domain ownership verification token (full TXT value, without quotes).
    Default: google-site-verification=REPLACE_WITH_REAL_TOKEN_1
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9=._:+/-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-255 characters without spaces or quotes.

  DomainVerificationToken2:
    Type: String
    Description: Second apex domain ownership verification token (full TXT value, without quotes).
    Default: verification-token=REPLACE_WITH_REAL_TOKEN_2
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9=._:+/-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-255 characters without spaces or quotes.

  SquarespaceVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Description: Squarespace-issued verification host label (the part before .radiotopia.fm).
    Default: sqs-verify-placeholder
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid lowercase DNS label.

  ZendeskVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Description: Zendesk-issued domain verification value for zendeskverification.radiotopia.fm.
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_ZENDESK_VERIFICATION_VALUE
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9=._:+/-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-255 characters without spaces or quotes.

  GoogleDkimPublicKeyPart1:
    Type: String
    Description: First chunk of the Google Workspace DKIM public key (base64, up to 237 characters).
    Default: MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAREPLACEWITHREALGOOGLEDKIMKEYPART1
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 237
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be base64 characters only, up to 237 characters.

  GoogleDkimPublicKeyPart2:
    Type: String
    Description: Remaining chunk of the Google Workspace DKIM public key (base64, up to 255 characters).
    Default: REPLACEWITHREALGOOGLEDKIMKEYPART2IDAQAB
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be base64 characters only, up to 255 characters.

  CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKeyPart1:
    Type: String
    Description: First chunk of the Campaign Monitor DKIM public key (base64, up to 246 characters).
    Default: MIGfMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUAA4GNADCBiQKBgQCREPLACEWITHREALCMDKIMKEYPART1
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 246
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be base64 characters only, up to 246 characters.

  CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKeyPart2:
    Type: String
    Description: Remaining chunk of the Campaign Monitor DKIM public key (base64, up to 255 characters).
    Default: REPLACEWITHREALCMDKIMKEYPART2IDAQAB
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be base64 characters only, up to 255 characters.

  AcmMediaValidationName:
    Type: String
    Description: ACM validation record host label for media.radiotopia.fm (starts with an underscore).
    Default: _00000000000000000000000000000001
    AllowedPattern: '^_[a-z0-9]{1,62}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an underscore followed by lowercase alphanumerics.

  AcmMediaValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Description: ACM validation target token for media (the part before .acm-validations.aws).
    Default: _00000000000000000000000000000001.placeholder
    AllowedPattern: '^_[a-z0-9]{1,62}(\.[a-z0-9]{1,63})*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an underscore-prefixed ACM validation token.

  AcmTowerValidationName:
    Type: String
    Description: ACM validation record host label for tower.radiotopia.fm (starts with an underscore).
    Default: _00000000000000000000000000000002
    AllowedPattern: '^_[a-z0-9]{1,62}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an underscore followed by lowercase alphanumerics.

  AcmTowerValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Description: ACM validation target token for tower (the part before .acm-validations.aws).
    Default: _00000000000000000000000000000002.placeholder
    AllowedPattern: '^_[a-z0-9]{1,62}(\.[a-z0-9]{1,63})*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an underscore-prefixed ACM validation token.

  AcmV1ValidationName:
    Type: String
    Description: ACM validation record host label for v1.radiotopia.fm (starts with an underscore).
    Default: _00000000000000000000000000000003
    AllowedPattern: '^_[a-z0-9]{1,62}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an underscore followed by lowercase alphanumerics.

  AcmV1ValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Description: ACM validation target token for v1 (the part before .acm-validations.aws).
    Default: _00000000000000000000000000000003.placeholder
    AllowedPattern: '^_[a-z0-9]{1,62}(\.[a-z0-9]{1,63})*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an underscore-prefixed ACM validation token.

  AcmPlusValidationName:
    Type: String
    Description: ACM validation record host label for plus.radiotopia.fm (starts with an underscore).
    Default: _00000000000000000000000000000004
    AllowedPattern: '^_[a-z0-9]{1,62}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an underscore followed by lowercase alphanumerics.

  AcmPlusValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Description: ACM validation target token for plus (the part before .acm-validations.aws).
    Default: _00000000000000000000000000000004.placeholder
    AllowedPattern: '^_[a-z0-9]{1,62}(\.[a-z0-9]{1,63})*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an underscore-prefixed ACM validation token.

  FeedProxyHostname:
    Type: String
    Description: Feed-proxy service hostname for feeds.radiotopia.fm (without a trailing dot).
    Default: radiotopia.feedproxy.example.com
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 253
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,63}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a fully qualified hostname without a trailing dot.

  EventSubdomainIPv4:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 address for the special event subdomain live.radiotopia.fm.
    Default: 192.0.2.10
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid dotted-quad IPv4 address.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted zone
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Production public DNS zone for radiotopia.fm
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront origin storage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OriginBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the radiotopia.fm CloudFront origin bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudFrontServicePrincipalSSEKMS
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                AWS:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudfront::${AWS::AccountId}:distribution/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production

  OriginBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/radiotopia-origin-${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref OriginBucketKey

  OriginBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OriginBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway (MCP) infrastructure for a protein variant effect
  prediction AI agent. Creates a placeholder backend Lambda and Cognito authorizer
  stand-ins, publishes their configuration to SSM Parameter Store, and provisions an
  AgentCore Gateway with a custom JWT authorizer and a Lambda-backed MCP gateway target.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only, starting with a letter or number (max 41 characters).
    Description: Project name used in resource names and SSM parameter paths.
  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: AgentCore Gateway exposing protein variant effect prediction tools via MCP
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: Description of the AgentCore Gateway.
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^([0-9a-zA-Z][-]?){1,100}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Alphanumeric characters separated by single hyphens, or empty to auto-generate.
    Description: Optional gateway name. Leave blank to use '<ProjectName>-gateway'.

Conditions:
  UseDefaultGatewayName: !Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']

Resources:
  BackendLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-backend-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  BackendLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-variant-effect-backend'
      Description: Placeholder backend for protein variant effect prediction MCP tools.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt BackendLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import uuid


          def handler(event, context):
              tool_name = ""
              try:
                  tool_name = context.client_context.custom.get("bedrockAgentCoreToolName", "")
              except AttributeError:
                  pass
              tool = tool_name.split("___")[-1] if tool_name else ""

              if tool == "invoke_endpoint":
                  sequence = event.get("sequence", "")
                  if not sequence:
                      return {"error": "sequence is required"}
                  return {
                      "job_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                      "status": "SUBMITTED",
                      "sequence_length": len(sequence),
                  }

              if tool == "get_results":
                  job_id = event.get("job_id", "")
                  if not job_id:
                      return {"error": "job_id is required"}
                  return {
                      "job_id": job_id,
                      "status": "IN_PROGRESS",
                      "message": "Placeholder backend: replace with the real prediction service.",
                  }

              return {"error": f"Unknown tool: {tool_name}", "event": json.dumps(event)}

  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-users'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: admin_only
            Priority: 1

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  LambdaArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/lambda-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt BackendLambda.Arn
      Description: ARN of the backend Lambda invoked by the AgentCore Gateway target.

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/cognito-discovery-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OIDC discovery URL of the Cognito user pool used by the gateway JWT authorizer.

  CognitoClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/cognito-client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
      Description: Cognito app client ID allowed by the gateway JWT authorizer.

  GatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      Description: Service role assumed by the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke the backend Lambda.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:gateway/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeBackendLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt BackendLambda.Arn
                  - !Sub '${BackendLambda.Arn}:*'

  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the AgentCore Gateway.

  Gateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    Properties:
      Name: !If [UseDefaultGatewayName, !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway', !Ref GatewayName]
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      RoleArn: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      ProtocolType: MCP
      ProtocolConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          SearchType: SEMANTIC
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
          AllowedClients:
            - !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient

  GatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-variant-effect-target'
      Description: Lambda target exposing protein variant effect prediction tools.
      GatewayIdentifier: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayIdentifier
      CredentialProviderConfigurations:
        - CredentialProviderType: GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt BackendLambda.Arn
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload:
                - Name: invoke_endpoint
                  Description: Submit a protein sequence for variant effect prediction. Returns a job ID used to retrieve results.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      sequence:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Protein amino acid sequence in single-letter code.
                      job_name:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Optional human-readable name for the prediction job.
                    Required:
                      - sequence
                - Name: get_results
                  Description: Check completion status of a prediction job and retrieve its results when complete.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      job_id:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Job ID returned by invoke_endpoint.
                    Required:
                      - job_id

  GatewayIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayIdentifier
      Description: Identifier of the AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayUrl
      Description: MCP endpoint URL of the AgentCore Gateway.

Outputs:
  GatewayId:
    Description: AgentCore Gateway identifier.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayIdentifier
  GatewayUrl:
    Description: AgentCore Gateway MCP endpoint URL.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayUrl
  GatewayArn:
    Description: AgentCore Gateway ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayArn
  GatewayRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN used by the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
  GatewayRoleArnParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name storing the gateway role ARN.
    Value: !Ref GatewayRoleArnParameter
  LambdaArn:
    Description: Backend Lambda function ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt BackendLambda.Arn
  CognitoUserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  CognitoClientId:
    Description: Cognito user pool client ID.
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
  CognitoDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: Cognito OIDC discovery URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
