AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Private VPC with two ALB subnets, a Lambda subnet, optional NAT Gateway egress for OAuth and IdP flows, and a customer-managed KMS-encrypted artifact bucket.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: private-app
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Environment name used in resource names, tags, and the KMS alias.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  AlbSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the first private ALB subnet.

  AlbSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the second private ALB subnet.

  LambdaSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the private Lambda subnet.

  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.100.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet hosting the NAT Gateway (used only when EnableNatGateway is true).

  EnableNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create a NAT Gateway for outbound internet egress (OAuth and external IdP flows).

  IdentityProviderEgressCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([8-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /8 and /32.
    Description: CIDR of the external OAuth/IdP endpoints, used only when EnableNatGateway is true.

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlbPrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-alb-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AlbPrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-alb-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LambdaPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-lambda-private-subnet
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AlbPrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbPrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  AlbPrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbPrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  LambdaPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref LambdaPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional NAT egress
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-public-subnet
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref NatPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref NatPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Gateway endpoint (private access to S3 without NAT)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlbSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Internal ALB security group allowing HTTPS from within the VPC
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from within the VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to targets within the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-alb-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Lambda security group allowing HTTPS from the ALB and scoped HTTPS egress
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt AlbSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Description: HTTPS from the ALB
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to VPC-internal targets and endpoints
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-lambda-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LambdaIdpEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt LambdaSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: !Ref IdentityProviderEgressCidr
      Description: HTTPS to external OAuth/IdP via NAT

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer-managed key for ${EnvironmentName} artifact bucket encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMPolicies
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-artifact-kms-key
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ArtifactKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${EnvironmentName}-artifacts
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ArtifactKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Artifact bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ArtifactKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-artifact-bucket
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyIncorrectEncryptionHeader
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
            Condition:
              StringNotEqualsIfExists:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Step Functions state machine with a two-step Pass workflow, exposed through two separate regional API Gateway REST APIs (GET and POST), each with its own IAM role to start executions.

Resources:
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sfn-execution-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-state-machine"
      RetentionInDays: 14

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pass-workflow"
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: false
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Simple two-step pass workflow
        StartAt: FirstStep
        States:
          FirstStep:
            Type: Pass
            Result:
              step: first
            ResultPath: $.firstStep
            Next: SecondStep
          SecondStep:
            Type: Pass
            Result:
              step: second
            ResultPath: $.secondStep
            End: true

  GetApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-get-apigw-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  PostApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-post-apigw-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  GetRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-get-api"
      Description: REST API exposing a GET endpoint that starts the state machine
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  GetApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt GetRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execute

  GetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref GetApiResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: AWS_IAM
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiGatewayRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            #set($params = $input.params().querystring)
            {
              "input": "{#foreach($key in $params.keySet())\"$util.escapeJavaScript($key)\":\"$util.escapeJavaScript($params.get($key))\"#if($foreach.hasNext),#end#end}",
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Bad request"}'
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Internal server error"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Error
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Error

  PostRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-post-api"
      Description: REST API exposing a POST endpoint that starts the state machine
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  PostApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt PostRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execute

  PostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref PostApiResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: AWS_IAM
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiGatewayRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))",
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Bad request"}'
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Internal server error"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Error
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Error

  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: GetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      Description: Deployment of the GET API

  GetApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref GetApiDeployment
      Description: Production stage for the GET API

  PostApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: PostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      Description: Deployment of the POST API

  PostApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref PostApiDeployment
      Description: Production stage for the POST API

Outputs:

    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  StateMachineName:
    Description: Name of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachine.Name
  StateMachineLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group for state machine execution logs
    Value: !Ref StateMachineLogGroup
  GetRestApiId:
    Description: ID of the GET REST API
    Value: !Ref GetRestApi
  GetApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL for the GET endpoint
    Value: !Sub "https://${GetRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${GetApiStage}/execute"
  PostRestApiId:
    Description: ID of the POST REST API
    Value: !Ref PostRestApi
  PostApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL for the POST endpoint
    Value: !Sub "https://${PostRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${PostApiStage}/execute"
  GetApiGatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the GET API to start executions
    Value: !GetAtt GetApiGatewayRole.Arn
  PostApiGatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the POST API to start executions
    Value: !GetAtt PostApiGatewayRole.Arn

Description: >-
  Hospitality Insights foundation IAM and Secrets Manager stack. Creates least-privilege
  Lambda execution roles for the scraper, analysis, alerts, API, admin, and archival
  microservices, a Bedrock AgentCore runtime role, and placeholder Secrets Manager secrets
  under the project/environment Secrets Manager naming prefix (default hospitality-insights/prod/).

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    Description: Lowercase project identifier used in resource names, tags, and IAM ARN patterns.
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (max 32 characters).

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used in resource names, tags, and IAM ARN patterns.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scraper Lambda role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScraperLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for the ${ProjectName} ${Environment} scraper Lambda functions.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: SQSConsumeAndSend
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: S3ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: S3ObjectReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: SecretsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Analysis Lambda role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AnalysisLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for the ${ProjectName} ${Environment} analysis Lambda functions.'

        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: SQSConsumeAndSend
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: SNSPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: ComprehendDetect
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:DetectEntities
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectEntities
                  - comprehend:DetectKeyPhrases
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectKeyPhrases
                  - comprehend:DetectDominantLanguage
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectDominantLanguage
                  - comprehend:DetectTargetedSentiment
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectTargetedSentiment
                # Comprehend real-time detect APIs do not support resource-level permissions.
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: BedrockInvokeFoundationModels
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource:
                  # Region wildcard permits cross-region inference profiles to route to foundation models.
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:application-inference-profile/*'
              - Sid: S3ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: S3ObjectReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: SecretsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alerts Lambda role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlertsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for the ${ProjectName} ${Environment} alerts Lambda functions.'

        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts-policy'
          PolicyDocument:

            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: SQSConsume
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: SNSPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                  - sns:GetTopicAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: SecretsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiLambdaRole:

        Statement:

      ManagedPolicyArns:

        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-api-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem

                  - dynamodb:Query

                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: SQSSend

              - Sid: S3ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket

              - Sid: S3ObjectRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: SecretsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Admin Lambda role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-admin-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for the ${ProjectName} ${Environment} admin Lambda functions.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-admin-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBCrud
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: SQSManage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:PurgeQueue

              - Sid: SNSPublish
                Effect: Allow

                  - sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: StepFunctionsStateMachines
                Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - states:DescribeStateMachine
                  - states:ListExecutions
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: StepFunctionsExecutions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:DescribeExecution
                  - states:GetExecutionHistory
                  - states:StopExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:execution:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*:*'
              - Sid: S3ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: S3ObjectReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject

              - Sid: SecretsManage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:

        - Key: Environment

              - Sid: SecretsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bedrock AgentCore runtime role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgentCoreRuntimeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-agentcore-runtime-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for the ${ProjectName} ${Environment} Bedrock AgentCore runtime.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-agentcore-runtime-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BedrockInvokeModels
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource:
                  # Region wildcard permits cross-region inference profiles to route to foundation models.
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:application-inference-profile/*'
              # VERIFY: bedrock-agentcore session/memory/event action names have not been validated
              # against the IAM service authorization reference. Scoped wildcards are used instead of
              # specific action names; replace with explicit actions once confirmed.
              - Sid: AgentCoreSessionsAndMemory
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:*Session*
                  - bedrock-agentcore:*Memory*
                  - bedrock-agentcore:*Event*
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: S3ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: S3ObjectRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: ECRImagePull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: ECRAuthToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                # ecr:GetAuthorizationToken does not support resource-level permissions.
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                # cloudwatch:PutMetricData does not support resource-level permissions; scoped by namespace.
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Secrets Manager placeholders
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SecretsPrefixSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/${Environment}/prefix'
      Description: !Sub 'Placeholder secret establishing the ${ProjectName}/${Environment}/ Secrets Manager naming prefix.'
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: !Sub '{"project":"${ProjectName}","environment":"${Environment}"}'
        GenerateStringKey: placeholder
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludePunctuation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ScrapingBeeApiKeySecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/${Environment}/scrapingbee-api-key'
      Description: !Sub 'ScrapingBee API key for ${ProjectName} ${Environment}. Generated placeholder value; replace with the real key after deployment.'
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"provider":"scrapingbee"}'
        GenerateStringKey: api_key
        PasswordLength: 64
        ExcludePunctuation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  ScraperLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the scraper Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt ScraperLambdaRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper-role-arn'

  AnalysisLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the analysis Lambda execution role.

    Export:

    Value: !GetAtt AlertsLambdaRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts-role-arn'

  ApiLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiLambdaRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-api-role-arn'

  AdminLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the admin Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt AdminLambdaRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-admin-role-arn'

  ArchivalLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the archival Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt ArchivalLambdaRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-archival-role-arn'

  AgentCoreRuntimeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Bedrock AgentCore runtime role.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreRuntimeRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-agentcore-runtime-role-arn'

  SecretsPrefixSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager prefix placeholder secret.
    Value: !Ref SecretsPrefixSecret
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-secrets-prefix-secret-arn'

  SecretsPrefix:
    Description: Secrets Manager naming prefix for this project and environment.
    Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}/${Environment}/'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a KMS-encrypted audit event SQS queue with key rotation, a conditional
  dead letter queue (non-dev environments), CloudWatch alarms for message age and
  DLQ activity, and SNS alerting for alarm notifications.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev

  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Description: Application name used in resource names and the KMS alias.
    Default: audit-events
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-40 characters of lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional email address to receive alarm notifications. Leave blank to skip the subscription.
    Default: ''

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      MaxReceiveCount: 5
      DeadLetterRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      OldestMessageAgeThreshold: 3600
    staging:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 604800
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
      MaxReceiveCount: 5
      DeadLetterRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      OldestMessageAgeThreshold: 1800
    prod:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 120
      MaxReceiveCount: 3
      DeadLetterRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      OldestMessageAgeThreshold: 900

Conditions:
  IsNotDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]]
  HasAlertEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertEmail, '']]

Resources:
  AuditEventsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${ApplicationName}-${Environment} audit event queues and alarm topic'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSQSServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsViaSQS
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sqs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowSNSServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AuditEventsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey

  AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-dlq'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, DeadLetterRetentionPeriod]
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AuditEventsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-queue'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNotDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MaxReceiveCount]
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AuditEventsQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref AuditEventsQueue
        - !If [IsNotDev, !Ref AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'sqs:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn
              - !If [IsNotDev, !GetAtt AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue.Arn, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AuditAlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-alarms'
      DisplayName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment} audit queue alarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AuditAlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AuditAlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AuditAlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AuditAlarmTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AuditAlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlertEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AuditAlarmTopic

  OldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Triggers when the oldest message in the ${ApplicationName}-${Environment} audit
        queue exceeds the environment threshold, indicating consumers are stalled or falling behind.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, OldestMessageAgeThreshold]
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AuditAlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AuditAlarmTopic

  DeadLetterQueueMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-dlq-messages'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Triggers when any message is visible in the ${ApplicationName}-${Environment}
        dead letter queue, indicating audit events failed processing after the maximum receive count.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AuditAlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AuditAlarmTopic

Outputs:
  AuditEventsQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the audit events queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsQueue

  AuditEventsQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn

  AuditEventsQueueName:
    Description: Name of the audit events queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName

  AuditEventsDeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: URL of the audit events dead letter queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue

  AuditEventsDeadLetterQueueArn:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: ARN of the audit events dead letter queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue.Arn

  AuditEventsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn

  AuditEventsKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the customer-managed KMS key.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsKeyAlias

  AuditAlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic receiving alarm notifications.
    Value: !Ref AuditAlarmTopic

  OldestMessageAgeAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the oldest message age alarm.
    Value: !Ref OldestMessageAgeAlarm

  DeadLetterQueueMessagesAlarmName:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: Name of the dead letter queue messages alarm.
    Value: !Ref DeadLetterQueueMessagesAlarm

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cognito identity layer for the "researchapp" / "AgentCore" application. Creates a
  Cognito user pool with optional software-token MFA, admin and customer groups, a
  hosted UI domain, a custom resource server, web (authorization code) and
  machine-to-machine (client credentials) app clients, a group-assignment Lambda
  function (not wired as a trigger), and configuration stored in SSM Parameter Store
  under /app/researchapp/agentcore/.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w\s+=,.@-]{1,128}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-128 characters of letters, numbers, spaces or +=,.@-_
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine app client.
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w\s+=,.@-]{1,128}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-128 characters of letters, numbers, spaces or +=,.@-_
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the web app client.
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w\s+=,.@-]{1,128}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-128 characters of letters, numbers, spaces or +=,.@-_

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: 'OPTIONAL'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrators of the researchapp AgentCore application.
      Precedence: 0
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Customers of the researchapp AgentCore application.
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: researchapp-agentcore-api
      Name: researchapp-agentcore-api
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the researchapp AgentCore API.

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - researchapp-agentcore-api/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  MachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - researchapp-agentcore-api/read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  MachineClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_secret
      Description: Client ID and secret for the researchapp AgentCore machine-to-machine Cognito app client.
      SecretString: !Sub
        - '{"client_id":"${ClientId}","client_secret":"${ClientSecret}"}'
        - ClientId: !Ref MachineClient
          ClientSecret: !GetAtt MachineClient.ClientSecret
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: researchapp
        - Key: Component
          Value: AgentCore

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user_pool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito user pool ID for researchapp AgentCore.

  UserPoolArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user_pool_arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Description: Cognito user pool ARN for researchapp AgentCore.

  WebClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebClient
      Description: Cognito web app client ID for researchapp AgentCore.

  MachineClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineClient
      Description: Cognito machine-to-machine app client ID for researchapp AgentCore.

  MachineClientSecretArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_secret_arn
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineClientSecret
      Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the machine-to-machine client secret.

  OAuthScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/oauth_scope
      Type: String
      Value: researchapp-agentcore-api/read
      Description: Custom OAuth scope for the researchapp AgentCore resource server.

  WebClientScopesParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web_client_scopes
      Type: String
      Value: openid email profile researchapp-agentcore-api/read
      Description: OAuth scopes granted to the web app client.

  CognitoDomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito hosted UI domain for researchapp AgentCore.

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL for researchapp AgentCore.

  TokenUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/token_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: OAuth2 token endpoint for researchapp AgentCore.

  AuthorizeUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/authorize_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Description: OAuth2 authorize endpoint for researchapp AgentCore.

  GroupAssignmentFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the researchapp AgentCore group-assignment Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GroupAssignmentPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/researchapp-agentcore-group-assignment:*'
              - Sid: AddUserToGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: researchapp
        - Key: Component
          Value: AgentCore

  GroupAssignmentFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: researchapp-agentcore-group-assignment
      Description: Adds newly confirmed users to the customer group (not wired as an active trigger).
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt GroupAssignmentFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME: !Ref CustomerGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          GROUP_NAME = os.environ["CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME"]


          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event["userPoolId"]
              username = event["userName"]
              cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  GroupName=GROUP_NAME,
              )
              logger.info("Added user to group %s", GROUP_NAME)
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: researchapp
        - Key: Component
          Value: AgentCore

  GroupAssignmentFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${GroupAssignmentFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  GroupAssignmentFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt GroupAssignmentFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  WebClientId:
    Description: Web app client ID.
    Value: !Ref WebClient
  MachineClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine app client ID.
    Value: !Ref MachineClient
  MachineClientSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the machine-to-machine client secret.
    Value: !Ref MachineClientSecret

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL API (CryptoTickerAPI) that fetches cryptocurrency prices from CoinGecko and stores price history in DynamoDB.

Resources:
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(symbol: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          priceUsd: Float
          timestamp: AWSDateTime
          priceHistory(limit: Int = 25, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type PriceRecord {
          ticker: String!
          priceUsd: Float
          timestamp: AWSDateTime
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceRecord]
          nextToken: String
        }

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.Arn
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${APIDataTable.Arn}/index/*'

  AppSyncHttpRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.Arn
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncHttpLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/appsync/apis/*'

  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoDataSource
      Description: CoinGecko public price API
      Type: HTTP
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncHttpRole.Arn
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com

  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSource
      Description: Price history table
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  FetchPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: FetchPriceFunction
      Description: Fetches the current USD price for a ticker from CoinGecko
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const id = ctx.args.symbol.toLowerCase();
          return {
            method: 'GET',
            resourcePath: '/api/v3/simple/price',
            params: {
              query: { ids: id, vs_currencies: 'usd' },
              headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
            },
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          const { error, result } = ctx;
          if (error) {
            util.error(error.message, error.type);
          }
          if (result.statusCode !== 200) {
            util.error(`CoinGecko returned status ${result.statusCode}`, 'HttpError');
          }
          const id = ctx.args.symbol.toLowerCase();
          const body = JSON.parse(result.body);
          const entry = body[id];
          if (!entry || entry.usd === undefined || entry.usd === null) {
            util.error(`No price found for ticker ${ctx.args.symbol}`, 'NotFound');
          }
          return { ticker: id, priceUsd: entry.usd };
        }

  StorePriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: StorePriceFunction
      Description: Stores a historical price record in DynamoDB
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const { ticker, priceUsd } = ctx.prev.result;
          const timestamp = util.time.nowISO8601();
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ hk: ticker, sk: timestamp }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ticker, priceUsd, timestamp }),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          const { error, result } = ctx;
          if (error) {
            util.error(error.message, error.type);
          }
          return result;
        }

  TickerQueryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt StorePriceFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const limit = ctx.args.limit ? ctx.args.limit : 25;
          const query = {
            operation: 'Query',
            query: {
              expression: 'hk = :hk',
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ':hk': ctx.source.ticker }),
            },
            scanIndexForward: false,
            limit: limit,
          };
          if (ctx.args.nextToken) {
            query.nextToken = ctx.args.nextToken;
          }
          return query;
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          const { error, result } = ctx;
          if (error) {
            util.error(error.message, error.type);
          }
          return { items: result.items, nextToken: result.nextToken };
        }

  GraphQLApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Description: Default API key for CryptoTickerAPI

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API ID
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the default API key (retrieve the key value via the AppSync console or CLI)
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApiKey.Arn
  APIDataTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table storing price history
    Value: !Ref APIDataTable
  APIDataTableArn:
    Description: DynamoDB table ARN
    Value: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn
