final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  MediaPackage (v1) live streaming channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints,
  plus optional live-to-VOD archive storage and optional VOD packaging
  (packaging group and configurations). All supporting S3 buckets, the KMS
  customer managed key, and the IAM role are created by this template, so no
  pre-existing infrastructure is needed.

# Greenfield reconciliation: the original request asks for a "user-provided
# ArchiveBucket" and a "user-provided VodSourceBucket". External bucket names
# cannot be referenced in a greenfield account, so they are replaced by the
# EnableArchive and EnableVod toggles. When a toggle is "true", this template
# CREATES the corresponding AWS::S3::Bucket. No bucket names are accepted.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming and Tagging
        Parameters:
          - LogicalNamePrefix
          - Environment
          - CustomTagKey
          - CustomTagValue
      - Label:
          default: Live Packaging
        Parameters:
          - OutputType
          - ManifestName
          - HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
          - StartoverWindowSeconds
      - Label:
          default: Live-to-VOD and VOD Workflows
        Parameters:
          - EnableArchive
          - EnableVod

Parameters:
  LogicalNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: live-stream
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,39}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only alphanumerics
      and hyphens (maximum 40 characters).
    Description: Prefix used for every MediaPackage Id and Name tag.

  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Which origin endpoint(s) to create (HLS, DASH, or both).

  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-64 characters of alphanumerics, underscores, or hyphens.
    Description: Manifest name applied to both origin endpoints.

  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: >-
      Segment duration in seconds for the HLS origin endpoint and the HLS VOD
      packaging configuration. The DASH endpoint always uses 2 seconds.

  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: Startover window in seconds (0 disables startover; max 14 days).

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Environment tag applied to every taggable resource.

  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag key (leave empty to skip the custom tag).

  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag value (used only when CustomTagKey is set).

  EnableArchive:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >-
      When "true", creates a live-to-VOD archive S3 bucket and sets origin
      endpoint origination to DENY (archive-only behavior).

  EnableVod:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >-
      When "true", creates a VOD source S3 bucket, a packaging group, and
      packaging configurations matching the selected output type.

Conditions:
  CreateHls: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateDash: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  ArchiveEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableArchive, 'true']
  VodEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableVod, 'true']
  CreateMediaPackageS3Role: !Or
    - !Condition ArchiveEnabled
    - !Condition VodEnabled
  VodHls: !And
    - !Condition VodEnabled
    - !Condition CreateHls
  VodDash: !And
    - !Condition VodEnabled
    - !Condition CreateDash
  HasCustomTag: !Not
    - !Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey, '']
  StartoverEnabled: !Not
    - !Equals [!Ref StartoverWindowSeconds, 0]

Resources:
  # MediaPackage generates ingest credentials itself; HlsIngest is read-only
  # and is intentionally not set here.
  Channel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
      Description: !Sub 'Live streaming channel for ${LogicalNamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # Origination DENY note: DENY blocks all direct playback requests to the
  # endpoints. Harvest (live-to-VOD clip) jobs still read from DENY endpoints,
  # which is the intended archive-only behavior.
  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateHls
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls'
      ChannelId: !Ref Channel
      Description: !Sub 'HLS origin endpoint for ${LogicalNamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [ArchiveEnabled, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !If
        - StartoverEnabled
        - !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      TimeDelaySeconds: 0
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        PlaylistType: NONE
        PlaylistWindowSeconds: 60
        ProgramDateTimeIntervalSeconds: 0
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: false
        AdMarkers: NONE
        StreamSelection:
          StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateDash
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash'
      ChannelId: !Ref Channel
      Description: !Sub 'DASH origin endpoint for ${LogicalNamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [ArchiveEnabled, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !If
        - StartoverEnabled
        - !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      TimeDelaySeconds: 0
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        ManifestWindowSeconds: 60
        MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
        MinUpdatePeriodSeconds: 15
        SuggestedPresentationDelaySeconds: 25
        Profile: NONE
        SegmentTemplateFormat: NUMBER_WITH_TIMELINE
        StreamSelection:
          StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # Customer managed key shared by the archive and VOD source buckets. The key
  # policy delegates to the account root only (never the role), so access is
  # granted through IAM and the dependency chain stays one-directional.
  S3EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateMediaPackageS3Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CMK for MediaPackage S3 buckets of ${LogicalNamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPolicies
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-s3-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  S3EncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateMediaPackageS3Role
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${LogicalNamePrefix}-s3'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref S3EncryptionKey

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: ArchiveEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt S3EncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-archive'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: VodEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt S3EncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-source'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ArchiveBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: ArchiveEnabled
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArchiveBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageRoleBucketAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:GetBucketRequestPayment
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageRoleObjectAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*'

  VodSourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: VodEnabled
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref VodSourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageRoleBucketAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:GetBucketRequestPayment
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageRoleObjectRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*'

  # The role references bucket and key ARNs only (never the bucket policies),
  # so there is no circular dependency.
  MediaPackageS3Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateMediaPackageS3Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Allows MediaPackage to access S3 buckets for ${LogicalNamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MediaPackageS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - ArchiveEnabled
                - Sid: ArchiveBucketAccess
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetBucketLocation
                    - s3:GetBucketRequestPayment
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource: !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - ArchiveEnabled
                - Sid: ArchiveObjectReadWrite
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:PutObject
                  Resource: !Sub '${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - VodEnabled
                - Sid: VodSourceBucketAccess
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetBucketLocation
                    - s3:GetBucketRequestPayment
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource: !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - VodEnabled
                - Sid: VodSourceObjectRead
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                  Resource: !Sub '${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - Sid: S3EncryptionKeyUsage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt S3EncryptionKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-mediapackage-s3-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  PackagingGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Condition: VodEnabled
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-group'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  HlsPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: VodHls
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-hls'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref PackagingGroup
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: false
        HlsManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
            AdMarkers: NONE
            IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
            ProgramDateTimeIntervalSeconds: 0
            RepeatExtXKey: false
            StreamSelection:
              StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-hls'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  DashPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: VodDash
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-dash'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref PackagingGroup
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        SegmentTemplateFormat: NUMBER_WITH_TIMELINE
        DashManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
            ManifestLayout: FULL
            MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
            Profile: NONE
            StreamSelection:
              StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-dash'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # Omitted: AWS::MediaPackage::Asset. It requires a SourceArn pointing to an
  # existing manifest object in S3. No source content exists in a greenfield
  # deployment, so assets must be ingested after deploy using the role ARN
  # output.
  #
  # Omitted: harvest jobs. No CloudFormation resource type for MediaPackage
  # harvest jobs is confirmed, so live-to-VOD harvests are triggered

  #
  # Omitted: channel ingest endpoint URLs as outputs. A GetAtt attribute for

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) IAM bootstrap resources covering EC2-based and
  EKS-based cluster lifecycle. Creates the control plane, controllers, nodes and
  EKS control plane IAM roles, three instance profiles, and the CAPA custom
  managed policies. Resources use explicit names, so deployment requires
  CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMRoleControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA role assumed by EC2 control plane instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/managed
          Value: 'true'

  AWSIAMRoleControllers:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA role assumed by the Cluster API Provider AWS controllers.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
      Tags:
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/managed
          Value: 'true'

  AWSIAMRoleNodes:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA role assumed by Kubernetes worker node instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
      Tags:
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/managed
          Value: 'true'

  AWSIAMRoleEKSControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-controlplane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA role assumed by the Amazon EKS control plane.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/managed
          Value: 'true'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance Profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMInstanceProfileControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControlPlane

  AWSIAMInstanceProfileControllers:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControllers

  AWSIAMInstanceProfileNodes:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleNodes

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Control plane custom managed policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMManagedPolicyCloudProviderControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: For the Kubernetes Cloud Provider AWS Control Plane
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControlPlane
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AutoScaling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EC2
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignIpv6Addresses
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ELBServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: KMS
            Effect: Allow
            Action: kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Controllers custom managed policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMManagedPolicyControllers:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: For the Kubernetes Cluster API Provider AWS Controllers
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControllers
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AssociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateCarrierGateway
              - ec2:CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:DeleteCarrierGateway
              - ec2:DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoints
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:GetSecurityGroupsForVpc
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScaling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CompleteLifecycleAction
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteLifecycleHook
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:Describe*
              - autoscaling:PutLifecycleHook
              - autoscaling:StartInstanceRefresh
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EKSAccessEntries
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:AssociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:CreateAccessEntry
              - eks:DeleteAccessEntry
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:ListAccessPolicies
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
              - eks:UpdateAccessEntry
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: autoscaling.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: ELBServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: SpotServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/spot.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForEC2Spot'
            Condition:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Configurable DynamoDB table with a parameterized partition key and optional
  sort key, PROVISIONED or PAY_PER_REQUEST billing, point-in-time recovery,
  optional customer-managed KMS encryption, and optional CloudWatch alarms
  for throttling and system errors that publish to an SNS topic.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Application
        Parameters:
          - AppName
          - Environment
      - Label:
          default: Table Keys
        Parameters:
          - PartitionKeyName
          - PartitionKeyType
          - SortKeyName
          - SortKeyType
      - Label:
          default: Capacity and Recovery
        Parameters:
          - BillingMode
          - ReadCapacityUnits
          - WriteCapacityUnits
          - EnablePointInTimeRecovery
      - Label:
          default: Encryption
        Parameters:
          - EnableCustomerManagedKey
      - Label:
          default: Alerting
        Parameters:
          - EnableAlarms
          - AlarmEmail
          - ThrottleAlarmThreshold
          - SystemErrorAlarmThreshold

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: myapp
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{3,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 3-40 characters of lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.
    Description: Application name used in resource names and tags.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used in resource names and tags.

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-255 characters of letters, digits, underscore, dot, or hyphen.
    Description: Attribute name of the partition (hash) key.

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Attribute type of the partition key (S=String, N=Number, B=Binary).

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Empty, or 1-255 characters of letters, digits, underscore, dot, or hyphen.
    Description: Attribute name of the optional sort (range) key. Leave empty for no sort key.

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Attribute type of the sort key. Used only when SortKeyName is set.

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
    Description: Table billing mode.

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Provisioned read capacity units. Used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED.

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Provisioned write capacity units. Used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED.

  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery on the table.

  EnableCustomerManagedKey:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Encrypt the table with a customer-managed KMS key created by this stack.

  EnableAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Create CloudWatch alarms and an SNS topic for alerting.

  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid email address.
    Description: Optional email address subscribed to the alarm topic. Leave empty for no subscription.

  ThrottleAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of throttle events in a 5-minute period that triggers the throttle alarms.

  SystemErrorAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of system errors in a 5-minute period that triggers the system error alarm.

Conditions:
  IsProvisioned: !Equals
    - !Ref BillingMode
    - PROVISIONED
  HasSortKey: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref SortKeyName
      - ''
  UsePITR: !Equals
    - !Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery
    - 'true'
  UseCMK: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableCustomerManagedKey
    - 'true'
  CreateAlarms: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableAlarms
    - 'true'
  HasAlarmEmail: !And
    - !Condition CreateAlarms
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Ref AlarmEmail
        - ''

Resources:
  TableKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: UseCMK
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${AppName}-${Environment} DynamoDB table encryption'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBServiceUseViaAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBServiceDescribeKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  TableKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: UseCMK
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AppName}-${Environment}-dynamodb'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TableKey

  AppTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AppName}-${Environment}-table'
      AttributeDefinitions: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
      KeySchema: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If
          - UsePITR
          - true
          - false
      SSESpecification: !If
        - UseCMK
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TableKey.Arn
        - SSEEnabled: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlarmTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${AppName}-${Environment} DynamoDB alarm SNS topic encryption'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowSNSServiceUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlarmTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AppName}-${Environment}-sns-alarms'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AppName}-${Environment}-dynamodb-alarms'
      DisplayName: !Sub '${AppName}-${Environment} DynamoDB alarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlarmEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${Environment}-ReadThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Read throttle events detected on DynamoDB table ${AppTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref AppTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${Environment}-WriteThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Write throttle events detected on DynamoDB table ${AppTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref AppTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${Environment}-SystemErrors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'DynamoDB system errors (HTTP 500) detected on table ${AppTable} across common operations'
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: !Ref SystemErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      Metrics:
        - Id: totalSystemErrors
          Label: TotalSystemErrors
          ReturnData: true
          Expression: >-
            FILL(getItem,0) + FILL(putItem,0) + FILL(updateItem,0) +
            FILL(deleteItem,0) + FILL(query,0) + FILL(scan,0) +
            FILL(batchGetItem,0) + FILL(batchWriteItem,0)
        - Id: getItem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Stat: Sum
            Period: 300

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipelines for Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs (x86_64 + arm64) with Docker, Docker Compose and Python data packages

# NOTE: Public AMI distribution fails at build time, not at stack creation, if the
# account-level "Block public access for AMIs" setting is enabled. New accounts have
# it on by default. No CloudFormation resource can change it, so disable it
# out-of-band before running the pipelines:
#   aws ec2 disable-image-block-public-access --region <region>
#
# Build and test instances run in a private subnet with no internet route. AWS
# services are reached through VPC endpoints. Python packages come from a
# CodeArtifact repository with a public PyPI upstream. The Docker Compose plugin
# binaries are staged in S3 by a Lambda-backed custom resource that runs outside
# the VPC.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Image Settings
        Parameters:
          - ImageVersion
          - RootVolumeSize
      - Label:
          default: Sharing
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationArn
    ParameterLabels:
      ImageVersion:
        default: Image / component semantic version
      RootVolumeSize:
        default: Root volume size (GiB)
      OrganizationArn:
        default: AWS Organization ARN to share AMIs with

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a semantic version in the form major.minor.patch (e.g. 1.0.0).
    Description: Semantic version applied to the component and both image recipes. Increment it to publish a new recipe version.
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 16384
    Description: Size in GiB of the root EBS volume (/dev/xvda) for the built AMIs.
  OrganizationArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:organizations::[0-9]{12}:organization/o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid AWS Organization ARN (arn:aws:organizations::<management-account-id>:organization/o-xxxxxxxxxx).
    Description: Optional AWS Organization ARN to grant launch permissions to. Leave empty to skip organization-level sharing.

Conditions:
  HasOrganization: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationArn, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption key (build log / artifact bucket, Lambda logs, CodeArtifact)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for the Image Builder log/artifact bucket, Lambda logs and CodeArtifact domain
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  ImageBuilderKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ImageBuilderKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private networking for build and test instances
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.20.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-vpc'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.20.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-private-subnet'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-private-rt'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildPrivateRouteTable

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Image Builder build instances - no inbound access, HTTPS egress to VPC endpoints and S3 only
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints inside the VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt BuildVpc.CidrBlock
        - Description: HTTPS to Amazon S3 through the gateway endpoint (dnf repos, AWSTOE, logs, artifacts, CodeArtifact assets)
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt DockerComposeArtifacts.S3PrefixListId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-sg'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Interface VPC endpoints - HTTPS from Image Builder build instances only
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from Image Builder build and test instances
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS within the VPC only (replaces the implicit allow-all egress rule)
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt BuildVpc.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref BuildPrivateRouteTable

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  ImageBuilderEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.imagebuilder'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  CodeArtifactApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.codeartifact.api'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  CodeArtifactRepositoriesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.codeartifact.repositories'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build log and artifact bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireBuildLogs
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: imagebuilder-logs/
            ExpirationInDays: 90
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentArtifacts
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: artifacts/
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
          - Id: AbortIncompleteUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref BuildLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt BuildLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${BuildLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CodeArtifact (PyPI proxy reachable from the private subnet)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CodeArtifactDomain:
    Type: AWS::CodeArtifact::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Join ['', ['ib-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      EncryptionKey: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  CodeArtifactRepository:
    Type: AWS::CodeArtifact::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: pypi-store
      DomainName: !GetAtt CodeArtifactDomain.Name
      Description: Proxy of public PyPI for Image Builder build instances
      ExternalConnections:
        - public:pypi
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Docker Compose artifact staging (Lambda-backed custom resource)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ComposeStagerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-compose-stager'
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  ComposeStagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Docker Compose artifact staging function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ComposeStager
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteOwnLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !GetAtt ComposeStagerLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: WriteArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                Resource: !Sub '${BuildLogBucket.Arn}/artifacts/*'
              - Sid: EncryptArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKey.Arn
              - Sid: LookUpS3PrefixList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:DescribePrefixLists'
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  ComposeStagerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-compose-stager'
      Description: Stages Docker Compose v2 plugin binaries in S3 and resolves the S3 managed prefix list
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ComposeStagerRole.Arn
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 512
      # No concurrency reservation: new accounts have a total quota of 10 and Lambda requires 10 unreserved.
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref ComposeStagerLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import hashlib
          import os
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          RELEASES = 'https://github.com/docker/compose/releases'
          ARCHES = ('x86_64', 'aarch64')
          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')


          def fetch(url, path=None):
              with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=120) as resp:
                  if path is None:
                      return resp.read().decode(), resp.geturl()
                  digest = hashlib.sha256()
                  with open(path, 'wb') as out:
                      for chunk in iter(lambda: resp.read(1048576), b''):
                          digest.update(chunk)
                          out.write(chunk)
                  return digest.hexdigest(), resp.geturl()


          def stage(bucket, prefix):
              _, final_url = fetch(RELEASES + '/latest')
              tag = final_url.rstrip('/').rsplit('/', 1)[-1]
              if not tag.startswith('v'):
                  raise ValueError('Unexpected release URL %s' % final_url)
              for arch in ARCHES:
                  name = 'docker-compose-linux-' + arch
                  url = '%s/download/%s/%s' % (RELEASES, tag, name)
                  expected = fetch(url + '.sha256')[0].split()[0]
                  path = '/tmp/' + name
                  actual = fetch(url, path)[0]
                  if actual != expected:
                      raise ValueError('Checksum mismatch for %s' % name)
                  with open(path, 'rb') as body:
                      s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key='%s/%s' % (prefix, name), Body=body)
                  os.remove(path)
              return tag


          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = 'docker-compose-artifacts'
              try:
                  data = {}
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      props = event['ResourceProperties']
                      prefix = props['KeyPrefix'].strip('/')
                      tag = stage(props['BucketName'], prefix)
                      name = 'com.amazonaws.%s.s3' % os.environ['AWS_REGION']
                      lists = ec2.describe_prefix_lists(
                          Filters=[{'Name': 'prefix-list-name', 'Values': [name]}])['PrefixLists']
                      if not lists:
                          raise ValueError('Prefix list %s not found' % name)
                      data = {
                          'ComposeKeyPrefix': prefix,
                          'ComposeVersion': tag,
                          'S3PrefixListId': lists[0]['PrefixListId'],
                      }
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  print('Error: %s' % exc)
                  status = cfnresponse.SUCCESS if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete' else cfnresponse.FAILED
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, status, {}, physical_id, reason=str(exc)[:500])
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  DockerComposeArtifacts:
    Type: Custom::DockerComposeArtifacts
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ComposeStagerFunction.Arn
      BucketName: !Ref BuildLogBucket
      KeyPrefix: artifacts/docker-compose
      # Re-stage the latest Docker Compose release whenever the image version changes.
      ImageVersion: !Ref ImageVersion

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build instance IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Instance role for EC2 Image Builder build and test instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderBuildAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteBuildLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                Resource: !Sub '${BuildLogBucket.Arn}/imagebuilder-logs/*'
              - Sid: ReadStagedArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                Resource: !Sub '${BuildLogBucket.Arn}/artifacts/*'
              - Sid: UseBucketKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKey.Arn
              - Sid: CodeArtifactToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'codeartifact:GetAuthorizationToken'
                Resource: !GetAtt CodeArtifactDomain.Arn
              - Sid: CodeArtifactRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'codeartifact:GetRepositoryEndpoint'
                  - 'codeartifact:ReadFromRepository'
                Resource: !GetAtt CodeArtifactRepository.Arn
              - Sid: CodeArtifactBearerToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'sts:GetServiceBearerToken'
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'sts:AWSServiceName': codeartifact.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder component
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-docker-python'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Installs Docker, the Docker Compose v2 plugin and Python data packages, and grants ssm-user passwordless sudo
      ChangeDescription: !Sub 'Component version ${ImageVersion}'
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Data: !Sub |
        name: al2023-docker-python
        description: Install Docker, Docker Compose v2, synapseclient, pandas and pysftp; grant ssm-user sudo
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - dnf -y update
                    - dnf -y install docker python3-pip
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - usermod -aG docker ec2-user
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - ARCH="$(uname -m)"
                    - mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
                    - aws s3 cp --region ${AWS::Region} "s3://${BuildLogBucket}/${DockerComposeArtifacts.ComposeKeyPrefix}/docker-compose-linux-${!ARCH}" /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - chmod 0755 /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - CA_TOKEN="$(aws codeartifact get-authorization-token --region ${AWS::Region} --domain ${CodeArtifactDomain.Name} --domain-owner ${AWS::AccountId} --query authorizationToken --output text)"
                    - CA_ENDPOINT="$(aws codeartifact get-repository-endpoint --region ${AWS::Region} --domain ${CodeArtifactDomain.Name} --domain-owner ${AWS::AccountId} --repository ${CodeArtifactRepository.Name} --format pypi --query repositoryEndpoint --output text)"
                    - pip3 install --no-cache-dir --index-url "https://aws:${!CA_TOKEN}@${!CA_ENDPOINT#https://}simple/" synapseclient pandas pysftp
                    - unset CA_TOKEN CA_ENDPOINT
              - name: GrantSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - "echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users"
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
              - name: Cleanup
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - dnf clean all
                    - if find /etc /root -name pip.conf -print | grep -q .; then echo "pip.conf found - refusing to bake package index credentials into a public AMI"; exit 1; fi
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: VerifyDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - docker --version
                    - systemctl is-enabled docker
              - name: VerifyDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - docker compose version
              - name: VerifyPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp; print('python imports ok')"
              - name: VerifySsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - grep -q 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
              - name: VerifyNoPipConfig
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - if find /etc /root -name pip.conf -print | grep -q .; then echo "pip.conf found in image"; exit 1; fi
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image recipes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 with Docker, Docker Compose and Python data packages
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            # Public AMIs cannot be backed by encrypted snapshots.
            Encrypted: false
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 with Docker, Docker Compose and Python data packages
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            # Public AMIs cannot be backed by encrypted snapshots.
            Encrypted: false
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared infrastructure configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # InstanceTypes is intentionally omitted so Image Builder selects a default
  # instance type matching each recipe's architecture (x86_64 or arm64).
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-infrastructure'
      Description: Shared build/test infrastructure for the Amazon Linux 2023 pipelines
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref BuildLogBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: imagebuilder-logs
      ResourceTags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distribution configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-distribution'
      Description: Distributes Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs publicly and to the configured AWS Organization
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: !Sub 'Amazon Linux 2023 with Docker, Docker Compose and Python data packages built by ${AWS::StackName}'
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns: !If
                - HasOrganization
                - - !Ref OrganizationArn
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pipelines (one recipe per pipeline)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  X86ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86-pipeline'
      Description: Builds the Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref X86ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  Arm64ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64-pipeline'
      Description: Builds the Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref Arm64ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

Outputs:

  Arm64ImagePipelineArn:
