AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo - Cognito User Pool with seeded test users

# NOTE: Deviation from request. The request asks for a hardcoded shared demo password
# (e.g. Demo1234!) in the seeding logic. Plain-text secrets are not allowed anywhere in
# the template, so an AWS::SecretsManager::Secret generates the shared demo password at
# deploy time and the seeder Lambda reads it at runtime. The template stays fully
# self-contained; demo users retrieve the password from Secrets Manager using the
# DemoUserPasswordSecretArn output.

Resources:
  DemoKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for AgentOps demo secret and seeder log encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/agentops-user-seeder
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: agentops
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce-analytics-demo
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo

  DemoKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/agentops-ecommerce-demo
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DemoKmsKey

  DemoUserPasswordSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: agentops-ecommerce-demo-user-password
      Description: Shared password for seeded AgentOps demo users (generated at deploy time)
      KmsKeyId: !Ref DemoKmsKey
      GenerateSecretString:
        PasswordLength: 20
        ExcludePunctuation: true
        RequireEachIncludedType: true
        IncludeSpace: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: agentops
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce-analytics-demo
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailSubject: Your AgentOps demo verification code
        EmailMessage: 'Your AgentOps demo verification code is {####}'
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      MfaConfiguration: 'OPTIONAL'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '32'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: agentops
        Application: ecommerce-analytics-demo
        Environment: demo

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub agentops-ecommerce-${AWS::AccountId}
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - custom:role
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 1
      Description: Platform administrators with access to all teams

  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 10
      Description: Team Alpha members of the e-commerce analytics demo

  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 20
      Description: Team Beta members of the e-commerce analytics demo

  UserSeederLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/agentops-user-seeder
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt DemoKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: agentops
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce-analytics-demo
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo

  UserSeederRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoSeedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CognitoSeedUsers
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Sid: ReadDemoPassword
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref DemoUserPasswordSecret
              - Sid: DecryptDemoPassword
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt DemoKmsKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub secretsmanager.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub ${UserSeederLogGroup.Arn}:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: agentops
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce-analytics-demo
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo

  UserSeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: UserSeederLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: agentops-user-seeder
      Description: Seeds AgentOps demo users into the Cognito User Pool
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt UserSeederRole.Arn
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 256
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref UserSeederLogGroup
        LogFormat: Text
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          from botocore.config import Config
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          log = logging.getLogger()
          log.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          CFG = Config(retries={"max_attempts": 5, "mode": "standard"}, connect_timeout=5, read_timeout=10)

          USERS = [
              ("alice@demo.local", "team-alpha", "member"),
              ("bob@demo.local", "team-alpha", "member"),
              ("charlie@demo.local", "team-alpha", "team_admin"),
              ("dave@demo.local", "team-beta", "member"),
              ("eve@demo.local", "team-beta", "team_admin"),
              ("admin@demo.local", "admin", "admin"),
          ]


          def seed(pool_id, secret_arn):
              sm = boto3.client("secretsmanager", config=CFG)
              password = sm.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_arn)["SecretString"]
              idp = boto3.client("cognito-idp", config=CFG)
              for email, group, role in USERS:
                  attrs = [
                      {"Name": "email", "Value": email},
                      {"Name": "email_verified", "Value": "true"},
                      {"Name": "custom:role", "Value": role},
                  ]
                  try:
                      idp.admin_get_user(UserPoolId=pool_id, Username=email)
                      idp.admin_update_user_attributes(UserPoolId=pool_id, Username=email, UserAttributes=attrs)
                      log.info("Updated user %s", email)
                  except ClientError as e:
                      if e.response["Error"]["Code"] != "UserNotFoundException":
                          raise
                      idp.admin_create_user(UserPoolId=pool_id, Username=email, UserAttributes=attrs, MessageAction="SUPPRESS")
                      log.info("Created user %s", email)
                  idp.admin_set_user_password(UserPoolId=pool_id, Username=email, Password=password, Permanent=True)
                  idp.admin_add_user_to_group(UserPoolId=pool_id, Username=email, GroupName=group)
                  log.info("Added %s to group %s", email, group)


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or "agentops-seed-users-" + str(props.get("UserPoolId", "none"))
              try:
                  request_type = event.get("RequestType")
                  log.info("Received %s request", request_type)
                  if request_type in ("Create", "Update"):

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provides AWS Client VPN usage reporting (AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, Mixed Auth)
  through a KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group and a CloudWatch dashboard
  built on embedded Logs Insights queries. NOTE - AWS::CloudWatchLogs::QueryDefinition
  is prohibited in this pipeline, so saved queries are reproduced as dashboard
  log widgets whose titles are prefixed with QueryFolderPath; standalone saved
  queries can be added manually if the restriction is lifted.

Metadata:
  SavedQuerySubstitution:
    Reason: AWS::CloudWatchLogs::QueryDefinition is on the prohibited resource-type list for this pipeline.
    Approach: Every Logs Insights query is embedded in the dashboard as a log widget. QueryFolderPath is used as the widget-title prefix to mirror the requested saved-query folder organization.
    FollowUp: If the restriction is lifted, create one AWS::CloudWatchLogs::QueryDefinition per dashboard widget using the name "<QueryFolderPath>/<Widget Title>" and the same query string.
  LogGroupNameDeviation:
    Reason: CloudWatch Logs reserves log group names beginning with "aws/" for AWS, so the requested default "aws/aws-client-vpn/prod" cannot be created.
    Approach: The ClientVpnLogGroupName default was changed to "/aws/aws-client-vpn/prod" (leading slash), and the AllowedPattern rejects any value starting with "aws/" in any casing.
    FollowUp: Configure Client VPN endpoints to send connection logs to the log group name output by this stack (LogGroupName).
    OperatorCleanup: A failed earlier deployment may have left an orphaned KMS key (retained by DeletionPolicy Retain). Schedule that key for deletion before redeploying; this template creates a fresh key and alias.
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Client VPN Reporting
        Parameters:
          - ClientVpnLogGroupName
          - QueryFolderPath

Parameters:
  QueryFolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_\-/]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: May contain only letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens and forward slashes. An empty value means no folder prefix is applied.
    Description: Optional folder path used to organize the Client VPN queries (applied as a dashboard widget-title prefix).

  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    AllowedPattern: '^(?![Aa][Ww][Ss]/)[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]{1,512}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-512 characters of letters, numbers, period, hyphen, underscore, forward slash or hash, and must not start with "aws/" (reserved by AWS). Use "/aws/..." or another prefix instead.
    Description: >-
      Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group created by this stack for Client VPN
      connection logs. The default was changed from "aws/aws-client-vpn/prod" to
      "/aws/aws-client-vpn/prod" because CloudWatch Logs reserves the "aws/" prefix;
      configure Client VPN endpoints to send connection logs to this name.

Conditions:
  HasQueryFolder: !Not [!Equals [!Ref QueryFolderPath, '']]

Resources:
  LogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key encrypting the Client VPN connection log group for stack ${AWS::StackName}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${ClientVpnLogGroupName}'

  LogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-client-vpn-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogKey

  ClientVpnLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogKey.Arn

  ClientVpnUsageDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-client-vpn-usage'
      DashboardBody: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "start": "-P7D",
            "widgets": [
              {
                "type": "text",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 0,
                "width": 24,
                "height": 3,
                "properties": {
                  "markdown": "## AWS Client VPN Usage Reporting\nAuthentication type classification: **AD/SAML** = username present and common-name absent or N/A; **Mutual Auth** = common-name present and username absent or N/A; **Mixed Auth** = both username and common-name present. Widget titles are prefixed with the query folder path '${Prefix}' to mirror saved-query folder organization. Source log group: ${ClientVpnLogGroup}"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 3,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "view": "table",
                  "title": "${Prefix}Total Usage per Endpoint",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroup}' | filter `connection-attempt-status` = 'successful' | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 3600 as total_hours, sum(`ingress-bytes`) as total_ingress_bytes, sum(`egress-bytes`) as total_egress_bytes by `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort connections desc"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 12,
                "y": 3,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "view": "table",
                  "title": "${Prefix}Total Usage per Authentication Type",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroup}' | fields if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != 'N/A' and ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != 'N/A', 'Mixed Auth', if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != 'N/A', 'AD/SAML', if(ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != 'N/A', 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as auth_type | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as total_seconds by auth_type, `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort connections desc"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 9,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "view": "table",
                  "title": "${Prefix}Distinct Users",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroup}' | fields coalesce(`username`, `common-name`) as identity, if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != 'N/A' and ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != 'N/A', 'Mixed Auth', if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != 'N/A', 'AD/SAML', if(ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != 'N/A', 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as auth_type | stats count_distinct(identity) as distinct_users by auth_type, `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort distinct_users desc"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 12,
                "y": 9,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "view": "table",
                  "title": "${Prefix}User Connection Summary",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroup}' | fields coalesce(`username`, `common-name`) as identity | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, max(`connection-start-time`) as last_connection_start by identity | sort connections desc"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 15,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "view": "table",
                  "title": "${Prefix}Connection Durations",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroup}' | filter `connection-duration-seconds` > 0 | fields coalesce(`username`, `common-name`) as identity, if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != 'N/A' and ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != 'N/A', 'Mixed Auth', if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != 'N/A', 'AD/SAML', if(ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != 'N/A', 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as auth_type, `connection-duration-seconds` / 60 as duration_minutes | display identity, auth_type, `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, `connection-start-time`, `connection-end-time`, duration_minutes | sort duration_minutes desc | limit 1000"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 12,
                "y": 15,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "view": "table",
                  "title": "${Prefix}Connection Duration Statistics",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroup}' | filter `connection-duration-seconds` > 0 | stats avg(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 60 as avg_minutes, max(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 60 as max_minutes, pct(`connection-duration-seconds`, 95) / 60 as p95_minutes by `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort avg_minutes desc | limit 1000"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 21,
                "width": 24,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "view": "table",
                  "title": "${Prefix}Failed Connection Attempts",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroup}' | filter `connection-attempt-status` = 'failed' | fields if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != 'N/A' and ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != 'N/A', 'Mixed Auth', if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != 'N/A', 'AD/SAML', if(ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != 'N/A', 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as auth_type | stats count(*) as failed_attempts by `connection-attempt-failure-reason`, auth_type | sort failed_attempts desc"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        - Prefix: !If [HasQueryFolder, !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/', '']

Outputs:
  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the Client VPN connection log group.
    Value: !Ref ClientVpnLogGroup
  LogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the Client VPN connection log group.
    Value: !GetAtt ClientVpnLogGroup.Arn
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key encrypting the log group.
    Value: !GetAtt LogKey.Arn
  DashboardName:
    Description: Name of the Client VPN usage dashboard.
    Value: !Ref ClientVpnUsageDashboard
  DashboardUrl:
    Description: Console URL of the Client VPN usage dashboard.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${AWS::Region}#dashboards:name=${ClientVpnUsageDashboard}'
  QueryFolderPrefix:
    Description: Folder prefix applied to dashboard query widget titles ('none' when QueryFolderPath is empty).
    Value: !If [HasQueryFolder, !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/', 'none']

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication stack - Cognito user pool (PLUS tier,
  enforced threat protection), SPA, admin auth, and M2M clients, staff role groups,
  OAuth2 resource server, and user pool domain.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name.

Conditions:
  IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Environment, prod]

Resources:
  HotelUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-users-${Environment}'
      DeletionProtection: !If [IsProd, ACTIVE, INACTIVE]
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: Your AnyCompany Hotel account
          EmailMessage: 'Welcome to AnyCompany Hotel. Your username is {username} and your temporary password is {####}'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '64'
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '64'
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '32'

  SpaClient:

      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:

        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

    Properties:

    Properties:

        - ScopeName: admin

    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ResourceServerIdentifier'

  UserPoolDomainName:

      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolDomainUrl'

    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: "Hospitality Insights (prod) - Cognito user pool, app client, groups, post-auth trigger, hosted UI domain, optional SAML SSO"

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Environment
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Hosted UI and App Client
        Parameters:
          - HostedUIDomainPrefix
          - AppCallbackUrl
          - AppLogoutUrl
      - Label:
          default: Optional SAML SSO (leave both empty to disable)
        Parameters:
          - SSOLoginUrl
          - SSOProviderName

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name used in resource names and tags.

  HostedUIDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights-prod
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, and must not start or end with a hyphen.
    Description: Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain (<prefix>.auth.<region>.amazoncognito.com).

  SSOLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^https://.+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or an HTTPS URL.
    Description: SAML metadata URL of the federated identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO.

  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^(?![Cc][Oo][Gg][Nn][Ii][Tt][Oo])[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or 1-32 characters of letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens, and must not be "COGNITO" or begin with "Cognito" (case-insensitive).
    Description: Name of the federated SAML identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO.

  AppCallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: http://localhost:3000/callback
    AllowedPattern: ^(https://.+|http://localhost(:[0-9]+)?(/.*)?)$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an HTTPS URL (non-HTTPS is only permitted for localhost).
    Description: OAuth callback URL for the app client. Production values must use HTTPS.

  AppLogoutUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: http://localhost:3000/logout
    AllowedPattern: ^(https://.+|http://localhost(:[0-9]+)?(/.*)?)$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an HTTPS URL (non-HTTPS is only permitted for localhost).
    Description: OAuth sign-out URL for the app client. Production values must use HTTPS.

Rules:
  ValidateSSOProviderName:
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Not
          - !Equals
            - !Ref SSOProviderName
            - COGNITO
        AssertDescription: SSOProviderName must not be "COGNITO".
      - Assert: !Or
          - !And
            - !Equals
              - !Ref SSOLoginUrl
              - ""
            - !Equals
              - !Ref SSOProviderName
              - ""
          - !And
            - !Not
              - !Equals
                - !Ref SSOLoginUrl
                - ""
            - !Not
              - !Equals
                - !Ref SSOProviderName
                - ""
        AssertDescription: SSOLoginUrl and SSOProviderName must both be set to enable SSO, or both left empty to disable it.

Conditions:
  EnableSSO: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOLoginUrl, ""]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, ""]]

Resources:
  PostAuthLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-post-auth
      RetentionInDays: 90
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-post-auth-logs
        - Key: Application
          Value: hospitality-insights
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostAuthLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-post-auth-role
      Description: Execution role for the Hospitality Insights post-authentication Lambda trigger.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-post-auth-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFunctionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-post-auth:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-post-auth-role
        - Key: Application
          Value: hospitality-insights
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostAuthCognitoPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-post-auth-cognito
      Roles:
        - !Ref PostAuthLambdaRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: UpdateLastLoginAttribute
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
            Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostAuthFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-post-auth
      Description: Cognito post-authentication trigger that records the custom:last_login attribute.
      Runtime: python3.13
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 5
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      LoggingConfig:
        LogFormat: JSON
        LogGroup: !Ref PostAuthLogGroup
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE: custom:last_login
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import os
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          ATTRIBUTE_NAME = os.environ.get("LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE", "custom:last_login")


          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event.get("userPoolId")
              username = event.get("userName")
              timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

              try:
                  cognito.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      UserAttributes=[{"Name": ATTRIBUTE_NAME, "Value": timestamp}],
                  )
                  logger.info(
                      "Updated last login",
                      extra={"userPoolId": user_pool_id, "lastLogin": timestamp},
                  )
              except (ClientError, BotoCoreError):
                  # Never block a successful sign-in because the audit attribute failed to update.
                  logger.exception("Failed to update last login attribute")

              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-post-auth
        - Key: Application
          Value: hospitality-insights
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-user-pool
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 3
          PasswordHistorySize: 5
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '0'
            MaxLength: '64'
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Name: !Sub hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-user-pool
        Application: hospitality-insights
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostAuthInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: !Sub Hospitality Insights ${EnvironmentName} administrators with full access.
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Description: !Sub Hospitality Insights ${EnvironmentName} standard users with read access to insights.
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Description: !Sub Hospitality Insights ${EnvironmentName} power users with advanced analytics access.
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  SSOIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: EnableSSO
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      ProviderDetails:
        MetadataURL: !Ref SSOLoginUrl
        IDPSignout: 'false'
      AttributeMapping:
        email: http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-app-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AuthSessionValidity: 3
      AccessTokenValidity: 24
      IdTokenValidity: 24
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: hours
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref AppCallbackUrl
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref AppLogoutUrl
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - EnableSSO
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SSOIdentityProvider
        - - COGNITO
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - custom:last_login
      WriteAttributes:
        - email

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref HostedUIDomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Hospitality Insights Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Hospitality Insights Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolProviderUrl:
    Description: Issuer URL of the user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderURL

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Hospitality Insights app client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  HostedUIDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI domain prefix.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain

  HostedUIBaseUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the Cognito hosted UI.
    Value: !Sub https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com

  HostedUILoginUrl:
    Description: Hosted UI login URL for the app client (authorization code flow).
    Value: !Sub https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/login?client_id=${UserPoolClient}&response_type=code&scope=openid+email+profile&redirect_uri=${AppCallbackUrl}

  PostAuthFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the post-authentication Lambda trigger.
    Value: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn

  AdminGroupName:
    Description: Name of the Admin user group.
    Value: !Ref AdminGroup

  RegularUserGroupName:
    Description: Name of the RegularUser user group.
    Value: !Ref RegularUserGroup

  PowerUserGroupName:
    Description: Name of the PowerUser user group.
    Value: !Ref PowerUserGroup

  SSOIdentityProviderName:
    Condition: EnableSSO
    Description: Name of the federated SAML identity provider.
    Value: !Ref SSOIdentityProvider

  SAMLEntityId:
    Condition: EnableSSO
    Description: SAML service provider entity ID (audience) to configure in the IdP.
    Value: !Sub urn:amazon:cognito:sp:${UserPool}

  SAMLAssertionConsumerServiceUrl:
    Condition: EnableSSO
    Description: SAML assertion consumer service (ACS) URL to configure in the IdP.
    Value: !Sub https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/saml2/idpresponse

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  WebSocket API for client connection and session-state management. The $connect
  and $disconnect routes write and delete session records directly in DynamoDB
  through API Gateway service integrations. The $default route echoes messages
  back through a Lambda function. Greenfield deployment: every dependency is
  created in this template.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API stage.
  SessionTtlSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7200
    MinValue: 60
    Description: Lifetime of a session record, in seconds, before DynamoDB TTL expires it.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Session state storage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # WebSocket API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api'
      Description: WebSocket API for client connection and session management
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  # Role that API Gateway assumes to write and delete session items
  ApiGatewayDynamoDbRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SessionTableWriteDelete
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # $connect: direct DynamoDB PutItem integration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Store new connection identifiers in the session table
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDbRole.Arn
      PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
      TemplateSelectionExpression: '\$default'
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: !Sub |
          #set($ttl = $context.requestTimeEpoch / 1000 + ${SessionTtlSeconds})
          {
            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Item": {
              "connectionId": { "S": "$context.connectionId" },
              "connectedAt": { "N": "$context.connectedAt" },
              "ttl": { "N": "$ttl" }
            }
          }

  ConnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref ConnectIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: '/2\d\d/'

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$connect'
      # No authorizer is configured yet. Attach a Lambda REQUEST authorizer here later if needed.
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: ConnectRoute
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # $disconnect: direct DynamoDB DeleteItem integration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Remove disconnected clients from the session table
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/DeleteItem'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDbRole.Arn
      PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
      TemplateSelectionExpression: '\$default'
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: !Sub |
          {
            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Key": {
              "connectionId": { "S": "$context.connectionId" }
            }
          }

        - Key: Environment
          Value: test

    Properties:

      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an AWS FIS cross-region connectivity chaos experiment template that blocks
  application traffic to a target region and pauses S3 and DynamoDB cross-region
  replication, together with its IAM role, dedicated KMS key, and encrypted CloudWatch log group.

# Notes:
# - No VPCs, subnets, transit gateways, buckets, or tables are created or referenced here.
#   All targets are resolved by FIS at experiment runtime using the tag ChaosAllowed=true.
# - EmptyTargetResolutionMode is set to skip, so the experiment can run in an account that
#   has no ChaosAllowed resources yet. Actions with no resolved targets are skipped.
# - The aws:network:route-table-disrupt-cross-region-connectivity action accepts only the
#   region and duration parameters. It blocks traffic from the targeted subnets to the
#   target region by swapping in temporary route tables for the duration of the action.
# - The aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication action accepts only a duration parameter.
#   It pauses replication for the targeted global table replicas and has no region parameter.
# - FIS tags the temporary route tables and prefix lists it creates with managedByFIS=true.
#   The IAM policy uses that tag to scope create, modify, and delete permissions.
# - The experiment has no CloudWatch alarm stop condition. Stop it manually from the FIS
#   console or API if needed.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region code such as us-west-2.
    Description: Destination region whose network traffic and replication are disrupted.

  DisruptionDurationMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Default: 20
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 720
    Description: Duration in minutes for each disruption action.

  ExperimentName:
    Type: String
    Default: cross-region-connectivity
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Only alphanumeric characters and hyphens are allowed.
    Description: Name used in resource names and tags.

Resources:
  FisLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for encrypting FIS experiment logs for ${ExperimentName}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/fis/${ExperimentName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'fis-${ExperimentName}-logs'
        - Key: ExperimentName
          Value: !Ref ExperimentName

  FisLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/fis-${ExperimentName}-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FisLogsKey

  FisLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/fis/${ExperimentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FisLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'fis-${ExperimentName}-logs'
        - Key: ExperimentName
          Value: !Ref ExperimentName

  FisExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Role assumed by AWS FIS for the ${ExperimentName} experiment'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:fis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FisCrossRegionConnectivityPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RouteTableDisruptReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcPeeringConnections
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpoints
                  - ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:GetManagedPrefixListEntries
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RouteTableDisruptCreateTagged
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateManagedPrefixList
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:RequestTag/managedByFIS': 'true'
              - Sid: RouteTableDisruptTagOnCreate
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'ec2:CreateAction':
                      - CreateRouteTable
                      - CreateManagedPrefixList
                      - CreateNetworkInterface
              - Sid: RouteTableDisruptModifyTagged
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
                  - ec2:ModifyManagedPrefixList
                  - ec2:DeleteManagedPrefixList
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:ResourceTag/managedByFIS': 'true'
              - Sid: RouteTableDisruptAssociation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:ReplaceRouteTableAssociation
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: TransitGatewayDisrupt
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayPeeringAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
                  - ec2:AssociateTransitGatewayRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateTransitGatewayRouteTable
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3ReplicationPause
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PauseReplication
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - Sid: DynamoDbReplicationPause
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetResourcePolicy
                  - dynamodb:PutResourcePolicy
                  - dynamodb:DeleteResourcePolicy
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:*:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
              - Sid: TargetResolution
                Effect: Allow
                Action: tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: FisLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'fis-${ExperimentName}-role'
        - Key: ExperimentName
          Value: !Ref ExperimentName

  FisExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Block traffic and pause replication from ${AWS::Region} to ${TargetRegion}'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      Targets:
        Subnets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        TransitGateways:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  VPC network foundation for a Kerberos-secured Amazon EMR on EKS deployment.
  Provides a VPC with two public and two private subnets across two Availability
  Zones, an internet gateway, one NAT gateway per AZ, route tables, and VPC flow
  logs encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key. Kerberos (KDC), EKS cluster,
  and EMR virtual cluster resources are out of scope for this template.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Network Addressing
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: emr-eks
    Description: Environment name used for Name and Environment tags and the KMS alias.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,30}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 2-32 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens, starting and ending with an alphanumeric character.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/26
    Description: /26 CIDR block for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])/26$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a /26 prefix length.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.64/26
    Description: /26 CIDR block for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])/26$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a /26 prefix length.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.128/26
    Description: /26 CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])/26$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a /26 prefix length.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.192/26
    Description: /26 CIDR block for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])/26$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a /26 prefix length.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways (one per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1Eip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2Eip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1Eip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2Eip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Routing (one route table per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Key for VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key encrypting VPC flow logs for ${EnvironmentName}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Group for Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows the VPC Flow Logs service to publish flow logs to the KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cloudwatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogsToLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: UseFlowLogsKmsKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Log
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block of the VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of public subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds'

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of private subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds'

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the public route table.
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTableId'

  PrivateRouteTable1Id:
    Description: ID of the private route table in the first Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable1Id'

  PrivateRouteTable2Id:
    Description: ID of the private route table in the second Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable2Id'

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway in the first Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1Id'

  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway in the second Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2Id'

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the internet gateway.
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InternetGatewayId'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting VPC flow logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsKmsKeyArn'

  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group receiving VPC flow logs.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsLogGroupName'

  FlowLogsRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by VPC Flow Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsRoleArn'

  VpcFlowLogId:
    Description: ID of the VPC flow log.
    Value: !Ref VpcFlowLog
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcFlowLogId'
