AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder test pipeline (Chef component, custom build workflow, lifecycle policy)

# SECURITY NOTE: AdministratorAccess on the build instance role and the Image Builder
# execution role is explicitly requested for a TEST environment only. Do not use in production.
#
# INSPECTOR NOTE: Image Builder only creates a pipeline with image scanning enabled if
# Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning is already active in the account. This stack turns it on
# through the InspectorEc2Scanning custom resource before it creates the pipeline.
# Activation applies to the whole account and is billed. It is intentionally NOT
# disabled when the stack is deleted, because other workloads may depend on it.
#
# NETWORK NOTE: Build and test instances run in a private subnet with no internet path.
# They reach AWS services (SSM, Image Builder, CloudWatch Logs, S3) only through VPC
# interface endpoints, and security group egress is limited to HTTPS within the VPC CIDR.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (private only, AWS services via interface endpoints)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # KNOWN GAP: the Chef installer WebDownload needs public internet access, which this
  # private-only network does not provide. The sample-component build step will fail at
  # pipeline run time until the owner either accepts an AWS-0104 exception for this test
  # stack (TCP 443 egress via a NAT gateway) or moves the installer source to S3.
  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Image Builder build and test instances - no ingress, HTTPS egress to VPC endpoints only. Chef WebDownload from the public internet will fail until an AWS-0104 exception is accepted or the installer is moved to S3
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
          Description: HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-sg'

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: VPC interface endpoints - HTTPS from Image Builder build and test instances
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS from build and test instances
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
          Description: HTTPS within the VPC only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  ImageBuilderEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.imagebuilder'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  # S3 interface endpoint serves Amazon Linux 2 yum repos, the SSM agent update package
  # and Image Builder component downloads. Because this VPC has no S3 gateway endpoint,
  # private DNS is set to AllResolvers so every resolver in the VPC sends S3 traffic
  # through this interface endpoint.
  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      DnsOptions:
        PrivateDnsOnlyForInboundResolverEndpoint: AllResolvers
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Image Builder build instance role with AdministratorAccess - test-only, do not use in production
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Image Builder workflow and lifecycle execution role with AdministratorAccess - test-only, do not use in production
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning enabler (prerequisite for pipeline image scanning)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InspectorEnablerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Lets the Inspector enabler Lambda activate Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning for this account
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: inspector-enable
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InspectorEnable
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - inspector2:Enable
                  - inspector2:BatchGetAccountStatus
                Resource: '*'
              # Enabling EC2 scanning creates both the Inspector and the Inspector agentless
              # scanning service-linked roles.
              - Sid: InspectorServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName:
                      - inspector2.amazonaws.com
                      - agentless.inspector2.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  InspectorEnablerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Enables Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning so Image Builder image scanning can be configured
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt InspectorEnablerRole.Arn
      Timeout: 600
      MemorySize: 128
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          POLL_SECONDS = 15
          MAX_WAIT_SECONDS = 540
          # Bounded retry for IAM propagation delay on the freshly attached role policy.
          # 6 attempts, 10 s apart, stays within roughly 90 s of the overall budget.
          ENABLE_ATTEMPTS = 6
          ENABLE_RETRY_SECONDS = 10


          def ec2_status(client, account_id):
              resp = client.batch_get_account_status(accountIds=[account_id])
              for account in resp.get('accounts', []):
                  if account.get('accountId') == account_id:
                      return account.get('resourceState', {}).get('ec2', {}).get('status', 'UNKNOWN')
              return 'UNKNOWN'


          def enable_with_retry(client, account_id):
              for attempt in range(1, ENABLE_ATTEMPTS + 1):
                  try:
                      client.enable(accountIds=[account_id], resourceTypes=['EC2'])
                      return
                  except ClientError as exc:
                      code = exc.response.get('Error', {}).get('Code')
                      if code != 'AccessDeniedException':
                          raise
                      print('Enable attempt %d/%d denied: %s' % (attempt, ENABLE_ATTEMPTS, exc))
                      if attempt == ENABLE_ATTEMPTS:
                          raise RuntimeError(
                              'iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole still denied after %d attempts. '
                              'An Organizations SCP may be blocking it; this needs an administrator '
                              'decision. Last error: %s' % (ENABLE_ATTEMPTS, exc))
                      time.sleep(ENABLE_RETRY_SECONDS)


          def handler(event, context):
              data = {}
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      # Intentionally leave Inspector enabled; other workloads may rely on it.
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, 'inspector-ec2-scanning')
                      return

                  deadline = time.time() + MAX_WAIT_SECONDS
                  account_id = context.invoked_function_arn.split(':')[4]
                  client = boto3.client('inspector2')

                  status = ec2_status(client, account_id)
                  if status != 'ENABLED':
                      enable_with_retry(client, account_id)

                  while True:
                      status = ec2_status(client, account_id)
                      print('Inspector EC2 status: %s' % status)
                      if status == 'ENABLED':
                          break
                      if time.time() + POLL_SECONDS > deadline:
                          raise RuntimeError('Inspector EC2 scanning not ENABLED in time, last status: %s' % status)
                      time.sleep(POLL_SECONDS)

                  data['Ec2Status'] = status
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, 'inspector-ec2-scanning')
              except Exception as exc:
                  print('Error: %s' % exc)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, data, 'inspector-ec2-scanning', reason=str(exc)[:500])

  InspectorEc2Scanning:
    Type: Custom::InspectorEc2Scanning
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt InspectorEnablerFunction.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder component
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KNOWN GAP: the WebDownload step below fetches the Chef installer from the public
  # internet (omnitruck.chef.io, then packages.chef.io). With the private-only network in
  # this stack it will fail at pipeline run time until the owner either accepts an
  # AWS-0104 exception for this test stack or moves the installer source to S3.
  SampleComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Downloads, installs and runs Chef Client on Linux
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
      Data: |
        name: sample-component
        description: Downloads, installs and runs Chef Client on Linux
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefInstaller
                action: WebDownload
                maxAttempts: 3
                inputs:
                  - source: https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh
                    destination: /tmp/chef-install.sh
                    overwrite: true
              - name: InstallChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo bash /tmp/chef-install.sh -P chef -v 18
                    - rm -f /tmp/chef-install.sh
              - name: RunChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo mkdir -p /tmp/chef-repo/cookbooks
                    - cd /tmp/chef-repo && sudo chef-client --local-mode --chef-license accept-silent
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chef-client --version --chef-license accept-silent

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder custom build workflow
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: sample-workflow
      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Description: Custom build workflow that updates the SSM agent and builds an AMI
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
      Data: |
        name: sample-workflow
        description: Custom build workflow that updates the SSM agent and builds an AMI
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        steps:
          - name: LaunchBuildInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              waitFor: "ssmAgent"
          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: RunCommand
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              documentName: "AWS-UpdateSSMAgent"
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
              parameters:
                allowDowngrade:
                  - "false"
          - name: ApplyBuildComponents
            action: ExecuteComponents
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: CreateOutputAMI
            action: CreateImage
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: TerminateBuildInstance
            action: TerminateInstance
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
        outputs:
          - name: "ImageId"
            value: "$.stepOutputs.CreateOutputAMI.imageId"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image recipe
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized recipe with Chef Client and chrony time configuration test
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SampleComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/chrony-time-configuration-test/x.x.x'
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Infrastructure configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-infrastructure-configuration
      Description: Build and test infrastructure for the sample image pipeline
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - m5.large
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distribution configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution-configuration
      Description: Distributes the sample AMI to us-east-1 with launch permissions for the current account
      Distributions:
        - Region: us-east-1
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'sample-ami-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: AMI built by the sample image pipeline
            AmiTags:
              Environment: Dev
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image pipeline
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SamplePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    # Image scanning requires Inspector EC2 scanning to be ENABLED at pipeline creation.
    DependsOn: InspectorEc2Scanning
    Properties:
      Name: sample-image-pipeline
      Description: Daily sample image pipeline with custom build workflow, scanning and tests
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt SampleImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt SampleInfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt SampleDistributionConfiguration.Arn
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
      Workflows:
        - WorkflowArn: !GetAtt SampleWorkflow.Arn
        - WorkflowArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:workflow/test/test-image/x.x.x'
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 9 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lifecycle policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: sample-lifecycle-policy
      Description: Deprecates AMIs older than 6 months for resources tagged Environment=Dev
      Status: ENABLED
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 6
            Unit: MONTHS
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Environment: Dev
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev

    Value: !GetAtt SampleComponent.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions a Cognito authentication layer (user pool, user pool client, identity pool) and IAM roles for authenticated and unauthenticated access to a Lex V1 or Lex V2 chatbot web UI, with an optional live chat API invoke permission.

Parameters:
  CognitoIdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: identity pool
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w\s+=,.@-]+$'
    Description: Name of the Cognito identity pool.
  BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: OrderFlowers
    Description: Name of the Lex V1 bot. Leave empty to use a Lex V2 bot instead.
  BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(|[0-9A-Z]{10})$'
    Description: Optional Lex V2 bot ID. Used only when BotName is empty.
  BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(|[0-9A-Z]{10})$'
    Description: Optional Lex V2 bot alias ID. If empty, all aliases of the Lex V2 bot are allowed.
  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: When true, unauthenticated identities are denied Lex and live chat API access.
  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: When true, grants permission to invoke the livechat API Gateway endpoint.

Conditions:
  UseLexV1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BotName, '']]
  HasBotId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BotId, '']]
  UseLexV2: !And
    - Condition: HasBotId
    - !Not [Condition: UseLexV1]
  HasBotAliasId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BotAliasId, '']]
  ShouldForceCognitoLogin: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, 'true']
  EnableLiveChat: !Equals [!Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat, 'true']

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      AliasAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref CognitoIdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false

  CognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by unauthenticated Cognito identities of the Lex web UI.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LexAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - UseLexV1
                - Sid: LexV1Runtime
                  Effect: !If [ShouldForceCognitoLogin, Deny, Allow]
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostText
                    - lex:PostContent
                    - lex:PutSession
                    - lex:GetSession
                    - lex:DeleteSession
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${BotName}:*'
                - !If
                  - UseLexV2
                  - Sid: LexV2Runtime
                    Effect: !If [ShouldForceCognitoLogin, Deny, Allow]
                    Action:
                      - lex:RecognizeText
                      - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                      - lex:StartConversation
                      - lex:PutSession
                      - lex:GetSession
                      - lex:DeleteSession
                    Resource: !If
                      - HasBotAliasId
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${BotId}/${BotAliasId}'
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${BotId}/*'
                  - Sid: NoLexBotConfigured
                    Effect: Deny
                    Action: lex:*
                    Resource: '*'
        - !If
          - EnableLiveChat
          - PolicyName: LiveChatApiInvoke
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: LiveChatInvoke
                  Effect: !If [ShouldForceCognitoLogin, Deny, Allow]
                  Action: execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/*/livechat*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  CognitoAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by authenticated Cognito identities of the Lex web UI.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LexAndPollyAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - UseLexV1
                - Sid: LexV1Runtime
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostText
                    - lex:PostContent
                    - lex:PutSession
                    - lex:GetSession
                    - lex:DeleteSession
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${BotName}:*'
                - !If
                  - UseLexV2
                  - Sid: LexV2Runtime
                    Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - lex:RecognizeText
                      - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                      - lex:StartConversation
                      - lex:PutSession
                      - lex:GetSession
                      - lex:DeleteSession
                    Resource: !If
                      - HasBotAliasId
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${BotId}/${BotAliasId}'
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${BotId}/*'
                  - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - Sid: PollySynthesizeSpeech
                Effect: Allow
                Action: polly:SynthesizeSpeech
                Resource: '*'
        - !If
          - EnableLiveChat
          - PolicyName: LiveChatApiInvoke
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: LiveChatInvoke
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action: execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/*/livechat*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt CognitoAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
  CognitoIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Cognito identity pool ID.
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoIdentityPoolId'
  CognitoUserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoUserPoolId'
  CognitoUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito user pool client ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoUserPoolClientId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the passengerlist.org Route 53 public DNS zone, its DNS records
  (SPF, site verification, G Suite MX, DMARC, Zendesk, Squarespace, and
  A/AAAA aliases), and the CloudFront distributions with private S3 origins
  that the alias records point to. Deploy in us-east-1, because ACM
  certificates used by CloudFront must be issued there.

# NOTE: This template cannot pre-populate site content, the Google DKIM TXT
# record, or ACM validation tokens.
#  - Site content must be uploaded to the S3 origin buckets after deployment.
#  - ACM DNS validation CNAMEs are created automatically in this hosted zone
#    only when EnableCustomDomainCertificates=true. Set it to true only after
#    the registrar delegates passengerlist.org to this zone's name servers
#    (see the NameServers output).
#  - The Google DKIM key must be generated in the Google Admin console, so the
#    google._domainkey TXT record is intentionally omitted.

Parameters:
  EnableCustomDomainCertificates:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Set to true after NS delegation to issue DNS-validated ACM certificates
      and attach custom domain aliases to the CloudFront distributions.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Google site verification value (for example google-site-verification=...).
      Leave empty to omit it.
    Default: ''
  SquarespaceVerificationHost:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Account-specific Squarespace verification host label. It is the left-hand
      part of the CNAME that points to verify.squarespace.com. Leave empty to omit it.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

Rules:
  RequireUsEast1:
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Equals
          - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          - us-east-1
        AssertDescription: This stack must be deployed in us-east-1 (ACM certificates and WAF for CloudFront).

  CloudFrontConstants:
    Global:
      AliasHostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
      CachingOptimizedPolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6

Conditions:
  CreateCertificates: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableCustomDomainCertificates
    - 'true'
  HasGoogleSiteVerification: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref GoogleSiteVerificationToken
      - ''
  HasSquarespaceVerification: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref SquarespaceVerificationHost
      - ''

  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone

        Comment: Public hosted zone for passengerlist.org managed by CloudFormation

        - Key: Project

        Statement:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL

        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet

            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:

            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: passengerlistCommonRuleSet
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet

            None: {}
          Statement:

  OriginAccessControl:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Customer support Cognito authentication stack - user pool, groups, OAuth clients, resource server, hosted UI domain, post-confirmation Lambda, and SSM parameters for backend consumption.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Application name used in resource names and tags.
  CallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: http://localhost:3000/callback
    Description: OAuth callback URL for the web application client.
  LogoutUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: http://localhost:3000/logout
    Description: Logout URL for the web application client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AppName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrators of the customer support system with elevated privileges.
      Precedence: 0
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Customers of the customer support system. New sign-ups are added automatically.
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Ref AppName
      Name: !Sub '${AppName}-resource-server'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to customer support resources.

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${AppName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppName}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub '${AppName}/read'
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackUrl
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref LogoutUrl
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  MachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppName}-machine-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${AppName}/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  PostConfirmationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Cognito post-confirmation Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostConfirmationLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AppName}-post-confirmation:*'
        - PolicyName: PostConfirmationAddToGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AppName}-post-confirmation'
      Description: Adds newly confirmed users to the customer group.
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostConfirmationRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DEFAULT_GROUP: customer
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          DEFAULT_GROUP = os.environ.get("DEFAULT_GROUP", "customer")


          def handler(event, context):
              if event.get("triggerSource") != "PostConfirmation_ConfirmSignUp":
                  return event

              user_pool_id = event["userPoolId"]
              username = event["userName"]

              try:
                  cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      GroupName=DEFAULT_GROUP,
                  )
                  logger.info("Added user to group %s", DEFAULT_GROUP)
              except Exception:
                  logger.exception("Failed to add user to group %s", DEFAULT_GROUP)
                  raise

              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  PostConfirmationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${PostConfirmationFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  PostConfirmationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  WebClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Description: Cognito web application client ID.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  MachineClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/machine_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineClient
      Description: Cognito machine-to-machine client ID. Retrieve the secret at runtime via cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/userpool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito user pool ID.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  OAuthScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_auth_scope
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${AppName}/read'
      Description: Custom OAuth scope for customer support resources.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL for the user pool.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  TokenEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_token_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: Cognito OAuth2 token endpoint.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  AuthorizeEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_auth_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Description: Cognito OAuth2 authorize endpoint.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  DomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito hosted UI domain URL.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  WebAppClientId:
    Description: Web application client ID.
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient
  MachineClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine client ID.
    Value: !Ref MachineClient
  OAuthScope:
    Description: Custom OAuth read scope.
    Value: !Sub '${AppName}/read'
  HostedUIDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI domain URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
  AuthorizeEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 authorize endpoint.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
  PostConfirmationFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the post-confirmation Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn

                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags

                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig

                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage

                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob

                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps

                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob

                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack

                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks

                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CodeBuild
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                Resource:

                  - codecommit:UploadArchive

              - Sid: Events

                  - events:PutTargets
                  - events:RemoveTargets
                Resource:

                Action:
                  - codestar-connections:UseConnection

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: "Route 53 hosted zone for prxu.org (Production) – Google Workspace email, CloudFront aliases, and service CNAMEs"

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: prxu.org.
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-z0-9-]+\.)+[a-z]{2,}\.$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a lowercase fully qualified domain name ending with a trailing period (e.g. prxu.org.).
    Description: Apex domain name for the hosted zone, including the trailing period.

  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: Production
    AllowedValues:
      - Production
      - Staging
      - Development
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging.

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^google-site-verification=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or of the form google-site-verification=<token>.
    Description: Optional Google Workspace site verification TXT value issued for your tenant.

  FeedProxyTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: feeds-origin.prxu.org
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}\.?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a fully qualified domain name.
    Description: CNAME target for the production authenticated feed proxy.

  FeedProxyStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: feeds-origin-staging.prxu.org
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}\.?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a fully qualified domain name.
    Description: CNAME target for the staging authenticated feed proxy.

  DovetailRouterTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: router-origin.prxu.org
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}\.?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a fully qualified domain name.
    Description: CNAME target for the production Dovetail router.

  DovetailRouterStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: router-origin-staging.prxu.org
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}\.?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a fully qualified domain name.
    Description: CNAME target for the staging Dovetail router.

Rules:
  RequireUsEast1:
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Equals [!Ref 'AWS::Region', 'us-east-1']
        AssertDescription: This stack must be deployed in us-east-1 because CLOUDFRONT-scope WAFv2 Web ACLs can only be created in us-east-1.

Conditions:
  HasGoogleVerification: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GoogleSiteVerificationToken, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted zone
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Production public zone for Google Workspace and Dovetail/PRX services
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google Workspace apex records
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords: !If
        - HasGoogleVerification
        - - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all"'
          - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'
        - - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all"'

  ApexMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # WAF for CloudFront
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CdnWebAcl:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cdn-web-acl'
      Description: Web ACL protecting the CDN CloudFront distributions
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cdn-web-acl'
      Rules:
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 0
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          Priority: 1
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          Priority: 2
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
        - Name: RateLimitPerIp
          Priority: 3
          Action:
            Block: {}
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 2000
              AggregateKeyType: IP
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: RateLimitPerIp
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cdn-web-acl'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront origin
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CdnOriginKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the CDN origin bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudFrontDecryptViaOac
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com
            Action: kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                AWS:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudfront::${AWS::AccountId}:distribution/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cdn-origin'

  CdnOriginKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-cdn-origin'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CdnOriginKey

  CdnOriginBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CdnOriginKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cdn-origin'

  CdnOriginAccessControl:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl
    Properties:
      OriginAccessControlConfig:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cdn-oac'
        Description: Origin access control for the CDN origin bucket
        OriginAccessControlOriginType: s3
        SigningBehavior: always
        SigningProtocol: sigv4

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront distributions
  # Aliases and an ACM certificate are intentionally not set: the certificate
  # cannot validate until the registrar delegates the domain to this zone.
  # Custom hostnames return 403 until Aliases and a us-east-1 certificate are
  # added post-delegation. MinimumProtocolVersion is declared now, but CloudFront
  # only enforces it once a custom certificate is attached; on the default
  # *.cloudfront.net certificate the effective floor remains TLSv1.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DovetailCdnDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub 'dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}'
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        WebACLId: !GetAtt CdnWebAcl.Arn
        Origins:
          - Id: CdnOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt CdnOriginBucket.RegionalDomainName
            OriginPath: /dovetail-cdn
            OriginAccessControlId: !GetAtt CdnOriginAccessControl.Id
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: ''
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: CdnOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6
          ResponseHeadersPolicyId: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Name
          Value: dovetail-cdn

  DovetailCdnStagingDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub 'dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}'
        HttpVersion: http2and3

        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Learning/demo VPC template with optional internet gateway, public subnet, route table, and security group controlled by boolean parameters.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: SimpleApp1
    Description: Prefix applied to the Name tag of every resource.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

  SecurityGroupIngressCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0
    Description: Source IPv4 CIDR range allowed to reach HTTP (80) and HTTPS (443).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/y.

  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create and attach an internet gateway.

  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the public subnet.

  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the public route table.

  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the web security group.

    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - NamePrefix
      - Label:

  DefaultPublicRoute:

      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:

      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet

  WebSecurityGroup:

        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
