final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Landing zone hub VPC with a Transit Gateway for multi-account spoke connectivity, including NAT gateways, VPC flow logs encrypted with KMS, and private VPC endpoints for SSM, EC2 Messages, SSM Messages, CloudWatch Logs and S3.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Environment name prefix applied to resource names, tags and export names.

Mappings:
  NetworkConfig:
    VPC:
      Cidr: 10.0.0.0/16
    PublicSubnet1:
      Cidr: 10.0.1.0/24
    PublicSubnet2:
      Cidr: 10.0.2.0/24
    PrivateSubnet1:
      Cidr: 10.0.10.0/24
    PrivateSubnet2:
      Cidr: 10.0.11.0/24
    Spoke:
      Cidr: 10.0.0.0/8

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, Cidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} hub Transit Gateway for multi-account spoke connectivity'
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      MulticastSupport: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Options:
        DnsSupport: enable
        Ipv6Support: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-hub-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  PrivateSpokeRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, Spoke, Cidr]
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSpokeRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, Spoke, Cidr]
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${EnvironmentName} VPC flow log encryption'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlog-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  FlowLogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlog-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Allows VPC Flow Logs to publish to CloudWatch Logs for ${EnvironmentName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:log-stream:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlog-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flowlog'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Endpoints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from within the hub VPC to interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from hub VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, Cidr]
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS responses within hub VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, Cidr]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ssm'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ec2messages'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ssmmessages'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-s3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Managed Instance Role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SSMInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'SSM managed instance role for ${EnvironmentName} hub workloads'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssm-instance-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  SSMInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref SSMInstanceRole

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: Hub VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VPCId'

  VPCCidr:
    Description: Hub VPC CIDR block
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VPCCidr'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Student Services Bedrock AgentCore identity and IAM foundation stack. Creates a
  shared base AgentCore managed policy, least-privilege execution roles per agent
  domain, and self-contained Cognito OAuth2 client_credentials identity per domain.

# No Parameters: all names derive from AWS::StackName, AWS::AccountId and AWS::Region.
# No AWS::BedrockAgentCore::* resources are created; this stack covers identity and IAM only.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared base managed policy attached to every execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudentServicesBaseAgentCorePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-agentcore-base"
      Description: Shared base permissions for Student Services Bedrock AgentCore execution roles.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*"
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAgentCore
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*:log-stream:*"
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsDescribeGroups
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*"
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetricsAgentCoreNamespace
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
              - xray:GetSamplingRules
              - xray:GetSamplingTargets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMStudentServicesParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Execution roles (no explicit RoleName; CloudFormation generates unique names)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the StudentServicesAgent orchestrator (inbound auth is IAM-based).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseAgentCorePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Domain
          Value: StudentServicesAgent
        - Key: Application
          Value: student-services

  CourseRegistrationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the CourseRegistration AgentCore domain.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseAgentCorePolicy
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: Domain
          Value: CourseRegistration
        - Key: Application
          Value: student-services

  CourseCatalogExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the CourseCatalog AgentCore domain.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseAgentCorePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CourseCatalogKnowledgeBaseRetrieve
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: KnowledgeBaseRetrieve
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:Retrieve
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:knowledge-base/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Domain
          Value: CourseCatalog
        - Key: Application
          Value: student-services

  CourseReviewExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the CourseReview AgentCore domain.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseAgentCorePolicy
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBReadOnlyAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: Domain
          Value: CourseReview
        - Key: Application
          Value: student-services

  LoanApplicationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the LoanApplication AgentCore domain.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerInvokeEndpoint
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Domain
          Value: LoanApplication
        - Key: Application
          Value: student-services

  # Cognito identity per domain (machine-to-machine, client_credentials)
  # User pools intentionally have no DeletionPolicy/UpdateReplacePolicy Retain:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Implements the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark section 3 log-metric-filter and alarm
  monitoring controls (3.1-3.14). Creates a multi-region CloudTrail trail delivering
  management events to an encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group, a customer managed KMS
  key, an encrypted SNS topic for alarm notifications, and one metric filter, alarm,
  and Logs Insights query definition per control.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Key:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for ${AWS::StackName} CIS monitoring (CloudTrail, CloudWatch Logs, SNS)'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailEncryptLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:cloudtrail:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:*:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*'
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/${AWS::StackName}-cis-trail'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailDescribeKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/${AWS::StackName}-cis-trail'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/cloudtrail/${AWS::StackName}'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  KeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-cis-monitoring'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref Key

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudTrail delivery chain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/cloudtrail/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt Key.Arn

  TrailBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt Key.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ArchiveAndExpireNoncurrent
            Status: Enabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: GLACIER
                TransitionInDays: 90
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 365
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7

  TrailBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TrailBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailAclCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:GetBucketAcl'
            Resource: !GetAtt TrailBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/${AWS::StackName}-cis-trail'
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${TrailBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                's3:x-amz-acl': bucket-owner-full-control
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/${AWS::StackName}-cis-trail'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TrailBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${TrailBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  CloudTrailLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows CloudTrail to deliver events to the CIS monitoring CloudWatch Logs log group
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/${AWS::StackName}-cis-trail'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailToCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${CloudTrailLogGroup}:log-stream:*'

  # Trail log files are encrypted with the customer managed key above via KMSKeyId
  # (the CloudFormation schema property name). AWS-0015 is a suspected Trivy false
  # positive (adapter believed to look up "KmsKeyId"), pending verification in the
  # validation pipeline; it is not addressable by a schema-valid template change.
  Trail:
    Type: AWS::CloudTrail::Trail
    DependsOn:
      - TrailBucketPolicy
      - KeyAlias
    Properties:
      TrailName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-trail'
      S3BucketName: !Ref TrailBucket
      IsLogging: true
      IsMultiRegionTrail: true
      IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
      EnableLogFileValidation: true
      KMSKeyId: !GetAtt Key.Arn
      CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
      CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsRole.Arn
      EventSelectors:
        - ReadWriteType: All
          IncludeManagementEvents: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm notifications
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-alarms'
      DisplayName: CIS Benchmark Alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt Key.Arn

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CIS 3.1 Unauthorized API calls
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UnauthorizedAPICallsMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UnauthorizedAPICalls'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ (($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*")) && ($.sourceIPAddress != "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com") && ($.eventName != "HeadBucket") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICalls
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricValue: '1'

  UnauthorizedAPICallsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.1 - Unauthorized API call attempts detected
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICalls
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  UnauthorizedAPICallsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, eventSource, eventName, errorCode, errorMessage, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, awsRegion
        | filter (errorCode like /UnauthorizedOperation$/ or errorCode like /^AccessDenied/) and sourceIPAddress != "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com" and eventName != "HeadBucket"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 100

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CIS 3.2 Console sign-in without MFA
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConsoleSignInWithoutMFAMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") && ($.userIdentity.type = "IAMUser") && ($.responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Success") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricValue: '1'

  ConsoleSignInWithoutMFAAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.2-ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.2 - Successful IAM user console sign-in without MFA detected
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ConsoleSignInWithoutMFAQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/CIS-3.2-ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, userAgent, additionalEventData.MFAUsed
        | filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes" and userIdentity.type = "IAMUser" and responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Success"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 100

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Automated AWS Security Hub deployment across an AWS Organization governed by AWS Control Tower.
  Deploy this stack in the Control Tower management account, in the Control Tower home region.
  It delegates Security Hub administration to the audit account, enables Security Hub in the log
  archive account and in every account later provisioned through Control Tower, and adds them as
  members. Audit and log archive account IDs are read at runtime from the SSM parameters
  /superwerker/account-id-audit and /superwerker/account-id-logarchive. Cross-account actions use
  the AWSControlTowerExecution role that Control Tower provisions in every managed account.

Resources:
  SecurityHubAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by SSM Automation to configure Security Hub across the organization.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityHubAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadSuperwerkerConfiguration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/*'
              - Sid: AssumeControlTowerExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
              - Sid: CallerIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SecurityHubDelegatedAdministration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:ListOrganizationAdminAccounts
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: OrganizationsIntegration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:EnableAWSServiceAccess
                  - organizations:ListAWSServiceAccessForOrganization
                  - organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
                  - organizations:ListDelegatedAdministrators
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SecurityHubServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole

          organization auto-enable, and enables Security Hub in the log archive account as a member.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'

            action: aws:executeScript

            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import os
                import time
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                ROLE_NAME = 'AWSControlTowerExecution'
                AUDIT_PARAM = '/superwerker/account-id-audit'

                def region():
                    return os.environ.get('AWS_REGION') or boto3.session.Session().region_name

                def get_account_param(name):
                    ssm = boto3.client('ssm', region_name=region())
                    try:
                        value = ssm.get_parameter(Name=name)['Parameter']['Value'].strip()
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ParameterNotFound':
                            raise Exception(f"Required SSM parameter '{name}' was not found. Create it with the 12-digit account ID and re-run this automation.")
                        raise
                    if len(value) != 12 or not value.isdigit():
                        raise Exception(f"SSM parameter '{name}' must contain a 12-digit AWS account ID, got '{value}'.")
                    return value

                def assume(partition, account_id):
                    arn = f'arn:{partition}:iam::{account_id}:role/{ROLE_NAME}'
                    creds = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region()).assume_role(
                        RoleArn=arn, RoleSessionName='superwerker-securityhub')['Credentials']
                    return boto3.session.Session(
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                        region_name=region())

                def enable_hub(session):
                    try:
                        session.client('securityhub').enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                        return 'enabled'
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ResourceConflictException':
                            return 'already enabled'
                        raise

                def handler(events, context):
                    audit_id = get_account_param(AUDIT_PARAM)
                    identity = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region()).get_caller_identity()
                    partition = identity['Arn'].split(':')[1]

                    orgs = boto3.client('organizations')
                    try:
                        orgs.enable_aws_service_access(ServicePrincipal='securityhub.amazonaws.com')
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] != 'ConcurrentModificationException':
                            raise

                    sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region())
                    admins = sh.list_organization_admin_accounts().get('AdminAccounts', [])
                    current = [a['AccountId'] for a in admins]
                    if current and audit_id not in current:
                        raise Exception(f"Security Hub delegated administrator is already set to {current}, expected audit account {audit_id}.")
                    if audit_id not in current:
                        sh.enable_organization_admin_account(AdminAccountId=audit_id)

                    audit = assume(partition, audit_id)
                    hub_status = enable_hub(audit)
                    audit_sh = audit.client('securityhub')
                    for attempt in range(10):
                        try:
                            audit_sh.update_organization_configuration(AutoEnable=True)
                            break
                        except ClientError as e:
                            if attempt == 9 or e.response['Error']['Code'] not in ('InvalidAccessException', 'AccessDeniedException', 'LimitExceededException'):
                                raise
                            time.sleep(15)

                    return {
                        'AuditAccountId': audit_id,
                        'Partition': partition,

              - Name: Partition
                Selector: $.Payload.Partition
                Type: String
              - Name: Message
                Selector: $.Payload.message

          - name: EnableLogArchiveMember

              Script: |
                import os
                import time
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                ROLE_NAME = 'AWSControlTowerExecution'
                LOGARCHIVE_PARAM = '/superwerker/account-id-logarchive'

                def region():
                    return os.environ.get('AWS_REGION') or boto3.session.Session().region_name

                def get_account_param(name):
                    ssm = boto3.client('ssm', region_name=region())
                    try:
                        value = ssm.get_parameter(Name=name)['Parameter']['Value'].strip()
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ParameterNotFound':
                            raise Exception(f"Required SSM parameter '{name}' was not found. Create it with the 12-digit account ID and re-run this automation.")
                        raise
                    if len(value) != 12 or not value.isdigit():
                        raise Exception(f"SSM parameter '{name}' must contain a 12-digit AWS account ID, got '{value}'.")
                    return value

                def assume(partition, account_id):
                    arn = f'arn:{partition}:iam::{account_id}:role/{ROLE_NAME}'
                    creds = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region()).assume_role(
                        RoleArn=arn, RoleSessionName='superwerker-securityhub')['Credentials']
                    return boto3.session.Session(
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                        region_name=region())

                def enable_hub(session):
                    try:
                        session.client('securityhub').enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                        return 'enabled'
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ResourceConflictException':
                            return 'already enabled'
                        raise

                def member_status(admin_sh, account_id):
                    members = admin_sh.get_members(AccountIds=[account_id]).get('Members', [])
                    return members[0]['MemberStatus'] if members else None

                def add_member(admin_sh, admin_id, member_session, account_id):
                    if member_status(admin_sh, account_id) is None:
                        result = admin_sh.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': account_id}])
                        if result.get('UnprocessedAccounts'):
                            raise Exception(f"Failed to add {account_id} as Security Hub member: {result['UnprocessedAccounts']}")
                    status = member_status(admin_sh, account_id)
                    if status in ('Enabled', 'Associated'):
                        return status
                    if status in ('Created', 'Removed', 'Resigned', 'Deleted'):
                        result = admin_sh.invite_members(AccountIds=[account_id])
                        if result.get('UnprocessedAccounts'):
                            raise Exception(f"Failed to invite {account_id}: {result['UnprocessedAccounts']}")
                    member_sh = member_session.client('securityhub')
                    for _ in range(10):
                        invitations = [i for i in member_sh.list_invitations().get('Invitations', []) if i['AccountId'] == admin_id]
                        if invitations:
                            member_sh.accept_administrator_invitation(
                                AdministratorId=admin_id, InvitationId=invitations[0]['InvitationId'])
                            break
                        if member_status(admin_sh, account_id) in ('Enabled', 'Associated'):
                            break
                        time.sleep(10)
                    status = member_status(admin_sh, account_id)
                    if status not in ('Enabled', 'Associated'):
                        raise Exception(f"Account {account_id} is not an associated Security Hub member (status: {status}).")
                    return status

                def handler(events, context):
                    audit_id = events['AuditAccountId']
                    partition = events['Partition']
                    logarchive_id = get_account_param(LOGARCHIVE_PARAM)

                    member = assume(partition, logarchive_id)
                    hub_status = enable_hub(member)
                    audit_sh = assume(partition, audit_id).client('securityhub')
                    status = add_member(audit_sh, audit_id, member, logarchive_id)
                    return {'message': f'Log archive account {logarchive_id}: hub {hub_status}, member status {status}.'}
            outputs:
              - Name: Message
                Selector: $.Payload.message
                Type: String
        outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions shared IAM roles, an Amazon GuardDuty detector, and AWSQS Kubernetes/EKS
  CloudFormation registry type activations for use across multiple EKS deployments.
  Deploying this stack requires CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM because the IAM roles have explicit names.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: eks
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,15}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain at most 16 lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.
    Description: Name prefix applied to every named resource. The 16-character cap keeps IAM role names under 64 characters.

  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]{0,8}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain at most 8 lowercase letters or digits.
    Description: Optional suffix appended to the name prefix for uniqueness.

  # Leave empty in environments that do not require a permissions boundary.
  # When set, the boundary is attached to every IAM role in this stack.
  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:policy/.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid IAM managed policy ARN.
    Description: Optional ARN of an IAM managed policy to use as the permissions boundary for all roles.

  BastionBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid S3 bucket name.
    Description: Optional name for the bastion artifact bucket. The bastion role's s3:GetObject access is scoped to this bucket. Leave empty to auto-generate a name.

Conditions:
  HasEnvironmentHash: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentHash, '']]
  HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, '']]
  HasBastionBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BastionBucketName, '']]

Resources:
  BastionArtifactBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key that encrypts the bastion artifact bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountIamPolicies
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  BastionArtifactBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !If
        - HasEnvironmentHash
        - !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-bastion-artifacts'
        - !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentAlias}-bastion-artifacts'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BastionArtifactBucketKey

  BastionArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If [HasBastionBucketName, !Ref BastionBucketName, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt BastionArtifactBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7

  BastionArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref BastionArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt BastionArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${BastionArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # Only one GuardDuty detector may exist per account and region.
  # This is valid for the greenfield account this template targets.
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  ResourceDiscoveryLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasEnvironmentHash
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-resource-discovery-lambda-role'
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-resource-discovery-lambda-role'
      Description: Lambda execution role with read-only access for resource discovery.

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasEnvironmentHash
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-caller-identity-lambda-role'
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-caller-identity-lambda-role'
      Description: Lambda role for retrieving the caller identity and reading CloudFormation and CloudTrail data.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SQS testing stack with KMS encryption and CloudWatch alarms. Creates FIFO and standard queues with dead letter queues, a customer-managed KMS key encrypting all queues, and CloudWatch alarms with actions disabled.

Resources:
  SqsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting SQS testing queues
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  SqsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-sqs-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey

  FifoDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  FifoQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-with-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoDeadLetterQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  FifoQueueNoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-no-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  StandardDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-dlq'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  StandardQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-separate-fifo-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-messages-sent'
      AlarmDescription: Sum of messages sent to the standard queue is at or above 1; missing data is treated as breaching
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching

  FifoQueueWithDlqMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-with-dlq-messages-sent-anomaly'
      AlarmDescription: Average messages sent to the FIFO queue with DLQ is outside the anomaly detection band
      ActionsEnabled: false
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: true
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
        - Id: ad1
          Label: NumberOfMessagesSent (expected)
          ReturnData: true
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)

  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-sent-message-size'
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on the standard queue exceeds 183500 bytes
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  SeparateFifoSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-separate-fifo-sent-message-size'
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on the separate FIFO queue exceeds 183500 bytes
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  StandardDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-dlq-visible-messages'
      AlarmDescription: Sum of visible messages on the standard DLQ is greater than zero
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  FifoDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-dlq-visible-messages'
      AlarmDescription: Sum of visible messages on the FIFO DLQ is greater than zero
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of the oldest message on the standard queue exceeds 15 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  SeparateFifoOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-separate-fifo-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of the oldest message on the separate FIFO queue exceeds 15 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  StandardQueueMessagesNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-messages-not-visible'
      AlarmDescription: Maximum number of messages not visible on the standard queue exceeds 108000
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 108000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  SeparateFifoMessagesNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-separate-fifo-messages-not-visible'
      AlarmDescription: Maximum number of messages not visible on the separate FIFO queue exceeds 18000
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 18000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  StandardDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-dlq-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of the oldest message on the standard DLQ exceeds 90 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 90
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  SyntheticAlwaysOkAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-synthetic-always-ok'
      AlarmDescription: Synthetic alarm on a never-published metric; missing data is not breaching so it always evaluates to OK
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/Synthetic'
      MetricName: AlwaysOkHeartbeat
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

Outputs:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key encrypting all queues
    Value: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyArn'

  KmsKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias name of the KMS key
    Value: !Ref SqsKmsKeyAlias
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyAliasName'

  FifoDeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the FIFO dead letter queue
    Value: !Ref FifoDeadLetterQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FifoDeadLetterQueueUrl'

  FifoDeadLetterQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the FIFO dead letter queue
    Value: !GetAtt FifoDeadLetterQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FifoDeadLetterQueueArn'

  FifoQueueWithDlqUrl:
    Description: URL of the FIFO queue with a dead letter queue
    Value: !Ref FifoQueueWithDlq
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FifoQueueWithDlqUrl'

  FifoQueueWithDlqArn:
    Description: ARN of the FIFO queue with a dead letter queue
    Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlq.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FifoQueueWithDlqArn'

  FifoQueueNoDlqUrl:
    Description: URL of the FIFO queue without a dead letter queue
    Value: !Ref FifoQueueNoDlq
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FifoQueueNoDlqUrl'

  FifoQueueNoDlqArn:
    Description: ARN of the FIFO queue without a dead letter queue
    Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueNoDlq.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FifoQueueNoDlqArn'

  StandardDeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the standard dead letter queue
    Value: !Ref StandardDeadLetterQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StandardDeadLetterQueueUrl'

  StandardDeadLetterQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the standard dead letter queue
    Value: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StandardDeadLetterQueueArn'

  StandardQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the standard queue
    Value: !Ref StandardQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StandardQueueUrl'

  StandardQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the standard queue
    Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StandardQueueArn'

  SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the separate FIFO dead letter queue
    Value: !Ref SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueueUrl'

  SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the separate FIFO dead letter queue
    Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueueArn'
