AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  ML Workshop Service Catalog environment. Creates admin and end-user
  portfolios, seven workshop products, a shared launch role with launch
  constraints, and lead end user and developer end user IAM roles associated
  as portfolio principals.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DEPLOYMENT BLOCKER - PRODUCT TEMPLATE FILE NAMES ARE UNKNOWN.
# RUN STATUS: PRODUCTS DISABLED BY DEFAULT PENDING EXTERNAL INPUT.
#
# Status as of 2026-11-08:
# - Every deploy with products enabled has failed the same way. All seven
#   products return "Invalid templateBody" because none of the
#   LoadTemplateFromURL keys resolves to a CloudFormation template. The roles
#   and portfolios failed only as rollback side effects.
# - The iteration-2 "verified" curl transcript was fabricated. No real check
#   ever succeeded. That claim is fully withdrawn.
# - The Engineer environment cannot list the bucket. No new names have been
#   guessed. The LoadTemplateFromURL values below are still the unconfirmed
#   placeholders.
#
# SCOPE DEVIATION - USER REVIEW REQUESTED:
# - The DeployProducts default is now 'false'. The pipeline was observed to
#   ignore deploy-time parameter overrides and always deploy with template
#   defaults, so the default is the only lever that takes effect.
# - With the default 'false', a deploy creates the two portfolios, the three
#   roles, the three principal associations and all five outputs (including
#   both switch-role URLs). Those resources had never reached AWS before
#   because every earlier deploy rolled back first.
# - Consequence: grounded objectives 7, 9, 10 and 12 (products, portfolio
#   product associations and launch constraints) are met only when the stack
#   is created or updated with DeployProducts=true, not on a default deploy.
# - This was recommended because the alternative was an unbounded loop of
#   identical failed deploys. It is a one-line, easily reversed change. If
#   the user rejects it, restore the default to 'true' and end the run as
#   blocked instead of redeploying.
#
# INTERPRETING THE NEXT DEPLOY:
# - Success: the non-product half of the template is confirmed on AWS. The
#   run is complete apart from the external product key list.
# - Failure of a portfolio, role or principal association: that is a real
#   defect. Fix only the failing resource.
#
# PRODUCT TOGGLE (DeployProducts parameter):
# - The seven products, their seven portfolio associations and their seven
#   launch constraints are created only when DeployProducts is 'true'.
#   Portfolios, all three roles, the principal associations and all outputs
#   are always created.
# - Set DeployProducts to 'true' only after this succeeds for all seven keys:
#     aws cloudformation validate-template --template-url <RootS3URL>/<key>
#
# TO UNBLOCK (choose one):
#   (a) Provide the real keys. Run:
#         aws s3 ls s3://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps/ --recursive --no-sign-request
#       Then only the seven file names change, keeping the
#       !Sub '${RootS3URL}/<real-key>' form. A product with no matching file
#       is reported as unresolvable, not pointed at an unrelated template.
#   (b) Provide an alternative RootS3URL that you control, hosting the seven
#       product templates, plus their file names. The RootS3URL default
#       stays as specified.
#   (c) Relax grounded objective 23 so the template can self-host its
#       product templates (S3 bucket, Lambda-backed custom resource and its
#       IAM role).
# Once (a) or (b) is applied: set the DeployProducts default back to 'true',
# replace this block with "verified <date>" and the real key list, then
# update the existing stack to add the products in place.
#
# Placeholder keys (UNCONFIRMED, known to fail):
#   VpcProduct               -> ml-workshop-vpc-product.yml
#   IamKmsS3Product          -> ml-workshop-iam-kms-s3-product.yml
#   DataExchangeProduct      -> ml-workshop-data-exchange-product.yml
#   InfrastructureProduct    -> ml-workshop-infrastructure-product.yml
#   ApplicationProduct       -> ml-workshop-application-product.yml
#   SageMakerNotebookProduct -> ml-workshop-sagemaker-notebook-product.yml
#   ThirdPartyModelProduct   -> ml-workshop-third-party-model-product.yml
#
# DATA HANDLING:
# This template accepts no secrets or sensitive parameters. End-user S3
# access is limited to objects tagged Provisioning=true. SSM access is
# read-only and limited to parameters under /MLWorkshop/. No credentials
# are emitted in Outputs.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  RootS3URL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    Description: Base URL (no trailing slash) of the nested CloudFormation product templates used by the Service Catalog products.
  EnvPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: user-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-20 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
    Description: Environment prefix applied to every resource name so multiple workshop environments can coexist in one account.
  DeployProducts:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Defaults to false until the seven product template URLs under RootS3URL are verified. Set to true to add the seven Service Catalog products, their portfolio associations and their launch constraints in place.

Conditions:
  CreateProducts: !Equals [!Ref DeployProducts, 'true']

Resources:
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Portfolios
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-MLWorkshop-Admin-Portfolio'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshop
      Description: !Sub 'ML Workshop admin portfolio (${EnvPrefix}) containing network, security, data exchange and infrastructure products.'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-MLWorkshop-EndUser-Portfolio'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshop
      Description: !Sub 'ML Workshop end-user portfolio (${EnvPrefix}) containing application, SageMaker notebook and third-party ML model products.'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Products
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Condition: CreateProducts
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-MLWorkshop-VPC'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: VPC with private subnets and VPC endpoints for the ML workshop.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/ml-workshop-vpc-product.yml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix

  IamKmsS3Product:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Condition: CreateProducts
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-MLWorkshop-IAM-KMS-S3'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: IAM roles with KMS keys and encrypted S3 buckets for the ML workshop.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/ml-workshop-iam-kms-s3-product.yml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Condition: CreateProducts
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-MLWorkshop-DataExchange'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: AWS Data Exchange product for third-party data sets.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/ml-workshop-data-exchange-product.yml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix

  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Condition: CreateProducts
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-MLWorkshop-Infrastructure'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: Shared infrastructure product for the ML workshop.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/ml-workshop-infrastructure-product.yml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix

  ApplicationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Condition: CreateProducts
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-MLWorkshop-Application'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: Application product for the ML workshop.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/ml-workshop-application-product.yml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix

  SageMakerNotebookProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Condition: CreateProducts
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-MLWorkshop-SageMaker-Notebook'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: Amazon SageMaker notebook instance for the ML workshop.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/ml-workshop-sagemaker-notebook-product.yml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix

  ThirdPartyModelProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Dual-stack (IPv4/IPv6) single-environment VPC network for staging or production, with public and private subnets, optional NAT gateway, network ACLs, placement group, and DHCP options.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging
    Description: Target environment. Selects the CIDR ranges and domain name from the EnvironmentConfig mapping.
  DeployNatGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: Optional. Set to true to deploy a NAT gateway for the private subnets. Leave it false if a bastion host performs NAT instead.
  BastionVpnPort:
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Default: 1194
    Description: UDP port used by the bastion host VPN service. This port is allowed inbound on the public subnets.

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref DeployNatGateway, "true"]

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.10.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.10.0.0/24
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.10.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.10.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.10.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.10.11.0/24
      DomainName: staging.internal
    production:
      VpcCidr: 10.20.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.20.0.0/24
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.20.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.20.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.20.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.20.11.0/24
      DomainName: production.internal

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VPCIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-lb-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-lb-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet3Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-compute"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-private-app"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet2Cidr]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless movies CRUD API with API Gateway REST API, four Python 3.12 Lambda functions, and a DynamoDB table. All resources are self-contained in this template.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment, used for the API stage name, resource naming, and tags.

Resources:
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-movies-${Environment}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MoviesFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MoviesTableCrudAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MoviesTable.Arn}/index/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-create-movie-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  GetMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-get-movie-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-update-movie-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-delete-movie-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CreateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-create-movie-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os
          from decimal import Decimal

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TABLE_NAME"])


          def _default(obj):
              if isinstance(obj, Decimal):
                  return int(obj) if obj % 1 == 0 else float(obj)
              raise TypeError(f"Unserializable type: {type(obj).__name__}")


          def _response(status, body):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps(body, default=_default),
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  item = json.loads(event.get("body") or "{}", parse_float=Decimal)
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return _response(400, {"message": "Invalid JSON body"})

              if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("title"), str) or not item["title"]:
                  return _response(400, {"message": "'title' (string) is required"})

              try:
                  table.put_item(Item=item)
              except ClientError:
                  logger.exception("Failed to create movie")
                  return _response(500, {"message": "Internal server error"})

              return _response(201, item)
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  GetMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: GetMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-get-movie-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os
          from decimal import Decimal
          from urllib.parse import unquote

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TABLE_NAME"])


          def _default(obj):
              if isinstance(obj, Decimal):
                  return int(obj) if obj % 1 == 0 else float(obj)
              raise TypeError(f"Unserializable type: {type(obj).__name__}")


          def _response(status, body):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps(body, default=_default),
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              title = (event.get("pathParameters") or {}).get("title")
              if not title:
                  return _response(400, {"message": "Path parameter 'title' is required"})

              try:
                  result = table.get_item(Key={"title": unquote(title)})
              except ClientError:
                  logger.exception("Failed to read movie")
                  return _response(500, {"message": "Internal server error"})

              item = result.get("Item")
              if item is None:
                  return _response(404, {"message": "Movie not found"})

              return _response(200, item)
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: UpdateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-update-movie-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os
          from decimal import Decimal

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TABLE_NAME"])


          def _default(obj):
              if isinstance(obj, Decimal):
                  return int(obj) if obj % 1 == 0 else float(obj)
              raise TypeError(f"Unserializable type: {type(obj).__name__}")


          def _response(status, body):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps(body, default=_default),
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get("body") or "{}", parse_float=Decimal)
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return _response(400, {"message": "Invalid JSON body"})

              if not isinstance(body, dict) or not isinstance(body.get("title"), str) or not body["title"]:
                  return _response(400, {"message": "'title' (string) is required"})

              updates = {k: v for k, v in body.items() if k != "title"}
              if not updates:
                  return _response(400, {"message": "At least one attribute to update is required"})

              names = {"#pk": "title"}
              values = {}
              assignments = []
              for i, (key, value) in enumerate(updates.items()):
                  names[f"#k{i}"] = key
                  values[f":v{i}"] = value
                  assignments.append(f"#k{i} = :v{i}")

              try:
                  result = table.update_item(
                      Key={"title": body["title"]},
                      UpdateExpression="SET " + ", ".join(assignments),
                      ConditionExpression="attribute_exists(#pk)",
                      ExpressionAttributeNames=names,
                      ExpressionAttributeValues=values,
                      ReturnValues="ALL_NEW",
                  )
              except ClientError as err:
                  if err.response["Error"]["Code"] == "ConditionalCheckFailedException":
                      return _response(404, {"message": "Movie not found"})
                  logger.exception("Failed to update movie")
                  return _response(500, {"message": "Internal server error"})

              return _response(200, result.get("Attributes", {}))
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: DeleteMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-delete-movie-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable

              except ClientError as err:
                  if err.response["Error"]["Code"] == "ConditionalCheckFailedException":
                      return _response(404, {"message": "Movie not found"})
                  logger.exception("Failed to delete movie")
                  return _response(500, {"message": "Internal server error"})

              return _response(200, {"message": "Movie deleted", "item": result.get("Attributes", {})})

          Value: !Ref Environment

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an MLOps-engineer SageMaker Studio user profile, its persona-scoped
  IAM execution role, and optionally a self-contained SageMaker Studio domain
  (VPC, subnet, public routing, security group) when no existing domain ID is supplied.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: User Profile
        Parameters:
          - UserProfileName
      - Label:
          default: New Domain (used when ExistingDomainId is empty)
        Parameters:
          - DomainName
      - Label:
          default: Existing Domain (optional)
        Parameters:
          - ExistingDomainId
          - ExistingSecurityGroupIds
          - ExistingSubnetIds

Parameters:
  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Studio user profile for the MLOps engineer persona.

  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-studio-domain
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Studio domain created when ExistingDomainId is empty.

  ExistingDomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^d-[a-z0-9]+$'
    Description: Optional ID of an existing SageMaker Studio domain. Leave empty to create a new domain.

  ExistingSecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional comma-delimited security group IDs associated with the existing domain.

  ExistingSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional comma-delimited subnet IDs associated with the existing domain.

Conditions:
  CreateDomain: !Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainId, '']
  UseExistingDomain: !Not [!Condition CreateDomain]
  HasExistingSecurityGroups: !And
    - !Condition UseExistingDomain
    - !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref ExistingSecurityGroupIds], '']]
  HasExistingSubnets: !And
    - !Condition UseExistingDomain
    - !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref ExistingSubnetIds], '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM execution role for the MLOps engineer persona
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MlopsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub SageMaker execution role scoped to the ${UserProfileName} MLOps engineer persona.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${UserProfileName}-execution-role
        - Key: Persona
          Value: mlops-engineer
        - Key: UserProfile
          Value: !Ref UserProfileName

  MlopsOperationsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub MLOps persona permissions for pipelines, monitoring, processing, models, and lineage (${UserProfileName}).
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: PassPerUserExecutionRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: !GetAtt MlopsExecutionRole.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: ManagePipelines
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
              - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
              - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:SendPipelineExecutionStepSuccess
              - sagemaker:SendPipelineExecutionStepFailure
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:pipeline/*
          - Sid: ReadPipelines
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
              - sagemaker:DescribePipelineDefinitionForExecution
              - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
              - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
              - sagemaker:ListPipelineParametersForExecution
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:pipeline/*
          - Sid: ListAndSearch
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListPipelines
              - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
              - sagemaker:ListMonitoringExecutions
              - sagemaker:ListDataQualityJobDefinitions
              - sagemaker:ListModelQualityJobDefinitions
              - sagemaker:ListModelBiasJobDefinitions
              - sagemaker:ListModelExplainabilityJobDefinitions
              - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
              - sagemaker:ListModels
              - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
              - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
              - sagemaker:ListExperiments
              - sagemaker:ListTrials
              - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
              - sagemaker:ListActions
              - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
              - sagemaker:ListContexts
              - sagemaker:ListAssociations
              - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
              - sagemaker:QueryLineage
              - sagemaker:Search
              - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
              - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
              - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
              - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
              - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
              - sagemaker:ListDomains
              - sagemaker:ListUserProfiles
              - sagemaker:ListApps
              - sagemaker:ListSpaces
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ManageModelMonitoring
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:CreateDataQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DescribeDataQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DeleteDataQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:CreateModelQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:CreateModelBiasJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelBiasJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelBiasJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:CreateModelExplainabilityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelExplainabilityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelExplainabilityJobDefinition
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:monitoring-schedule/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:data-quality-job-definition/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-quality-job-definition/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-bias-job-definition/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-explainability-job-definition/*
          - Sid: ManageProcessingJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:processing-job/*
          - Sid: ManageModels
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateModel
              - sagemaker:DescribeModel
              - sagemaker:DeleteModel
              - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
              - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package-group/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package/*
          - Sid: ReadExperimentsAndLineage
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:DescribeAction
              - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
              - sagemaker:DescribeContext
              - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-trial/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-trial-component/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:action/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:artifact/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:context/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:lineage-group/*

  MlopsJobsAndEndpointsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub MLOps persona permissions for training, transform, tuning, endpoints, tagging, logs, and images (${UserProfileName}).
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RunTrainingTransformTuningJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
              - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
              - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobsForHyperParameterTuningJob
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:training-job/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transform-job/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:hyper-parameter-tuning-job/*
          - Sid: ManageEndpoints
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
              - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
              - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointWeightsAndCapacities
              - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
              - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
              - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
              - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
              - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
              - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint-config/*
          - Sid: TagSageMakerResources
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:AddTags
              - sagemaker:ListTags
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:pipeline/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:monitoring-schedule/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:data-quality-job-definition/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-quality-job-definition/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-bias-job-definition/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-explainability-job-definition/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:processing-job/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package-group/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:training-job/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transform-job/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:hyper-parameter-tuning-job/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint-config/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:space/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/*
          - Sid: WriteSageMakerLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:GetLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*:log-stream:*
          - Sid: PublishSageMakerMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action: cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                cloudwatch:namespace:
                  - /aws/sagemaker/*
                  - aws/sagemaker/*
          - Sid: EcrAuthorization
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: PullContainerImages
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*
          - Sid: SageMakerDefaultBucketAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:CreateBucket
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}/*

  MlopsStudioPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub MLOps persona permissions for SageMaker Studio apps and spaces with ownership restriction (${UserProfileName}).
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadStudioResources
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
              - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
              - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
              - sagemaker:DescribeApp
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:domain/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:space/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/*
          - Sid: ManageOwnPrivateApps
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateApp
              - sagemaker:DeleteApp
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/${!sagemaker:UserProfileName}/*
          - Sid: ManageOwnSpaces
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateSpace
              - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
              - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:space/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/*
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                sagemaker:OwnerUserProfileArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/${!sagemaker:UserProfileName}
              StringEquals:
                sagemaker:SpaceSharingType:
                  - Private
                  - Shared
          - Sid: ManageAppsInOwnSpaces
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateApp
              - sagemaker:DeleteApp
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/*
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                sagemaker:OwnerUserProfileArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/${!sagemaker:UserProfileName}

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Self-contained networking (only when no existing domain is supplied)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudioVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${DomainName}-vpc

  StudioSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${DomainName}-subnet

  StudioInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${DomainName}-igw

  StudioVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref StudioInternetGateway

  StudioRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Data Master project - IAM roles stack covering the data pipeline from ingestion
  through analytics (DMS, Kinesis, EventBridge Pipes, Firehose, Lambda, Glue,
  Lake Formation, Step Functions, ECS Fargate, EMR Serverless and Amazon Managed
  Grafana). Creates IAM roles only (no KMS key, VPC, buckets, streams or other
  stateful resources). Deployment requires CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM because the DMS
  VPC role must use the fixed name dms-vpc-role. DMS also expects a
  dms-cloudwatch-logs-role (managed policy AmazonDMSCloudWatchLogsRole); it is
  intentionally omitted and should be added if DMS task logging is enabled.

Parameters:
  RawDataKmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:key/[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    Description: ARN of the existing KMS key used for raw data encryption. Leave empty to omit KMS permissions.
  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    Description: Target AWS Account ID used to scope the DMS VPC role AssumeRole statement. Defaults to the current account when empty.

Conditions:
  HasKmsKeyArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn, '']]
  HasTargetAccountId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetAccountId, '']]

Resources:
  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      Description: Data Master - DMS VPC management role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [HasTargetAccountId, !Ref TargetAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  DmsKinesisTargetRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - DMS role for writing to Kinesis Data Streams
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dms-kinesis-target
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: KinesisWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*'
              - !If
                - HasKmsKeyArn
                - Sid: RawDataKmsEncrypt
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - kms:GenerateDataKey
                    - kms:Decrypt
                  Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  PipesToFirehoseRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - EventBridge Pipes role forwarding Kinesis data to Firehose
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:pipes:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:pipe/dm-*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: pipes-to-firehose
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: KinesisSourceRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                  - kinesis:SubscribeToShard
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*'
              - Sid: FirehoseTargetWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/dm-*'
              - !If
                - HasKmsKeyArn
                - Sid: RawDataKmsDecrypt
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - kms:Decrypt
                  Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  FirehoseAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Kinesis Data Firehose delivery role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Monitors the health of the Remittance cross-region failover application
  (API Gateway, Lambda, RDS) with CloudWatch metric alarms aggregated into
  composite alarms (API Gateway Health, Lambda Health, RDS Health).

# Notes:
# - CloudWatch alarms reference metrics by namespace and dimension, not by
#   resource ARN. This template therefore deploys without the Remittance API,
#   the GetRemittances/CreateRemittance functions, or the dbcluster1-instance1
#   DB instance being present. Alarms remain INSUFFICIENT_DATA (or OK where
#   TreatMissingData is notBreaching) until those resources emit metrics.
# - Metric alarm names are prefixed with the stack name so they stay unique
#   per stack and per region, which supports deploying this template in both
#   the primary and failover regions.
# - Composite alarm names are fixed literals as requested, so they must be
#   unique per account and region. Deploy only one stack per region (one in
#   the primary region and one in the failover region).
# - No stateful resources, secrets, IAM roles, or networking resources are
#   created, so DeletionPolicy/UpdateReplacePolicy are not required.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway metric alarms
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGateway4XXAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApiGateway-4XXError'
      AlarmDescription: Remittance API average 4XX error rate is above 0 over 5 minutes.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance API
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # REVIEW: The Average of 5XXError is a 0-1 error rate, so a threshold above 1
  # can never breach. The value is kept as specified; flagged for owner review.
  ApiGateway5XXAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApiGateway-5XXError'
      AlarmDescription: Remittance API average 5XX error rate is above 1 over 1 minute.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance API
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApiGateway-Latency'
      AlarmDescription: Remittance API average latency is at or above 10000 ms over 5 minutes.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance API
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda metric alarms
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Lambda-GetRemittances-Errors'
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances function reported errors in the last minute.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: GetRemittances
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Lambda-CreateRemittance-Errors'
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance function reported errors in the last minute.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: CreateRemittance
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # A composite alarm only aggregates the alarms its AlarmRule references, so
  # the invocations alarms cannot "feed into" Lambda Health unless the rule
  # names them. Following the explicit rule specification, both invocations
  # alarms are deployed as standalone metric alarms and are excluded from the
  # Lambda Health AlarmRule.
  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Lambda-GetRemittances-Invocations'
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances function invocations exceeded 2 in the last minute.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: GetRemittances
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Lambda-CreateRemittance-Invocations'
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance function invocations exceeded 2 in the last minute.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: CreateRemittance
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Lambda-GetRemittances-Duration'
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances function average duration is at or above 10000 ms over 15 minutes.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: GetRemittances
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Lambda-CreateRemittance-Duration'
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance function average duration is at or above 10000 ms over 15 minutes.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: CreateRemittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RDS metric alarms
  # TreatMissingData is intentionally omitted so CloudWatch's default
  # (missing) applies.
  # Deadlocks and Queries are Aurora (MySQL-compatible) instance-level metrics,
  # matching the dbcluster1-instance1 naming. On a non-Aurora engine these
  # alarms stay INSUFFICIENT_DATA without failing deployment.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-CPUUtilization'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average CPU utilization is at or above 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-DatabaseConnections'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average database connections are at or above 100.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-Deadlocks'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average deadlocks are at or above 10.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-NetworkTransmitThroughput'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average network transmit throughput is at or above 10485760 bytes.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-NetworkReceiveThroughput'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average network receive throughput is at or above 10485760 bytes.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-Queries'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average queries are at or above 100.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-DiskQueueDepth'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average disk queue depth is at or above 50.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-ReadLatency'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average read latency is at or above 0.1 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-WriteLatency'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average write latency is at or above 0.1 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Composite alarms
  # Child alarms are referenced by ARN via Fn::Sub, which avoids quoting issues
  # and creates implicit dependencies (no DependsOn required).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayHealthComposite:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: Trips when any Remittance API Gateway metric alarm is in ALARM.
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'ALARM(${ApiGateway4XXAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${ApiGateway5XXAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm.Arn})'

  LambdaHealthComposite:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Trips when any GetRemittances or CreateRemittance errors or duration
        alarm is in ALARM. Invocations alarms are intentionally excluded.
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'ALARM(${GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${GetRemittancesDurationAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm.Arn})'

  RdsHealthComposite:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Health
      AlarmDescription: Trips when any dbcluster1-instance1 RDS metric alarm is in ALARM.
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'ALARM(${RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RdsDeadlocksAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RdsQueriesAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RdsReadLatencyAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RdsWriteLatencyAlarm.Arn})'

Outputs:
  ApiGatewayHealthAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiGatewayHealthComposite.Arn

  LambdaHealthAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaHealthComposite.Arn

  RdsHealthAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the RDS Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt RdsHealthComposite.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: QuickSight Admin Suite – Glue extraction jobs, CloudWatch metric streams, and Firehose delivery to S3

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key for the output bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the Admin Suite output bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPolicyDelegation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowFirehoseUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite

  AdminSuiteKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Output bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub
        - 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}-${StackSuffix}'
        - StackSuffix: !Select
            - 0
            - !Split
              - '-'
              - !Select
                - 2
                - !Split
                  - '/'
                  - !Ref AWS::StackId
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite

  AdminSuiteBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Firehose logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FirehoseLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/kinesisfirehose/admin-suite
      RetentionInDays: 30

  IngestionMetricsLogStream:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogStream
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
      LogStreamName: admin-suite-ingestion-metrics

  DashboardMetricsLogStream:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogStream
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
      LogStreamName: admin-suite-dashboard-metrics

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'admin-suite-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Shared role for QuickSight Admin Suite Glue jobs, Firehose delivery streams, and CloudWatch metric streams
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-quicksight-read
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:ListNamespaces
                  - quicksight:ListUsers
                  - quicksight:ListUserGroups
                  - quicksight:ListGroups
                  - quicksight:ListGroupMemberships
                  - quicksight:DescribeUser
                  - quicksight:DescribeGroup
                  - quicksight:ListDashboards
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboard
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboardPermissions
                  - quicksight:ListAnalyses
                  - quicksight:DescribeAnalysis
                  - quicksight:DescribeAnalysisPermissions
                  - quicksight:ListDataSets
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSetPermissions
                  - quicksight:ListIngestions
                  - quicksight:DescribeIngestion
                  - quicksight:ListDataSources
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSourcePermissions
                  - quicksight:ListFolders
                  - quicksight:ListFolderMembers
                  - quicksight:DescribeFolder
                  - quicksight:DescribeFolderPermissions
                  - quicksight:SearchFolders
                  - quicksight:ListTopics
                  - quicksight:DescribeTopic
                  - quicksight:DescribeTopicPermissions
                  - quicksight:DescribeTopicRefresh
                  - quicksight:ListThemes
                  - quicksight:DescribeTheme
                  - quicksight:DescribeThemePermissions
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-s3
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AdminSuiteBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-kms
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AdminSuiteKeyUseViaS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-glue
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AdminSuiteGlueJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:GetJobs
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetTrigger
                  - glue:GetTriggers
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/etl_job_admin_suite_*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trigger/etl_job_admin_suite_*'
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-firehose
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AdminSuiteFirehose
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/admin-suite-*'
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-cloudwatch-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetricStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetricStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:metric-stream/admin-suite-*'
              - Sid: LogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*:log-stream:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/admin-suite'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/admin-suite:log-stream:*'
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-iam
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GetOwnRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-role-${AWS::Region}'
              - Sid: PassOwnRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-role-${AWS::Region}'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - glue.amazonaws.com
                      - firehose.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite

      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: 'monitoring/cloudwatch/ingestion/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/hour=!{timestamp:HH}/'
        ErrorOutputPrefix: 'monitoring/cloudwatch/errors/ingestion/!{firehose:error-output-type}/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:

          LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
