AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained serverless CRUD API for the Kitten service (API Gateway REST API with direct DynamoDB service integrations)

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Data layer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Service
          Value: Kitten

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by API Gateway to call DynamoDB
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows API Gateway to perform CRUD operations on the Kitten DynamoDB table
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KittenTableCrudAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Service
          Value: Kitten

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # REST API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  KittenApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-kitten-api'
      Description: CRUD API for the Kitten service
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Service
          Value: Kitten

  KittenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt KittenApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: kitten

  KittenIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !Ref KittenResource
      PathPart: '{id}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Request validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  KittenModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: KittenModel
      ContentType: application/json
      Description: Request body for creating or replacing a kitten
      Schema:
        $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#'
        title: Kitten
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required:
          - name
          - color
        properties:
          name:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 256
          color:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 256

  BodyAndParamsValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: body-and-params-validator
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: true

  ParamsValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: params-validator
      ValidateRequestBody: false
      ValidateRequestParameters: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # POST /kitten
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CreateKittenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      OperationName: CreateKitten
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref BodyAndParamsValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref KittenModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "TableName": "${KittenTable}",
              "Item": {
                "KittenId": {"S": "$context.requestId"},
                "name": {"S": $input.json('$.name')},
                "color": {"S": $input.json('$.color')}
              },
              "ConditionExpression": "attribute_not_exists(KittenId)"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '201'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {"KittenId": "$context.requestId"}
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Bad request"}'
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Internal server error"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '201'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Error
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Error
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GET /kitten
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      OperationName: ListKittens
      AuthorizationType: NONE

        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/Scan'

          - StatusCode: '400'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Standard Step Functions state machine with a version and alias, invoked by API Gateway, EventBridge rules, and an EventBridge Scheduler schedule.

Resources:
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLoggingAndTracing
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # CloudWatch Logs delivery and X-Ray actions do not support resource-level permissions.
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Single pass state that returns 1
        StartAt: PassState
        States:
          PassState:
            Type: Pass
            Result: 1
            End: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ERROR
        IncludeExecutionData: false
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      TracingConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  StateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine
      Description: Initial version of the pass state machine

  StateMachineAlias:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineAlias
    Properties:
      Description: Alias pointing to the current state machine version
      RoutingConfiguration:
        - StateMachineVersionArn: !Ref StateMachineVersion
          Weight: 100

  ApiGatewayStartExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      # Name is required when no OpenAPI Body is supplied; derived from the stack name to stay unique per stack.
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-start-execution-api
      Description: REST API that starts executions of the state machine alias
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  StartExecutionResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: start

  StartExecutionGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref StartExecutionResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      # WARNING: This endpoint is public. Add AWS_IAM or COGNITO_USER_POOLS authorization if required.
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayStartExecutionRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub '{"stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineAlias}"}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
        - StatusCode: '400'
        - StatusCode: '500'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: StartExecutionGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment of the start execution API

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      TracingEnabled: true
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 50
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 25
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TerminatedRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TerminatedStateRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the state machine alias when an EC2 instance enters the terminated state
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - terminated
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TerminatedRuleRole.Arn

  ScheduledRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the state machine alias every minute (initially disabled)
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt ScheduledRuleRole.Arn

  TagEventRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TagEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the state machine alias on tag change events from the AWS Tag service
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.tag
        detail-type:
          - Tag Change on Resource
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TagEventRuleRole.Arn

  SchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  StateMachineSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the state machine alias every minute
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: ENABLED
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: 'OFF'
      Target:
        Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
        RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerRole.Arn
        RetryPolicy:
          MaximumRetryAttempts: 3
          MaximumEventAgeInSeconds: 300

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  StateMachineVersionArn:
    Description: ARN of the state machine version
    Value: !Ref StateMachineVersion
  StateMachineAliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the state machine alias
    Value: !Ref StateMachineAlias
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: GET this URL to start an execution of the state machine alias
    Value: !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ApiStage}/start
  TerminatedStateRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the terminated state EventBridge rule
    Value: !GetAtt TerminatedStateRule.Arn
  ScheduledRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the scheduled EventBridge rule
    Value: !GetAtt ScheduledRule.Arn
  TagEventRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the tag event EventBridge rule
    Value: !GetAtt TagEventRule.Arn
  ScheduleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge Scheduler schedule
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachineSchedule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CAPA (Cluster API Provider AWS) bootstrap IAM stack for EKS-based clusters.
  Creates the IAM roles, instance profiles, and customer managed policies used by
  Cluster API Provider AWS controllers, control-plane nodes, worker nodes, and the
  EKS control plane, plus a standalone read-only EKS console policy.
  Deployment requires CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM because all IAM resources use fixed CAPA names
  (for example: aws cloudformation deploy --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM).

Resources:
  AWSIAMRoleControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA control-plane role assumed by EC2 control-plane instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  AWSIAMRoleNodes:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA nodes role assumed by EC2 worker node instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  AWSIAMRoleControllers:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA controllers role assumed by EC2 instances and EKS Pod Identity.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowEKSPodIdentityAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: General-purpose VPC networking foundation with managed NAT gateways, two public and two private subnets across two Availability Zones, VPC flow logs to CloudWatch Logs, an S3 gateway endpoint, and ECR interface endpoints.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC. Four /24 subnets are derived from this range.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-4])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /24.

  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Number of days to retain VPC flow log events in CloudWatch Logs.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653

  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    Description: Type of traffic to capture in the VPC flow logs.
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 4, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 4, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 4, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 4, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key encrypting VPC flow logs for ${AWS::StackName}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs-key'

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs'

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows the VPC Flow Logs service to publish to the flow log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs-role'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 600
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlog'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Endpoints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-endpoint'

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'
      GroupDescription: Restricts interface VPC endpoint traffic to HTTPS within the VPC CIDR.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from within the VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS to within the VPC only
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecr-api-endpoint'

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecr-dkr-endpoint'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block of the VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  AvailabilityZone1:
    Description: First Availability Zone used by the subnets.
    Value: !GetAtt PublicSubnet1.AvailabilityZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZone1'

  AvailabilityZone2:
    Description: Second Availability Zone used by the subnets.
    Value: !GetAtt PublicSubnet2.AvailabilityZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZone2'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 1.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 2.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 1.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 2.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

  EndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group protecting the interface VPC endpoints.
    Value: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EndpointSecurityGroupId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions a VPC for the KerberosEMRonEKS Microsoft AD infrastructure, with public and private subnets across two AZs, NAT Gateways, KMS-encrypted VPC flow logs, and interface endpoints for SSM, SSM Messages, EC2 Messages, and Secrets Manager.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: KerberosEMRonEKS
    AllowedPattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    Description: Prefix used for resource names and tags.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.64/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet2"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.128/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.192/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet2"

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NatEIP1"

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NatEIP2"

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NatGW1"

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NatGW2"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicRT"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRT1"

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRT2"

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for encrypting ${EnvironmentName} VPC flow logs"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-FlowLogKey"

  FlowLogKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flowlogs"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKMSKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc-flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-FlowLogGroup"

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogGroup}:log-stream:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-FlowLogRole"

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VPCFlowLog"

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained, VPC-Only SageMaker Domain with one test user profile and a dedicated execution role. Creates its own VPC, private subnets, security group, VPC endpoints, KMS key, and default S3 bucket.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: vpc-only-studio-domain
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}'
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Domain.
  TestUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: test-user
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}'
    Description: Name of the test SageMaker user profile.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|20)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /20.
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC. Subnet CIDRs are derived automatically.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-vpc'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  StudioSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Studio apps, jobs, and VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Allow HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints within the VPC CIDR
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
        - Description: Allow NFS to the domain home EFS mount targets within the VPC CIDR
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 2049
          ToPort: 2049
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-studio-sg'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  StudioSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow all traffic between members of this security group (Studio apps, EFS NFS, HTTPS to endpoints)
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup

  StudioSecurityGroupSelfEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow all traffic to members of this security group (Studio app-to-app traffic)
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup

  S3InterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      DnsOptions:
        PrivateDnsOnlyForInboundResolverEndpoint: AllResolvers
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref StudioSecurityGroup

  SageMakerApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sagemaker.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref StudioSecurityGroup

  SageMakerRuntimeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sagemaker.runtime'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref StudioSecurityGroup

  StsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref StudioSecurityGroup

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref StudioSecurityGroup

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref StudioSecurityGroup

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref StudioSecurityGroup

  KmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref StudioSecurityGroup

  # SageMaker Studio UI interface endpoint. ServiceName format aws.sagemaker.<region>.studio
  # is the documented format (e.g. aws.sagemaker.us-east-1.studio).
  StudioEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'aws.sagemaker.${AWS::Region}.studio'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref StudioSecurityGroup

  DefaultBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the SageMaker domain default S3 bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPolicies
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-default-bucket-key'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  DefaultBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${DomainName}-default-bucket'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DefaultBucketKey

  DefaultBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DefaultBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-default-bucket'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  DefaultBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref DefaultBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt DefaultBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${DefaultBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /service-role/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-execution-role'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  SageMakerExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Permissions for the SageMaker Studio test user execution role
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SageMakerJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
              - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
              - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJob
              - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJobV2
              - sagemaker:StopAutoMLJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJobV2
              - sagemaker:ListCandidatesForAutoMLJob
              - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobsForHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:AddTags
              - sagemaker:ListTags
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: SageMakerExperimentsLineage
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
              - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
              - sagemaker:UpdateExperiment
              - sagemaker:DeleteExperiment
              - sagemaker:CreateTrial
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
              - sagemaker:UpdateTrial
              - sagemaker:DeleteTrial
              - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:UpdateTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:DeleteTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:AssociateTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:DisassociateTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:BatchPutMetrics
              - sagemaker:CreateArtifact
              - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
              - sagemaker:UpdateArtifact
              - sagemaker:DeleteArtifact
              - sagemaker:CreateAction
              - sagemaker:DescribeAction
              - sagemaker:UpdateAction
              - sagemaker:DeleteAction
              - sagemaker:CreateContext
              - sagemaker:DescribeContext
              - sagemaker:UpdateContext
              - sagemaker:DeleteContext
              - sagemaker:AddAssociation
              - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: SageMakerModels
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateModel
              - sagemaker:DescribeModel
              - sagemaker:DeleteModel
              - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
              - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
              - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:GetModelPackageGroupPolicy
              - sagemaker:PutModelPackageGroupPolicy
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroupPolicy
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: SageMakerStudio
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateApp
              - sagemaker:DeleteApp
              - sagemaker:DescribeApp
              - sagemaker:CreateSpace
              - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
              - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
              - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
              - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
              - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
              - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: SageMakerListAndSearch
            Effect: Allow
            Action:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions saved CloudWatch Logs Insights queries for Claude Code usage,
  performance, and cost analysis. Queries are grouped into real-time monitoring,
  user and session analytics, cost attribution, and debugging and analysis folders.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CloudWatch Logs log group name.
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives Claude Code OpenTelemetry metrics.

Resources:
  ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 365

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1 - Real-time monitoring
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TokenAndRequestRatePerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/1-RealTime/TokenAndRequestRatePerUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Per-user tokens per minute and request count per minute
        # Requests are approximated by the number of input-token datapoints
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields `user.id` as userId, `claude_code.token.usage` as tokens, strcontains(coalesce(`type`, ""), "input") as isInput
        | stats sum(tokens) as tokensPerMinute, sum(isInput) as requestsPerMinute, count(*) as datapoints by userId, bin(1m) as minute
        | sort minute desc, tokensPerMinute desc

  CurrentTPMandRPMAveragesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/1-RealTime/CurrentTPMandRPMAverages
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Average tokens per minute (TPM) and requests per minute (RPM)
        # Run with a short time range, e.g. the last 15 minutes
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields `claude_code.token.usage` as tokens, strcontains(coalesce(`type`, ""), "input") as isInput
        | stats sum(tokens) as tpm, sum(isInput) as rpm by bin(1m) as minute
        | stats avg(tpm) as avgTPM, max(tpm) as peakTPM, avg(rpm) as avgRPM, max(rpm) as peakRPM, count(*) as minutesObserved

  RateLimitRiskQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/1-RealTime/RateLimitRisk
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Flags user-minutes approaching rate limits
        # Placeholder limits: TPM_LIMIT = 400000, RPM_LIMIT = 4000
        # Edit the constants below to match your organization's actual limits
        # A bin is flagged when TPM or RPM exceeds 80% of its limit
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields `user.id` as userId, `claude_code.token.usage` as tokens, strcontains(coalesce(`type`, ""), "input") as isInput
        | stats sum(tokens) as tpm, sum(isInput) as rpm by userId, bin(1m) as minute
        | fields tpm / 400000 * 100 as tpmPctOfLimit, rpm / 4000 * 100 as rpmPctOfLimit
        | filter tpm > 320000 or rpm > 3200
        | sort tpm desc

  ActiveUsersNowQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/1-RealTime/ActiveUsersNow
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Concurrent users and sessions per 5-minute window
        filter ispresent(`user.id`)
        | stats count_distinct(`user.id`) as activeUsers, count_distinct(`session.id`) as activeSessions by bin(5m) as period
        | sort period desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2 - User and session analytics
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SessionLevelUsageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/2-UserSession/SessionLevelUsage
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Token, cost, and request totals per session
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`) or ispresent(`claude_code.cost.usage`)
        | fields `session.id` as sessionId, `user.id` as userId, coalesce(`type`, "") as tokenType,
            coalesce(`claude_code.token.usage`, 0) as tokens, coalesce(`claude_code.cost.usage`, 0) as cost
        | fields strcontains(tokenType, "input") * tokens as inputTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "output") * tokens as outputTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "cacheRead") * tokens as cacheReadTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "cacheCreation") * tokens as cacheCreationTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "input") as isInput
        | stats sum(inputTokens) as totalInput, sum(outputTokens) as totalOutput, sum(cacheReadTokens) as totalCacheRead,
            sum(cacheCreationTokens) as totalCacheCreation, sum(tokens) as totalTokens, sum(cost) as totalCostUSD,
            sum(isInput) as requests, min(@timestamp) as sessionStart, max(@timestamp) as sessionEnd
            by sessionId, userId
        | sort totalTokens desc

  HourlyActivityTimelineQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/2-UserSession/HourlyActivityTimeline
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Tokens, requests, and distinct users per hour
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields `claude_code.token.usage` as tokens, strcontains(coalesce(`type`, ""), "input") as isInput
        | stats sum(tokens) as totalTokens, sum(isInput) as requests, count_distinct(`user.id`) as distinctUsers by bin(1h) as hour
        | sort hour asc

  ErrorAndThrottlingDetectionQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/2-UserSession/ErrorAndThrottlingDetection
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Errors, throttling, and rate-limit signals grouped by user, model, and 5-minute window
        filter @message like /(?i)(error|throttl|429|rate.?limit|overloaded)/
            or `status` like /(?i)(error|throttl|429|rate.?limit|overloaded)/
            or `error` like /(?i)(error|throttl|429|rate.?limit|overloaded)/
        | fields `user.id` as userId, `model` as modelName
        | stats count(*) as errorCount by userId, modelName, bin(5m) as period
        | sort period desc, errorCount desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3 - Cost and attribution
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CostByUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/3-CostAttribution/CostByUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Total cost (USD) and tokens per user
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.cost.usage`) or ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields `user.id` as userId, coalesce(`claude_code.cost.usage`, 0) as cost, coalesce(`claude_code.token.usage`, 0) as tokens
        | stats sum(cost) as totalCostUSD, sum(tokens) as totalTokens by userId
        | sort totalCostUSD desc

  CostByModelQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/3-CostAttribution/CostByModel
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Cost, token totals split by token type, and request count per model
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.cost.usage`) or ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields `model` as modelName, coalesce(`type`, "") as tokenType,
            coalesce(`claude_code.token.usage`, 0) as tokens, coalesce(`claude_code.cost.usage`, 0) as cost
        | fields strcontains(tokenType, "input") * tokens as inputTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "output") * tokens as outputTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "cacheRead") * tokens as cacheReadTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "cacheCreation") * tokens as cacheCreationTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "input") as isInput
        | stats sum(cost) as totalCostUSD, sum(inputTokens) as totalInput, sum(outputTokens) as totalOutput,
            sum(cacheReadTokens) as totalCacheRead, sum(cacheCreationTokens) as totalCacheCreation,
            sum(isInput) as requests by modelName
        | sort totalCostUSD desc

  CostByOrganizationQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/3-CostAttribution/CostByOrganization
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Finance chargeback: cost, distinct users, and tokens per organization
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.cost.usage`) or ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields `organization.id` as orgId, coalesce(`claude_code.cost.usage`, 0) as cost, coalesce(`claude_code.token.usage`, 0) as tokens
        | stats sum(cost) as totalCostUSD, count_distinct(`user.id`) as distinctUsers, sum(tokens) as totalTokens by orgId
        | sort totalCostUSD desc

  DailyCostTrendQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/3-CostAttribution/DailyCostTrend
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Daily spend per model for trend review
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.cost.usage`)
        | fields `model` as modelName, `claude_code.cost.usage` as cost
        | stats sum(cost) as dailyCostUSD by bin(1d) as day, modelName
        | sort day asc, dailyCostUSD desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4 - Debugging and analysis
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ModelEfficiencyQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/4-DebugAnalysis/ModelEfficiency
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Output/input ratio, average tokens per request, and cost per 1K tokens per model
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.cost.usage`) or ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields `model` as modelName, coalesce(`type`, "") as tokenType,
            coalesce(`claude_code.token.usage`, 0) as tokens, coalesce(`claude_code.cost.usage`, 0) as cost
        | fields strcontains(tokenType, "input") * tokens as inputTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "output") * tokens as outputTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "input") as isInput
        | stats sum(inputTokens) as totalInput, sum(outputTokens) as totalOutput, sum(tokens) as totalTokens,
            sum(cost) as totalCostUSD, sum(isInput) as requests by modelName
        | fields totalOutput / totalInput as outputToInputRatio,
            totalTokens / requests as avgTokensPerRequest,
            totalCostUSD / totalTokens * 1000 as costPer1KTokensUSD
        | sort costPer1KTokensUSD desc

  CacheHitMissOverallQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/4-DebugAnalysis/CacheHitMissOverall
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Overall prompt cache hit rate
        # hitRatePct = cacheRead / (cacheRead + cacheCreation + input) * 100
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields coalesce(`type`, "") as tokenType, `claude_code.token.usage` as tokens
        | fields strcontains(tokenType, "cacheRead") * tokens as cacheReadTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "cacheCreation") * tokens as cacheCreationTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "input") * tokens as inputTokens
        | stats sum(cacheReadTokens) as cacheRead, sum(cacheCreationTokens) as cacheCreation, sum(inputTokens) as uncachedInput
        | fields cacheRead / (cacheRead + cacheCreation + uncachedInput) * 100 as hitRatePct

  CacheHitRateOverTimeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/4-DebugAnalysis/CacheHitRateOverTime
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Hourly prompt cache hit rate
        # hitRatePct = cacheRead / (cacheRead + cacheCreation + input) * 100
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields coalesce(`type`, "") as tokenType, `claude_code.token.usage` as tokens
        | fields strcontains(tokenType, "cacheRead") * tokens as cacheReadTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "cacheCreation") * tokens as cacheCreationTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "input") * tokens as inputTokens
        | stats sum(cacheReadTokens) as cacheRead, sum(cacheCreationTokens) as cacheCreation, sum(inputTokens) as uncachedInput by bin(1h) as hour
        | fields cacheRead / (cacheRead + cacheCreation + uncachedInput) * 100 as hitRatePct
        | sort hour asc

  CacheHitRateBySessionQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/4-DebugAnalysis/CacheHitRateBySession
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Prompt cache hit rate per session, lowest first to surface inefficient sessions
        # hitRatePct = cacheRead / (cacheRead + cacheCreation + input) * 100
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields `session.id` as sessionId, coalesce(`type`, "") as tokenType, `claude_code.token.usage` as tokens
        | fields strcontains(tokenType, "cacheRead") * tokens as cacheReadTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "cacheCreation") * tokens as cacheCreationTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "input") * tokens as inputTokens
        | stats sum(cacheReadTokens) as cacheRead, sum(cacheCreationTokens) as cacheCreation, sum(inputTokens) as uncachedInput by sessionId
        | fields cacheRead / (cacheRead + cacheCreation + uncachedInput) * 100 as hitRatePct
        | sort hitRatePct asc

  PeakUsageWindowsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/4-DebugAnalysis/PeakUsageWindows
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Top 20 busiest 15-minute windows by token volume
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields `claude_code.token.usage` as tokens, strcontains(coalesce(`type`, ""), "input") as isInput
        | stats sum(tokens) as totalTokens, sum(isInput) as requests by bin(15m) as window
        | sort totalTokens desc
        | limit 20

  SessionDeepDiveQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/4-DebugAnalysis/SessionDeepDive
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Replace REPLACE_WITH_SESSION_ID with the session.id to investigate before running
        filter `session.id` = "REPLACE_WITH_SESSION_ID"
        | fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, `user.id`, `model`, `type`, `claude_code.token.usage`, `claude_code.cost.usage`
        | sort @timestamp asc

  FieldExplorerQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/4-DebugAnalysis/FieldExplorer
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Inspect raw records to discover available metric attributes
        # Expand a result row to list all discovered fields
        # To profile a field, replace the lines below with: stats count(*) by <field>
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 50

  DailyUsageSummaryQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/4-DebugAnalysis/DailyUsageSummary
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Daily summary of users, sessions, requests, tokens by type, and cost
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`) or ispresent(`claude_code.cost.usage`)
        | fields coalesce(`type`, "") as tokenType, coalesce(`claude_code.token.usage`, 0) as tokens, coalesce(`claude_code.cost.usage`, 0) as cost
        | fields strcontains(tokenType, "input") * tokens as inputTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "output") * tokens as outputTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "cacheRead") * tokens as cacheReadTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "cacheCreation") * tokens as cacheCreationTokens,
            strcontains(tokenType, "input") as isInput
        | stats count_distinct(`user.id`) as distinctUsers, count_distinct(`session.id`) as distinctSessions,
            sum(isInput) as requests, sum(inputTokens) as totalInput, sum(outputTokens) as totalOutput,
            sum(cacheReadTokens) as totalCacheRead, sum(cacheCreationTokens) as totalCacheCreation,
            sum(tokens) as totalTokens, sum(cost) as totalCostUSD by bin(1d) as day
        | sort day asc
