AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AppSync GraphQL API "SuperCoolAPI" with AWS IAM authentication and full CloudWatch Logs
  request logging, backed by the DynamoDB table "Table1" (on-demand). The template defines
  multiple DynamoDB data sources that reference the table and region in different ways,
  scoped IAM roles and policies, and a Todo schema with resolvers.

Resources:
  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Table1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  AppSyncCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows AppSync to push request logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs

  SuperCoolAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL
        ExcludeVerboseContent: false

  SuperCoolAPILogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/appsync/apis/${SuperCoolAPI.ApiId}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows AppSync data sources to read and write Table1.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBTable1ReadWrite
      Roles:
        - !Ref AppSyncDynamoDBRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Table1ReadWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
              - !Sub '${Table1.Arn}/index/*'

  # Data source 1: table referenced via !Ref, region via the AWS::Region pseudo parameter.
  DynamoDBDataSourceRef:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    DependsOn: AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSourceRef
      Description: Table referenced with Ref, region with the AWS::Region pseudo parameter.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  # Data source 2: table referenced by its literal name, region via Fn::Sub.
  DynamoDBDataSourceLiteral:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    DependsOn:
      - AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy
      - Table1
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSourceLiteral
      Description: Table referenced by literal name, region with Fn::Sub.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: Table1
        AwsRegion: !Sub '${AWS::Region}'

  # Data source 3: table name and region parsed out of the table ARN.
  DynamoDBDataSourceArnParsed:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    DependsOn: AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSourceArnParsed
      Description: Table name and region parsed from the table ARN.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Select [1, !Split ['/', !GetAtt Table1.Arn]]
        AwsRegion: !Select [3, !Split [':', !GetAtt Table1.Arn]]

  SuperCoolAPISchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          description: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

        type Mutation {
          addTodo(id: ID!, description: String): Todo
        }

  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SuperCoolAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSourceRef.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "GetItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  AddTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SuperCoolAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addTodo
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSourceRef.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          },
          "attributeValues": $util.dynamodb.toMapValuesJson($util.map.copyAndRemoveAllKeys($ctx.args, ["id"]))
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

    Description: ID of the SuperCoolAPI AppSync API.
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the SuperCoolAPI AppSync API.
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.Arn
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: GraphQL endpoint URL of SuperCoolAPI.
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group for SuperCoolAPI request logs.
    Value: !Ref SuperCoolAPILogGroup
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref Table1
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt Table1.Arn
  DynamoDBRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role that AppSync data sources assume to access DynamoDB.
    Value: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) IAM bootstrap stack for Amazon EKS with managed
  node groups and Fargate support. Creates the CAPA control plane, controllers and
  nodes roles and instance profiles, the EKS control plane, EKS Fargate and EKS
  managed node group service roles, and the CAPA customer managed policies. This
  stack must be deployed with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM because roles, instance profiles
  and managed policies use explicit CAPA names.

Resources:
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA role for Kubernetes control plane EC2 instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA role for the Cluster API AWS controllers
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA role for Kubernetes worker node EC2 instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-controlplane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA service role for the Amazon EKS control plane
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-fargate.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA pod execution role for Amazon EKS Fargate profiles
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:*:${AWS::AccountId}:fargateprofile/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-nodegroup.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA role for Amazon EKS managed node group instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'

  ControlPlanePolicy:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared VPC for EMR on EKS and Celeborn shuffle service

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: emr-eks-celeborn
    Description: Environment name used in Name tags
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,64}$'
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in the first Availability Zone
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.16.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in the second Availability Zone
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.32.0/19
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in the first Availability Zone
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.64.0/19
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in the second Availability Zone
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways (one per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1Eip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2Eip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1Eip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2Eip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-2'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private routing (one route table per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Gateway Endpoint
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Interface Endpoints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from within the VPC to interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from VPC CIDR
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Restrict egress to HTTPS within the VPC CIDR
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg'

  # NOTE: Full SSM Session Manager and SSM Agent functionality commonly also
  # requires the ssmmessages and ec2messages interface endpoints. They are not
  # included because the request lists only "Systems Manager"; add them if needed.
  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ssm'

  Ec2Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ec2'

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-logs'

  MonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-monitoring'

  StsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sts'

  # EMR service endpoint. EMR on EKS control-plane calls use the separate
  # emr-containers service; add that endpoint if it is required.
  EmrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.elasticmapreduce'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-emr'

  KmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-kms'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs (KMS encrypted CloudWatch Logs)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch Logs encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-kms'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs'

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to deliver logs to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-role'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the shared VPC
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  VpcCidr:

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group protecting the interface VPC endpoints
    Value: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcEndpointSecurityGroupId'
  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key encrypting VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsKmsKeyArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Dual-stack (IPv4 + IPv6) VPC spanning three Availability Zones with always-on private subnets and optional public subnets with Internet Gateway access.

Parameters:
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Default: dual-stack-vpc
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-64 characters of letters, numbers, or hyphens.
    Description: Identifier used in Name tags for all resources in this VPC.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-4])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /24.
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC (prefix length /16 to /24).

  CreatePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create public subnets, an Internet Gateway, and a public route table.

Conditions:
  HasPublicSubnets: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnets, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-vpc'

  VPCIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # Public tier

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, 4]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-az1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, 4]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-az2'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, 4]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-az3'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicDefaultRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private tier

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, 4]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-az1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, 4]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-az2'

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM bootstrap stack for Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA).
  Creates IAM roles, instance profiles, managed policies, a bootstrapper group,
  and a bootstrapper user with explicit names. This stack must be deployed with
  the CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM capability. Controller permissions span two managed
  policies (controllers and controllers-eks) with identical role and group
  attachments. No access keys are created for the bootstrapper user;
  credentials must be issued out of band.

Resources:
  AWSIAMRoleControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Role assumed by CAPA Kubernetes control plane EC2 instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: control-plane
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AWSIAMRoleControllers:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Role assumed by the CAPA controller manager via EC2 or EKS Pod Identity
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
      Tags:
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: controllers
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AWSIAMRoleNodes:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Role assumed by CAPA Kubernetes worker node EC2 instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
      Tags:
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: nodes
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AWSIAMRoleEKSControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-controlplane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Role assumed by the Amazon EKS service for CAPA-managed EKS control planes
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: eks-controlplane
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AWSIAMInstanceProfileControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControlPlane

  AWSIAMInstanceProfileControllers:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControllers

  AWSIAMInstanceProfileNodes:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleNodes

    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy

      ManagedPolicyName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io

        Statement:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  VPC foundation for OpenSearch cross-region resilience. Region-agnostic template
  that deploys unchanged in either the primary or secondary region. Creates a VPC
  with three public and three private subnets across separate Availability Zones,
  an Internet Gateway, configurable NAT Gateway topology (single or per-AZ), and
  VPC Flow Logs delivered to CloudWatch Logs with 7-day retention.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    Description: Environment name used in resource Name tags and naming.

  NatGatewayMode:
    Type: String
    Default: single
    AllowedValues:
      - single
      - per-az
    Description: >-
      "single" creates one NAT Gateway shared by all private subnets (lower cost).
      "per-az" creates one NAT Gateway per Availability Zone (high availability).

Conditions:
  CreatePerAzNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayMode, 'per-az']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.101.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.102.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.103.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways and Elastic IPs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-eip-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway3EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Routing (one route table per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If
        - CreatePerAzNat
        - !Ref NatGateway2
        - !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-private-rt-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If
        - CreatePerAzNat
        - !Ref NatGateway3
        - !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${EnvironmentName} VPC Flow Logs encryption in ${AWS::Region}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::Region}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-flowlogs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-flowlogs-${AWS::Region}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::Region}'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-flowlogs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Allows VPC Flow Logs to publish to CloudWatch Logs for ${EnvironmentName} in ${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-flowlogs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-vpc-flowlog'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the OpenSearch VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the OpenSearch VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PublicSubnet3Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 3
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet3Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet3Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 3
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet3Id'

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs (for OpenSearch VPC domains)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds'

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds'

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the Internet Gateway
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InternetGatewayId'

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: ID of NAT Gateway 1
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1Id'

  NatGateway2Id:
    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    Description: ID of NAT Gateway 2 (per-az mode only)
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2Id'

  NatGateway3Id:
    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    Description: ID of NAT Gateway 3 (per-az mode only)
    Value: !Ref NatGateway3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway3Id'

  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs group receiving VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogGroupName'

  Region:
    Description: Region in which this stack is deployed
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Region'

  EnvironmentName:
    Description: Environment name for this deployment
    Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EnvironmentName'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Isolated private VPC for an AI-powered customer support application. No internet
  path (no IGW, NAT, EIGW, EIP, public subnets or 0.0.0.0/0 routes). Three private
  subnets across three AZs, gateway endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB, interface endpoints
  for Bedrock Runtime, ECR, CloudWatch Logs/Monitoring, RDS Data API, Secrets Manager,
  SSM, KMS and X-Ray, and VPC Flow Logs encrypted with a rotating customer-managed KMS
  key. Assumption: direct DynamoDB access (via the gateway endpoint prefix list) is
  granted only to Agent Runtime (session/conversation state) and Lambda functions (data
  access); MCP Runtime is restricted to HTTPS egress to the interface endpoints only.

Metadata:
  Assumptions:
    DynamoDbDirectAccess: >-
      The request does not name which components need direct DynamoDB access. It is
      granted to Agent Runtime (session/conversation state) and Lambda functions (data
      access). MCP Runtime has endpoint-only HTTPS egress.
    OmittedEndpoints: >-
      The bedrock-agentcore interface endpoint is not created because its service name
      and regional availability are unverified here; add it if managed AgentCore Agent
      or MCP Runtimes are used. The sts, ssmmessages and ec2messages endpoints are not
      created because they were not requested; they may be needed for regional STS role
      assumption or for Session Manager access.
    NetworkAcls: >-
      The default Network ACL is intentionally retained. S3 and DynamoDB gateway
      endpoint traffic targets public AWS service IP ranges that a restrictive NACL
      would have to allow. Isolation is enforced by the absence of internet routes and
      by least-privilege security groups.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: ai-support
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (2-31 characters).
    Description: Project name used in resource names and tags.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.16.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.32.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  # Route tables contain only the implicit local route (plus gateway endpoint
  # prefix-list routes added automatically). No route to 0.0.0.0/0 exists.
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-rt-3'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key for log encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${ProjectName} VPC flow logs and supporting log groups'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn':
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/${ProjectName}-flowlogs'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-prefix-list-resolver'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flowlogs-key'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/${ProjectName}-flowlogs'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flowlogs'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Allows VPC Flow Logs to deliver ${ProjectName} flow logs to CloudWatch Logs'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flowlogs-role'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-flowlog'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Interface VPC endpoints - HTTPS ingress from application components only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Placeholder rule to suppress default allow-all egress
          IpProtocol: icmp
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          CidrIp: 127.0.0.1/32
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Agent Runtime - HTTPS egress to VPC endpoints and DynamoDB only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Placeholder rule to suppress default allow-all egress
          IpProtocol: icmp
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          CidrIp: 127.0.0.1/32
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agent-runtime-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  McpRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: MCP Runtime - HTTPS egress to VPC endpoints only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Placeholder rule to suppress default allow-all egress
          IpProtocol: icmp
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          CidrIp: 127.0.0.1/32
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-runtime-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Lambda functions - HTTPS egress to VPC endpoints and DynamoDB only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Placeholder rule to suppress default allow-all egress
          IpProtocol: icmp
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          CidrIp: 127.0.0.1/32
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lambda-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  # Endpoint SG ingress (standalone to avoid circular references)
  EndpointIngressFromAgentRuntime:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: HTTPS from Agent Runtime
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup.GroupId

  EndpointIngressFromMcpRuntime:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: HTTPS from MCP Runtime
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt McpRuntimeSecurityGroup.GroupId

  EndpointIngressFromLambda:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: HTTPS from Lambda functions
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt LambdaSecurityGroup.GroupId

  # Component SG egress to interface endpoints
  AgentRuntimeEgressToEndpoints:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId

  McpRuntimeEgressToEndpoints:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt McpRuntimeSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId

  LambdaEgressToEndpoints:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt LambdaSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId

  # Direct DynamoDB access (via gateway endpoint) for Agent Runtime and Lambda only
  AgentRuntimeEgressToDynamoDb:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: HTTPS to DynamoDB via gateway endpoint
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt DynamoDbPrefixList.PrefixListId

  LambdaEgressToDynamoDb:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt LambdaSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: HTTPS to DynamoDB via gateway endpoint
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt DynamoDbPrefixList.PrefixListId

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom resource: resolve regional DynamoDB managed prefix list ID
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrefixListResolverLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-prefix-list-resolver'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-prefix-list-resolver-logs'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  PrefixListResolverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for the ${ProjectName} DynamoDB prefix list resolver'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PrefixListResolver
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists does not support resource-level permissions
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt PrefixListResolverLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-prefix-list-resolver-role'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  # Runs outside the VPC: it only calls the regional EC2 API during stack operations,
  # and the isolated VPC has no EC2 API endpoint.
  PrefixListResolverFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-prefix-list-resolver'
      Description: Resolves the regional DynamoDB managed prefix list ID for CloudFormation
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PrefixListResolverRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref PrefixListResolverLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse


          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  name = event['ResourceProperties']['PrefixListName']
                  ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                  resp = ec2.describe_managed_prefix_lists(
                      Filters=[{'Name': 'prefix-list-name', 'Values': [name]}]
                  )
                  lists = resp.get('PrefixLists', [])
                  if not lists:
                      raise ValueError(f'Managed prefix list {name} not found')
                  prefix_list_id = lists[0]['PrefixListId']
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                      {'PrefixListId': prefix_list_id}, prefix_list_id
                  )
              except Exception as exc:
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      {}, physical_id, reason=str(exc)
                  )
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-prefix-list-resolver'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Isolation
          Value: private

  DynamoDbPrefixList:
    Type: Custom::DynamoDbPrefixList
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt PrefixListResolverFunction.Arn
      PrefixListName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway VPC endpoints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSameAccountPrincipals
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:PrincipalAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowEcrImageLayerDownloads
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::prod-${AWS::Region}-starport-layer-bucket/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:PrincipalAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-s3-gateway-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
