AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a three-AZ VPC for an Amazon EKS cluster, with three public and three
  private subnets, an Internet Gateway, per-AZ NAT Gateways with Elastic IPs,
  per-AZ private route tables, and security groups for the EKS control plane and
  application ingress traffic.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-vpc
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    Description: Name prefix used to tag all resources created by this stack.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.

  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the third Availability Zone.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.64.0/19
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.96.0/19
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.

  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.128.0/19
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the third Availability Zone.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Network CIDR Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PublicSubnet3Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet3Cidr

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Subnets
  #
  # Public IPs are intentionally NOT auto-assigned in these subnets. They remain
  # "public" via their association with PublicRouteTable (0.0.0.0/0 -> IGW).
  # - NAT Gateways use their own dedicated Elastic IPs.
  # - Internet-facing load balancers receive their own public IPs.
  # - EKS worker nodes belong in the private subnets and egress via NAT.
  # If an EKS managed node group is ever placed in these public subnets, assign
  # public IPs through the node group's launch template (network interface
  # AssociatePublicIpAddress), not through the subnet attribute.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways and Elastic IPs (one per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway3EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-3'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-2'

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway3EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-3'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Routing (one route table per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'

  DefaultPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'

  DefaultPrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-3'

  DefaultPrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security Groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: EKS control plane communication with worker nodes
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow worker nodes and pods within the VPC to reach the Kubernetes API server
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow control plane to reach extension API servers on worker nodes
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 1025
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow control plane to communicate with kubelets and pods on worker nodes
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-control-plane-sg'

  # SECURITY NOTE: Exposing non-HTTP(S) ports (8080, 8443, 15021, 15443) to
  # 0.0.0.0/0 is a deliberate requirement of this request to support an ingress
  # or service mesh gateway. In production, narrow the source CIDR to known
  # client ranges, or front these ports with a load balancer (e.g. an NLB/ALB)
  # and restrict this security group to traffic originating from it.
  ApplicationSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Application ingress ports exposed to the internet for ingress and service mesh gateways
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP from the internet
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTPS from the internet
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8080
          ToPort: 8080
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Alternate HTTP port for ingress gateway
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8443
          ToPort: 8443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Alternate HTTPS port for ingress gateway
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 15021
          ToPort: 15021
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Service mesh gateway health check port
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 15443
          ToPort: 15443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Service mesh gateway mTLS passthrough port
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-application-sg'

Outputs:

    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  ControlPlaneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group for EKS control plane to worker node communication
    Value: !Ref ControlPlaneSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ControlPlaneSecurityGroupId'

  ApplicationSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group exposing application ports to the internet

    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApplicationSecurityGroupId'

  SubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of all public and private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PublicSubnet1

        - !Ref PublicSubnet3
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SubnetIds'

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
        - !Ref PublicSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds'

  PrivateSubnetIds:

      - ','
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the SageMaker HyperPod (EKS-orchestrated) execution role plus the
  networking (VPC, private subnets, security group) and KMS-encrypted S3
  (lifecycle scripts, optional RIG input/output) prerequisites it depends on,
  all inside a greenfield account.

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hyperpod
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,55}$'
    Description: >-
      Prefix for resource names. Max 56 characters so that "<prefix>ExecRole"
      stays within the 64-character IAM role name limit.

  # This is the one intentional forward reference: the EKS cluster is created
  # later or separately. IAM accepts a policy resource ARN for a cluster that
  # does not exist yet, so deployment does not fail.
  EksClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: hyperpod-eks-cluster
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-_]{0,99}$'
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster used to scope eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity.

  CreateRigResources:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the RIG input bucket and RIG policy.

  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether to grant gated-access S3 access point and SQS permissions in the RIG policy.

  CreateSeparateRigOutputBucket:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a separate RIG output bucket (requires CreateRigResources=true).

Conditions:
  CreateRig: !Equals [!Ref CreateRigResources, 'true']
  CreateRigGatedAccess: !And
    - !Condition CreateRig
    - !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, 'true']
  CreateRigOutputBucket: !And
    - !Condition CreateRig
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateSeparateRigOutputBucket, 'true']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HyperPodVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-vpc'

  # Fn::GetAZs with an empty string resolves to the stack's current region.
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HyperPodVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HyperPodVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  HyperPodSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HyperPodVpc
      GroupDescription: SageMaker HyperPod EKS node security group
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  # Self-referencing rules are defined as separate resources to avoid a
  # circular dependency. All intra-cluster traffic is required by EFA/NCCL.
  HyperPodSgSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt HyperPodSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt HyperPodSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: Allow all intra-cluster traffic (EFA/NCCL)

  # The default 0.0.0.0/0 egress rule is retained for outbound reachability.
  HyperPodSgSelfEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt HyperPodSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt HyperPodSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: Allow all intra-cluster traffic (EFA/NCCL)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS customer managed key for S3 encryption.
  # Deviation: a CMK replaces SSE-S3 to satisfy Trivy AWS-0132, and
  # AWS::KMS::Key is added to the permitted resource types. The key is
  # retained because the buckets are retained and their contents would
  # otherwise become unrecoverable.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for SageMaker HyperPod prerequisite S3 buckets
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      # Root delegation prevents key lockout and lets IAM policies grant key
      # usage. ExecutionRole is not referenced here to avoid a circular dependency.
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 buckets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LifecycleScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain

        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  LifecycleScriptsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LifecycleScriptsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LifecycleScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${LifecycleScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  RigInputBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: CreateRig
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt S3EncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  RigInputBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: CreateRig
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref RigInputBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt RigInputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${RigInputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  RigOutputBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: CreateRigOutputBucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt S3EncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  RigOutputBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: CreateRigOutputBucket
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref RigOutputBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt RigOutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${RigOutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM execution role
  # Deployment requires CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM because the role is explicitly named.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-EksCniPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # Describe actions do not support resource-level permissions.
              - Sid: EksCniDescribeAndAttach
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EksCniCreateTags
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-ExecRolePolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EniManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${HyperPodVpc}'
              - Sid: NetworkRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              # ecr:GetAuthorizationToken does not support resource scoping.
              - Sid: EcrAuthorization
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrPull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchDescribeAlarms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EksPodIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EksClusterName}'
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt LifecycleScriptsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsGet
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${LifecycleScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
              # Covers lifecycle-script and RIG input reads; all buckets share the key.
              - Sid: S3EncryptionKeyDecrypt
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt S3EncryptionKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Per-subnet and per-security-group ENI policies.
  # AWS::IAM::Policy has no Tags property, so these policies cannot be tagged.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SubnetEniPolicy1:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-Subnet1EniPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Subnet1EniManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${PrivateSubnet1}'

  SubnetEniPolicy2:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-Subnet2EniPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Subnet2EniManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${PrivateSubnet2}'

  SecurityGroupEniPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-SgEniPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SecurityGroupEniManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/${HyperPodSecurityGroup.GroupId}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RIG policy (conditional). Not taggable (AWS::IAM::Policy has no Tags).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RigPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateRig
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-RigPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RigInputList
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt RigInputBucket.Arn
          - Sid: RigInputGet
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${RigInputBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Sid: RigInvokeSageMakerLambda
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*SageMaker*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*sagemaker*'
          - !If
            - CreateRigGatedAccess
            - Sid: RigGatedS3Get
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*sagemaker*/object/*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*SageMaker*/object/*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*sagemaker*/*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*SageMaker*/*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - CreateRigGatedAccess
            - Sid: RigGatedSqs
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - sqs:SendMessage
                - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                - sqs:DeleteMessage
                - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*sagemaker*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*SageMaker*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - CreateRigOutputBucket
            - Sid: RigOutputList
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:ListBucket
              Resource: !GetAtt RigOutputBucket.Arn
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - CreateRigOutputBucket
            - Sid: RigOutputReadWriteDelete
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
                - s3:DeleteObject
              Resource: !Sub '${RigOutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          # s3:PutObject to an SSE-KMS bucket requires kms:GenerateDataKey.
          - !If
            - CreateRigOutputBucket
            - Sid: RigOutputKmsEncrypt
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - kms:GenerateDataKey
                - kms:Decrypt
              Resource: !GetAtt S3EncryptionKey.Arn
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

Outputs:
  ExecutionRoleName:
    Description: Name of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role
    Value: !Ref ExecutionRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ExecutionRoleName'

  ExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role
    Value: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ExecutionRoleArn'

  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the HyperPod VPC
    Value: !Ref HyperPodVpc

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated IDs of the HyperPod private subnets
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the HyperPod node security group
    Value: !GetAtt HyperPodSecurityGroup.GroupId

  LifecycleScriptsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the lifecycle scripts S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref LifecycleScriptsBucket

  S3EncryptionKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS customer managed key used to encrypt the S3 buckets
    Value: !GetAtt S3EncryptionKey.Arn

  RigInputBucketName:
    Condition: CreateRig
    Description: Name of the RIG input S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref RigInputBucket

  RigOutputBucketName:
    Condition: CreateRigOutputBucket
    Description: Name of the RIG output S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref RigOutputBucket

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained private-subnet tier with per-AZ NAT egress and an S3 gateway endpoint. Creates a VPC, Internet Gateway, three public subnets hosting per-AZ NAT gateways, three private subnets (10.24.24.0/24, 10.24.25.0/24, 10.24.26.0/24) with dedicated route tables, a shared private network ACL, and an S3 gateway VPC endpoint attached to all private route tables.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.24.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetCRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIPA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatEIPB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatEIPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGatewayC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPC.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.24.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.25.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.26.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

    Type: AWS::EC2::Route

      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  PrivateDefaultRouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableC
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC

    Properties:

    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 210

      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry

      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PrivateNaclEgressVpcEphemeralTcp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 10.24.0.0/16
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  PrivateSubnetANetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:

  S3VPCEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint

    Value: !Ref S3VPCEndpoint

    Description: ID of the private network ACL
    Value: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Baseline IAM personas stack - creates IAM groups, roles, instance profiles, and
  customer managed policies for the System Administrator, IAM Administrator,
  Instance Operations, Read-Only Administrator, and Read-Only Billing personas,
  plus a protected logging KMS key. Requires CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

# Design note:
#   EC2 instance credentials cannot satisfy MFA. The DenyAllWithoutMFA guardrail
#   exempts requests made with EC2 instance role credentials by requiring the
#   ec2:SourceInstanceARN context key to be absent (Null = 'true') before denying.
#   This lets the "require MFA" and "every EC2-assumable role has an instance
#   profile" requirements coexist. Human access remains MFA-gated through the
#   policy condition and the role trust policies.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Logging KMS key protected by the tamper-protection guardrail
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LoggingKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} logging KMS key protected against tampering by persona policies'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  LoggingKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/logging
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LoggingKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed policies
  # Each non-billing policy repeats the three shared guardrail Deny statements:
  #   DenyAllWithoutMFA, DenyBillingConsoleAccess, DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdministratorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SystemAdministrator'
      Path: /personas/
      Description: Near-full access to AWS services outside of IAM, with MFA, billing, and logging key guardrails.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAllServicesExceptIAM
            Effect: Allow
            NotAction:
              - iam:*
              - organizations:*
              - account:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowIAMReadAndServiceLinkedRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:Get*
              - iam:List*
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyAllWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            NotAction:
              - iam:ChangePassword
              - iam:CreateVirtualMFADevice
              - iam:EnableMFADevice
              - iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy
              - iam:GetUser
              - iam:ListMFADevices
              - iam:ListVirtualMFADevices
              - iam:ResyncMFADevice
              - sts:GetSessionToken
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'false'
              'Null':
                'ec2:SourceInstanceARN': 'true'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsoleAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - payments:*
              - invoicing:*
              - purchase-orders:*
              - tax:*
              - cur:*
              - consolidatedbilling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:CreateAlias
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:UpdateAlias
              - kms:UpdateKeyDescription
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LoggingKmsKey.Arn
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/logging'

  IAMAdministratorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IAMAdministrator'
      Path: /personas/
      Description: Full IAM access, with MFA, billing, and logging key guardrails.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFullIAMAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyAllWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            NotAction:
              - iam:ChangePassword
              - iam:CreateVirtualMFADevice
              - iam:EnableMFADevice
              - iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy
              - iam:GetUser
              - iam:ListMFADevices
              - iam:ListVirtualMFADevices
              - iam:ResyncMFADevice
              - sts:GetSessionToken
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'false'
              'Null':
                'ec2:SourceInstanceARN': 'true'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsoleAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - payments:*
              - invoicing:*
              - purchase-orders:*
              - tax:*
              - cur:*
              - consolidatedbilling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:CreateAlias
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:UpdateAlias
              - kms:UpdateKeyDescription
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LoggingKmsKey.Arn
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/logging'

  InstanceOperationsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InstanceOperations'
      Path: /personas/
      Description: EC2, Elastic Load Balancing, CloudWatch, and Auto Scaling operations; VPC networking changes denied.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowInstanceOperations
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - cloudwatch:*
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyVpcNetworkingModification
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - ec2:AcceptVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:AssociateDhcpOptions
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AssociateSubnetCidrBlock
              - ec2:AssociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachVpnGateway
              - ec2:CreateCustomerGateway
              - ec2:CreateDhcpOptions
              - ec2:CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAcl
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTransitGateway
              - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayVpcAttachment
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:CreateVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:CreateVpnConnection
              - ec2:CreateVpnGateway
              - ec2:DeleteCustomerGateway
              - ec2:DeleteDhcpOptions
              - ec2:DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGateway
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayVpcAttachment
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoints
              - ec2:DeleteVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:DeleteVpnConnection
              - ec2:DeleteVpnGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachVpnGateway
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateSubnetCidrBlock
              - ec2:DisassociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:ModifyVpcPeeringConnectionOptions
              - ec2:ModifyVpcTenancy
              - ec2:RejectVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation
              - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceRouteTableAssociation
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyAllWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            NotAction:
              - iam:ChangePassword
              - iam:CreateVirtualMFADevice
              - iam:EnableMFADevice
              - iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy
              - iam:GetUser
              - iam:ListMFADevices
              - iam:ListVirtualMFADevices
              - iam:ResyncMFADevice
              - sts:GetSessionToken
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'false'
              'Null':
                'ec2:SourceInstanceARN': 'true'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsoleAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - payments:*
              - invoicing:*
              - purchase-orders:*
              - tax:*
              - cur:*
              - consolidatedbilling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:CreateAlias
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:UpdateAlias
              - kms:UpdateKeyDescription
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LoggingKmsKey.Arn
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/logging'

  ReadOnlyAdministratorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReadOnlyAdministrator'
      Path: /personas/
      Description: Broad read-only access across core AWS services, with MFA, billing, and logging key guardrails.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowReadOnlyAccessToCoreServices
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - acm:Describe*
              - acm:List*
              - autoscaling:Describe*
              - cloudformation:Describe*
              - cloudformation:Get*
              - cloudformation:List*
              - cloudfront:Get*
              - cloudfront:List*
              - cloudtrail:Describe*
              - cloudtrail:Get*
              - cloudtrail:List*
              - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
              - cloudwatch:Describe*
              - cloudwatch:Get*
              - cloudwatch:List*
              - config:Describe*
              - config:Get*
              - config:List*
              - dynamodb:Describe*
              - dynamodb:List*
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:Get*
              - ecr:Describe*
              - ecr:List*
              - ecs:Describe*
              - ecs:List*
              - eks:Describe*
              - eks:List*
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - iam:Get*
              - iam:List*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:GetKeyPolicy
              - kms:GetKeyRotationStatus
              - kms:List*
              - lambda:GetAccountSettings
              - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
              - lambda:GetPolicy
              - lambda:List*
              - logs:Describe*
              - logs:FilterLogEvents
              - logs:Get*
              - rds:Describe*
              - rds:List*
              - route53:Get*
              - route53:List*
              - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
              - s3:GetBucket*
              - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
              - s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration
              - s3:List*
              - sns:Get*
              - sns:List*
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:List*
              - ssm:Describe*
              - ssm:List*
              - tag:Get*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyAllWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            NotAction:
              - iam:ChangePassword
              - iam:CreateVirtualMFADevice
              - iam:EnableMFADevice
              - iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy
              - iam:GetUser
              - iam:ListMFADevices
              - iam:ListVirtualMFADevices
              - iam:ResyncMFADevice
              - sts:GetSessionToken
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'false'
              'Null':
                'ec2:SourceInstanceARN': 'true'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsoleAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - payments:*
              - invoicing:*
              - purchase-orders:*
              - tax:*
              - cur:*
              - consolidatedbilling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:CreateAlias
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:UpdateAlias
              - kms:UpdateKeyDescription
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LoggingKmsKey.Arn
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/logging'

  ReadOnlyBillingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReadOnlyBilling'
      Path: /personas/
      Description: Read-only access to billing, cost, and usage information.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowReadOnlyBilling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - aws-portal:ViewBilling
              - aws-portal:ViewUsage
              - billing:Get*
              - billing:List*
              - budgets:ViewBudget
              - ce:Describe*
              - ce:Get*
              - ce:List*
              - consolidatedbilling:Get*
              - consolidatedbilling:List*
              - cur:Describe*
              - cur:Get*
              - invoicing:Get*
              - invoicing:List*
              - payments:Get*
              - payments:List*
              - tax:Get*
              - tax:List*
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SystemAdministrator'
      Path: /personas/
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorPolicy

  IAMAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IAMAdministrator'
      Path: /personas/
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdministratorPolicy

  InstanceOperationsGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InstanceOperations'
      Path: /personas/
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReadOnlyAdministrator'
      Path: /personas/
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorPolicy

  ReadOnlyBillingGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReadOnlyBilling'
      Path: /personas/
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyBillingPolicy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Roles - non-billing personas are assumable by EC2 and by MFA-authenticated
  # same-account principals
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SystemAdministrator'
      Path: /personas/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowSameAccountWithMFA
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'true'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorPolicy

  IAMAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IAMAdministrator'
      Path: /personas/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowSameAccountWithMFA
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'true'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdministratorPolicy

  InstanceOperationsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InstanceOperations'
      Path: /personas/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowSameAccountWithMFA
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'true'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReadOnlyAdministrator'
      Path: /personas/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowSameAccountWithMFA
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'true'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorPolicy

  # Billing role is not EC2-assumable, so it has no instance profile
  ReadOnlyBillingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReadOnlyBilling'
      Path: /personas/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSameAccountWithMFA
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'true'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyBillingPolicy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance profiles - one per EC2-assumable role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SystemAdministrator'
      Path: /personas/
      Roles:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorRole

  IAMAdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IAMAdministrator'
      Path: /personas/
      Roles:
        - !Ref IAMAdministratorRole

  InstanceOperationsInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InstanceOperations'
      Path: /personas/
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsRole

  ReadOnlyAdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReadOnlyAdministrator'
      Path: /personas/
      Roles:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorRole

Outputs:
  SystemAdministratorGroupId:
    Description: Identifier (group name) of the System Administrator group
    Value: !Ref SystemAdministratorGroup

  IAMAdministratorGroupId:
    Description: Identifier (group name) of the IAM Administrator group
    Value: !Ref IAMAdministratorGroup

  InstanceOperationsGroupId:
    Description: Identifier (group name) of the Instance Operations group
    Value: !Ref InstanceOperationsGroup

  ReadOnlyAdministratorGroupId:
    Description: Identifier (group name) of the Read-Only Administrator group
    Value: !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorGroup

  ReadOnlyBillingGroupId:
    Description: Identifier (group name) of the Read-Only Billing group
    Value: !Ref ReadOnlyBillingGroup

  LoggingKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the tamper-protected logging KMS key for adoption by logging resources
    Value: !GetAtt LoggingKmsKey.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Three-AZ, three-tier VPC (web, application, database) with an Internet Gateway routing the web tier and per-AZ NAT Gateways for the application and database tiers.

Mappings:
  SubnetConfig:
    VPC:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/16
    Web:
      AZ1: 10.0.0.0/24
      AZ2: 10.0.1.0/24
      AZ3: 10.0.2.0/24
    App:
      AZ1: 10.0.10.0/24
      AZ2: 10.0.11.0/24
      AZ3: 10.0.12.0/24
    Db:
      AZ1: 10.0.20.0/24
      AZ2: 10.0.21.0/24
      AZ3: 10.0.22.0/24

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Web tier subnets (public via IGW route; no automatic public IP assignment)
  WebSubnetAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Web, AZ1]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnetAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Web, AZ2]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-az2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnetAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Web, AZ3]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-az3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  # Application tier subnets
  AppSubnetAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, App, AZ1]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnetAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, App, AZ2]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-az2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnetAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, App, AZ3]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-az3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  # Database tier subnets
  DbSubnetAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Db, AZ1]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnetAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Db, AZ2]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-az2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnetAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Db, AZ3]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-az3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  # Web tier routing
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-rt'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnetAZ1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetAZ1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnetAZ2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetAZ2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnetAZ3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetAZ3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # NAT Gateways
  NatEIPAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az1'

  NatEIPAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az2'

  NatEIPAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az3'

  NatGatewayAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPAZ1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetAZ1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az1'

  NatGatewayAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPAZ2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetAZ2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az2'

  NatGatewayAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPAZ3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetAZ3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az3'

  # Application tier routing
  AppRouteTableAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppRouteTableAZ2:
