AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Amazon EKS Quick Start - shared IAM roles and instance profiles stack. Creates the
  Lambda execution roles, EKS control plane role, Fargate execution role, managed and
  unmanaged node instance roles and instance profiles, and the role creation role used
  by the Amazon EKS Quick Start stacks. Role and instance profile ARNs are stored in SSM
  Parameter Store under /quickstart/amazon-eks. Requires CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

# Notes:
# - All role names use the static prefix "eks-quickstart" (hardcoded RoleName values),
#   so this template must be deployed with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.
# - AmazonEKSServicePolicy is a legacy AWS managed policy but still exists; it is
#   retained per the original request.
# - Resource "*" is used only where the IAM actions do not support resource-level
#   permissions (Describe*/List*, sts:GetCallerIdentity, cloudtrail:LookupEvents,
#   cloudformation type registry APIs).
# - No stateful resources or secrets are created by this stack.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CopyZipsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CopyZips
      Description: Lambda execution role used by EKS Quick Start to copy zip artifacts between S3 buckets.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: copy-zips
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadSourceArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Sid: WriteDestinationArtifactsInThisAccount
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ResourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ResourceReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-ResourceReader
      Description: Lambda execution role used by EKS Quick Start to read resource information across the account.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'

  CreateVpcRoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CreateVpcRole
      Description: Lambda execution role used by EKS Quick Start to create the Kubernetes VPC role.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: create-vpc-role
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeNetworking
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                Resource: '*'

  DeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-DeleteBucketContents
      Description: Lambda execution role used by EKS Quick Start to empty S3 buckets before deletion.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: delete-bucket-contents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EmptyBucketsInThisAccount
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ResourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  CleanupLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CleanupLoadBalancers
      Description: Lambda execution role used by EKS Quick Start to clean up load balancers created by Kubernetes.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cleanup-load-balancers
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DeleteLoadBalancers
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:loadbalancer/*'
              - Sid: CleanupSecurityGroupsAndInterfaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group-rule/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'

  CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CleanupSecurityGroupDependencies
      Description: Lambda execution role used by EKS Quick Start to remove security group dependencies before deletion.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cleanup-security-group-dependencies
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CleanupDependencies
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group-rule/*'

  CleanupLambdasRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CleanupLambdas
      Description: Lambda execution role used by EKS Quick Start to clean up hyperplane ENIs left by VPC Lambda functions.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cleanup-lambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadFunctionConfiguration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'
              - Sid: CleanupHyperplaneEnis
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'

  GetCallerArnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-GetCallerArn

        - !GetAZs ''

        - Key: Tier

        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

          Value: lab

  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

    Properties:

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web tier security group allowing HTTPS from within the VPC
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: HTTPS from within the VPC address range
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-web-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: lab

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref SharedRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ReadAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'

  FirehoseInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  KinesisStreamsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

Outputs:

    Description: ID of the lab VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPCId'

    Description: ID of web tier subnet 1 (first Availability Zone)
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnet1Id'

  WebSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of web tier subnet 2 (second Availability Zone)
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnet2Id'

  AppSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of app tier subnet 1 (first Availability Zone)
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnet1Id'

  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of app tier subnet 2 (second Availability Zone)
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnet2Id'

  WebSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the web tier security group
    Value: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSecurityGroupId'

  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-shared
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,27}$'

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${NamePrefix}-*:log-stream:*'

                  - s3:PutObject

                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${NamePrefix}-*/*'
              - Sid: ListBuckets

Description: Provisions a self-contained on-demand DynamoDB table plus an IAM managed policy granting CRUD access to that table.

# App, Env, and Name intentionally have no Default values and must be supplied at deploy time.
Parameters:
  App:
    Type: String
    Description: The application name.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 35
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-35 characters containing only alphanumeric characters, underscores, periods, or hyphens.
  Env:
    Type: String
    Description: The target environment name.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 35
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-35 characters containing only alphanumeric characters, underscores, periods, or hyphens.
  Name:
    Type: String
    Description: The workload name.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 35
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-35 characters containing only alphanumeric characters, underscores, periods, or hyphens.

Resources:
  BsDynamoDbTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: bs
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: bs
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: App
          Value: !Ref App
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref Name

  BsDynamoDbAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb-policy'
      Description: Grants item-level CRUD access to the bs DynamoDB table and its indexes.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BsDynamoDbCrud
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt BsDynamoDbTable.Arn
              - !Sub '${BsDynamoDbTable.Arn}/index/*'

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref BsDynamoDbTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TableName'
  PolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM managed policy granting CRUD access to the table.
    Value: !Ref BsDynamoDbAccessPolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PolicyArn'

deploy_logs: ['App: Required parameter has no Default value | Env: Required parameter has no Default value | Name: Required parameter has no Default value']

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Multi-account Transit Gateway network hub and Resource Access Manager (RAM) share infrastructure for enterprise network transit. Creates the Transit Gateway and RAM share in the transit account, or resolves the shared Transit Gateway reference in spoke accounts.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Stack/System Identification
        Parameters:
          - ReferenceFunctionsStackName
          - CompanyName
          - SystemName
          - AccountName
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Transit Gateway Configuration
        Parameters:
          - TransitGatewayAccount
          - TransitGatewayASN
          - AutoAcceptSharedAttachments
          - DnsSupport
          - VpnEcmpSupport
      - Label:
          default: Resource Share Configuration
        Parameters:
          - TransitGatewayResourceShareName
          - Organization
          - AllowExternalPrincipals
      - Label:
          default: Account IDs
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationAccount
          - JumpstartAccount
          - ManagementAccount
          - LogAccount
          - RecoveryAccount
          - BuildAccount
          - CoreAccount
          - ProductionAccount
          - StagingAccount
          - UATAccount
          - QAAccount
          - TestingAccount
          - DevelopmentAccount
    ParameterLabels:
      ReferenceFunctionsStackName:
        default: ReferenceFunctions Stack Name
      TransitGatewayAccount:
        default: Transit Gateway Account ID
      TransitGatewayASN:
        default: Transit Gateway BGP ASN

Parameters:
  ReferenceFunctionsStackName:
    Description: Name of the CloudFormation stack exporting the Transit Gateway reference Lambda function ARN (used only in spoke accounts)
    Type: String
    Default: ReferenceFunctions
    MinLength: 1
    AllowedPattern: ^[A-Za-z][-A-Za-z0-9]*$
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens

  CompanyName:
    Description: Company name used for tagging
    Type: String
    Default: Camelz
    MinLength: 1

  SystemName:
    Description: System name used for tagging
    Type: String
    Default: Prototype
    MinLength: 1

  AccountName:
    Description: Account name used for tagging
    Type: String
    Default: Core
    MinLength: 1

  EnvironmentName:
    Description: Environment name used for naming and tagging
    Type: String
    Default: Core
    MinLength: 1

  TransitGatewayAccount:
    Description: Account ID owning the Transit Gateway. Leave empty (or set to this account ID) to create the Transit Gateway in this account
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  TransitGatewayASN:
    Description: Private Autonomous System Number (ASN) for the Amazon side of a BGP session
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534

  AutoAcceptSharedAttachments:
    Description: Automatically accept cross-account attachments
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable

  DnsSupport:
    Description: Enable DNS support on the Transit Gateway
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable

  VpnEcmpSupport:
    Description: Enable Equal Cost Multipath (ECMP) routing support between VPN connections
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable

  TransitGatewayResourceShareName:
    Description: Name of the RAM Resource Share for the Transit Gateway
    Type: String
    Default: Core-TransitGatewayResourceShare
    MinLength: 1

  Organization:
    Description: AWS Organizations ID to share the Transit Gateway with (requires OrganizationAccount). Leave empty to share with individual accounts
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid AWS Organizations ID (o-xxxxxxxxxx)

  AllowExternalPrincipals:
    Description: Allow sharing with principals outside the AWS Organization (forced to true when individual accounts are targeted without an Organization)
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  OrganizationAccount:
    Description: Organization (management/payer) Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  JumpstartAccount:
    Description: Jumpstart Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  ManagementAccount:
    Description: Management Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  LogAccount:
    Description: Log Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  RecoveryAccount:
    Description: Recovery Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  BuildAccount:
    Description: Build Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  CoreAccount:
    Description: Core Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  ProductionAccount:
    Description: Production Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  StagingAccount:
    Description: Staging Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  UATAccount:
    Description: UAT Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  QAAccount:
    Description: QA Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  TestingAccount:
    Description: Testing Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

  DevelopmentAccount:
    Description: Development Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID

Conditions:
  IsTransitGatewayAccount: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, '']
    - !Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']

  IsSpokeAccount: !Not [!Condition IsTransitGatewayAccount]

  HasOrganization: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Organization, '']]

  HasOrganizationAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationAccount, '']]

  ShareWithOrganization: !And
    - !Condition IsTransitGatewayAccount
    - !Condition HasOrganization
    - !Condition HasOrganizationAccount

  ShareWithJumpstartAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref JumpstartAccount, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref JumpstartAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']]

  ShareWithManagementAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref ManagementAccount, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref ManagementAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']]

  ShareWithLogAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref LogAccount, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref LogAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']]

  ShareWithRecoveryAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RecoveryAccount, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RecoveryAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']]

  ShareWithBuildAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref BuildAccount, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref BuildAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']]

  ShareWithCoreAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref CoreAccount, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref CoreAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']]

  ShareWithProductionAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref ProductionAccount, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref ProductionAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']]

  ShareWithStagingAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref StagingAccount, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref StagingAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']]

  ShareWithUATAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref UATAccount, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref UATAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']]

  ShareWithQAAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref QAAccount, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref QAAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']]

  ShareWithTestingAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref TestingAccount, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref TestingAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']]

  ShareWithDevelopmentAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref DevelopmentAccount, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref DevelopmentAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']]

  # Fn::Or accepts at most 10 conditions, so the 12 accounts are split into two nested groups
  HasAnyAccountPrincipal: !Or
    - !Or
      - !Condition ShareWithJumpstartAccount
      - !Condition ShareWithManagementAccount
      - !Condition ShareWithLogAccount
      - !Condition ShareWithRecoveryAccount
      - !Condition ShareWithBuildAccount
      - !Condition ShareWithCoreAccount
    - !Or
      - !Condition ShareWithProductionAccount
      - !Condition ShareWithStagingAccount
      - !Condition ShareWithUATAccount
      - !Condition ShareWithQAAccount
      - !Condition ShareWithTestingAccount
      - !Condition ShareWithDevelopmentAccount

  ForceExternalPrincipals: !And
    - !Condition HasAnyAccountPrincipal
    - !Not [!Condition HasOrganization]

  AllowExternalPrincipalsTrue: !Or
    - !Condition ForceExternalPrincipals
    - !Equals [!Ref AllowExternalPrincipals, 'true']

Resources:
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Condition: IsTransitGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway'
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayASN
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: !Ref AutoAcceptSharedAttachments
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: !Ref DnsSupport
      VpnEcmpSupport: !Ref VpnEcmpSupport
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway'
        - Key: Company
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: System
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: Account
          Value: !Ref AccountName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayResourceShare:
    Type: AWS::RAM::ResourceShare
    Condition: IsTransitGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
      AllowExternalPrincipals: !If [AllowExternalPrincipalsTrue, true, false]
      ResourceArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transit-gateway/${TransitGateway}'
      Principals:
        - !If
          - ShareWithOrganization
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${OrganizationAccount}:organization/${Organization}'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If [ShareWithJumpstartAccount, !Ref JumpstartAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [ShareWithManagementAccount, !Ref ManagementAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [ShareWithLogAccount, !Ref LogAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [ShareWithRecoveryAccount, !Ref RecoveryAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [ShareWithBuildAccount, !Ref BuildAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [ShareWithCoreAccount, !Ref CoreAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [ShareWithProductionAccount, !Ref ProductionAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [ShareWithStagingAccount, !Ref StagingAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [ShareWithUATAccount, !Ref UATAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [ShareWithQAAccount, !Ref QAAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [ShareWithTestingAccount, !Ref TestingAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [ShareWithDevelopmentAccount, !Ref DevelopmentAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
        - Key: Company
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: System
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: Account
          Value: !Ref AccountName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Spoke accounts only: depends on a Lambda function ARN exported by the ReferenceFunctions stack.

  # import is never resolved, and the stack deploys fully self-contained.
  TransitGatewayReference:
    Type: Custom::TransitGatewayReference
    Condition: IsSpokeAccount
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${ReferenceFunctionsStackName}-TransitGatewayReferenceFunctionArn'
      AccountId: !Ref TransitGatewayAccount
      Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway'

Outputs:
  TransitGateway:
    Description: Transit Gateway ID
    Value: !If
      - IsTransitGatewayAccount
      - !Ref TransitGateway
      - !GetAtt TransitGatewayReference.TransitGatewayId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TransitGateway'

  TransitGatewayResourceShareArn:
    Condition: IsTransitGatewayAccount
    Description: Transit Gateway RAM Resource Share ARN
    Value: !GetAtt TransitGatewayResourceShare.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayResourceShare'
deploy_logs: ["Creating stack 'iac-god-eval-3ae13267' on aws", 'iac-god-eval-3ae13267: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - User Initiated', 'TransitGateway: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'TransitGateway: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'TransitGateway: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'TransitGatewayResourceShare: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'TransitGatewayResourceShare: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'TransitGatewayResourceShare: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'iac-god-eval-3ae13267: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A']

Description: Provisions an Amazon Bedrock Guardrail, a Guardrail Version, and an SSM version pointer for the AWS pricing assistant.

Parameters:

Resources:

    Type: AWS::Bedrock::Guardrail
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-guardrail'
      Description: Restricts the assistant to AWS pricing, cost estimation, and AWS infrastructure and architecture design topics.
      BlockedInputMessaging: Sorry, your request is outside the scope of AWS pricing and infrastructure design, or it violates our content policy. Please ask a question about AWS pricing, cost estimation, or AWS architecture.
      BlockedOutputsMessaging: Sorry, the response was withheld because it fell outside the allowed AWS pricing and infrastructure design topics or violated our content policy.
      # Bedrock topic policies support only DENY topics; there is no allow-list topic type.
      # The "AWS pricing only" restriction is enforced through deny topics plus the blocked messaging.
      TopicPolicyConfig:
        TopicsConfig:
          - Name: OffTopicGeneralConversation
            Type: DENY
            Definition: General conversation unrelated to AWS pricing, cost estimation, or AWS infrastructure design, such as weather, cooking, sports, entertainment, or personal advice.
            Examples:
              - What is the weather going to be like tomorrow?
              - Can you give me a recipe for chocolate cake?
              - Who won the football game last night?
              - Recommend a good movie to watch this weekend.
      ContentPolicyConfig:
        FiltersConfig:
          - Type: SEXUAL
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: VIOLENCE
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: HATE
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: PROMPT_ATTACK
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE

          import base64
          import hashlib
          import hmac
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ssm = boto3.client("ssm")

          # AWS published SES SMTP credential conversion constants (version 4).
          DATE = "11111111"
          SERVICE = "ses"
          TERMINAL = "aws4_request"
          MESSAGE = "SendRawEmail"
          VERSION = 0x04


          def _sign(key, msg):
              return hmac.new(key, msg.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).digest()


          def smtp_password(secret_access_key, region):
              signature = _sign(("AWS4" + secret_access_key).encode("utf-8"), DATE)
              signature = _sign(signature, region)
              signature = _sign(signature, SERVICE)
              signature = _sign(signature, TERMINAL)
              signature = _sign(signature, MESSAGE)
              return base64.b64encode(bytes([VERSION]) + signature).decode("utf-8")


          def send_response(event, context, status, physical_id, reason=None):
              body = json.dumps({
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or "See CloudWatch Logs stream: " + context.log_stream_name,
                  "PhysicalResourceId": physical_id,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "NoEcho": True,
                  "Data": {},
              }).encode("utf-8")
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=body,
                  method="PUT",
                  headers={"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(body))},
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
                  logger.info("CloudFormation response sent: HTTP %s", response.status)


          def put_secure_parameter(name, value, description, kms_key_id):
              kwargs = {
                  "Name": name,
                  "Value": value,
                  "Description": description,
                  "Type": "SecureString",
                  "Overwrite": True,
                  "Tier": "Standard",
              }
              if kms_key_id:
                  kwargs["KeyId"] = kms_key_id
              ssm.put_parameter(**kwargs)


          def delete_parameter(name):
              try:
                  ssm.delete_parameter(Name=name)
              except ClientError as exc:
                  if exc.response.get("Error", {}).get("Code") != "ParameterNotFound":
                      raise
                  logger.info("Parameter %s not found; nothing to delete", name)


          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event.get("RequestType")
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              user_param = props.get("UserNameParameterName", "")
              pass_param = props.get("PasswordParameterName", "")
              physical_id = "ses-smtp:" + user_param + "," + pass_param

              # Never log the event or properties: they contain the secret access key.
              logger.info("Received %s request for %s", request_type, event.get("LogicalResourceId"))

              try:
                  if not user_param or not pass_param:
                      raise ValueError("UserNameParameterName and PasswordParameterName are required")

                  if request_type in ("Create", "Update"):
                      access_key_id = props.get("AccessKeyId")
                      secret_access_key = props.get("SecretAccessKey")
                      region = props.get("Region")
                      if not access_key_id or not secret_access_key or not region:
                          raise ValueError("AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey and Region are required")

                      password = smtp_password(secret_access_key, region)
                      kms_key_id = props.get("KmsKeyId")
                      put_secure_parameter(user_param, access_key_id,
                                           "SES SMTP username", kms_key_id)
                      put_secure_parameter(pass_param, password,
                                           "SES SMTP password for region " + region, kms_key_id)
                      logger.info("Stored SMTP credentials in %s and %s", user_param, pass_param)
                  elif request_type == "Delete":
                      delete_parameter(user_param)
                      delete_parameter(pass_param)
                      logger.info("Deleted SMTP credential parameters")
                  else:
                      raise ValueError("Unsupported request type")

                  send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  if isinstance(exc, ClientError):
                      detail = exc.response.get("Error", {}).get("Code", "ClientError")
                  else:
                      detail = type(exc).__name__
                  logger.error("%s request failed: %s", request_type, detail)
                  try:
                      send_response(
                          event, context, "FAILED", physical_id,
                          "Request failed (" + detail + "); see CloudWatch Logs stream: " + context.log_stream_name,
                      )
                  except Exception as send_exc:
                      logger.error("Failed to send CloudFormation response: %s", type(send_exc).__name__)

          import json

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["CONNECTIONS_TABLE"]
          TTL_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get("CONNECTION_TTL_SECONDS", "7200"))

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(TABLE_NAME)


          def _management_client(request_context):
              # Built from the request so the API endpoint is never an env var
              endpoint = "https://{}/{}".format(
                  request_context["domainName"], request_context["stage"]
              )
              return boto3.client("apigatewaymanagementapi", endpoint_url=endpoint)


          def _post(client, connection_id, payload):
              try:
                  client.post_to_connection(
                      ConnectionId=connection_id,
                      Data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
                  )
                  return True
              except ClientError as err:
                  code = err.response.get("Error", {}).get("Code")
                  if code == "GoneException":
                      table.delete_item(Key={"connectionId": connection_id})
                  else:
                      logger.warning("post_to_connection failed for %s: %s", connection_id, code)
                  return False


          def _parse_body(event):
              try:
                  return json.loads(event.get("body") or "{}")
              except (TypeError, ValueError):
                  return {}


          def on_connect(event, ctx):
              table.put_item(
                  Item={
                      "connectionId": ctx["connectionId"],
                      "connectedAt": int(time.time()),
                      "expiresAt": int(time.time()) + TTL_SECONDS,
                  }
              )
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Connected."}


          def on_disconnect(event, ctx):
              table.delete_item(Key={"connectionId": ctx["connectionId"]})
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Disconnected."}


          def on_default(event, ctx):
              client = _management_client(ctx)
              _post(
                  client,
                  ctx["connectionId"],
                  {
                      "type": "error",
                      "message": "Unknown action. Use {\"action\": \"sendStatus\", \"jobId\": ..., \"status\": ...}.",
                  },
              )
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Unrecognized action."}


          def on_send_status(event, ctx):
              body = _parse_body(event)
              job_id = body.get("jobId")
              status = body.get("status")
              if not job_id or not status:
                  return {"statusCode": 400, "body": "jobId and status are required."}

              message = {
                  "type": "grantJobStatus",
                  "jobId": str(job_id),
                  "status": str(status),
                  "detail": body.get("detail"),
                  "timestamp": int(time.time()),
              }

              client = _management_client(ctx)
              delivered = 0
              scan_kwargs = {"ProjectionExpression": "connectionId"}
              while True:
                  page = table.scan(**scan_kwargs)
                  for item in page.get("Items", []):
                      if _post(client, item["connectionId"], message):
                          delivered += 1
                  if "LastEvaluatedKey" not in page:
                      break
                  scan_kwargs["ExclusiveStartKey"] = page["LastEvaluatedKey"]

              logger.info("Delivered status for job %s to %d connections", job_id, delivered)
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"delivered": delivered})}


          ROUTES = {
              "$connect": on_connect,
              "$disconnect": on_disconnect,
              "$default": on_default,
              "sendStatus": on_send_status,
          }


          def handler(event, context):
              request_context = event["requestContext"]
              route_key = request_context["routeKey"]
              route = ROUTES.get(route_key, on_default)
              try:
                  return route(event, request_context)
              except Exception:
                  logger.exception("Error handling route %s", route_key)
                  return {"statusCode": 500, "body": "Internal server error."}

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Stripe -> Squarespace -> SNS/Slack sales-notification webhook handler.
  Provisions an API Gateway REST API (POST /webhooks, prod stage) backed by a
  Lambda function. The function verifies the Stripe webhook signature, looks up
  the related Squarespace Commerce order and its inventory, and publishes a
  formatted notification to an SNS topic, encrypted with a customer managed KMS
  key, for relaying to Slack. Secrets are stored in Secrets Manager and must be
  populated after deployment (see Metadata PostDeploySteps).

Metadata:
  PostDeploySteps:
    - >-
      1. Set the Squarespace API token: aws secretsmanager put-secret-value
      --secret-id <SquarespaceApiTokenSecretArn output> --secret-string '<token>'
    - >-
      2. In the Stripe Dashboard, create a webhook endpoint pointing to the
      WebhookUrl output, subscribed to payment_intent.succeeded,
      checkout.session.completed and/or charge.succeeded.
    - >-
      3. Set the Stripe signing secret (whsec_...): aws secretsmanager
      put-secret-value --secret-id <StripeWebhookSecretArn output>
      --secret-string '<whsec_...>'
    - >-
      4. Ensure Stripe PaymentIntents / Checkout Sessions carry a
      metadata.squarespace_order_id value so the order can be looked up.
    - >-
      5. Relay to Slack: in AWS Chatbot (Amazon Q Developer in chat
      applications) configure a Slack channel and subscribe it to the
      SalesNotificationTopicArn output. Messages are published in the Chatbot
      custom-notification JSON format.
    - >-
      6. Optionally subscribe an on-call endpoint to the
      WebhookFunctionErrorsAlarm via an alarm action.
    - >-
      7. The sales-notification topic is encrypted with the customer managed
      KMS key in the SalesNotificationTopicKeyArn output. Its key policy already
      allows the SNS and CloudWatch service principals in this account to use
      it, so subscribers such as AWS Chatbot and CloudWatch alarm actions
      targeting the topic work without changes. Any other publisher that is
      added later needs kms:GenerateDataKey* and kms:Decrypt on this key.

Resources:
  SquarespaceApiTokenSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/squarespace-api-token'
      Description: Squarespace Commerce API token. Replace the generated placeholder after deployment.
      GenerateSecretString:
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludePunctuation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: stripe-squarespace-slack-webhook

  StripeWebhookSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/stripe-webhook-signing-secret'
      Description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...). Replace the generated placeholder after deployment.
      GenerateSecretString:
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludePunctuation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: stripe-squarespace-slack-webhook

  SalesNotificationTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for the sales-notification SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmPublishing
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: stripe-squarespace-slack-webhook

  SalesNotificationTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-sales-notifications'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SalesNotificationTopicKey

  SalesNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sales-notifications'
      DisplayName: Sales notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SalesNotificationTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: stripe-squarespace-slack-webhook

  WebhookFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-webhook'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: stripe-squarespace-slack-webhook

  WebhookFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: webhook-function-permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt WebhookFunctionLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: PublishSalesNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
              - Sid: UseSalesNotificationKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt SalesNotificationTopicKey.Arn
              - Sid: ReadWebhookSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource:
                  - !Ref SquarespaceApiTokenSecret
                  - !Ref StripeWebhookSecret
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: stripe-squarespace-slack-webhook

  WebhookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: WebhookFunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-webhook'
      Description: Verifies Stripe webhooks, enriches with Squarespace order/inventory data, publishes to SNS.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt WebhookFunctionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 25
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
          SQUARESPACE_SECRET_ARN: !Ref SquarespaceApiTokenSecret
          STRIPE_SECRET_ARN: !Ref StripeWebhookSecret
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, os, time, urllib.parse, urllib.request
          import boto3

          sm = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
          sns = boto3.client('sns')
          TYPES = {'payment_intent.succeeded', 'checkout.session.completed', 'charge.succeeded'}
          _cache = {}

          def secret(arn):
              if arn not in _cache:
                  _cache[arn] = sm.get_secret_value(SecretId=arn)['SecretString'].strip()
              return _cache[arn]

          def resp(code, msg):
              return {'statusCode': code, 'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': msg})}

          def verify(body, header, key):
              t, sigs = None, []
              for part in header.split(','):
                  k, _, v = part.strip().partition('=')
                  if k == 't':
                      t = v
                  elif k == 'v1':
                      sigs.append(v)
              try:
                  if not t or not sigs or abs(time.time() - int(t)) > 300:
                      return False
              except ValueError:
                  return False
              expected = hmac.new(key.encode(), f'{t}.{body}'.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
              return any(hmac.compare_digest(expected, s) for s in sigs)

          def squarespace(path):
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  'https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce/' + path,
                  headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + secret(os.environ['SQUARESPACE_SECRET_ARN']),
                           'User-Agent': 'stripe-squarespace-slack-webhook'})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=8) as f:
                  return json.load(f)

          def handler(event, context):
              body = event.get('body') or ''
              if event.get('isBase64Encoded'):
                  body = base64.b64decode(body).decode()
              headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in (event.get('headers') or {}).items()}
              if not verify(body, headers.get('stripe-signature', ''), secret(os.environ['STRIPE_SECRET_ARN'])):
                  return resp(400, 'invalid signature')
              try:
                  evt = json.loads(body)
              except ValueError:
                  return resp(400, 'invalid payload')
              if evt.get('type') not in TYPES:
                  return resp(200, 'ignored')
              obj = evt.get('data', {}).get('object', {})
              amount = obj.get('amount_received') or obj.get('amount_total') or obj.get('amount') or 0
              currency = (obj.get('currency') or 'usd').upper()
              lines = [f'New sale: {amount / 100:.2f} {currency}',
                       f"Stripe event: {evt.get('type')} ({evt.get('id')})"]
              order_id = (obj.get('metadata') or {}).get('squarespace_order_id')
              if order_id:
                  try:
                      order = squarespace('orders/' + urllib.parse.quote(order_id, safe=''))
                      lines.append(f"Squarespace order #{order.get('orderNumber')} {order.get('customerEmail', '')}")
                      items = order.get('lineItems', [])
                      vids = [i['variantId'] for i in items if i.get('variantId')]
                      inv = {}
                      if vids:
                          data = squarespace('inventory/' + ','.join(vids))
                          inv = {x.get('variantId'): x for x in data.get('inventory', [])}
                      for i in items:
                          s = inv.get(i.get('variantId'), {})
                          stock = 'unlimited' if s.get('isUnlimited') else s.get('quantity', 'n/a')
                          lines.append(f"- {i.get('quantity')} x {i.get('productName')} "
                                       f"(SKU {i.get('sku') or s.get('sku', 'n/a')}, stock left: {stock})")
                  except Exception as ex:
                      print(json.dumps({'error': 'squarespace lookup failed', 'orderId': order_id, 'detail': str(ex)}))
                      lines.append(f'Squarespace order {order_id}: lookup failed')
              else:
                  lines.append('No squarespace_order_id in Stripe metadata')
              message = {'version': '1.0', 'source': 'custom',
                         'content': {'textType': 'client-markdown', 'title': 'New sale',
                                     'description': '\n'.join(lines)}}
              sns.publish(TopicArn=os.environ['TOPIC_ARN'], Subject='New sale', Message=json.dumps(message))
              return resp(200, 'ok')
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: stripe-squarespace-slack-webhook

  WebhookApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-webhook-api'
      Description: Receives Stripe webhooks and forwards them to the webhook Lambda function.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: stripe-squarespace-slack-webhook

  WebhooksResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt WebhookApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: webhooks

  WebhooksPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      ResourceId: !Ref WebhooksResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebhookFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  WebhookApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: WebhooksPostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      Description: Deployment of the POST /webhooks endpoint

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref WebhookApiDeployment
      StageName: prod
      Description: Production stage
      TracingEnabled: true
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 50
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: stripe-squarespace-slack-webhook

  WebhookFunctionInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt WebhookFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebhookApi}/*/POST/webhooks'

  WebhookFunctionErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-webhook-function-errors'
      AlarmDescription: Webhook Lambda function invocation errors exceeded zero within one minute.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref WebhookFunction
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: stripe-squarespace-slack-webhook

Outputs:
  WebhookUrl:
    Description: URL to configure as the Stripe webhook endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${WebhookApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ProdStage}/webhooks'
  SalesNotificationTopicArn:
    Description: SNS topic to subscribe the Slack relay (e.g. AWS Chatbot) to
    Value: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
  SalesNotificationTopicKeyArn:
    Description: Customer managed KMS key encrypting the sales-notification topic
    Value: !GetAtt SalesNotificationTopicKey.Arn
  WebhookFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the webhook Lambda function
    Value: !Ref WebhookFunction
  WebhookFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the webhook Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt WebhookFunction.Arn
  SquarespaceApiTokenSecretArn:
    Description: Secret to populate with the Squarespace API token after deployment
    Value: !Ref SquarespaceApiTokenSecret

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained Amazon ElastiCache for Redis (cluster mode enabled) Multi-AZ resilience/gameday test environment with a private VPC, customer-managed KMS encryption, an SNS alarm topic, and an IAM role for SSM Automation approval signals.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: redis-resilience-test
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (max 40 characters).
    Description: Name prefix applied to resources in this environment.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/22
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the first private subnet (first Availability Zone).
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the second private subnet (second Availability Zone).

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  RedisSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows Redis traffic between the private subnets of the resilience test environment
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          Description: Redis from private subnet 1
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          Description: Redis from private subnet 2
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Redis traffic within the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-redis-sg'

  RedisSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Private subnets across two Availability Zones for the Redis replication group
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-subnet-group'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-subnet-group'

  EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for ElastiCache and SNS encryption in the Redis resilience test environment
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowElastiCacheUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'elasticache.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowSNSUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-key'

  EncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  RedisReplicationGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      ReplicationGroupId: !Ref EnvironmentName
      ReplicationGroupDescription: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} Redis cluster mode enabled Multi-AZ resilience test replication group'
      Engine: redis
      EngineVersion: '7.1'
      CacheNodeType: cache.t4g.small
      CacheParameterGroupName: default.redis7.cluster.on
      ClusterMode: enabled
      Port: 6379
      NumNodeGroups: 2
      MultiAZEnabled: true
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      AtRestEncryptionEnabled: true
      TransitEncryptionEnabled: true
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref RedisSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt RedisSecurityGroup.GroupId
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      SnapshotRetentionLimit: 1
      NodeGroupConfiguration:
        - NodeGroupId: '0001'
          Slots: '0-8191'
          ReplicaCount: 1
          PrimaryAvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
          ReplicaAvailabilityZones:
            - !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
        - NodeGroupId: '0002'
          Slots: '8192-16383'
          ReplicaCount: 1
          PrimaryAvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
          ReplicaAvailabilityZones:
            - !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-redis'

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-alarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-alarms'

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  GamedayApprovalRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows SSM Automation to send approval signals during resilience/gameday runbook execution
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SendAutomationSignal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-gameday-approval-role'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the test environment VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  RedisSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the Redis security group
    Value: !GetAtt RedisSecurityGroup.GroupId
  CacheSubnetGroupName:
    Description: Name of the ElastiCache subnet group
    Value: !Ref RedisSubnetGroup
  ReplicationGroupId:
    Description: ID of the Redis replication group
    Value: !Ref RedisReplicationGroup
  ConfigurationEndpointAddress:
    Description: Configuration endpoint address of the cluster mode enabled replication group
    Value: !GetAtt RedisReplicationGroup.ConfigurationEndPoint.Address
  ConfigurationEndpointPort:
    Description: Configuration endpoint port of the cluster mode enabled replication group
    Value: !GetAtt RedisReplicationGroup.ConfigurationEndPoint.Port
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
  KmsKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the customer-managed KMS key
    Value: !Ref EncryptionKeyAlias
  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the encrypted SNS alarm topic
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic
  GamedayApprovalRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used for SSM Automation approval signals
    Value: !GetAtt GamedayApprovalRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL songs service with IAM authorization, X-Ray tracing, a DynamoDB backing table and a JavaScript pipeline resolver.

Resources:
  SongsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-songs'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-songs-service'

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role allowing AppSync to read and write the songs DynamoDB table.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SongsTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${SongsTable.Arn}/index/*'

  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role allowing AppSync to publish logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/appsync/apis/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/appsync/apis/*:log-stream:*'

  SongsApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-songs-api'
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ERROR
        ExcludeVerboseContent: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-songs-service'

  SongsApiLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/appsync/apis/${SongsApi.ApiId}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  SongsSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          artist: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song]
        }

        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String!): Song
        }

  SongsTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: SongsTableDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB data source for the songs table.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref SongsTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  NoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: NoneDataSource
      Description: Local data source used for input validation.
      Type: NONE

  ValidateArtistFunction:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cognito user pool with email-based sign-in and strong password policy, a public app client,
  and a regional REST API secured by a Cognito user pool authorizer. It exposes a protected
  GET /me endpoint and an unauthenticated GET /open endpoint, both backed by a single Lambda
  function and deployed to a prod stage.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  IdentityFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
