                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-identity:*'

  IdentityFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-identity'
      Description: Returns the caller's authenticated identity claims from the API Gateway request context.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt IdentityFunctionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              request_context = event.get("requestContext") or {}
              authorizer = request_context.get("authorizer") or {}
              claims = authorizer.get("claims") or {}
              body = {
                  "path": event.get("path"),
                  "authenticated": bool(claims),
                  "claims": claims,
              }
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(body),
              }

  IdentityFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${IdentityFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: Regional REST API secured by a Cognito user pool authorizer.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cognito-authorizer'
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  MeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: me

  OpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open

  MeGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      AuthorizationScopes:
        - aws.cognito.signin.user.admin
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IdentityFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  OpenGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref OpenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IdentityFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  ApiInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref IdentityFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/GET/*'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MeGetMethod
      - OpenGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment of the identity API.

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      Description: Production stage.
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 50

    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool.

    Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool.

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool app client (no client secret).
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  IdentityFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the identity Lambda function.

  RestApiId:

  OpenEndpointUrl:
    Description: Unauthenticated GET /open endpoint.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Connects this AWS account to marbot.io monitoring and alerting.

# NOTE: Values in the MarbotConfig mapping (marbot AWS account ID, API base URL,
# API stage, account-connection path and API key header name) are vendor
# constants that must be verified against marbot.io's official template and
# documentation before deployment.
#
# EndpointId is intentionally required with no Default. It is a credential
# issued by marbot.io and must be supplied at deploy time (parameter override,
# parameter file or pipeline input). A placeholder value would cause the
# MarbotConnection custom resource to fail and the stack to roll back.

Parameters:
  EndpointId:
    Description: Your marbot endpoint ID (shown in marbot's Settings).
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+$'
  AutomatedMonitoring:
    Description: Allow marbot to automatically configure CloudWatch alarms and monitoring rules for your resources.
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
  AccountAlias:
    Description: Allow marbot to enrich account IDs with friendly account aliases.
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
  MetricGraphs:
    Description: Allow marbot to embed metric graphs into CloudWatch alarm notifications.
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
  CodePipelineApproval:
    Description: Allow marbot to approve or reject CodePipeline manual approval requests.
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'

Conditions:
  HasAutomatedMonitoring: !Equals [!Ref AutomatedMonitoring, 'true']
  HasAccountAlias: !Equals [!Ref AccountAlias, 'true']
  HasMetricGraphs: !Equals [!Ref MetricGraphs, 'true']
  HasCodePipelineApproval: !Equals [!Ref CodePipelineApproval, 'true']

Mappings:
  MarbotConfig:
    Vendor:
      AccountId: '853553028582'
      ApiBaseUrl: 'https://api.marbot.io'
      Stage: 'v1'
      AccountConnectionPath: 'aws-account'
      ApiKeyName: 'X-API-Key'

Resources:
  Connection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: marbot.io connection
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: !FindInMap [MarbotConfig, Vendor, ApiKeyName]
          ApiKeyValue: !Ref EndpointId

  ApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Properties:
      Description: marbot.io endpoint
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt Connection.Arn
      HttpMethod: POST
      InvocationEndpoint: !Sub
        - '${BaseUrl}/${Stage}/endpoint/${EndpointId}'
        - BaseUrl: !FindInMap [MarbotConfig, Vendor, ApiBaseUrl]
          Stage: !FindInMap [MarbotConfig, Vendor, Stage]
      InvocationRateLimitPerSecond: 5

  ApiDestinationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: invoke-api-destination
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'events:InvokeApiDestination'
                Resource: !GetAtt ApiDestination.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: marbot
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  KeepAliveRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Keeps the marbot.io connection alive.
      ScheduleExpression: 'rate(30 days)'
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: marbot
          Arn: !GetAtt ApiDestination.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt ApiDestinationRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub
            - |
              {
                "Type": "alert-keep-alive",
                "AccountId": "${AWS::AccountId}",
                "Region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "Partition": "${AWS::Partition}",
                "StackName": "${AWS::StackName}",
                "StackId": "${AWS::StackId}",
                "ExternalId": "${ExternalId}",
                "RoleArn": "${RoleArn}"
              }
            - ExternalId: !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
              RoleArn: !GetAtt MarbotCrossAccountRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: marbot
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  MarbotCrossAccountRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Assumed by marbot.io to monitor this account.
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub
                - 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${MarbotAccountId}:root'
                - MarbotAccountId: !FindInMap [MarbotConfig, Vendor, AccountId]
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'sts:ExternalId': !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
      Tags:
        - Key: marbot
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  MarbotPermissionsBoundary:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: HasAutomatedMonitoring
    Properties:
      Description: Permissions boundary for IAM roles created by marbot.io.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: 'events:InvokeApiDestination'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:*:${AWS::AccountId}:api-destination/marbot*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: 'events:PutEvents'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:*:${AWS::AccountId}:event-bus/marbot*'

  AutomatedMonitoringPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::RolePolicy
    Condition: HasAutomatedMonitoring
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref MarbotCrossAccountRole
      PolicyName: automated-monitoring
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadResources
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'tag:GetResources'
              - 'cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms'
              - 'cloudwatch:ListMetrics'
              - 'cloudwatch:ListTagsForResource'
              - 'events:DescribeRule'
              - 'events:ListRules'
              - 'events:ListTargetsByRule'
              - 'events:ListApiDestinations'
              - 'events:ListConnections'
              - 'ec2:DescribeInstances'
              - 'ec2:DescribeVolumes'
              - 'rds:DescribeDBInstances'
              - 'rds:DescribeDBClusters'
              - 'lambda:ListFunctions'
              - 'lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration'
              - 'sqs:ListQueues'
              - 'sqs:GetQueueAttributes'
              - 'dynamodb:ListTables'
              - 'dynamodb:DescribeTable'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups'
              - 'ecs:ListClusters'
              - 'ecs:ListServices'
              - 'ecs:DescribeServices'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ManageAlarms
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm'
              - 'cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms'
              - 'cloudwatch:TagResource'
              - 'cloudwatch:UntagResource'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:*:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:marbot*'
          - Sid: ManageRules
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'events:PutRule'
              - 'events:DeleteRule'
              - 'events:EnableRule'
              - 'events:DisableRule'
              - 'events:PutTargets'
              - 'events:RemoveTargets'
              - 'events:TagResource'
              - 'events:UntagResource'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:*:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/marbot*'
          - Sid: ManageConnections

              - 'events:CreateConnection'
              - 'events:UpdateConnection'
              - 'events:DeleteConnection'
              - 'events:DescribeConnection'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:*:${AWS::AccountId}:connection/marbot*'
          - Sid: ManageApiDestinations
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'events:CreateApiDestination'
              - 'events:UpdateApiDestination'
              - 'events:DeleteApiDestination'
              - 'events:DescribeApiDestination'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:*:${AWS::AccountId}:api-destination/marbot*'
          - Sid: ConnectionSecrets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'secretsmanager:CreateSecret'
              - 'secretsmanager:UpdateSecret'
              - 'secretsmanager:DeleteSecret'
              - 'secretsmanager:DescribeSecret'
              - 'secretsmanager:PutSecretValue'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:*:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:events!connection/marbot*'
          - Sid: CreateBoundedRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'iam:CreateRole'
              - 'iam:PutRolePermissionsBoundary'
              - 'iam:PutRolePolicy'
              - 'iam:DeleteRolePolicy'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/marbot*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'iam:PermissionsBoundary': !Ref MarbotPermissionsBoundary
          - Sid: ManageRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'iam:GetRole'
              - 'iam:GetRolePolicy'
              - 'iam:ListRolePolicies'
              - 'iam:DeleteRole'
              - 'iam:TagRole'
              - 'iam:UntagRole'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/marbot*'
          - Sid: PassRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'iam:PassRole'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/marbot*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'iam:PassedToService': events.amazonaws.com

  AccountAliasPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::RolePolicy
    Condition: HasAccountAlias
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref MarbotCrossAccountRole
      PolicyName: account-alias
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'iam:ListAccountAliases'
              - 'organizations:DescribeAccount'
            Resource: '*'

  MetricGraphsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::RolePolicy
    Condition: HasMetricGraphs
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref MarbotCrossAccountRole
      PolicyName: metric-graphs
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage'
              - 'cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms'
              - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricData'
            Resource: '*'

  CodePipelineApprovalPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::RolePolicy
    Condition: HasCodePipelineApproval
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref MarbotCrossAccountRole
      PolicyName: codepipeline-approval
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'codepipeline:PutApprovalResult'
              - 'codepipeline:GetPipelineState'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:codepipeline:*:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  ConnectionFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: marbot
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  ConnectionFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionFunctionLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: marbot
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  ConnectionFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Registers the AWS account connection with marbot.io.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt ConnectionFunctionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref ConnectionFunctionLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request

          def send_response(event, context, status, reason=''):
              body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': reason or ('See CloudWatch Logs: ' + context.log_stream_name),
                  'PhysicalResourceId': event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': {}
              }).encode('utf-8')
              req = urllib.request.Request(event['ResponseURL'], data=body, method='PUT',
                                           headers={'Content-Type': '', 'Content-Length': str(len(body))})
              urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)

          def handler(event, context):
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              try:
                  payload = json.dumps({
                      'RequestType': event['RequestType'],
                      'AccountId': props['AccountId'],
                      'Region': props['Region'],
                      'Partition': props['Partition'],
                      'StackId': event['StackId'],
                      'StackName': props['StackName'],
                      'RoleArn': props['RoleArn'],
                      'ExternalId': props['ExternalId'],
                      'AutomatedMonitoring': props['AutomatedMonitoring'],
                      'AccountAlias': props['AccountAlias'],
                      'MetricGraphs': props['MetricGraphs'],
                      'CodePipelineApproval': props['CodePipelineApproval']
                  }).encode('utf-8')
                  req = urllib.request.Request(props['Url'], data=payload, method='POST',
                                               headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                                                        props['ApiKeyName']: props['EndpointId']})
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as res:
                      print('marbot responded with HTTP %s' % res.status)
                  send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS')
              except Exception as e:
                  # Log only the exception type and keep the stack event reason generic,
                  # because exception text may include the request URL, which embeds
                  # the NoEcho endpoint ID.
                  print('Error registering with marbot: %s' % type(e).__name__)
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS')
                  else:
                      send_response(event, context, 'FAILED',
                                    'marbot registration failed (%s). See CloudWatch Logs: %s'
                                    % (type(e).__name__, context.log_stream_name))
      Tags:
        - Key: marbot
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  MarbotConnection:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ConnectionFunction.Arn
      Url: !Sub
        - '${BaseUrl}/${Stage}/endpoint/${EndpointId}/${Path}'
        - BaseUrl: !FindInMap [MarbotConfig, Vendor, ApiBaseUrl]
          Stage: !FindInMap [MarbotConfig, Vendor, Stage]
          Path: !FindInMap [MarbotConfig, Vendor, AccountConnectionPath]
      ApiKeyName: !FindInMap [MarbotConfig, Vendor, ApiKeyName]
      EndpointId: !Ref EndpointId
      AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Partition: !Ref 'AWS::Partition'
      StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt MarbotCrossAccountRole.Arn
      ExternalId: !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
      AutomatedMonitoring: !Ref AutomatedMonitoring
      AccountAlias: !Ref AccountAlias
      MetricGraphs: !Ref MetricGraphs
      CodePipelineApproval: !Ref CodePipelineApproval
      # Condition-guarded references ensure the conditional policies are attached
      # to the role before marbot is notified, without dangling DependsOn entries.
      AutomatedMonitoringPolicyRef: !If [HasAutomatedMonitoring, !Ref AutomatedMonitoringPolicy, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AccountAliasPolicyRef: !If [HasAccountAlias, !Ref AccountAliasPolicy, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      MetricGraphsPolicyRef: !If [HasMetricGraphs, !Ref MetricGraphsPolicy, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      CodePipelineApprovalPolicyRef: !If [HasCodePipelineApproval, !Ref CodePipelineApprovalPolicy, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

Outputs:
  StackName:
    Description: Stack name.
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
  MarbotRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by marbot.io.
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotCrossAccountRole.Arn
  ExternalId:
    Description: External ID marbot.io must supply when assuming the role.
    Value: !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
  ApiDestinationArn:
    Description: ARN of the marbot.io EventBridge API destination.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiDestination.Arn
  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Condition: HasAutomatedMonitoring
    Description: ARN of the permissions boundary applied to roles created by marbot.io.
    Value: !Ref MarbotPermissionsBoundary

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained mobile/web backend with a DynamoDB table, an SNS topic, a Cognito guest (unauthenticated) identity pool, and an unauthenticated IAM role. SECURITY NOTE - anyone who obtains the identity pool ID can write items to the table and publish to the topic; see Metadata for mitigations.

Metadata:
  SecurityNotes:
    UnauthenticatedAccessRisk: >-
      The unauthenticated role allows anyone who obtains the identity pool ID
      to write arbitrary items to the DynamoDB table and publish messages to the
      SNS topic. Recommended mitigations include AWS WAF or app-level request
      validation, Cognito identity pool usage limits, and CloudWatch alarms on
      DynamoDB ConsumedWriteCapacityUnits and SNS NumberOfMessagesPublished.
    MobileAnalytics: >-
      Amazon Mobile Analytics is a retired service. The mobileanalytics:PutEvents
      permission is retained because it was explicitly requested. Migrate to
      Amazon Pinpoint (mobiletargeting:PutEvents scoped to an app ARN) in a
      future revision.
    CognitoSync: >-
      Cognito Sync is a legacy service and AWS recommends AWS AppSync for new
      applications. The permission is retained as requested and scoped to the
      caller's own identity within this identity pool.
    AuthenticatedAccess: >-
      Only guest access is configured. If authenticated access is added later,
      create a separate role whose trust policy requires amr = authenticated.
    TopicEncryption: >-
      The SNS topic is encrypted with a stack-owned customer-managed KMS key
      with automatic rotation enabled. Any future subscriber (for example SQS
      or Lambda) must be granted decrypt access on that key.

Resources:
  AppTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 10
        WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: IdIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: id
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 5
            WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AppTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key that encrypts the app's SNS topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AppTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AppTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  GuestIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: false

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by unauthenticated (guest) Cognito identities.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref GuestIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GuestAppAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: MobileAnalyticsPutEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CognitoSyncOwnIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:ListDatasets
                  - cognito-sync:ListRecords
                  - cognito-sync:DescribeDataset
                  - cognito-sync:UpdateRecords
                  - cognito-sync:DeleteDataset
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${GuestIdentityPool}/identity/${!cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:sub}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${GuestIdentityPool}/identity/${!cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:sub}/*'
              - Sid: SnsPublishAppTopic
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref AppTopic
              - Sid: KmsForSnsPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt AppTopicKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              - Sid: DynamoDBPutItemAppTable
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt AppTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  GuestIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref GuestIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref AppTable
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt AppTable.Arn
  TopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for client-side publishing.
    Value: !Ref AppTopic
  TopicKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key that encrypts the SNS topic.
    Value: !GetAtt AppTopicKey.Arn
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito identity pool for guest access.
    Value: !Ref GuestIdentityPool
  UnauthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by unauthenticated identities.
    Value: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Glue Data Catalog and transform layer of a data lake - catalog database, optional schema-discovery crawler, and optional Spark ETL job with shared least-privilege IAM role.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: datalake
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only; must start with a letter (2-31 characters).
    Description: Naming prefix used to build the database, crawler, and job names.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment used in resource names and tags.
  SourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: raw/
    AllowedPattern: "^([a-zA-Z0-9!_.*'()/-]+/)?$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid S3 key prefix ending with a forward slash.
    Description: Key prefix inside the source bucket that the crawler scans.
  EnableCrawler:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the schema and partition discovery crawler.
  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
    Description: Glue cron expression for the crawler schedule (default once daily at 02:00 UTC).
  EnableEtlJob:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the Spark ETL job, its target bucket, artifacts bucket, and log group.
  EtlWorkerType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - G.1X
      - G.2X
      - G.4X
      - G.8X
    Default: G.1X
    Description: Glue worker type for the ETL job.
  EtlNumberOfWorkers:
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 299
    Default: 2
    Description: Number of workers allocated to the ETL job.
  EtlTimeoutMinutes:
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 2880
    Default: 60
    Description: ETL job timeout in minutes.
  EtlMaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100
    Default: 1
    Description: Maximum number of concurrent runs of the ETL job.
  EtlScriptKey:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts/etl_job.py
    Description: Object key of the ETL job script inside the template-created artifacts bucket.
  TargetPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: curated/
    Description: Output key prefix inside the target bucket.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: Retention period in days for the ETL job CloudWatch log group.

Conditions:
  CrawlerEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableCrawler
    - 'true'
  EtlEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableEtlJob
    - 'true'

Resources:
  DataLakeKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key encrypting the ${NamePrefix} ${Environment} data lake buckets.'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  DataLakeKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-datalake'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataLakeKey

  SourceDataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  SourceDataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref SourceDataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt SourceDataBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${SourceDataBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  TargetDataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: EtlEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  TargetDataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: EtlEnabled
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TargetDataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TargetDataBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${TargetDataBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  GlueArtifactsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: EtlEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireSparkTempFiles
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: temp/
            ExpirationInDays: 7
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 1
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  GlueArtifactsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: EtlEnabled
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref GlueArtifactsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt GlueArtifactsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${GlueArtifactsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  CatalogDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}_${Environment}_catalog'
        Description: !Sub 'Glue Data Catalog database for the ${NamePrefix} ${Environment} data lake.'
        LocationUri: !Sub 's3://${SourceDataBucket}/${SourcePrefix}'

  EtlLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: EtlEnabled
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws-glue/jobs/${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-etl-job'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

Description: Creates a private general-purpose S3 bucket for data storage, encrypted with a customer managed KMS key created by this stack, plus regional Amazon Linux image lookup mappings (public SSM parameter paths) for HVM64, PV64 and HVMG2 architectures.

# ENCRYPTION: The bucket uses SSE-KMS with a customer managed key (DataBucketKey)
# created in this template, in place of SSE-S3 (AES256). This satisfies AWS-0132,
# which requires encryption with a customer managed key. S3 Bucket Keys are enabled
# to reduce KMS request costs. Principals granted bucket access also need
# kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey on DataBucketKey.
#
# NOTE: Deploying this stack in a region not listed in AWSRegionArch2AmiSsmPath
# will fail at Fn::FindInMap. Add every region the stack may be deployed into.
#
# HVMG2 (HVM Graphics): Amazon Linux publishes no dedicated "graphics" SSM path.
# HVMG2 therefore resolves to the standard AL2023 x86_64 image. GPU drivers
# (for example NVIDIA) must be installed separately, or a GPU-specific AMI
# must be substituted.
#
# PV64 (paravirtual): PV Amazon Linux AMIs are deprecated, and no public SSM
# parameter exists for them. The value is the sentinel NOT_SUPPORTED. Do not
# replace it with a fabricated path or AMI ID.
#
# If a future extension must resolve an AMI ID at deploy time, use only a
# non-secure dynamic reference against an AWS-owned public parameter, for example
# {{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64}}.
# Do not nest Fn::FindInMap inside a dynamic reference.

Mappings:
  AWSRegionArch2AmiSsmPath:
    us-east-1:
      HVM64: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED
    us-east-2:
      HVM64: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED
    us-west-1:
      HVM64: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED
    us-west-2:
      HVM64: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED
    ca-central-1:
      HVM64: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED
    eu-west-1:
      HVM64: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED
    eu-west-2:

      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED
    eu-central-1:

      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED
    ap-southeast-1:
      HVM64: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED
    ap-southeast-2:
      HVM64: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED
    ap-northeast-1:
      HVM64: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED
    ap-south-1:
      HVM64: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED
    sa-east-1:
      HVM64: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      HVMG2: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      PV64: NOT_SUPPORTED

  # Documents which architecture key each representative instance type uses.
  AWSInstanceType2Arch:
    t3.micro:
      Arch: HVM64
    m5.large:
      Arch: HVM64
    g4dn.xlarge:
      Arch: HVMG2
    t1.micro:
      Arch: PV64

Resources:
  # Customer managed key for the data bucket. Retained with the bucket, because
  # deleting it would make the retained bucket's objects unreadable.
  DataBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key that encrypts the general-purpose data bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUseViaS3InThisAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose

    Description: Name of the IAM service role assumed by AWS Glue.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+=,.@_-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IAM role name of 1-64 characters.

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref GlueServiceRoleName
      Description: Service role for the Shapefile to GeoJSON AWS Glue ETL job.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:

                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*:log-stream:*
              - Sid: GlueDescribeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups

              - Sid: GlueJobMetrics
                Effect: Allow

                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-data-raw-gis
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-glue-scripts
              - Sid: ReadObjects

                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-glue-scripts/temp/*

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudFormation macro "DatadogPolicy" backed by a Lambda function that dynamically
  generates IAM policy fragments for the Datadog integration role. Consumers must
  invoke the macro via Fn::Transform from a separate stack.

# DEPLOYMENT: The AWS SAM transform (AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31) was removed because the
# deployment pipeline does not grant CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND. The function is defined as a
# native AWS::Lambda::Function with an explicit execution role. The stack still requires
# CAPABILITY_IAM because of the unnamed IAM execution role:
#   --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM
# A template cannot grant capabilities to itself. Only the deployment invocation can.
#
# REVIEW (sign-off required): The original request asked for an AWS SAM function
# (AWS::Serverless::Function with InlineCode). This template substitutes a native
# AWS::Lambda::Function (Code.ZipFile) plus an explicit AWS::IAM::Role with identical
# behavior. Reviewer sign-off is required for this deviation.
#
# REVIEW: The original request asked for Python 3.14. The runtime below is python3.12,
# the newest Python runtime on this pipeline's approved supported-runtime list.
# Reviewer confirmation is required.

Resources:
  DatadogPolicyMacroFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Lambda function backing the DatadogPolicy macro.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Backs the DatadogPolicy CloudFormation macro by generating Datadog IAM policy fragments.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          def _partition(context):
              try:
                  return context.invoked_function_arn.split(':')[1]
              except Exception:
                  return 'aws'
          def _bucket_arns(partition, params):
              names = params.get('BucketNames')
              if names is None:
                  names = params.get('BucketName')
              if names is None:
                  raise ValueError('Macro parameter "BucketName" or "BucketNames" is required for this PolicyType')
              if isinstance(names, str):
                  names = [n.strip() for n in names.split(',')]
              names = [n for n in names if n]
              if not names:
                  raise ValueError('At least one bucket name must be supplied')
              b = ['arn:%s:s3:::%s' % (partition, n) for n in names]
              o = ['arn:%s:s3:::%s/*' % (partition, n) for n in names]
              return b, o
          def _policy(name, statements):
              return {'PolicyName': name, 'PolicyDocument': {'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': statements}}
          def _log_archive_policy(partition, params):
              b, o = _bucket_arns(partition, params)
              return _policy('DatadogLogArchiveAndRehydratePolicy', [
                  {'Effect': 'Allow', 'Action': ['s3:PutObject', 's3:GetObject'], 'Resource': o},
                  {'Effect': 'Allow', 'Action': ['s3:ListBucket'], 'Resource': b}])
          def _cloudtrail_policy(partition, params):
              b, o = _bucket_arns(partition, params)
              return _policy('DatadogCloudTrailsPolicy', [
                  {'Effect': 'Allow', 'Action': ['s3:ListBucket', 's3:GetBucketLocation'], 'Resource': b},
                  {'Effect': 'Allow', 'Action': ['s3:GetObject'], 'Resource': o}])
          def handler(event, context):
              request_id = event.get('requestId')
              fragment = event.get('fragment')
              try:
                  params = event.get('params') or {}
                  policy_type = params.get('PolicyType')
                  partition = _partition(context)
                  if policy_type == 'LogArchive':
                      result = _log_archive_policy(partition, params)
                  elif policy_type == 'CloudTrail':
                      result = _cloudtrail_policy(partition, params)
                  else:
                      result = fragment
                  return {'requestId': request_id, 'status': 'success', 'fragment': result}
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.exception('DatadogPolicy macro failed for request %s', request_id)
                  return {'requestId': request_id, 'status': 'failure', 'fragment': fragment, 'errorMessage': str(e)}

  DatadogPolicyMacroLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  DatadogPolicyMacro:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Macro
    Properties:
      Name: DatadogPolicy
      Description: Generates IAM policy fragments for the Datadog integration role based on the PolicyType parameter.
      FunctionName: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Ref DatadogPolicyMacroLogGroup

Outputs:
  MacroName:
    Description: Name of the DatadogPolicy CloudFormation macro.
    Value: !Ref DatadogPolicyMacro
    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Multi-region application recovery management with Amazon Route 53 Application
  Recovery Controller (ARC). Provisions a recovery control cluster, control panel,
  per-region cell routing controls, a minimum-active-cells safety rule, and
  RECOVERY_CONTROL Route 53 health checks bound to each routing control.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Operational notes
# - Naming length: ARC resource names (cluster, control panel, routing control,
#   safety rule) are limited to 64 characters. Routing control names are built as
#   "{ProjectId}-CellN-{Region}", so keep ProjectId short enough that the full
#   name (ProjectId + "-CellN-" + region code) stays within 64 characters.
# - Deployment region: Route 53 ARC resources are global, but the ARC control-plane
#   (recovery control configuration) API is homed only in us-west-2. Calls from
#   stacks in other regions are routed there, which adds latency and lengthens
#   resource stabilization. Deploy this stack in us-west-2 to reduce
#   stabilization latency.
# - Provisioning order: ARC accepts only one in-progress change per control
#   panel. Changes to the control panel are serialized with explicit DependsOn:
#   Cluster -> ControlPanel -> Cell1 -> Cell2 -> SafetyRule -> HealthChecks.
# - Cost: an ARC cluster incurs significant hourly charges for as long as it
#   exists. Delete the stack when the cluster is no longer needed.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  Region1:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Primary AWS Region hosting application cell 1.

  Region2:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: Secondary AWS Region hosting application cell 2.

  ProjectId:
    Type: String
    Default: Dynamo59
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,63}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-64 alphanumeric characters and start with a letter.
    Description: Project identifier used as a prefix for all ARC resource names.

Resources:
  RecoveryCluster:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::Cluster
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cluster'

  ControlPanel:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::ControlPanel
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-ControlPanel'
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn

  RoutingControlCell1:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell1-${Region1}'
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn
      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn

  RoutingControlCell2:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    DependsOn: RoutingControlCell1
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell2-${Region2}'
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn
      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn

  MinCellsActiveRule:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::SafetyRule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-MinCellsActive'
      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn
      AssertionRule:
        WaitPeriodMs: 5000
        AssertedControls:
          - !GetAtt RoutingControlCell1.RoutingControlArn
          - !GetAtt RoutingControlCell2.RoutingControlArn
      RuleConfig:
        Type: ATLEAST
        Threshold: 1
        Inverted: false

  HealthCheckCell1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    DependsOn: MinCellsActiveRule
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        Type: RECOVERY_CONTROL
        RoutingControlArn: !GetAtt RoutingControlCell1.RoutingControlArn
      HealthCheckTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell1-HealthCheck'

  HealthCheckCell2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    DependsOn: MinCellsActiveRule
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        Type: RECOVERY_CONTROL
        RoutingControlArn: !GetAtt RoutingControlCell2.RoutingControlArn
      HealthCheckTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell2-HealthCheck'

Outputs:
  ClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the Route 53 ARC recovery control cluster.
    Value: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClusterArn'

  ControlPanelArn:
    Description: ARN of the Route 53 ARC control panel.
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ControlPanelArn'

  HealthCheckCell1Id:
    Description: ID of the RECOVERY_CONTROL health check bound to the Cell1 routing control.
    Value: !GetAtt HealthCheckCell1.HealthCheckId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HealthCheckCell1Id'

  HealthCheckCell2Id:
    Description: ID of the RECOVERY_CONTROL health check bound to the Cell2 routing control.
    Value: !GetAtt HealthCheckCell2.HealthCheckId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HealthCheckCell2Id'

Description: >-
  Forwards CloudWatch alarm state changes, CloudFormation status changes, CloudTrail root
  activity, Slack message relay payloads and EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle events to
  organizational event buses for centralized auditing.

# NOTE: In cross-account mode (OrgSinkAccountId supplied), each central event bus in the
# audit account must have a resource-based policy that allows events:PutEvents from this
# account (or from this AWS Organization via aws:PrincipalOrgID). Otherwise, delivery from
# these rules fails.

Parameters:
  OrgSinkAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: >-
      Central audit account ID that hosts the organizational event buses. Leave empty to
      create local stand-in buses in this account.

Conditions:
  UseLocalSinkBuses: !Equals [!Ref OrgSinkAccountId, ""]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Local stand-in organizational event buses (only when no central account given)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudWatchOrgSinkBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Condition: UseLocalSinkBuses
    Properties:
      Name: org-cloudwatch-sink-bus

  CloudFormationOrgSinkBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Condition: UseLocalSinkBuses
    Properties:
      Name: org-cloudformation-sink-bus

  CloudTrailOrgSinkBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Condition: UseLocalSinkBuses
    Properties:
      Name: org-cloudtrail-sink-bus

  SlackOrgSinkBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Condition: UseLocalSinkBuses
    Properties:
      Name: org-slack-sink-bus

  AutoScalingOrgSinkBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Condition: UseLocalSinkBuses
    Properties:
      Name: org-autoscaling-sink-bus

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM roles assumed by EventBridge to put events on the organizational buses
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudWatchOrgSinkRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: PRX-CloudWatchOrgSinkRole
      Description: Allows EventBridge to forward CloudWatch alarm events to the organizational CloudWatch event bus.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

        - PolicyName: PutEventsToOrgCloudWatchBus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !Sub
                  - 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${SinkAccount}:event-bus/${BusName}'
                  - SinkAccount: !If [UseLocalSinkBuses, !Ref AWS::AccountId, !Ref OrgSinkAccountId]
                    BusName: !If [UseLocalSinkBuses, !Ref CloudWatchOrgSinkBus, org-cloudwatch-sink-bus]

  CloudFormationOrgSinkRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: PRX-CloudFormationOrgSinkRole
      Description: Allows EventBridge to forward CloudFormation status events to the organizational CloudFormation event bus.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsToOrgCloudFormationBus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !Sub
                  - 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${SinkAccount}:event-bus/${BusName}'
                  - SinkAccount: !If [UseLocalSinkBuses, !Ref AWS::AccountId, !Ref OrgSinkAccountId]

  CloudTrailOrgSinkRole:

              StringEquals:

      Policies:

            Statement:

                Resource: !Sub
                  - 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${SinkAccount}:event-bus/${BusName}'
                  - SinkAccount: !If [UseLocalSinkBuses, !Ref AWS::AccountId, !Ref OrgSinkAccountId]
                    BusName: !If [UseLocalSinkBuses, !Ref CloudTrailOrgSinkBus, org-cloudtrail-sink-bus]

  SlackOrgSinkRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: PRX-SlackOrgSinkRole

  AutoScalingOrgSinkRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: PRX-AutoScalingOrgSinkRole

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsToOrgAutoScalingBus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !Sub

                  - SinkAccount: !If [UseLocalSinkBuses, !Ref AWS::AccountId, !Ref OrgSinkAccountId]
                    BusName: !If [UseLocalSinkBuses, !Ref AutoScalingOrgSinkBus, org-autoscaling-sink-bus]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge rules on the default bus. Dependencies on the conditional local
  # buses are expressed only through ARN construction (!Ref inside !If), so no

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmStateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:

      Description: Forwards CloudWatch alarm state change events to the organizational CloudWatch event bus.

      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudwatch
        detail-type:
          - CloudWatch Alarm State Change
      Targets:
        - Id: org-sink-alarm-state-change
          Arn: !Sub
            - 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${SinkAccount}:event-bus/${BusName}'
            - SinkAccount: !If [UseLocalSinkBuses, !Ref AWS::AccountId, !Ref OrgSinkAccountId]
              BusName: !If [UseLocalSinkBuses, !Ref CloudWatchOrgSinkBus, org-cloudwatch-sink-bus]
          RoleArn: !GetAtt CloudWatchOrgSinkRole.Arn

  CloudFormationStateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: org-sink-cfn-state-change-rule
      Description: Forwards CloudFormation resource, stack, stack set and stack set operation status changes to the organizational CloudFormation event bus.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Creates a customer-managed KMS key with an alias, plus optional EventBridge alerts when the key is scheduled for deletion or disabled.'

# Considerations (comment-only):
# - KeyDeletionAlertRule matches "AWS API Call via CloudTrail" events. CloudTrail management
#   events must be enabled in this account and Region for the rule to fire. This template does
#   not create a CloudTrail trail, because one was not requested.
# - The Fn::ImportValue in KeyDeletionAlertRule is the only cross-stack reference. It is included
#   because it was explicitly requested, and it is evaluated only when HasAlertTopic is true.
#   With the default empty ParentAlertStack, this stack deploys in a greenfield account with no
#   external dependencies.
# - The parent alert stack's SNS topic policy must allow events.amazonaws.com to publish.

Parameters:
  ParentAlertStack:
    Description: 'Optional. Name of the parent alert stack that exports <StackName>-TopicARN. Leave empty to disable deletion and disable alerts.'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-zA-Z][-a-zA-Z0-9]{0,127}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be empty or a valid CloudFormation stack name.'
  Service:
    Description: 'AWS service allowed to use this key. ALL_SERVICES allows any service in this account. S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS also allows public decryption through Amazon S3.'
    Type: String
    Default: 'ALL_SERVICES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'ALL_SERVICES'
      - 'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS'
      - connect
      - dms
      - ssm
      - ec2
      - elasticfilesystem
      - es
      - kinesis
      - kinesisvideo
      - lambda
      - lex
      - redshift
      - rds
      - secretsmanager
      - ses
      - s3
      - importexport
      - sqs
      - workmail
      - workspaces

Conditions:
  HasAlertTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ParentAlertStack, '']]
  HasServiceAllServices: !Equals [!Ref Service, 'ALL_SERVICES']
  HasServiceS3PublicAccess: !Equals [!Ref Service, 'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS']
  HasSpecificService: !Not [!Or [!Condition HasServiceAllServices, !Condition HasServiceS3PublicAccess]]
  HasUnrestrictedCallerAccount: !Or [!Condition HasServiceAllServices, !Condition HasServiceS3PublicAccess]

Resources:
  Key:
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Key'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed KMS key for stack ${AWS::StackName}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - !If
            - HasUnrestrictedCallerAccount
            - Sid: AllowCallerAccountCryptographicOperations
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: '*'
              Action:
                - 'kms:Encrypt'
                - 'kms:Decrypt'
                - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                - 'kms:CreateGrant'
                - 'kms:ListGrants'
                - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - HasSpecificService
            - Sid: AllowCallerAccountCryptographicOperationsViaService
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: '*'
              Action:
                - 'kms:Encrypt'
                - 'kms:Decrypt'
                - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                - 'kms:CreateGrant'
                - 'kms:ListGrants'
                - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                  'kms:ViaService': !Sub '${Service}.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - HasServiceS3PublicAccess
            - Sid: AllowPublicDecryptViaS3
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: '*'
              Action:
                - 'kms:Decrypt'
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  KeyAlias:
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Alias'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref Key

  KeyDeletionAlertRule:
    Type: 'AWS::Events::Rule'
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Alerts when KMS key of stack ${AWS::StackName} is scheduled for deletion or disabled'
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - 'aws.kms'
        detail-type:
          - 'AWS API Call via CloudTrail'
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - 'kms.amazonaws.com'
          eventName:
            - 'ScheduleKeyDeletion'
            - 'DisableKey'
          resources:
            ARN:
              - !GetAtt Key.Arn
      Targets:
        - Id: AlertTopic
          Arn:
            Fn::ImportValue: !Sub '${ParentAlertStack}-TopicARN'

Outputs:
  KeyId:
    Description: 'ID of the customer-managed KMS key.'
    Value: !Ref Key
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyId'
  KeyArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the customer-managed KMS key.'
    Value: !GetAtt Key.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyArn'
  StackName:
    Description: 'Name of this stack.'
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Automates EBS snapshot lifecycle management for web servers with Amazon Data
  Lifecycle Manager (DLM). Creates an IAM role for DLM and an enabled EBS volume
  lifecycle policy that takes daily snapshots, retains a defined count, and copies
  volume tags to snapshots. Deployment requires CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM because the
  IAM role has an explicit name.

Metadata:
  RequiredCapabilities:
    - CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Snapshot Schedule
        Parameters:
          - DailySnapshotScheduledAt
          - SnapshotInterval
          - SnapshotRetainRule
      - Label:
          default: Targeting
        Parameters:
          - LogicalName
          - Environment
          - TagKey
          - TagValue

Parameters:
  DailySnapshotScheduledAt:
    Type: String
    Default: '17:00'
    Description: Daily time (UTC) at which snapshots start, formatted as HH:MM (24-hour clock).
    AllowedPattern: '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid time in HH:MM 24-hour format, e.g. 17:00.

  SnapshotInterval:
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
    Description: Interval in hours between snapshots.
    AllowedValues:
      - 2
      - 3
      - 4
      - 6
      - 8
      - 12
      - 24

  SnapshotRetainRule:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of snapshots to retain for each volume.

  LogicalName:
    Type: String
    Default: WebServers
    Description: Logical name used in the IAM role name and the policy Name tag.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 24
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens (max 24 characters).

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment tag value of the EBS volumes to target.
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - test
      - development

  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: createdby
    Description: Custom tag key that target EBS volumes must have.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128

  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-cloudformation-templates
    Description: Custom tag value that target EBS volumes must have.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256

Resources:
  DataLifecycleManagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalName}-DataLifecycleManager-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Allows Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to create and manage EBS snapshots.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dlm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataLifecycleManagerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageSnapshots
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshots
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: TagSnapshots
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*::snapshot/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref TagKey
          Value: !Ref TagValue

  BasicLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::DLM::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Daily EBS volume snapshot lifecycle policy for web servers
      State: ENABLED
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt DataLifecycleManagerRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        PolicyType: EBS_SNAPSHOT_MANAGEMENT
        ResourceTypes:
          - VOLUME
        TargetTags:
          - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref TagKey
            Value: !Ref TagValue
        Schedules:
          - Name: Daily Snapshots
            CopyTags: true
            CreateRule:
              Interval: !Ref SnapshotInterval
              IntervalUnit: HOURS
              Times:
                - !Ref DailySnapshotScheduledAt
            RetainRule:
              Count: !Ref SnapshotRetainRule
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'policy-${LogicalName}-${AWS::Region}'

Outputs:
  DataLifecycleManagerRoleName:
    Description: Name of the IAM role used by Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager
    Value: !Ref DataLifecycleManagerRole

  DataLifecycleManagerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager
    Value: !GetAtt DataLifecycleManagerRole.Arn

  LifecyclePolicyId:
    Description: ID of the DLM lifecycle policy
    Value: !Ref BasicLifecyclePolicy

  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the DLM lifecycle policy
    Value: !GetAtt BasicLifecyclePolicy.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Enforces account-level S3 Block Public Access daily using an SSM Automation document invoked by a scheduled EventBridge rule. Deploy with CAPABILITY_IAM.

Resources:
  SsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by Systems Manager Automation to enforce account-level S3 Block Public Access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccountPublicAccessBlock
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'

  S3BlockPublicAccessDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables all four S3 Block Public Access settings at the account level for the local account.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run this document.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
          AccountId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the AWS account on which to enforce S3 Block Public Access.
            default: !Ref AWS::AccountId
        mainSteps:
          - name: PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{ AccountId }}'
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true
          - name: VerifyAccountPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            onFailure: Abort
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: GetPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{ AccountId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: BlockPublicAcls
                Selector: $.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.BlockPublicAcls
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: BlockPublicPolicy
                Selector: $.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.BlockPublicPolicy
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: IgnorePublicAcls
                Selector: $.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.IgnorePublicAcls
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: RestrictPublicBuckets
                Selector: $.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.RestrictPublicBuckets
                Type: Boolean

  EventBridgeSsmRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by EventBridge to start the S3 Block Public Access SSM Automation.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
