AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito OAuth2 client-credentials auth layer for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Project name used for naming, tagging, and the Secrets Manager secret path.

  PasswordRequireSymbols:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether the user pool password policy requires at least one symbol.

Conditions:
  RequireSymbols: !Equals [!Ref PasswordRequireSymbols, 'true']

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentcore-gateway-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: !If [RequireSymbols, true, false]
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub
        - '${AWS::Region}-${StackFragment}'
        - StackFragment: !Select
            - 0
            - !Split
              - '-'
              - !Select
                - 2
                - !Split
                  - '/'
                  - !Ref AWS::StackId

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: agentcore-gateway
      Name: agentcore-gateway
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AgentCore Gateway tools
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AgentCore Gateway tools
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AgentCore Gateway

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: agentcore-gateway-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - agentcore-gateway/read
        - agentcore-gateway/write
        - agentcore-gateway/admin
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  SecretWriterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-cognito-secret-writer'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SecretWriterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Cognito client secret writer custom resource
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecretWriterPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub '${SecretWriterLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: ReadCognitoClient
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Sid: ManageClientSecret
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
                  - secretsmanager:TagResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret-??????'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SecretWriterFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-cognito-secret-writer'
      Description: Stores the Cognito app client credentials in Secrets Manager
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SecretWriterRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref SecretWriterLogGroup
        LogFormat: Text
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          secrets = boto3.client("secretsmanager")


          def send_response(event, context, status, data=None, physical_id=None, reason=None):
              body = json.dumps({
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or f"See CloudWatch Logs: {context.log_group_name} {context.log_stream_name}",
                  "PhysicalResourceId": physical_id or event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or context.log_stream_name,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "NoEcho": False,
                  "Data": data or {},
              }).encode("utf-8")
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=body,
                  method="PUT",
                  headers={"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(body))},
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
                  logger.info("CloudFormation response status: %s", response.status)


          def upsert_secret(name, value, project):
              try:
                  return secrets.put_secret_value(SecretId=name, SecretString=value)["ARN"]
              except ClientError as err:
                  if err.response["Error"]["Code"] != "ResourceNotFoundException":
                      raise
              return secrets.create_secret(
                  Name=name,
                  Description="Cognito OAuth2 client credentials for AgentCore Gateway",
                  SecretString=value,
                  Tags=[{"Key": "Project", "Value": project}],
              )["ARN"]


          def delete_secret(name):
              try:
                  secrets.delete_secret(SecretId=name, ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True)
                  logger.info("Force-deleted secret %s", name)
              except ClientError as err:
                  if err.response["Error"]["Code"] != "ResourceNotFoundException":
                      raise
                  logger.info("Secret %s not found; nothing to delete", name)


          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received %s request for %s", event["RequestType"], event["LogicalResourceId"])
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              secret_name = props["SecretName"]
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      # Only delete when the physical ID is the secret this resource created.
                      if event.get("PhysicalResourceId") == secret_name:
                          delete_secret(secret_name)
                      send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS")
                      return

                  client = cognito.describe_user_pool_client(
                      UserPoolId=props["UserPoolId"],
                      ClientId=props["ClientId"],
                  )["UserPoolClient"]
                  value = json.dumps({
                      "client_id": client["ClientId"],
                      "client_secret": client["ClientSecret"],
                      "user_pool_id": props["UserPoolId"],
                  })
                  arn = upsert_secret(secret_name, value, props["ProjectName"])
                  send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", {"SecretArn": arn}, physical_id=secret_name)
              except Exception as exc:
                  logger.exception("Custom resource failed")
                  send_response(event, context, "FAILED", reason=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"[:1000])

  ClientSecretWriter:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SecretWriterFunction.Arn
      ServiceTimeout: 300
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
      SecretName: !Sub '${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret'
      ProjectName: !Ref ProjectName

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/discovery-url
      Type: String
      Description: OIDC discovery URL for the AgentCore Gateway Cognito user pool
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  ClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/client-id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito app client ID for the AgentCore Gateway
      Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito user pool ID for the AgentCore Gateway
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  UserPoolArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-arn
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito user pool ARN for the AgentCore Gateway
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  DomainUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/domain-url
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito hosted domain URL for the AgentCore Gateway
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn'

  ClientId:
    Description: Cognito app client ID
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClientId'

  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OIDC discovery URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DiscoveryUrl'

  DomainUrl:
    Description: Cognito hosted domain URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DomainUrl'

  TokenEndpointUrl:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL for the client credentials flow
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TokenEndpointUrl'

  Scopes:
    Description: Space-separated list of OAuth2 scopes granted to the app client
    Value: agentcore-gateway/read agentcore-gateway/write agentcore-gateway/admin
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Scopes'

  DiscoveryUrlParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name holding the OIDC discovery URL
    Value: !Ref DiscoveryUrlParameter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DiscoveryUrlParameterName'

  ClientIdParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name holding the app client ID
    Value: !Ref ClientIdParameter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClientIdParameterName'

  UserPoolIdParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name holding the user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPoolIdParameter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolIdParameterName'

  UserPoolArnParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name holding the user pool ARN
    Value: !Ref UserPoolArnParameter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArnParameterName'

  DomainUrlParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name holding the hosted domain URL
    Value: !Ref DomainUrlParameter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DomainUrlParameterName'

  ClientSecretName:
    Description: Secrets Manager secret name holding the client credentials
    Value: !Ref ClientSecretWriter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClientSecretName'

  ClientSecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager secret ARN holding the client credentials
    Value: !GetAtt ClientSecretWriter.SecretArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClientSecretArn'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cognito identity bootstrap for the multi-tenant SaaS Operations application.
  Creates the pooled tenant user pool, app client, hosted domain, and identity pool;
  the operations users pool, app client, hosted domain, SystemAdmins group, and identity pool;
  tag-based authenticated pooled and siloed IAM roles scoped to DynamoDB; and OIDC
  identity provider registrations for each user pool.

Parameters:
  TenantCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Host name (optionally with port) of the tenant application, without scheme or path.
    Default: localhost
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]+)?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a host name with an optional port, without a scheme or path.
  AdminCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Host name (optionally with port) of the admin application, without scheme or path.
    Default: localhost
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]+)?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a host name with an optional port, without a scheme or path.
  SiloedTenantRoleName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the IAM role assumed by authenticated siloed tenant users.
    Default: authenticated-siloed-user-role
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IAM role name.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pooled tenant user pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PooledTenantUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: Your temporary password for the SaaS Operations tenant application
          EmailMessage: !Sub "Log in to the tenant application at https://${TenantCallbackHost}/ with username {username} and temporary password {####}"
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true

  PooledTenantUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${TenantCallbackHost}"
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${TenantCallbackHost}"
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  PooledTenantUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool
      Domain: !Sub "pooledtenant-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}"

  PooledTenantIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt PooledTenantUserPool.ProviderName

  PooledTenantIdentityPoolPrincipalTag:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolPrincipalTag
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
      IdentityProviderName: !GetAtt PooledTenantUserPool.ProviderName
      UseDefaults: false
      PrincipalTags:
        tenantId: custom:tenantId
        userRole: custom:userRole

  PooledTenantIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedPooledUserRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Authenticated pooled user role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuthenticatedPooledUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: authenticated-pooled-user-role
      Description: Role assumed by authenticated pooled tenant and operations users through Cognito identity pools.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud:
                  - !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
                  - !Ref OperationsUserIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PooledTenantDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TenantItemAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-pooled"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-pooled/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-pooled"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-pooled/index/*"
                Condition:
                  ForAllValues:StringLike:
                    dynamodb:LeadingKeys:
                      - "${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}-*"
              - Sid: TenantAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-TenantUserMapping"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-TenantUserMapping/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-TenantDetails"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-TenantDetails/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-TenantStackMapping"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-TenantStackMapping/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-Settings"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-Settings/index/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: TenantAdmin
              - Sid: SystemAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: SystemAdmin

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Authenticated siloed user role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuthenticatedSiloedUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SiloedTenantRoleName
      Description: Role assumed by authenticated siloed tenant users; table access is scoped by session principal tags.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SiloedTenantDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TenantItemAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}/index/*"
              - Sid: TenantAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-TenantUserMapping"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-TenantUserMapping/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-TenantDetails"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-TenantDetails/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-TenantStackMapping"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-TenantStackMapping/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-Settings"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/SaaSOperations-Settings/index/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: TenantAdmin
              - Sid: SystemAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: SystemAdmin

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Operations users pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OperationUsersUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: OperationUsers-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: Your temporary password for the SaaS Operations admin application
          EmailMessage: !Sub "Log in to the admin application at https://${AdminCallbackHost}/ with username {username} and temporary password {####}"
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        - Name: apiKey
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true

  OperationUsersUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsOperationUsersPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${AdminCallbackHost}"
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${AdminCallbackHost}"
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
        - custom:apiKey
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  OperationUsersUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool
      Domain: !Sub "operationsusers-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}"

  SystemAdminsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdmins
      Description: System administrators of the SaaS Operations application.
      Precedence: 0
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool

  OperationsUserIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: OperationsUser-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt OperationUsersUserPool.ProviderName

  OperationsUserIdentityPoolPrincipalTag:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolPrincipalTag
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref OperationsUserIdentityPool
      IdentityProviderName: !GetAtt OperationUsersUserPool.ProviderName
      UseDefaults: false
      PrincipalTags:
        tenantId: custom:tenantId
        userRole: custom:userRole

  OperationsUserIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref OperationsUserIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedPooledUserRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # OIDC identity provider registrations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PooledTenantOidcIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool
      ProviderName: Cognito
      ProviderType: OIDC
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref PooledTenantUserPoolClient
        authorize_scopes: openid email profile
        attributes_request_method: GET
        oidc_issuer: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PooledTenantUserPool}"
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email

  OperationUsersOidcIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool
      ProviderName: Cognito
      ProviderType: OIDC
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref OperationUsersUserPoolClient
        authorize_scopes: openid email profile
        attributes_request_method: GET
        oidc_issuer: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${OperationUsersUserPool}"
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Reusable, parameter-driven DynamoDB table stack with optional sort key, extra
  attribute definitions, global secondary indexes, TTL, streams, provisioned
  capacity with auto scaling or on-demand billing, point-in-time recovery,
  optional SSE with the AWS managed KMS key, AWS Backup protection, and optional
  CloudWatch alarms with SNS notifications.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Table Keys
        Parameters:
          - TableName
          - PartitionKeyName
          - PartitionKeyType
          - SortKeyName
          - SortKeyType
      - Label:
          default: Additional Attribute Definitions
        Parameters:
          - Attribute1Name
          - Attribute1Type
          - Attribute2Name
          - Attribute2Type
          - Attribute3Name
          - Attribute3Type
      - Label:
          default: Global Secondary Indexes
        Parameters:
          - Index1Name
          - Index1PartitionKeyName
          - Index1SortKeyName
          - Index2Name
          - Index2PartitionKeyName
          - Index2SortKeyName
      - Label:
          default: Table Features
        Parameters:
          - TimeToLiveAttribute
          - StreamViewType
          - PointInTimeRecovery
          - ServerSideEncryption
      - Label:
          default: Capacity
        Parameters:
          - BillingMode
          - ReadMinCapacity
          - ReadMaxCapacity
          - WriteMinCapacity
          - WriteMaxCapacity
          - TargetUtilization
      - Label:
          default: Backup and Alerting
        Parameters:
          - BackupRetentionDays
          - EnableAlerts

Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the partition (HASH) key attribute.
    Default: id
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-255 characters of letters, numbers, underscore, period, or hyphen.
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Type of the partition key attribute.
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Default: S
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional table name. Leave empty to let CloudFormation generate a name.
    Default: ''
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional sort (RANGE) key attribute name.
    Default: ''
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Type of the sort key attribute.
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Default: N
  Attribute1Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional extra attribute definition name (for use as a GSI key).
    Default: ''
  Attribute1Type:
    Type: String
    Description: Type of extra attribute 1.
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Default: S
  Attribute2Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional extra attribute definition name (for use as a GSI key).
    Default: ''
  Attribute2Type:
    Type: String
    Description: Type of extra attribute 2.
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Default: S
  Attribute3Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional extra attribute definition name (for use as a GSI key).
    Default: ''
  Attribute3Type:
    Type: String
    Description: Type of extra attribute 3.
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Default: S
  Index1Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional name of global secondary index 1.
    Default: ''
  Index1PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Partition key attribute of global secondary index 1.
    Default: ''
  Index1SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional sort key attribute of global secondary index 1.
    Default: ''
  Index2Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional name of global secondary index 2.
    Default: ''
  Index2PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Partition key attribute of global secondary index 2.
    Default: ''
  Index2SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional sort key attribute of global secondary index 2.
    Default: ''
  TimeToLiveAttribute:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional attribute name used for Time to Live.
    Default: ''
  StreamViewType:
    Type: String
    Description: DynamoDB stream view type, or DISABLED to turn streams off.
    AllowedValues: [DISABLED, NEW_IMAGE, OLD_IMAGE, NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES, KEYS_ONLY]
    Default: DISABLED
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Description: Provisioned capacity with auto scaling, or on-demand billing.
    AllowedValues: [PROVISIONED, PAY_PER_REQUEST]
    Default: PROVISIONED
  ReadMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Minimum read capacity units for auto scaling.
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  ReadMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum read capacity units for auto scaling.
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  WriteMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Minimum write capacity units for auto scaling.
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  WriteMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum write capacity units for auto scaling.
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  TargetUtilization:
    Type: Number
    Description: Target capacity utilization percentage for auto scaling.
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 20
    MaxValue: 90
  PointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery.
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
  ServerSideEncryption:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable server-side encryption with the AWS managed aws/dynamodb KMS key.
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'
  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: AWS Backup retention in days. Set to 0 to disable AWS Backup entirely.
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
  EnableAlerts:
    Type: String
    Description: Create an SNS alert topic, CloudWatch alarms, and backup vault notifications.
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  HasAttribute1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute1Name, '']]
  HasAttribute2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute2Name, '']]
  HasAttribute3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute3Name, '']]
  HasIndex1: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref Index1Name, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref Index1PartitionKeyName, '']]
  HasIndex1SortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Index1SortKeyName, '']]
  HasIndex2: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref Index2Name, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref Index2PartitionKeyName, '']]
  HasIndex2SortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Index2SortKeyName, '']]
  HasAnyIndex: !Or
    - !Condition HasIndex1
    - !Condition HasIndex2
  HasTTL: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TimeToLiveAttribute, '']]
  HasStream: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, DISABLED]]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, PROVISIONED]
  EnablePITR: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecovery, 'true']
  EnableSSE: !Equals [!Ref ServerSideEncryption, 'true']
  EnableBackup: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, 0]]
  EnableAlerting: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlerts, 'true']
  EnableBackupAlerting: !And
    - !Condition EnableBackup
    - !Condition EnableAlerting

Resources:
  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !If [HasTableName, !Ref TableName, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasAttribute1
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute1Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasAttribute2
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute2Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasAttribute3
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute3Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes: !If
        - HasAnyIndex
        - - !If
            - HasIndex1
            - IndexName: !Ref Index1Name
              KeySchema:
                - AttributeName: !Ref Index1PartitionKeyName
                  KeyType: HASH
                - !If
                  - HasIndex1SortKey
                  - AttributeName: !Ref Index1SortKeyName
                    KeyType: RANGE
                  - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
              Projection:
                ProjectionType: ALL
              ProvisionedThroughput: !If
                - IsProvisioned
                - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
                  WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - HasIndex2
            - IndexName: !Ref Index2Name
              KeySchema:
                - AttributeName: !Ref Index2PartitionKeyName
                  KeyType: HASH
                - !If
                  - HasIndex2SortKey
                  - AttributeName: !Ref Index2SortKeyName
                    KeyType: RANGE
                  - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
              Projection:
                ProjectionType: ALL
              ProvisionedThroughput: !If
                - IsProvisioned
                - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
                  WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTTL
        - AttributeName: !Ref TimeToLiveAttribute
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - HasStream
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [EnablePITR, true, false]
      SSESpecification: !If
        - EnableSSE
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      Description: Allows Application Auto Scaling to manage DynamoDB table capacity.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScaling
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt Table.Arn
                  - !Sub '${Table.Arn}/index/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                Resource: '*'

  ReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${Table}'
      MinCapacity: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ReadMaxCapacity
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  WriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${Table}'
      MinCapacity: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
      MaxCapacity: !Ref WriteMaxCapacity
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  ReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-read-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  WriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-write-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref WriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

  AlertTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: EnableAlerting
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key encrypting the DynamoDB alert SNS topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowServicePublishers
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: EnableAlerting
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} DynamoDB alerts'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AlertTopicKey

  AlertTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Condition: EnableBackupAlerting
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBackupPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlertTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  BackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vault'
      Notifications: !If
        - EnableAlerting
        - SNSTopicArn: !Ref AlertTopic
          BackupVaultEvents:
            - BACKUP_JOB_STARTED
            - BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED
            - RESTORE_JOB_STARTED
            - RESTORE_JOB_COMPLETED
            - RECOVERY_POINT_MODIFIED
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyBackup
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 * * ? *)
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 1440
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref BackupRetentionDays

  BackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      Description: Allows AWS Backup to back up the DynamoDB table.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBBackup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:CreateBackup
                  - dynamodb:StartAwsBackupJob
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeBackup
                  - dynamodb:DeleteBackup
                Resource: !Sub '${Table.Arn}/backup/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:ListBackups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - backup:DescribeBackupVault
                  - backup:CopyIntoBackupVault
                Resource: !GetAtt BackupVault.BackupVaultArn

  BackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-table'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - !GetAtt Table.Arn

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm

    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Read throttle events on DynamoDB table ${Table}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerting

      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents

      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

        - !Ref AlertTopic

      AlarmActions:

          ReturnData: true
        - Id: getitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: GetItem
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: putitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: PutItem
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: updateitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: UpdateItem
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: deleteitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: DeleteItem
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: query
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: Query
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: scan
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: Scan
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: batchgetitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: BatchGetItem
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: batchwriteitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ThrottledRequests
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: BatchWriteItem
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerting
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'DynamoDB user errors in ${AWS::Region} (account-level metric) for stack ${AWS::StackName}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerting
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'System errors across operations on DynamoDB table ${Table}'
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

        - !Ref AlertTopic
      Metrics:
        - Id: total
          Expression: SUM(METRICS())
          Label: SystemErrors
          ReturnData: true
        - Id: getitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: GetItem
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: putitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: PutItem
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: updateitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: UpdateItem
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: deleteitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: DeleteItem
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: query
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation

            Metric:

                - Name: Operation

        - Id: batchgetitem

            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: DynamoDB table set for the account-vending (talr) automation tool, including Application Auto Scaling for the accountInfo and taskStatus tables.

Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment stage appended to every table name (alphanumeric only).
    Default: 'dev'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    ConstraintDescription: Stage must be 1-32 alphanumeric characters.

Resources:
  CbInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-cbInfo-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  AccountInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: gsiRequestId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: requestId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: KEYS_ONLY
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - IndexName: gsiAccountId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: accountId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  TaskStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  NipapCfnTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-nipapCfn-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  OpsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-ops-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: layer
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: layer
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  DxInterfaceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-dxInterface-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: vlan
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: vlan
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ClaStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-claStatus-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ConfigRulesComplianceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-configRulesCompliance-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by Application Auto Scaling to adjust talr DynamoDB capacity.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: talr-dynamodb-autoscaling
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBCapacityManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AccountInfoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AccountInfoTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt TaskStatusTable.Arn
              - Sid: CloudWatchAlarmManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetricRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                Resource: '*'

  AccountInfoTableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoTableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  GsiRequestIdReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  GsiRequestIdWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  GsiAccountIdReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  GsiAccountIdWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  TaskStatusTableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${TaskStatusTable}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  TaskStatusTableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${TaskStatusTable}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Highly available network foundation and ECS cluster for a containerised Streamlit application

Parameters:
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the first availability zone
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the second availability zone
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the first availability zone
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the second availability zone
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public subnets are public via the IGW route; public IPs are not auto-assigned
  # (AWS-0164). Workloads needing one should request it per ENI or use an EIP.
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-az1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-az2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-az1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-az2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az1'

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az2'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-az1'

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-az2'

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 7

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlog-role'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlog'

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-cluster'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  VpcCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in the first availability zone
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in the second availability zone
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the first availability zone
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the second availability zone
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'
  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway in the first availability zone
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1Id'
  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway in the second availability zone
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2Id'
  EcsClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EcsClusterName'
  EcsClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS cluster
    Value: !GetAtt EcsCluster.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EcsClusterArn'
  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group receiving VPC flow logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogGroupName'
