AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Service Catalog preventive-controls test environment: private VPC, subnets,
  security groups, KMS key, DMS and ElastiCache subnet groups, SageMaker
  execution role and Service Catalog launch roles. Deploy with
  CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM because dms-vpc-role has a fixed name required by DMS.
  The stack fails if dms-vpc-role already exists, which is acceptable in a
  greenfield account. Subnets are private with no IGW, NAT or public routes.

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-preventive-controls-test-vpc

  SubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-preventive-controls-test-subnet-a

  SubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 172.16.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-preventive-controls-test-subnet-b

  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service Catalog preventive-controls test resources
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS within the VPC only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-preventive-controls-test-sg

  TestSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS between test resources

  CacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Cache security group for ElastiCache test clusters
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
          Description: Redis replication traffic within the VPC only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-preventive-controls-test-cache-sg

  CacheSecurityGroupIngressFromTest:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref CacheSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 6379
      ToPort: 6379
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
      Description: Redis access from test resources

  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      Description: DMS service role for VPC management
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole

  DmsReplicationSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DMS::ReplicationSubnetGroup
    DependsOn: DmsVpcRole
    Properties:
      ReplicationSubnetGroupDescription: DMS replication subnet group for Service Catalog preventive-controls tests
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetA
        - !Ref SubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-preventive-controls-test-dms-subnet-group

  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: ElastiCache subnet group for Service Catalog preventive-controls tests
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetA
        - !Ref SubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-preventive-controls-test-cache-subnet-group

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SageMaker execution role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sagemaker-execution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [logs:CreateLogGroup, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents, logs:DescribeLogStreams]
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    cloudwatch:namespace: [/aws/sagemaker/*, aws/sagemaker/*]
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability, ecr:BatchGetImage, ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer]
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:ListBucket, s3:GetBucketLocation]

                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-*

              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission, ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface, ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission, ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces, ec2:DescribeVpcs, ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions, ec2:DescribeSubnets, ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless AI campaign orchestration platform (Step Functions, Lambda, Bedrock, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito HTTP API, optional OpenSearch Serverless, monitoring). All resources are created in-template.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: aicampaign
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,19}$'
    Description: Lowercase application name prefix.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, prod]
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment.
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: amazon.nova-lite-v1:0
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9.:-]+$'
    Description: Bedrock foundation model ID.
  SenderEmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: noreply@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    Description: Sender email address; example.com values simulate delivery.
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: alerts@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    Description: Alarm email; skipped when empty or the placeholder.
  SmsOriginationIdentity:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-ORIGINATION-ID
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_+:/-]{1,256}$'
    Description: SMS origination identity; PLACEHOLDER values simulate delivery.
  SmsConfigurationSetName:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder-config-set
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'
    Description: SMS configuration set name.
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Create the OpenSearch Serverless vector collection.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]
    Description: Log retention in days.

Conditions:
  SemanticSearchEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, 'true']
  CreateAlarmEmailSubscription: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, alerts@example.com]]

Resources:
  DataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName} data key'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'}
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'}
            Action: [kms:Encrypt*, kms:Decrypt*, kms:ReEncrypt*, kms:GenerateDataKey*, kms:Describe*]
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
          - Sid: TopicPublishers
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: [cloudwatch.amazonaws.com, ses.amazonaws.com, sms-voice.amazonaws.com]}
            Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey*]
            Resource: '*'
      Tags: [{Key: Environment, Value: !Ref EnvironmentName}]

  DataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-data'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataKey

  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: customerId, AttributeType: S}
        - {AttributeName: segment, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema: [{AttributeName: customerId, KeyType: HASH}]
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: segment-index
          KeySchema: [{AttributeName: segment, KeyType: HASH}]
          Projection: {ProjectionType: ALL}
      SSESpecification: {SSEEnabled: true, SSEType: KMS, KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref DataKey}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}
      Tags: [{Key: Environment, Value: !Ref EnvironmentName}]

  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions: [{AttributeName: channel, AttributeType: S}]
      KeySchema: [{AttributeName: channel, KeyType: HASH}]
      TimeToLiveSpecification: {AttributeName: expiresAt, Enabled: true}
      SSESpecification: {SSEEnabled: true, SSEType: KMS, KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref DataKey}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}
      Tags: [{Key: Environment, Value: !Ref EnvironmentName}]

  DeliveryTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: messageId, AttributeType: S}
        - {AttributeName: campaignId, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema: [{AttributeName: messageId, KeyType: HASH}]
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: campaignId-index
          KeySchema: [{AttributeName: campaignId, KeyType: HASH}]
          Projection: {ProjectionType: ALL}
      TimeToLiveSpecification: {AttributeName: expiresAt, Enabled: true}
      SSESpecification: {SSEEnabled: true, SSEType: KMS, KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref DataKey}

          SEARCH_INDEX: customer-profiles
      Tags: [{Key: Environment, Value: !Ref EnvironmentName}]
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import hashlib,json,os,urllib.request,boto3
          from decimal import Decimal
          from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Key
          from botocore.auth import SigV4Auth
          from botocore.awsrequest import AWSRequest
          d=boto3.resource('dynamodb');t=d.Table(os.environ['CUSTOMER_PROFILES_TABLE']);N=int(os.environ['MAX_AUDIENCE']);E=os.environ['SEARCH_ENDPOINT']
          F=('customerId','firstName','email','phone','preferredChannel','engagement','optIn')
          def search(q):
           u=E+'/'+os.environ['SEARCH_INDEX']+'/_search';b=json.dumps({'size':N,'_source':['customerId'],'query':{'match':{'profileText':q}}}).encode()
           r=AWSRequest('POST',u,data=b,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Amz-Content-SHA256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
           SigV4Auth(boto3.Session().get_credentials(),'aoss',os.environ['AWS_REGION']).add_auth(r)
           h=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(u,data=b,headers=dict(r.headers.items()),method='POST'),timeout=10).read())['hits']['hits']
           ids=[x['_source']['customerId'] for x in h if x.get('_source',{}).get('customerId')];o=[]
           for k in range(0,len(ids),100):o+=d.batch_get_item(RequestItems={t.name:{'Keys':[{'customerId':i} for i in ids[k:k+100]]}})['Responses'].get(t.name,[])
           return o
          def scan(g):
           k={'Limit':N};op=t.scan;o=[]
           if g:op=t.query;k.update(IndexName='segment-index',KeyConditionExpression=Key('segment').eq(g))
           while len(o)<N:
            r=op(**k);o+=r.get('Items',[])
            if 'LastEvaluatedKey' not in r:break
            k['ExclusiveStartKey']=r['LastEvaluatedKey']
           return o
          def handler(e,c):
           p=e.get('plan') or {};g=p.get('segment');i=[]
           if E:
            try:i=search(g or p.get('goal',''))
            except Exception as x:print(json.dumps({'level':'WARN','message':'semantic search unavailable','error':str(x)}))
           i=i or scan(g)
           a=[{k:v[k] for k in F if k in v} for v in i if v.get('optIn',True) is not False][:N]
           e['audience']=json.loads(json.dumps(a,default=lambda o:float(o) if isinstance(o,Decimal) else str(o)))
           e['audienceSize']=len(a)
           return e

          import json,os,time,uuid,boto3

          DL=int(os.environ['DEFAULT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE']);TTL=int(os.environ['TRACKING_TTL_DAYS'])*86400
          def allow(ch,lim):

           m=int(time.time()//60)
           try:L.update_item(Key={'channel':'%s#%d'%(ch,m)},UpdateExpression='ADD sentCount :o SET expiresAt=:t',ConditionExpression='attribute_not_exists(sentCount) OR sentCount<:m',ExpressionAttributeValues={':o':1,':m':lim[ch],':t':m*60+3600});return True
           except ClientError as x:
            if x.response['Error']['Code']=='ConditionalCheckFailedException':return False
            raise
          def send(ch,u,ct):

           if not sub or json.loads(x.get('input') or '{}').get('requestedBy')!=sub:return r(404,{'message':'Campaign not found'})
           n={};out=None;k={'IndexName':'campaignId-index','KeyConditionExpression':Key('campaignId').eq(cid),'ProjectionExpression':'#s,recordType','ExpressionAttributeNames':{'#s':'status'}}
           while True:
            q=T.query(**k)
            for i in q.get('Items',[]):
             if i.get('recordType')=='SUMMARY':out=i.get('status')
             else:n[i.get('status','UNKNOWN')]=n.get(i.get('status','UNKNOWN'),0)+1
            if 'LastEvaluatedKey' not in q:break
            k['ExclusiveStartKey']=q['LastEvaluatedKey']
           return r(200,{'campaignId':cid,'executionStatus':x['status'],'startDate':x.get('startDate'),'stopDate':x.get('stopDate'),'outcome':out,'deliveries':n})

  DeliveryCallbackFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-delivery-callback'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Architectures: [arm64]
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
      TracingConfig: {Mode: Active}
      LoggingConfig: {LogFormat: JSON, LogGroup: !Ref PipelineLogGroup}
      Environment: {Variables: {DELIVERY_TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable}}
      Tags: [{Key: Environment, Value: !Ref EnvironmentName}]
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,boto3
          from datetime import datetime,timezone
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
          T=boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['DELIVERY_TRACKING_TABLE'])
          def handler(e,c):
           n=0
           for rec in e.get('Records',[]):
            try:m=json.loads(rec['Sns']['Message'])
            except (KeyError,TypeError,ValueError):continue
            if not isinstance(m,dict):continue
            ml=m.get('mail') if isinstance(m.get('mail'),dict) else m
            mid=ml.get('messageId');ts=ml.get('timestamp') or m.get('eventTimestamp')
            st=str(m.get('eventType') or m.get('notificationType') or m.get('messageStatus') or 'UNKNOWN').upper()
            if not mid:continue
            now=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
            try:T.update_item(Key={'messageId':mid},UpdateExpression='SET #s=:s,deliveryStatusAt=:e,updatedAt=:u',ConditionExpression='attribute_exists(messageId)',ExpressionAttributeNames={'#s':'status'},ExpressionAttributeValues={':s':st,':e':str(ts or now),':u':now});n+=1
            except ClientError as x:
             if x.response['Error']['Code']!='ConditionalCheckFailedException':raise
           return {'updated':n}

  CampaignStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-orchestrator'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: false
        Destinations: [{CloudWatchLogsLogGroup: {LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}}]
      TracingConfiguration: {Enabled: true}
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        L: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::lambda:invoke'
        Parse: !GetAtt ParseInstructionFunction.Arn
        Segment: !GetAtt SegmentCustomersFunction.Arn
        Predict: !GetAtt PredictChannelFunction.Arn
        Safety: !GetAtt SafetyCheckFunction.Arn
        Adapt: !GetAtt AdaptContentFunction.Arn
        Deliver: !GetAtt DeliverMessagesFunction.Arn
        Record: !GetAtt RecordResultsFunction.Arn
      Definition:
        StartAt: ParseInstruction
        TimeoutSeconds: 3600
        States:
          ParseInstruction: {Type: Task, Resource: '${L}', Parameters: {FunctionName: '${Parse}', Payload.$: '$'}, OutputPath: '$.Payload', Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.SdkClientException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 3, BackoffRate: 2}], Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: '$.error', Next: RecordResults}], Next: SegmentCustomers}
          SegmentCustomers: {Type: Task, Resource: '${L}', Parameters: {FunctionName: '${Segment}', Payload.$: '$'}, OutputPath: '$.Payload', Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.SdkClientException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 3, BackoffRate: 2}], Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: '$.error', Next: RecordResults}], Next: CheckAudience}
          CheckAudience: {Type: Choice, Choices: [{Variable: '$.audienceSize', NumericEquals: 0, Next: RecordResults}], Default: PredictChannels}
          PredictChannels: {Type: Task, Resource: '${L}', Parameters: {FunctionName: '${Predict}', Payload.$: '$'}, OutputPath: '$.Payload', Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.SdkClientException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 3, BackoffRate: 2}], Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: '$.error', Next: RecordResults}], Next: SafetyCheck}
          SafetyCheck: {Type: Task, Resource: '${L}', Parameters: {FunctionName: '${Safety}', Payload.$: '$'}, OutputPath: '$.Payload', Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.SdkClientException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 3, BackoffRate: 2}], Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: '$.error', Next: RecordResults}], Next: SafetyDecision}
          SafetyDecision: {Type: Choice, Choices: [{Variable: '$.safety.safe', BooleanEquals: true, Next: AdaptContent}], Default: RecordResults}
          AdaptContent: {Type: Task, Resource: '${L}', Parameters: {FunctionName: '${Adapt}', Payload.$: '$'}, OutputPath: '$.Payload', Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.SdkClientException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 3, BackoffRate: 2}], Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: '$.error', Next: RecordResults}], Next: DeliverMessages}
          DeliverMessages: {Type: Task, Resource: '${L}', Parameters: {FunctionName: '${Deliver}', Payload.$: '$'}, OutputPath: '$.Payload', TimeoutSeconds: 330, Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.SdkClientException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 2, BackoffRate: 2}], Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: '$.error', Next: RecordResults}], Next: RecordResults}
          RecordResults: {Type: Task, Resource: '${L}', Parameters: {FunctionName: '${Record}', Payload.$: '$'}, OutputPath: '$.Payload', Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.SdkClientException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 3, BackoffRate: 2}], Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: '$.recordError', Next: PipelineFailed}], Next: FinalStatus}
          FinalStatus: {Type: Choice, Choices: [{Variable: '$.error', IsPresent: true, Next: PipelineFailed}, {And: [{Variable: '$.safety.safe', IsPresent: true}, {Variable: '$.safety.safe', BooleanEquals: false}], Next: ContentBlocked}], Default: CampaignSucceeded}
          ContentBlocked: {Type: Fail, Error: ContentBlocked, Cause: Campaign content did not pass the safety check}
          PipelineFailed: {Type: Fail, Error: CampaignPipelineFailed, Cause: A campaign pipeline step failed}
          CampaignSucceeded: {Type: Succeed}
      Tags: [{Key: Environment, Value: !Ref EnvironmentName}]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless URL shortener - DynamoDB table, two Python Lambda functions (create and
  retrieve) sharing one execution role, a regional REST API, and a test stage with
  account-level API Gateway CloudWatch logging.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener-table
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,200}$'
    Description: >-
      Base name of the DynamoDB table that stores short identifiers. A stack-unique
      suffix is appended to form the physical table name.
  FunctionPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{1,40}$'
    Description: Prefix used to name the Lambda functions, role, log groups and API.
  PythonRuntime:
    Type: String
    Default: python3.12
    AllowedValues:
      - python3.12
      - python3.11
    Description: Python runtime for the Lambda functions.
  AppUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional custom base URL for shortened links (e.g. https://sho.rt). Leave empty to
      use the API Gateway test stage URL.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Environment tag value.
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Service tag value.
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: platform-team
    Description: Owner tag value.

Conditions:
  UseCustomAppUrl: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AppUrl, '']]

Resources:
  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: RetainExceptOnCreate
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-${StackSuffix}'
        - StackSuffix: !Select
            - 4
            - !Split
              - '-'
              - !Select
                - 2
                - !Split
                  - '/'
                  - !Ref AWS::StackId
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: shortid
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: shortid
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  CreateFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${FunctionPrefix}-create
      RetentionInDays: 30

  RetrieveFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${FunctionPrefix}-retrieve
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/apigateway/${FunctionPrefix}-api-access
      RetentionInDays: 30

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${FunctionPrefix}-lambda-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub ${FunctionPrefix}-lambda-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CreateFunctionLogGroup.Arn
                  - !GetAtt RetrieveFunctionLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  CreateFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CreateFunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${FunctionPrefix}-create
      Description: Generates a random short identifier and stores it against a long URL.
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref Table
          APP_URL: !If
            - UseCustomAppUrl
            - !Ref AppUrl
            - !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/test
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import secrets
          import string
          from urllib.parse import urlparse

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          TABLE = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TABLE_NAME"])
          APP_URL = os.environ["APP_URL"].rstrip("/")
          ALPHABET = string.ascii_letters + string.digits
          MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5


          def _response(status, body):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(body),
              }


          def _generate_id():
              length = 12 + secrets.randbelow(5)
              return "".join(secrets.choice(ALPHABET) for _ in range(length))


          def _valid_url(value):
              if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > 2048:
                  return False
              parsed = urlparse(value)
              return parsed.scheme in ("http", "https") and bool(parsed.netloc)


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get("body") or "{}")
              except (TypeError, ValueError):
                  return _response(400, {"error": "Request body must be valid JSON"})
              if not isinstance(body, dict):
                  return _response(400, {"error": "Request body must be a JSON object"})

              long_url = body.get("long_url") or body.get("url")
              if not _valid_url(long_url):
                  return _response(400, {"error": "A valid http(s) long_url is required"})

              for _ in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):
                  short_id = _generate_id()
                  try:
                      TABLE.put_item(
                          Item={"shortid": short_id, "long_url": long_url},
                          ConditionExpression="attribute_not_exists(shortid)",
                      )
                  except ClientError as err:
                      if err.response["Error"]["Code"] == "ConditionalCheckFailedException":
                          continue
                      print(f"DynamoDB error: {err}")
                      return _response(500, {"error": "Could not store URL"})
                  return _response(
                      201,
                      {
                          "short_id": short_id,
                          "short_url": f"{APP_URL}/{short_id}",
                          "long_url": long_url,
                      },
                  )

              return _response(500, {"error": "Could not generate a unique identifier"})
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  RetrieveFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: RetrieveFunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${FunctionPrefix}-retrieve
      Description: Looks up a short identifier and redirects to the original URL.
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref Table
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import re

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          TABLE = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TABLE_NAME"])
          ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9]{12,16}$")


          def _error(status, message):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"error": message}),
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              short_id = (event.get("pathParameters") or {}).get("shortid", "")
              if not ID_PATTERN.match(short_id):
                  return _error(400, "Invalid short identifier")

              try:
                  result = TABLE.get_item(Key={"shortid": short_id})
              except ClientError as err:
                  print(f"DynamoDB error: {err}")
                  return _error(500, "Could not look up URL")

              item = result.get("Item")
              if not item:
                  return _error(404, "Short link not found")

              return {
                  "statusCode": 301,
                  "headers": {"Location": item["long_url"], "Cache-Control": "no-cache"},
                  "body": "",
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${FunctionPrefix}-api
      Description: Serverless URL shortener API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  AppResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: app

  AdminResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: admin

  ShortIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: '{shortid}'

  CreateMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref AppResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateFunction.Arn}/invocations

  RetrieveMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ShortIdResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.shortid: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${RetrieveFunction.Arn}/invocations

  # Placeholder: replace this MOCK integration if an admin backend function is required.
  AdminMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref AdminResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Admin endpoint placeholder"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

  CreateFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/POST/app

  RetrieveFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref RetrieveFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/GET/*

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - CreateMethod
      - RetrieveMethod
      - AdminMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: URL shortener API deployment

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      StageName: test
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      TracingEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status","responseLength":"$context.responseLength"}'
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          MetricsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

Outputs:

    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref Table
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt Table.Arn
  CreateFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the create Lambda function
    Value: !Ref CreateFunction
  CreateFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the create Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt CreateFunction.Arn
  RetrieveFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the retrieve Lambda function
    Value: !Ref RetrieveFunction
  RetrieveFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the retrieve Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt RetrieveFunction.Arn
  RestApiId:
    Description: ID of the REST API
    Value: !Ref RestApi
  ApiBaseUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the test stage
    Value: !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Stage}
  CreateLinkEndpoint:

    Value: !If
      - UseCustomAppUrl

      - !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/test

      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: incidentId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SES sender identity (verification completed out-of-band)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SenderEmailIdentity:
    Type: AWS::SES::EmailIdentity
    Properties:
      EmailIdentity: !Ref SenderEmail

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared Lambda execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AppName}-lambda-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ConfigurationTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ServicesTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt OnCallSchedulesTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt IncidentsTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: SESSendEmail
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/${SenderEmail}'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    ses:FromAddress: !Ref SenderEmail
        - PolicyName: SSMParameterRead
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AppName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AppName}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  StartExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AppName}-start-execution'
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - states:StartExecution
            Resource: !Ref IncidentStateMachine

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda functions (placeholder code; real code deployed separately)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IncidentProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AppName}-incident-processor'
      Description: Handles incoming HTTP API requests for incidents.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          APP_NAME: !Ref AppName
          SSM_PREFIX: !Sub '/${AppName}'
          CONFIGURATION_TABLE: !Ref ConfigurationTable
          SERVICES_TABLE: !Ref ServicesTable
          ONCALL_SCHEDULES_TABLE: !Ref OnCallSchedulesTable
          INCIDENTS_TABLE: !Ref IncidentsTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"message": "Incident processor placeholder"}),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  NotifierFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AppName}-notifier'
      Description: Sends on-call and escalation notifications through SES.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          APP_NAME: !Ref AppName
          SSM_PREFIX: !Sub '/${AppName}'
          SENDER_EMAIL: !Ref SenderEmail
          CONFIGURATION_TABLE: !Ref ConfigurationTable
          SERVICES_TABLE: !Ref ServicesTable
          ONCALL_SCHEDULES_TABLE: !Ref OnCallSchedulesTable
          INCIDENTS_TABLE: !Ref IncidentsTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              print(json.dumps(event))
              return {"status": "notification placeholder"}
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  IncidentProcessorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${IncidentProcessorFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  NotifierLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${NotifierFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions escalation workflow
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AppName}-incident-workflow'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AppName}-state-machine-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeNotifier
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${NotifierFunction.Arn}:*'
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # Log delivery APIs do not support resource-level permissions
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  IncidentStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AppName}-incident-workflow'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ERROR
        IncludeExecutionData: false
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        NotifierFunctionArn: !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn
        LambdaInvokeArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::lambda:invoke'
      Definition:
        Comment: Notify the on-call responder immediately and escalate after five minutes.
        StartAt: NotifyAndEscalate
        States:
          NotifyAndEscalate:
            Type: Parallel
            End: true
            Branches:
              - StartAt: NotifyOnCall
                States:
                  NotifyOnCall:
                    Type: Task
                    Resource: '${LambdaInvokeArn}'
                    Parameters:
                      FunctionName: '${NotifierFunctionArn}'
                      Payload:
                        notificationType: PRIMARY
                        incident.$: '$'
                    OutputPath: '$.Payload'
                    Retry:
                      - ErrorEquals:
                          - Lambda.ServiceException
                          - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                          - Lambda.SdkClientException
                          - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                        IntervalSeconds: 2
                        MaxAttempts: 3
                        BackoffRate: 2
                    End: true
              - StartAt: WaitBeforeEscalation
                States:
                  WaitBeforeEscalation:
                    Type: Wait
                    Seconds: 300
                    Next: SendEscalation
                  SendEscalation:
                    Type: Task
                    Resource: '${LambdaInvokeArn}'
                    Parameters:
                      FunctionName: '${NotifierFunctionArn}'
                      Payload:
                        notificationType: ESCALATION
                        incident.$: '$'
                    OutputPath: '$.Payload'
                    Retry:
                      - ErrorEquals:
                          - Lambda.ServiceException
                          - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                          - Lambda.SdkClientException
                          - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                        IntervalSeconds: 2
                        MaxAttempts: 3
                        BackoffRate: 2
                    End: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # HTTP API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${AppName}-http-api'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  HttpApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AppName}-api'
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      Description: HTTP API for the on-call incident alerting service.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  ProcessorIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt IncidentProcessorFunction.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'
      TimeoutInMillis: 29000

  GetIncidentRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: 'GET /incidents/{incidentId}'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ProcessorIntegration}'

  PutIncidentRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: 'PUT /incidents/{incidentId}'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ProcessorIntegration}'

  DefaultStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      StageName: '$default'
      AutoDeploy: true
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 50
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol","responseLength":"$context.responseLength","integrationError":"$context.integrationErrorMessage"}'
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  ProcessorApiPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref IncidentProcessorFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${HttpApi}/*/*/incidents/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameter Store discovery values
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SenderEmailParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/sender-email'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref SenderEmail
      Description: Sender email address used for incident notifications.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  StateMachineArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/state-machine-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref IncidentStateMachine
      Description: ARN of the incident escalation state machine.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  ApiEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/api-endpoint'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt HttpApi.ApiEndpoint
      Description: Invoke URL of the incident HTTP API.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

Outputs:

    Value: !GetAtt HttpApi.ApiEndpoint

    Description: ID of the HTTP API.
    Value: !Ref HttpApi
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the incident escalation state machine.
    Value: !Ref IncidentStateMachine
  IncidentProcessorFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the incident processor Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt IncidentProcessorFunction.Arn
  NotifierFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the notifier Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn
  LambdaExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
  ConfigurationTableName:
    Description: Name of the configuration table.
    Value: !Ref ConfigurationTable
  ServicesTableName:
    Description: Name of the services table.
    Value: !Ref ServicesTable

    Description: Name of the on-call schedules table.

    Description: SSM parameter holding the state machine ARN.
    Value: !Ref StateMachineArnParameter

    Description: SSM parameter holding the API endpoint.
    Value: !Ref ApiEndpointParameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions the SimpleTodoAPI AWS AppSync GraphQL API backed by an Amazon DynamoDB
  table and AppSync JavaScript (APPSYNC_JS) resolvers, secured with an API key for
  testing. NOTE - API_KEY auth is intended for testing only and the key value is
  exposed in stack Outputs. For production, switch to AMAZON_COGNITO_USER_POOLS or
  AWS_IAM and remove the key output.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: createdAt
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: byOwner
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: createdAt
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: SimpleTodoAPI

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role assumed by AppSync to read and write the TodoTable.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TodoTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TodoTableItemAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt TodoTable.Arn
              - Sid: TodoTableOwnerIndexQuery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !Sub '${TodoTable.Arn}/index/byOwner'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: SimpleTodoAPI

  AppSyncLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role assumed by AppSync to push API logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/appsync/apis/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: SimpleTodoAPI

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AppSync API, key and schema
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SimpleTodoApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SimpleTodoAPI
      # API_KEY auth is for testing only. Use AMAZON_COGNITO_USER_POOLS or AWS_IAM in production.
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      XrayEnabled: true
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLogsRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ERROR
        ExcludeVerboseContent: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: SimpleTodoAPI

  SimpleTodoApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoApi.ApiId
      Description: API key for testing SimpleTodoAPI (not for production use).

  TodoSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
          completed: Boolean!
          createdAt: AWSDateTime!
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
        }

        type TodoConnection {
          items: [Todo!]!
          nextToken: String
        }

        input CreateTodoInput {
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
          completed: Boolean
        }

        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
          completed: Boolean
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection!
          todosByOwner(owner: String!, limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection!
        }

        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Data source
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TodoTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoTableDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB data source for the TodoTable.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # JavaScript unit resolvers
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: TodoSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoTableDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const input = ctx.args.input;
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const item = {
            ...input,
            completed: input.completed === undefined || input.completed === null ? false : input.completed,
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now,
          };
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: util.autoId() }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(item),
            condition: { expression: 'attribute_not_exists(id)' },
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result;
        }

  UpdateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: TodoSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: updateTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoTableDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const { id, ...fields } = ctx.args.input;
          const expressionNames = { '#updatedAt': 'updatedAt' };
          const values = { ':updatedAt': util.time.nowISO8601() };
          const setClauses = ['#updatedAt = :updatedAt'];

          for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(fields)) {
            if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
              expressionNames[`#${name}`] = name;
              values[`:${name}`] = value;
              setClauses.push(`#${name} = :${name}`);
            }
          }

          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id }),
            update: {
              expression: `SET ${setClauses.join(', ')}`,
              expressionNames,
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(values),
            },
            condition: { expression: 'attribute_exists(id)' },
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result;
        }

  DeleteTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: TodoSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoTableDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'DeleteItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.args.id }),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result;
        }

  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: TodoSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoTableDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'GetItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.args.id }),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result;
        }

  ListTodosResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: TodoSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodos
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoTableDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const { limit = 20, nextToken } = ctx.args;
          const req = { operation: 'Scan', limit };
          if (nextToken) {
            req.nextToken = nextToken;
          }
          return req;
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return { items: ctx.result.items, nextToken: ctx.result.nextToken };
        }

  TodosByOwnerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: TodoSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: todosByOwner
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoTableDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const { owner, limit = 20, nextToken } = ctx.args;
          const req = {
            operation: 'Query',
            index: 'byOwner',
            query: {
              expression: '#owner = :owner',
              expressionNames: { '#owner': 'owner' },
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ':owner': owner }),
            },
            scanIndexForward: false,
            limit,
          };
          if (nextToken) {
            req.nextToken = nextToken;
          }
          return req;
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return { items: ctx.result.items, nextToken: ctx.result.nextToken };
        }
