AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Operational Best Practices for Amazon CloudWatch conformance pack, including the AWS Config configuration recorder, delivery channel, and delivery bucket required in a greenfield account.

Parameters:
  CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: 'TRUE'
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarms must have at least one alarm action (TRUE/FALSE). Leave blank to omit.
  CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: 'TRUE'
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarms must have at least one insufficient-data action (TRUE/FALSE). Leave blank to omit.
  CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: 'FALSE'
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarms must have at least one OK action (TRUE/FALSE). Leave blank to omit.
  CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName:
    Type: String
    Default: CPUUtilization
    Description: Metric name that must have an associated CloudWatch alarm. Leave blank to omit.
  CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType:
    Type: String
    Default: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Description: Resource type that must have an alarm for the specified metric. Leave blank to omit.
  CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName:
    Type: String
    Default: CPUUtilization
    Description: Metric name whose CloudWatch alarm settings are evaluated. Leave blank to omit.

Conditions:
  HasCloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired: !Not [!Equals ['', !Ref CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired]]
  HasCloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired: !Not [!Equals ['', !Ref CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired]]
  HasCloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired: !Not [!Equals ['', !Ref CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired]]
  HasCloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName: !Not [!Equals ['', !Ref CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName]]
  HasCloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType: !Not [!Equals ['', !Ref CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType]]
  HasCloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName: !Not [!Equals ['', !Ref CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName]]

Resources:
  ConfigDeliveryKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for encrypting AWS Config delivery channel snapshots and history.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowConfigServiceUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ConfigDeliveryKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/aws-config-delivery
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ConfigDeliveryKey

  ConfigDeliveryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 365
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7

  ConfigDeliveryBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ConfigDeliveryBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketPermissionsCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketExistenceCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/Config/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ConfigRecorderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWS_ConfigRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConfigDeliveryBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/Config/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryKey.Arn

  ConfigRecorder:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder
    Properties:
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ConfigRecorderRole.Arn
      RecordingGroup:
        AllSupported: true
        IncludeGlobalResourceTypes: true

  ConfigDeliveryChannel:
    Type: AWS::Config::DeliveryChannel
    DependsOn: ConfigDeliveryBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      S3BucketName: !Ref ConfigDeliveryBucket
      S3KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryKey.Arn
      ConfigSnapshotDeliveryProperties:
        DeliveryFrequency: TwentyFour_Hours

  CloudWatchConformancePack:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConformancePack
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigRecorder
      - ConfigDeliveryChannel
    Properties:
      ConformancePackName: Operational-Best-Practices-for-Amazon-CloudWatch
      ConformancePackInputParameters:
        - !If
          - HasCloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired
          - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired
            ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasCloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired
          - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired
            ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasCloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired
          - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired
            ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasCloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName
          - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName
            ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasCloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType
          - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType
            ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasCloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName
          - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName
            ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      TemplateBody: |
        Parameters:
          CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired:
            Type: String
            Default: 'TRUE'
          CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired:
            Type: String
            Default: 'TRUE'
          CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired:
            Type: String
            Default: 'FALSE'
          CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName:
            Type: String
            Default: CPUUtilization
          CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType:
            Type: String
            Default: AWS::EC2::Instance
          CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName:
            Type: String
            Default: CPUUtilization
        Conditions:
          CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired:
            Fn::Not:
              - Fn::Equals:
                  - ''
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired
          CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired:
            Fn::Not:
              - Fn::Equals:
                  - ''
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired
          CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired:
            Fn::Not:
              - Fn::Equals:
                  - ''
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired
          CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName:
            Fn::Not:
              - Fn::Equals:
                  - ''
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName
          CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType:
            Fn::Not:
              - Fn::Equals:
                  - ''
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType
          CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName:
            Fn::Not:
              - Fn::Equals:
                  - ''
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName
        Resources:
          CloudwatchAlarmActionCheck:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-action-check
              Description: Checks whether CloudWatch alarms have the required alarm, insufficient-data, and OK actions configured.
              Scope:
                ComplianceResourceTypes:
                  - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_CHECK
              InputParameters:
                alarmActionRequired:
                  Fn::If:
                    - CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired
                    - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired
                    - Ref: AWS::NoValue
                insufficientDataActionRequired:
                  Fn::If:
                    - CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired
                    - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired
                    - Ref: AWS::NoValue
                okActionRequired:
                  Fn::If:
                    - CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired
                    - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired
                    - Ref: AWS::NoValue
          CloudwatchAlarmActionEnabledCheck:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-action-enabled-check
              Description: Checks whether CloudWatch alarm actions are enabled.
              Scope:
                ComplianceResourceTypes:
                  - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_ENABLED_CHECK
          CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheck:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-resource-check
              Description: Checks whether a CloudWatch alarm exists for the specified metric and resource type.
              Scope:
                ComplianceResourceTypes:
                  - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_RESOURCE_CHECK
              InputParameters:
                metricName:
                  Fn::If:
                    - CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName
                    - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName
                    - Ref: AWS::NoValue
                resourceType:
                  Fn::If:
                    - CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType
                    - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType
                    - Ref: AWS::NoValue
          CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheck:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-settings-check
              Description: Checks whether CloudWatch alarms for the specified metric have the expected settings.
              Scope:
                ComplianceResourceTypes:
                  - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_SETTINGS_CHECK
              InputParameters:
                metricName:
                  Fn::If:
                    - CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName
                    - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName
                    - Ref: AWS::NoValue
          CloudwatchLogGroupEncrypted:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-log-group-encrypted
              Description: Checks whether CloudWatch Logs log groups are encrypted with an AWS KMS key.
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP_ENCRYPTED

  socless_ prefix required by the SOCless naming convention, so only one copy

      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Encryption-at-rest foundation for the restaurant assistant application. Creates a
  customer managed KMS key with automatic rotation and alias, four KMS-encrypted
  on-demand DynamoDB tables with point-in-time recovery, a KMS-encrypted image bucket,
  and a dedicated access-log bucket.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: restaurant-assistant
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,30}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      3-32 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, and must start and
      end with a letter or digit.
    Description: Project name used as a prefix for all resource names, tags and the KMS alias.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used in all resource names, tags and the KMS alias.

Conditions:
  IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Environment, prod]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed encryption-at-rest key for ${ProjectName} (${Environment})'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-key-policy'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              - 'kms:CreateGrant'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUseForImageBucket
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-key'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  EncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-sessions'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: !If [IsProd, true, false]
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: sessionId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: dataType
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: sessionId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: dataType
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-sessions'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MarketPricesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-market-prices'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: !If [IsProd, true, false]
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ingredient
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: marketName
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: lastUpdated
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ingredient
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: marketName
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: IngredientLastUpdatedIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: ingredient
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: lastUpdated
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-market-prices'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RemindersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reminders'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: !If [IsProd, true, false]
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: userId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: reminderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: userId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: reminderId
          KeyType: RANGE
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reminders'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rate-limits'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: !If [IsProd, true, false]
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: identifier
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: identifier
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expiresAt
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rate-limits'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 - access logs
  # S3 server access log delivery does not support SSE-KMS destination buckets,
  # so this bucket uses SSE-S3 (AES256).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccessLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-access-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireAccessLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-access-logs'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/image-bucket/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !GetAtt ImageBucket.Arn
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 - images
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-images-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: image-bucket/
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: CleanupNoncurrentAndIncomplete
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-images'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ImageBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ImageBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ImageBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ImageBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: DenyNonKmsEncryptionHeader
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${ImageBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEqualsIfExists:
                's3:x-amz-server-side-encryption': 'aws:kms'
          - Sid: DenyWrongKmsKey
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${ImageBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEqualsIfExists:
                's3:x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id': !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn

Outputs:
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: ID of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !Ref EncryptionKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyId'
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyArn'
  KmsKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias name of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !Ref EncryptionKeyAlias
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyAliasName'
  SessionsTableName:
    Description: Name of the sessions table.
    Value: !Ref SessionsTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SessionsTableName'
  SessionsTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the sessions table.
    Value: !GetAtt SessionsTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SessionsTableArn'
  MarketPricesTableName:
    Description: Name of the market prices table.
    Value: !Ref MarketPricesTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MarketPricesTableName'
  MarketPricesTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the market prices table.
    Value: !GetAtt MarketPricesTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MarketPricesTableArn'
  RemindersTableName:
    Description: Name of the reminders table.
    Value: !Ref RemindersTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RemindersTableName'
  RemindersTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the reminders table.
    Value: !GetAtt RemindersTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RemindersTableArn'
  RateLimitsTableName:
    Description: Name of the rate limits table.
    Value: !Ref RateLimitsTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RateLimitsTableName'
  RateLimitsTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the rate limits table.
    Value: !GetAtt RateLimitsTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RateLimitsTableArn'
  ImageBucketName:
    Description: Name of the image bucket.
    Value: !Ref ImageBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ImageBucketName'
  ImageBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the image bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBucket.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ImageBucketArn'
  AccessLogBucketName:
    Description: Name of the access-log bucket.
    Value: !Ref AccessLogBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AccessLogBucketName'
  AccessLogBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the access-log bucket.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AgentCore stateful-agent shared identity and state layer. Provisions a Cognito
  user pool with hosted domain, resource server, machine-to-machine and web
  clients, a seeded test user, a DynamoDB finance state table, IAM execution
  roles for the MCP server and agent runtimes, and SSM parameters for runtime
  discovery. AgentCore runtimes are deployed separately and consume these values.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: agentcore-finance-demo
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with a lowercase letter and contain 3-31 lowercase letters,
      digits or hyphens.
    Description: Project name used for resource naming, the Cognito domain prefix, the SSM path root and tags.

  TestUserEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: testuser@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address.
    Description: Email address (and username) of the seeded Cognito test user. Replace the placeholder before real use.

  WebClientCallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: http://localhost:8501/
    AllowedPattern: '^https?://.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an http or https URL.
    Description: Callback and logout URL for the interactive web client.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption key for secrets and table data
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SharedKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for ${ProjectName} secrets and DynamoDB state'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SharedKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-shared'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SharedKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Test user password (generated, never a plain-text parameter)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TestUserPasswordSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/test-user-credentials'
      Description: !Sub 'Generated credentials for the ${ProjectName} Cognito test user'
      KmsKeyId: !Ref SharedKmsKey
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: !Sub '{"username":"${TestUserEmail}"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 24
        RequireEachIncludedType: true
        ExcludeCharacters: '"''\/@`% '
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito identity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 3
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      DeletionProtection: INACTIVE
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Sub '${ProjectName}-api'
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName} agent API'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: mcp.invoke
          ScopeDescription: Invoke tools exposed by the MCP server runtime
        - ScopeName: finance.read
          ScopeDescription: Read finance tracking state
        - ScopeName: finance.write
          ScopeDescription: Write finance tracking state

  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-m2m-client'
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-api/mcp.invoke'
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-api/finance.read'
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-api/finance.write'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web-client'
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-api/mcp.invoke'
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-api/finance.read'
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-api/finance.write'
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref WebClientCallbackUrl
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref WebClientCallbackUrl
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  M2MClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/m2m-client-credentials'
      Description: !Sub 'Client credentials for the ${ProjectName} machine-to-machine Cognito client'
      KmsKeyId: !Ref SharedKmsKey
      SecretString: !Sub
        - '{"client_id":"${M2MClient}","client_secret":"${ClientSecret}","token_endpoint":"https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token","scope":"${ProjectName}-api/mcp.invoke ${ProjectName}-api/finance.read ${ProjectName}-api/finance.write"}'
        - ClientSecret: !GetAtt M2MClient.ClientSecret
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Seeded test user (custom resource sets a permanent password)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TestUserSeederLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-test-user-seeder'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  TestUserSeederRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-test-user-seeder-role'
      Description: Execution role for the Cognito test user seeding custom resource
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TestUserSeeder
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt TestUserSeederLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: ManageTestUser
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminDeleteUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Sid: ReadTestUserPassword
                Effect: Allow
                Action: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref TestUserPasswordSecret
              - Sid: DecryptTestUserPassword
                Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt SharedKmsKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 'secretsmanager.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  TestUserSeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: TestUserSeederLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-test-user-seeder'
      Description: Creates the Cognito test user with a permanent password from Secrets Manager
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt TestUserSeederRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          secrets = boto3.client("secretsmanager")


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              pool_id = props["UserPoolId"]
              username = props["Username"]
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId", f"{pool_id}|{username}")
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      try:
                          cognito.admin_delete_user(UserPoolId=pool_id, Username=username)
                      except (cognito.exceptions.UserNotFoundException,
                              cognito.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException):
                          pass
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return

                  physical_id = f"{pool_id}|{username}"
                  secret = secrets.get_secret_value(SecretId=props["SecretArn"])
                  password = json.loads(secret["SecretString"])["password"]
                  try:
                      cognito.admin_create_user(
                          UserPoolId=pool_id,
                          Username=username,
                          MessageAction="SUPPRESS",
                          UserAttributes=[
                              {"Name": "email", "Value": username},
                              {"Name": "email_verified", "Value": "true"},
                          ],
                      )
                  except cognito.exceptions.UsernameExistsException:
                      pass
                  cognito.admin_set_user_password(
                      UserPoolId=pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      Password=password,
                      Permanent=True,
                  )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                                   {"Username": username}, physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  print(f"Test user seeding failed: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id)
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  TestUser:
    Type: Custom::TestUser
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt TestUserSeederFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Username: !Ref TestUserEmail
      SecretArn: !Ref TestUserPasswordSecret

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Agent state
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FinanceStateTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-finance-state'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: pk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: pk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expiresAt
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref SharedKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AgentCore runtime execution roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  McpServerRuntimeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-runtime-role'
      Description: Execution role for the AgentCore MCP server runtime
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AgentCoreRuntimeTrust
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AgentCoreRuntimeBaseline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrImageAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/${ProjectName}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/bedrock-agentcore-*'
              - Sid: EcrTokenAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LogGroupAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*'
              - Sid: LogGroupDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
              - Sid: LogStreamWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
              - Sid: WorkloadAccessTokens
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetWorkloadAccessToken
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetWorkloadAccessTokenForJWT
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetWorkloadAccessTokenForUserId
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workload-identity-directory/default'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workload-identity-directory/default/workload-identity/*'
              - Sid: ReadProjectParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ProjectName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ProjectName}/*'
        - PolicyName: FinanceStateAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: FinanceStateReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource: !GetAtt FinanceStateTable.Arn
              - Sid: FinanceStateEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt SharedKmsKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  AgentRuntimeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agent-runtime-role'
      Description: Execution role for the AgentCore stateful agent runtime
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AgentCoreRuntimeTrust
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AgentCoreRuntimeBaseline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrImageAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/${ProjectName}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/bedrock-agentcore-*'
              - Sid: EcrTokenAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LogGroupAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*'
              - Sid: LogGroupDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
              - Sid: LogStreamWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
              - Sid: WorkloadAccessTokens
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetWorkloadAccessToken
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetWorkloadAccessTokenForJWT
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetWorkloadAccessTokenForUserId
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workload-identity-directory/default'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workload-identity-directory/default/workload-identity/*'
              - Sid: ReadProjectParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ProjectName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ProjectName}/*'
        - PolicyName: AgentModelAndMcpAccess

            Version: '2012-10-17'

                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*'
              - Sid: ReadM2MClientCredentials
                Effect: Allow
                Action: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref M2MClientSecret
              - Sid: DecryptM2MClientCredentials
                Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt SharedKmsKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 'secretsmanager.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Ref ResourceServer

        Project: !Ref ProjectName

      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Ref FinanceStateTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Highly available two-tier VPC network with public and private subnets across two Availability Zones, an internet gateway, and one NAT gateway per AZ. Public subnets do not auto-assign public IPs; public addresses must be assigned explicitly per resource.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(\d|[1-2]\d|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16).

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(\d|[1-2]\d|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (e.g. 10.0.1.0/24).

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(\d|[1-2]\d|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (e.g. 10.0.2.0/24).

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(\d|[1-2]\d|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (e.g. 10.0.101.0/24).

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(\d|[1-2]\d|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (e.g. 10.0.102.0/24).

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  DefaultPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  DefaultPrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

Outputs:
  VPC:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPCID'

  PublicSubnet1:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2'

  PublicSubnets:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of the public subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnets'

  PrivateSubnets:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of the private subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnets'
